string.value: You must be the new traveler. I'll be giving you important information so listen up. First, if you want to talk to anyone, #bclick#k the person with your mouse.
The #bleft and right arrows#k allow you to move. Press #bAlt#k to jump. Jump diagonally by pressing both together.
Man, it's scorching hot today! The sun is burning my beautiful skin! Can you get me a #bmirror#k from #r#p2100##k, please? I have to check my skin!

If you want to check your progress in a quest, open the #bQuest Window#k by pressing the #bQ key#k, then press #bQuest Helper#k. You'll be able to view the progress of quests registered to the Quest Helper.
Thank you. #r#p2100##k is on the hill to the east, hanging laundry. The mirror looks like this #i4031003#.
Don't want to? Fine, come back when you change your mind.
Haven't met with #r#p2100##k yet? She should be down a hill to the east. It shouldn't be hard to find her.
How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me #p2101# asked you for this...
Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.
Oh? Why aren't you accepting the mirror? Do you no longer wish to see #p2101#?
Oh wow! You brought #p2100#'s mirror! Thank you so, so much. Let's see...no skin damage whatsoever... Whew! That's a relief.
If you go right, you will see a shiny aura. We call that a Portal. If you press #bup-arrow#k, you will teleport to the next area. So long!
It looks like you haven't delivered the mirror to #b#p2101##k yet. Please hurry!
Did you lose the mirror? Ask my sister for it again then.
How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me #p2101# asked you for this...
Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.
That's my little brother, #r#p2001##k. Will you please ask him what he wants for dinner?
Oh, a traveler! Nice, right on time... I have a favor to ask. Head towards your right and you'll find a boy.
Oh, I guess you're very busy. Still, it's not too difficult of a job, so please help if you can.
You didn't talk to #p2001# yet? Please, open your eyes!
Please tell my sister I really, really want #bmushroom soup#k for dinner!
Ahh, soooo hungry. Where's my sister?! I was gonna ask her to make me mushroom soup. Soooo hungry!
What...? Aren't you gonna deliver it?
He wants mushroom soup? I guess that's our dinner then. Thanks for helping me out.
I'm getting anxious. I need to get this letter to #p12000# fast. It's urgent! But I have things to do here so I can't leave this spot...
Can you take this #bletter#k to #r#p12000##k in #b#m1010000##k? It'll only take a minute…
You will? Thank goodness. Now I can breathe a sigh of relief. Here's the letter. Take it to the town chief of #b#m1010000##k.
Head northeast to get to #b#m1010000##k. #p12000# is the chief of #m1010000#. He's probably taking a walk in front of the general store.
Ahhhh, this is not good. If I don't get this to the town chief... Please reconsider!
You haven't met #r#p12000##k in #m1010000# yet? Please bring him my letter. It's urgent.
#r#p2103#'s#k should have arrived by now. What happened...?
You lost my letter! Be more careful! Good thing I made a copy. This time, be more careful!
Ohhh, the letter from #p2103#! I was beginning to worry. Okay, here's the #breply letter#k. Head back to #p2103# and deliver it. Thanks.
Oh... Are you really busy? Sigh. This letter needs to be delivered right away...
Oh, the reply letter! Thank you! I want to give you something to show my appreciation.
Ta da! A hat! It has a level limitation, but I think you're strong enough to wear it. Thanks again for all your help!

To equip items, press the #bI key#k to open the Item Inventory, and then click on #bEquip#k. You can also switch between the different windows by pressing the #bTab#k button. To equip an item, simply #bdouble-click#k on the desired item. To check whether an item has been equipped, press the #bE#k key.
You didn't deliver my reply to #r#p2103##k yet? If you lose my reply, just tell me. I suppose I can write up another one.
Have you not gone to the Chief yet? Or did you lose the letter? Please deliver the letter soon and bring back Chief #b#p12000##'s reply.
You lost my reply letter? Bah, such carelessness! I have a town to run, you know. But fine, I'll rewrite the letter. Here, take it, and don't lose it this time.
I'll give you something nice if you get me #b#e10#n #t4000001#s#k and #b#e30#n #t4000000#s#k! Eliminate monsters to get those items, but looking at you, I don't know if you're up to the challenge...
Oh, you sound so confident! Let's put your money where your mouth is. Make sure to bring back #b1 #t4000001# and #b5 #t4000000#s. I'll be waiting!
You'll regret not taking a chance on such a good item!
Oh wow! You really managed to gather all the stuff I asked for! Here's an item like I promised.
Wow, I didn't really think you would be able to gather it all. Okay, I'll give you the item as promised. I don't need it anyhow... Here you go! #l
You don't have #e10#n #b#t4000001#s#k and #e30#n#k #b#t4000000#s#k, right? Don't worry about it. I'll be here for a while.
My goodness. I've been wandering around town, and I see so many recyclable items just being thrown away! Say, can you help me collect those? \n Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your effort.
That's right! Collect all the 'trash' around town.

I don't know if you've seen any abandoned wooden boxes on your way here, but your job is to break those boxes apart into #t4031162#s and #t4031161#s. Collect 1 of each for me, okay? 

#i4031161# #b1#k #t4031161#s
#i4031162# #b1#k #t4031162#s
Come on! Think about the planet!
What? You brought them all? Okay, let's see ...
See what I'm talking about? So many recyclable items, just carelessly tossed away. Hopefully there are more people like you in the world.
No, no, no! Press 'Q' to look at the Quest Info to check what you need to do!

Hello! How're you liking Maple World so far? Let me give you a brief rundown of the place, and then I'll give you a quiz. If you answer my questions correctly, I'll give you something handy. Interested?
Hehe! Let me warn you, don't underestimate my quiz. There's a lot to learn, so pay attention!

You've hunted monsters already. Remember what keys you had to use? #bCtrl to attack#k and #bAlt to jump#k, right? And #bZ to pick up the items#k? #nYou can also use the #rKey Config#k on the bottom right of your screen to recalibrate the buttons to your liking.

But what you haven't experienced yet is Job Advancement. To become a more powerful traveler, you need a job! To get one, you'll first have to leave this place, Maple Island, and head to Victoria Island. You need to be at least at level #b10#k to become a Warrior, Bowman, or Thief, and at least level #b8#k to be a Magician. Each job has its pros and cons, so choose carefully.
I didn't tell you EVERYTHING you need to know for the quiz, so make sure to focus. Ready for the questions?
Hmm, you could learn a lot through my quiz. I think you should try it!

What do you press to open the item inventory? 

#L0##b I#l
#L1# K#l
#L2# S#l
#L3# E#k#l
That's right! To open up the item inventory, you press #rI#k.
K is for the Skill Window. You'll be able to use skills once you get yourself a job. Don't you remember the shortcut key for the, ahem, i-tem inventory?
No, no. S is to check out your stats and your Ability Points. Come on, think!
Eh? E is to check out your equipment. Try again.
Alright, talk to me when you're ready for the next question.

Can you wear an item just by double-clicking it with your mouse? 

#L0##bOh yes#l
#L1#No way.#k#l
Yup, you can wear an item just by double-clicking it from your inventory. If you can't wear something, check that your character meets the level and statistic requirements.
Try it! Press E, then take off an item by double-clicking it. Then, double-click the item from the item inventory (in case you forgot, press I) to put it back on.
My questions aren't that hard because I let you keep trying until you get them right. Nice of me, huh? Tell me when you're ready for the 3rd question.

What do you press to open up your equipment inventory? 

#L0##b E#l
#L1# S#l
#L2# I#k#l
That's right! To check out what you have equipped, just press E.
S is to check out the skill book and your skill points. Please remember that.
I is to check out your item inventory.
Alright! You're on question number 4, out of 7 questions total. Talk to me when you're ready.

What do you press to pick up an item on the ground?

#L0##b X#l
#L1# S#l
#L2# I#l
#L3# Z#k#l
That's correct. #bZ#k is used to pick up items dropped by monsters. You can also use #b0 on the number pad#k. As for X, you use that to sit on a chair, which lets you recover much faster.

If you see a chair or a bench, you can sit on it. Unfortunately, you won't find any chairs in Maple Island. You'll have to head over to Victoria Island to do that. When you find one, press X, and you'll recover much faster!
You can raise your ability stats using the AP you earn each time you level up. To check your AP, simply press S.
I is used to check your item inventory. It is one of the most useful functions in the game.
You're inching closer and closer towards making your job advancement. I'm wondering which job you're going to pick. Now, talk to me when you're ready for the 5th question.

In order to make the job advancement as a Warrior, Bowman, or Thief, you have to be at least level 10. What level do you have to be to make the job advancement as a Magician? 

#L0##bLevel 10#l#l
#L1#Level 8#k#l

Ding! To become a Magician, you only need to be at level 8. You'll need to head to Victoria Island, to a magician town called Ellinia, and look for Grendel the Really Old, the chief magician that'll lead you down the Magician's path.
Hm, I think you can make the job advancement as a Magician earlier than that.
Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.

Every time you level up, you can raise your character's ability stats. How many ability points (AP) are you awarded after every level up? 

#L0##b2 points#l
#L1#10 points #l
#L2#5 points #k#l
That's right. Every time you level up, you're awarded #r5 AP#k, which can be used to raise your character's abilities. Press #bS#k after every level up and make sure to assign those points well.
Come on, you get more than 2 measly points! You should check your AP after leveling up by pressing S.
Nope, not 10 points. Press S to check.
Alright, last question! Talk to me when you're ready.

This is important! You can only make the job advancement at Victoria Island, but you're currently on Maple Island. Where do you go to get a ride to Victoria Island? 

#L0##bSouthperry#l
#L1#Amherst#l
#L2#No way I can get there#k#l
That's absolutely correct. Head over to Southperry and get on the #rship#k that heads to Victoria Island.

Once you get there, the first thing you want to do is make the job advancement. You should make sure you're the right level to advance. Head to Perion to become a Warrior, Henesys to become a Bowman, Kerning City to be a Thief, Ellinia to be a Magician, and Nautilus to be a Pirate. #bPress W for the world map if you get lost#k. Alright, happy Mapling!
You won't find any ports at Amherst. Head over to the only place in Maple Island with a port to catch a ride to Victoria Island.
You won't be able to come back once you leave this place, but trust me, you CAN leave...
Hmm, you look like you're in serious need of my guidance. Is it your first time here? What you need more than anything right now is FOCUS. So...want me to train you?
It's simple actually. All you need to do right now is to hunt monsters. I'll assign you a few tasks, and you'll be surprised to see how much you grow.

Head out of town, and you'll run into lots of monsters. The weakest is the Snail, a tiny green snail, and it's a piece of cake. Next are the Blue Snails and the Shrooms. Listen, feast on the weaker monsters until you can handle bigger, stronger, and faster monsters. It's all about hunting the right monsters. 

#r10#k #o100100#s
#r10#k #o100101#s
#r10#k #o120100#s#k

Oh, and press W to see the World Map and locate Southperry. Go there and meet #p20002#. He may have something for you. You can accept #p20002#'s quest while training with me, so I suggest you meet him pronto.

Oh, by the way, if you press the W key, you can check the location of #m60000#. From #b#m60000##k you can find #b#p20002##k. He's looking for the things that you can collect by completing my training, so be sure to speak with him.
Hmm... So, you don't want to receive training? It's good that you have so much confidence. But if you change your mind, come talk to me again.
Have you been training by preying on the weak? Let me see...
I don't think you understood what I told you. You haven't defeated enough monsters. You know you can check on your quest progress by pressing Q, right?

Wow, you're fast! That's awesome. We'll head straight to the next quest. It's important to know your limits, but it's also important to test your abilities. Want to try defeating some powerful monsters?

This time, you'll be hunting #o1210102#, which you WON'T find just casually wandering around. You'll have to go into every portal to find them. I want you to defeat #r10#k! Oh, and Biggs is collecting something about dropped by the #o1210102#s. I suggest you help him out while training. \n\n#o1210102# #r#a10171# #k
Also, I've heard that Biggs is collecting something from the #o1210102#s... If you haven't filled Biggs's request yet, you might want to try doing so while you train.
If it seems too difficult for you, come back after training against easier monsters.
So you've taken care of the Orange Mushrooms? Weren't they hard to find? Let's see how strong you have become...
Great job! You're now strong enough to hold your own against any monster here. You'll have to start making job decisions once you reach level 8. Well then, until we meet again...
I don't think you're quite done yet. Press Q to check the quest.

A new traveler, eh? Want to learn how to hunt? The Jr. Sentinels you see here are normally too powerful for you to handle, but Grendel the Really Old, the head of all magicians, sealed up their power. So take one down, pick up what it drops, and go see #b#p2002##k, who should be up around here somewhere.

Look at your minimap (#bM#k), located at the top left corner of the screen. You should see something green blinking on the northeast side of the map. That's #b#p2002##k. You'll run into a Jr. Sentinel on your way to meet #b#p2002##k. Defeat it, pick up 1 #t4000142#, then talk to #p2002#.
Oh, you know how to hunt already? Well, you can still test your abilities!
Are you the one #p2004# is training? He mentioned you... Let's see if you've trained correctly.

Someday, long after you leave this place, you'll be powerful enough to take on real Jr. Sentinels. Oh, and when you level up, press #bS#k to check your #bAbility Points.#k\n\nTo move on to the next map, either press the #bup arrow#k in front of the portal to the right or just talk to me again.
What? Haven't you gone to #b#p2002##k yet? You need to defeat #1 Sentinel#k and take #b1 #t4000142##k with you!
Huh? You're not carrying a #b#t4000142##k. After you've defeated a Jr. Sentinel, it'll drop a #t4000142#. Then press #rZ#k to pick up the item.
Hmm, you should have seen a small Jr. Sentinel at the bottom of the map. Press #rCtrl#k to attack it. Pick up the item it drops once you defeat it, and then come talk to me.
Hello, I'm Sam. You look like someone who should go talk to #p12100#. What do you think?
#p12100# is one of the very best fighters in MapleStory. To prepare yourself properly, I suggest you take down #r10#k #o100100#s before seeing her.
After defeating #r10#k #o100100#s, go see #b#p12100##k, who should be standing on a fork in the road out to the east.
Trust me. You'll want to prepare yourself before meeting Mai...
Are you the one that #p2005# mentioned? Do you need me for something...?
Well, defeating #r10#k #b#o100100#s#k is a piece of cake! Haha!
I will allow you to proceed onto the next training after you increase your abilities.
Have you not gone to #b#p12100##k yet? She is the pretty gal at #b#m50000##k. Don't forget to eliminate the #r#o100100#s#k before you see her!
I'm sure #p2005# told you to defeat #r10#k #b#o100100#s#k. Press #rQ#k to check your quest progress.
I got the recycling materials you got me, and I some leftovers that I don't need. Would you like me to make something nice with it for you?
Ahh, the green cloth should be here somewhere... Hmm, and I should cut this wood, and put the screws on, and... Please come back in a little bit. I'll get this done by then!
Eh? You don't doubt my skills, do you?
Perfect timing! How did you know that I'm done? Very impressive!
Doesn't it look comfy? This chair is very handy. When you're low on HP and MP, just take the chair out and rest!

It'll let you relax and you'll be able to recover more quickly. Because of that, I've named the chair...The Relaxer! Great name, right? Don't forget that The Relaxer was made by yours truly, the great Pio!
Eat the #r#t2010007##k I gave you by opening your Item Inventory and clicking the #bUse tab#k. Double-click the #t2010007# to recover some HP.
Hmm, seems you just started an adventure. Good for you. My daughter, on the other hand, is still young and not brave enough to travel around...\r\n#b#L0#You have a daughter?#l

I sure do. She is the cutest and nicest creature in the entire world. She went to #b#m60000##k to look at the sea and hasn't come back yet. I'm sure she's afraid of the monsters on the path home. Could you help her?

Then please eliminate #r7 #o0130101#s#k. There are tons of #o0130101#s from #m1010000# to #m60000#. They're what's keeping #p20100# from returning home, you know. When you get rid of them, let #b#p20100##k know it's safe to come home. Thank you.
Hmm, I see...

Did you need something? Huh? You were asked to eliminate #o0130101#s for me? That wasn't the reason I didn't go home... Anyhow, thank you nonetheless. Sorry for making you go through all that trouble.
Someday, I'll leave this place and see beyond Maple Island.
Hmmm... Haven't you met #b#p20100##k yet? Try to find the most beautiful girl in #b#m60000##k.
If you want to leave Maple Island, speak with that handsome captain.
Argh! I've had it up to here! I can't stand it! Someone is spreading rumors that I look like a #o1210100#! What an insult! I need your help!

Clear out all the #o1210100#s around #m60000#! If all the #o1210100#s disappear, so will the rumor. What? There are too many #o1210100#s? Oh, come on. Fine, just kill #r2 #o1210100#s#k. You can handle that, can't you?
You don't want to help me? Are you saying I look like a #o1210100#?!
Yes! You killed two #o1210100#s! Wonderful! Thank you so, so much! That rumor should go away now.
You saved my life. If I ever find out who spread that rumor, he's a dead man.
You still have #rtwo#o1210100#s#k to defeat. You can do it if you're willing to. Please try! My reputation is at stake!
Yoo hoo! I'm a love counselor! I'm helping a young man be the best boyfriend he can be. Want to do me a favor?
It's #b#p20001##k of #b#m60000##k who needs help. He says that he wants to make a great, big boat so he can take his girlfriend on a romantic trip. Find #b3 #t4000003#es#k and give them to #p20001#.

Ah, you can get #t4000003#es by defeating #r#o0130100#s#k. They look like walking tree stumps. Good luck! And if you're ever interested in love, be sure to visit the town of Amoria! Just speak with Thomas Swift in Henesys to travel there!
Oh, oh, oh! You don't know what love is!
Hmm? Anything I can help you with? Huh? #p2005# asked you to come? Actually, I didn't ask #p2005# for help... But, uh, thanks anyway.

You're probably thinking it'll take forever to make a boat out of #t4000003#es, but I'm determined to make my boat and go on a trip with #p20100#. That's my dream. #p20100# always gazes longingly at boats and wants to go out on the sea.
Oh, oh, oh! You haven't found #b#p20001##k yet. He is in #b#m60000##k.
What's the matter? Are you lost in #m60000#? Or are you looking for medicine for being sea sick?
Hi? You're an adventurer, aren't you? Hmm... May I ask you for a favor?
Ah! Thank you. It's not that hard. You only have to find healthy ingredients for juice. The ingredients are one #b1#t4000004##k and 5 #b#t4000011#s#k.It shouldn't be hard to find them.
You can get #t4000004#s from #o0210100#s and #t4000011#s from #o0120100#s. Slimes are green jumping monsters. They're fast and strong, so be careful!
Hmm... Since you just started your adventure, I guess you're quite busy. When you are free, come back to me.
Wow! You have all ingredients to make some nutritious juice. Fantastic! Now, it will only take a second to make the juice!
Would you please wait until I make the juice?

Hmm... I think you haven't gathered the ingredients yet. You need #bone#t4000004##k and #bfive#t4000011#s#k. If you want to know how many ingredients you have gathered, please check your inventory or quest window.
I'm sorry to ask you for help again but I'm lucky to meet a kind adventurer like you. Can you do me a favor?
Ah! Thank you! I'm so glad to have a nice person like you in Maple World. Can you give this complete #b#t04031556##k to #b#p22000##k. He is a captain in #b#m60000##k. You can't miss him. Thank you.
Well. I've already asked two things. I've been annoying, haven't I?
Huh? What the matter? Ah. This is #p2103#'s special nutritious juice. Did #p2103# send you here? Thank you very much! It's a great pleasure to have a nice partner.
Now, you are ready to take an adventure. Would you like to go to a new world? Once on board, I can show you #bVictoria Island#k. Once you leave, you can't come back though. What do you say?
You haven't found #b#p22000##k yet. He's a captain in #b#m60000##k.
What's the matter? I'm willing to take you, if you're ready to leave Maple Island and start your adventure elsewhere!
What? You lost the nutritious juice! I'll give you more as I made some for you as well. But don't lose it.

Maple Island is a land for beginning adventurers. Monsters are relatively weak here, but you need some experience to become a skilled adventurer. When you are a beginner, you have to try your best to train hard. \r\n#b#L0# You look very strong. Why are you on Maple Island?#l

Because I'm a trainer. Mr. #p12000# hired me. I quit adventuring in Victoria Island to protect the people in this town instead. Besides that, beginners always need a bit of guidance. But I've got far too much work these days...If you have a chance to go to #m1010000#, can you give a message to Mr. #p12000#?

Ah, thank you. There are a lot of travelers in Maple Island and even more monsters. It's hard for me to protect people by myself. So please tell #b#p12000##k of #b#m1010000##k to hire one more person. Thank you.
Hmm... Aren't you planning to go to #m1010000#? You can go to #m60000# directly.

Hmm... Who are you? Did #p12100# send you here? Why? 
#b#L0# #p12100# asked you for a raise. #l
#L1#Because there are many beginners in Maple Island, it's hard for #p12100# to work by herself. #l
#L2# #p12100# said she wanted to compete with #p12000#. #l

Hmm... Did #p12100# say that? Would you tell #b#p1002101##k in #b#m104000000##k what she said? You won't be here much longer so you can deliver the message when you get to #bVictoria Island#k. Thank you.
Thank you. Ah, don't worry about the fare. You have to go to #b#m60000##k to go to Victoria Island. #m60000# knows who #b#p22000##k is. I'll tell him to take you for free.
Mai asked for a raise? I don't believe it. Are you lying?
Compete...? Did Mai say that? I know there's no strong men in Maple Island, but it's nonsense to ask this old man like me to compete.
Haven't you met #b#p12000##k yet? I'll take a walk in front of the store of #b#m1010000##k. Go ahead.
Welcome to #m104000000#. Is this your first time in Victoria Island? Huh? You came here to deliver the message from #p12000#?
Ah. So, #p12100# can't protect Maple Island by herself, huh? Ok. Then I'll hire one more person. I can do that for my friend's sake. Thank you.
AP means #bABILITY POINT#k. Now, press #bS#k. You will see all the stats you have. AP is on the left bottom side. If you haven't invested AP yet, your AP is still 5. Where can you use AP?

AP is used to improve your stats. When you invest AP into #bSTR, your power will be enhanced; if into INT, intelligence; if into DEX, agility; if LUK, luck#k. You can increase HP or MP if you want. AP is worthy as it can be used many different ways. Every class has one primary stat and one secondary stat. For Warriors, it's STR and DEX; for Magicians, it's INT and LUK; if you're a Bowman then you'll need DEX and STR, while Thieves use LUK and DEX.
Did you get how to use AP? When you make use of AP, you can become a strong Warrior. But, as you are still a beginner, I'll give you one more piece of advice about changing jobs and AP investment.

Yoo hoo! Hello? Let me see... You just leveled two. Then you've got #bAP#k. Have you decided where to invest your AP? You still don't know what AP is? Well, well... I kindly enough will explain it to you.
If you want to hear about changing your job and AP investment, please come back. Yoo hoo.
Hmm. You're not interested in this story. Well, that's fine. Have a good adventure.
Yoo hoo. You came again. You are a real adventurer not to miss any information! Shall we talk about changing a job?
If you want to be a stronger adventurer, you have to advance your job. You can advance your job in Victoria Island, not in Maple Island. You can choose one among #bWarrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief#k.

#bWarriors should have at least 35 STR and above, Magicians will need 20 INT and above, Bowman must have 25 DEX and above, and Thief also need 25 DEX and above#k Under this condition, you are qualified to have a job.
You can't advance your job when you're short of either level and/or stat. Although you're a beginner, you have to consider investing AP if you want to have a job. Never ever forget!

But there's some condition to change your job. #bWarriors, Bowmen, and Thieves should be at least level 10#k. #bMagicians should be at least level 8#k. Other than level, you need to be ready to have a job. What does that mean? Where you placed your AP will help determine what path you take, that's why it's very important.
I hope the explanation on AP and changing job helps you a lot!
Oh, you look lost. Well...Beginners not familiar with Maple World often are lost. Probably you don't know how to read the world map. Do you want to know?
Haha. It's very easy. Press W. You will see Maple Island and where you are. If you click the right mouse button, you can see the whole Maple World. Isn't it easy?

It gets much easier to go around when you make use of world map. For sure, there are many areas that you can't see in the world map. Keep that in mind please. Now, do you have an idea where to go? Have a nice trip.
Hello! You must be new! Your name is #h0#? You might feel a little weird stepping into Maple World, but don't worry about a thing! Maple World welcomes you with open arms.
To start a conversation with people in this world, just #bclick#k on them. You can talk to any person that displays a blinking mouse icon when you place your mouse cursor over them.
#bAnyone with a light bulb above their head has a quest for you#k. These people need your help, so don't hesitate to click on them!
I just remembered that #bSera#k has been looking for a traveler to talk to. Do you want to say hello to Sera?

You've just accepted a quest! Now, check the #bMinimap#k on the left side of the screen. Press #bM#k to open/close it. It displays various colors to indicate different people, and the blinking green figures signify residents of this world.

If you look at the Minimap right now, you'll see two green spots. The left one is me, Heena, and the right one is Sera. All you need to do is move to the #bright#k, and you'll see Sera hanging her laundry.
Don't be shy! We're all eager to see you.
Oh, hello there! You must be a new traveler! Did you just talk to Heena?
Maple Island may be small, but it's also the perfect place for me to meet new travelers. There's nothing quite like making new friends. #h0#, hopefully you will make lots of new friends here too.

To continue, use the #bportal#k located to the right. See that spot on the ground that's glowing? That's the portal. Step in it and press the #bUp#k arrow key. I'll now bid you adieu. May your journey be blessed!
You haven't gone to see #bSera#k yet, have you? Just head #beast#k a bit and you'll see her.

Oh, hello traveler! Good thing you're here, I need your help! Head to the right a bit, and you'll see a #bhouse with a yellow roof#k. That's my house, and my baby brother #bSen#k is the only one inside right now.
Sen did a great job taking care of the house by himself. He deserves a reward, but I don't know what to give him. Maybe something delicious... Can you ask him what he'd like to eat?
Thanks. To enter the house, press the #bUp arrow#k on your keyboard in front of the house, just like when you use a portal.
Oh, you must be busy. Wouldn't it be fun to get to know some others, though?
You haven't talk to #bSen#k, yet? Head right and you'll see a #bhouse with a yellow roof#k. He should be inside.

Who-who are you? Oh. My sister asked you to find out what I want to eat? Mmmm... Oh yeah, that #bmushroom candy#k she made for me the other day! Can you please tell her I'd like some delicious Mushroom Candy? Thank you!
You know where my sister is, right? I mean, you just talked to her...
Awww... You aren't going to tell her?
You haven't talked to #bNina#k yet? Awww... I want some Mushroom Candy...
So what did Sen want? What? Mushroom Candy? Haha... He was getting cavities so I told him not to eat any more candy. Well, he was good today, so I'll let him have some.
Here are 10 Mushroom Candies. Please give them to #bSen#k for me. Thanks in advance.
Eh...? You don't want to do it? I mean, you've helped me this far already...
Wow! She did make me Mushroom Candy! Yeah! Those are so sweet, and I really like them, you know! Thanks!
Oh yeah, you should try some too. My sister always told me it's always better to share.
You didn't go see #bSen#k yet? He must be eagerly waiting for the candy. Please go see him soon.
Hmmm? You haven't gone to see #bNina#k yet? I really want that Mushroom Candy... Yum!
What? You lost the Mushroom Candy? Oh no... Where did you drop them? Sigh...oh well... I'll give you another one this time, so please don't lose them, okay?

Oh, hello! My name is Todd, and I teach new travelers like you #bhow to hunt monsters#k. You won't find any real monsters around here, but if you venture out into the world, you'll find a ton. It can be quite dangerous if you're not prepared...
Let's discuss #bbasic attacks#k. You can perform them by pressing the #bCtrl key#k. Approach a monster, but not so close that you touch it, then attack with confidence! Got it?
You see the #rJr. Sentinel#k there? Attack it! Normally, they're very powerful, but Grendel the Really Old, the head of all magicians, put a seal on it so beginners like you can practice.

Once you successfully hunt a Jr. Sentinel, you can pick up the item it drops! In this case, that's a Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece. To pick it up, press #bZ#k while standing on top of it. Try picking up a #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k and giving it to #bPeter#k.
Are you afraid of fighting? Don't worry. Practice makes perfect, and you'll be good at this in no time.
Ah, you have a Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece. I see that Todd has taught you the basics of hunting. Now, I shall teach you how to #buse skills#k.

Press #bK#k to open the Skill Inventory and see your skills. Unlike regular attacks, skills can only be used after you raise a skill's level using Skill Points. You earn Skill Points by leveling up, but be careful when assigning those points to different skills.
The level of a skill affects how well it works. You have to calculate which skills will maximize your hunting abilities and invest in them first.

Assign skills to the #bQuick Slot#k at the bottom right of the screen. Just drag icons from the Skill Inventory to the Quick Slots and you're set! Right now, regular attacks might be the most effective, but later on, skills become devastatingly powerful.

That's about it for skills. As a gift, I just gave you an item you can wear on your head. Go to the Equip tab in your Item Inventory and #bdouble-click on the item#k to equip it. To #bcheck that you've equipped it,#k press #bE#k. Happy traveling!
Eh? You haven't gone to see #bPeter#k yet? Just hunt a #rJr. Sentinel#k, pick up a #bJr. Sentinel's Shellpiece#k, and give it to him.

Todd taught you how to hunt, but you haven't really put that into practice. Either that or you forgot to pick up the dropped item. Press #bCtrl#k to attack a #rJr. Sentinel#k, and then pick up #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k by pressing Z.

Todd taught you how to hunt, but you haven't really put that into practice. Either that or you forgot to pick up the dropped item. Press #bCtrl#k to attack a #rJr. Sentinel#k, and then pick up #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k by pressing Z.

A new traveler! You should have some #bAP#k by now. Did you #bdistribute it#k? No? Then, allow me to teach you a thing or two. I'll give you a #bquiz#k at the end to make sure you understand stats, AP, and job advancement. Oh, I do so love any excuse for a quiz!

Click on me again and ask me all your questions! Once you're confident you have all the answers, click on the #bRobin the Walking Encyclopedia#k quest to start the quiz! Hehehe, quizzes make me sooo happy!
Aha! You think you already know everything, eh? If so, then I dare you to take my quiz. Do it! Make my day!

Ready for the quiz? Yippee! First question! When you level up, you get #bAbility Points, or AP for short#k. You use AP to raise your #bSTR, INT, DEX, and LUK#k stats. As a #rBeginner#k, is it possible to raise your #bHP and MP#k with AP? \r\n#b#L0# Yes, it's possible starting at level 11. #l\r\n#L1# No, it's not possible ever. #l

You've got the answer! Next question! Although you start as a beginner, you can eventually make a job advancement after you have reached a certain level. #bYou can normally make a job advancement when you have reached Level 10#k, but #bwith this particular job, you can make a job advancement at Level 8.#k. What is this job? 
#L0##b Warrior #l
#L1# Magician #l
#L2# Bowman #l
#L3# Thief#l
#k

Ding, ding, ding! Yes! Only Magicians can undergo job advancement at Level 8. Laaaaaast question! Here's a list of jobs and the locations where you undergo job advancement. #bWhich of these do not match?#k
#b#L0# Warrior - Perion #l
#L1# Magician - Ellinia #l 
#b#L2# Bowman - Henesys 
#b#L3# Thief - Nautilus

Yesssss! #bThieves must go to Kerning City!#k Only #bPirates go to the Nautilus for their job advancement#k! Bravo! Now you'll have no trouble picking a job when the time comes. Thank you for humoring me. This quiz totally made my day!
Plan ahead and think about what job you'd like. When you make your job advancement, your AP will be redistributed to fit your new job. So you don't need to worry about your AP just yet.
Please reconsider.
That is incorrect. You can make a job advancement at Level 10 for most of the jobs. Only Magicians can make job advancements at Level 8. Please try again from the beginning.
That is incorrect. You can make a job advancement at Level 10 for most of the jobs. Only Magicians can make job advancements at Level 8. Please try again from the beginning.
That is incorrect. You can make a job advancement at Level 10 for most of the jobs. Please try again from the beginning.
WRONG!! Only Magicians can make their job advancement at Level 8, because users that have raised INT to become a Magician have a rougher time leveling up at first. RESTART!

Noooo!! Hehe, I love saying that. Warriors go to Perion, Magicians go to Ellinis, Bowmen go to Henesys...and Thieves go to Kerning City. I gave you the answer, so now...start over from the BEGINNING. Muahaha!

Noooo!! Hehe, I love saying that. Warriors go to Perion, Magicians go to Ellinis, Bowmen go to Henesys...and Thieves go to Kerning City. I gave you the answer, so now...start over from the BEGINNING. Muahaha!

Noooo!! Hehe, I love saying that. Warriors go to Perion, Magicians go to Ellinis, Bowmen go to Henesys...and Thieves go to Kerning City. I gave you the answer, so now...start over from the BEGINNING. Muahaha!
I wonder where Maria is... Oh, hello traveler! Are you, by any chance, heading east? If so, can you do me a favor?
Lucas, who lives in Amherst, asked me to get rid of the snails to protect his neighbors. I have a hunch it's because of their fear of #rSnails#k.
Could you please hunt #r10 Snails#k, so the village is safe from them? Afterwards, please notify #bLucas#k and let him know it's safe.
You can reach Amherst by traveling east. Also, you can check the World Map by pressing the #bW key#k.
Hmmm... But think of other people in fear!
You're new here, aren't you? What can I do for you?
Oh, did you eliminate some Snails? Well, that is just so nice of you! Now we can all pick mushrooms in peace.

I think you deserve something nice for helping us out! Don't try to be modest...It's my turn to help you. You've got that look that says you want to be strong, am I right? Well, I can #bintroduce you to a trainer#k that will pump you right up! That's right, so come talk to me when you're ready.
Hmmm... Defeat #r10 Snails#k, then keep heading right until you see Lucas.
Hmmm? Are you here on Sam's behalf? Then please hunt #r10 Snails#k first then talk to me.
Oh, hey there! You must be new and... What? Sam asked you to clear out some snails for me?
How thoughtful of both of you! You know, delicious mushrooms grow outside town. With the Snails gone, I can now safely walk over and meet up with Sam to pick some.
I feel so much better. The thought of those icky Snails, with their slimy bodies and beady eyes and...ugh. I'm grateful you got rid of them, but, er, can you do me another favor?

If I get too caught up in picking mushrooms and don't return to town until late, Lucas, the chief of this town, gets worried. Please give this letter to #bLucas#k in #bAmherst#k. What? Where's Amherst?
Are you serious? Hehe! How adorable. You're IN Amherst, silly! If you're ever unsure of your location, you can press #bW#k to open the #bWorld Map#k and see where you are.
I understand... I wish you a pleasant journey anyway.
Eh. You look new. How can I help you? Eh? Maria wrote me a letter?

Ahh, you helped her? Maria's not afraid of much, but she's got Snail-phobia. Now, she can concentrate on picking mushrooms. She makes the most am-a-zing mushroom stew... That's why I worry so much. Without her...no stew!
Seriously, I appreciate what you did. To prove it, I want to introduce you to #bsomeone that can help you get stronger.#k Fast. Let me know when you've got some time.
You didn't see #bLucas#k, yet? He really cares about my safety. You can find Lucas in Amherst. Just look to your #bright#k a bit...
You're new, eh? I'm the chief of Amherst. Hmmm... I wonder how Maria is. She went to collect mushrooms with Sam, but she's deathly afraid of Snails...
Oh no, you lost the letter! I can write another one, so don't you fret.
Ahhhh! What can I do?! Someone help me! Hey, aren't you a new traveler? Can you...hunt #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k by any chance?

I heard Maria was going to pick some mushrooms, so I headed out of town to find her, only to be surrounded by monsters! Please! Take care of #r10 Blue Snails#k and #r10 Spores#k for me! Pretty please!
Nooooo! What can I do, then? How else can I get home safely?
Wow! You cleared out the Blue Snails and Spores! That's amazing! Thank you! Now I can safely walk home.
If you're looking for Amherst, head west. If you're looking for Southperry, it's southeast of here.
I don't think you have defeated all the #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k yet. Please hunt #r10 of each#k for me!
I knew you'd be back. Ready for training?
Then head east. You'll find #bMai#k at the #bEast Field of Amherst#k. She is more than qualified to train you. Once you're done with all her lessons, return to Amherst. I'll be waiting for you.
If you aren't ready yet, then I'll wait. Let me know when you're ready.
Ohhh, you've completed all of Mai's Training! You look much stronger than when I first met you. A bit more training and you'll be ready to head over to Victoria Island. Do you need directions?

There's actually only one way to get to Victoria Island from here. Take the #bsoutheast route at the split road#k to get to #bSouthperry#k where you'll find #bShanks#k running a ship that's heading to Victoria Island. He usually charges 150 mesos per ride, but he'll let a great traveler like you go for free.
Here's a #brecommendation letter#k I wrote for you. Take it to Shanks and he'll definitely let you get on the ride for free. I hope your journey is filled with greatness!
I don't think you have completed all of Mai's Training yet. I understand that Mai's Trainings are tough, but I suggest you gut it out. She knows what she's doing.
Hey! Lucas sent you, right? I'm Mai. I used to fight in Victoria Island, but I hang around here these days, recharging and training. Don't worry, I can make time to help you.
Shall we start? I'll start your training off easy. Ready?

Here. Take this #bRazor#k. It's a type of dagger. It should be slightly more powerful than what you currently have. To hunt well, you need good weapons, so take this one as a gift. Don't forget to #bequip#k it!

Now, go hunt #r5 Stumps#k and bring back #b3 Tree Branches#k. Stumps have a lot of HP, but they're so slow that you shouldn't have too much trouble. Enter the portal to my right to find them. Good luck!
It's dangerous to start training if you aren't mentally prepared. Let me know when you're ready.
You haven't defeated #r5 Stumps#k and brought back #b3 Tree Branches#k yet. Some Stumps drop branches. Others don't. Just be patient and keep hunting.
You haven't defeated #r5 Stumps#k and brought back #b3 Tree Branches#k yet. Some Stumps drop branches. Others don't. Just be patient and keep hunting.
Whoa, that was fast! You've got a talent for hunting... Impressive! Okay, moving on. This time, hunt #r5 Red Snails#k.
Red Snails have more HP than Snails and Blue Snails. They are also faster than Stumps, so don't underestimate them.
Five Red Snails too much for you? I'm telling you, enduring hardships like will help you progress!
You haven't hunted #r5 Red Snails#k yet. If it's too hard, just take your time!

I see that you have eliminated the Red Snails. Hope you didn't get too roughed up. Your next mission involves an even more powerful monster. This time, you'll be slaying #r3 Slimes#k. Bring me back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k, too! That's all.
Slimes are worlds faster than Stumps and Snails. They also jump around, so you really need to be careful. I suggest you use the skill #bThree Snails#k to attack from a distance. Good luck!
If you're worried about safety, take some time to calm down and prepare yourself.
It doesn't look like you've defeated #r3 Slimes#k and brought back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k. I suggest you use some 'Use' items while hunting. They'll definitely help.
It doesn't look like you've defeated #r3 Slimes#k and brought back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k. I suggest you use some 'Use' items while hunting. They'll definitely help.
Whoa, you really obtained a Squishy Liquid from a Slime. You're doing much better than I expected! I think... Yes. Yes, I think you're ready to take on a really challenging monster.

This time, you need to hunt #r3 Pigs#k. They are fast and very powerful, but thankfully they aren't the Ribbon Pigs found on Victoria Island. These are just regular Pigs. If you focus, you should be able to handle two of them.
Did I scare you? Don't worry. If you are persistent, you'll be able to handle the next assignment. I wouldn't make you hunt monsters you couldn't handle, you know. Hehe.
You did it! You hunted 3 Pigs! That's incredible. Seriously, you're doing amazingly well. You may be just a Beginner, but I have a feeling that you'll one day become a legendary hero in Maple World.
Your training is now complete. You may still have some weaknesses, but you'll be able to overcome them in no time. Keep training!
Oh, and I have one last #btask#k. If you want to push further, then talk to #bBari#k, who has a test for you.
You haven't slain #r3 Pigs#k yet. Please take care of two, and then let me know of the results.

You must be #h0#. I've been waiting for you. Mai told me to give you an ultimate test to gauge your hunting skills. Since you can reach Southperry after passing me and get a ride to Victoria Island that way, she wanted me to test you one last time before you leave.
Of course, this test is not mandatory. If you feel that you're ready head to Victoria Island right now, by all means, please go. But if not... Well, do you want to take the test?

Your test is to hunt an #rOrange Mushroom#k, the most powerful monster on Maple Island. To pass this test, you must defeat #r1 Orange Mushroom#k and bring back #b1 Orange Mushroom Cap#k as evidence. Head straight up to find Orange Mushrooms. Good luck.
If you're that confident, I can't MAKE you do it. I'll let Mai know you declined.
What? You really did slay an Orange Mushroom and bring back 1 Orange Mushroom Cap! That's...why, that's just amazing! There's a reason why Mai has been saying all those good things about you!
You have now passed every test Mai has to offer. Once you meet the requirements for the job advancement, you'll be ready to take on Victoria Island.

If you want to learn more about Victoria Island before you actually head there, go to #bSouthperry#k and look for #bBiggs#k. He has acquired extensive knowledge on Victoria Island and should be a great help to you.
I don't think you've defeated #r1 Orange Mushroom#k and brought back #b1 Orange Mushroom Cap#k yet. Climb up the ropes nearby to find Orange Mushrooms.
I don't think you've defeated #r1 Orange Mushroom#k and brought back #b1 Orange Mushroom Cap#k yet. Climb up the ropes nearby to find Orange Mushrooms.

You must be new. You've made your way to Southperry, so I suppose you're ready to head to Victoria Island, right? Making a journey to an unknown place requires preparation. Would you like some information on #bVictoria Island#k?
Victoria Island is a #bhumongous#k island! That place, along with the continent of Ossyria, takes up the majority of Maple World. I heard Victoria Island used to be one with Ossyria...

Anyway, Victoria Island has #bfour major towns#k along with #bone port#k in the southwest, a harbor where #bThe Nautilus#k is docked in the southeast, and the small town of Sleepywood in the center. #bA job instructor#k can be found in #beach major town and in The Nautilus#k. These instructors are who you need to visit to make a job advancement.
Maple Island can't possibly compare to Victoria Island in size. I hear that Orange Mushrooms, the strongest monsters on Maple Island, are nothing compared to the grisly beasts on Victoria Island!

Beginners that set foot in Victoria Island should be very careful. But no worries. The first place you'll land at Victoria Island, #bLith Harbor#k, has someone that specializes in helping out Beginners like you.
Look for #bOlaf#k at #bLith Harbor#k. He'll help you get acclimated to Victoria Island. He shouldn't be hard to find. Good luck on your journey!
Hmmm... If you don't need information, then oh well...
You must be new... I can smell it! Muahaha! Have you just arrived from Maple Island? If so, then I, the great Olaf, shall help you.
This world may be full of dangerous monsters, but people oughta stick together and help each other out, am I right or am I right? Especially a youngling like you, who's the future of the Maple World.
Ah, lessee. I can help you out with your first job advancement. I'm friends with all the chiefs on this island, so I know a ton about every occupation. I'll help you find the perfect job!

You haven't made your way to Victoria Island yet. It's a good idea to quietly train here until you're ready to make a job advancement. Once you are, then head to Victoria Island and find #bOlaf#k at #bLith Harbor#k.

Been a while, #h0#. Or has it? You've gotten pretty strong in such a short time! But you can't stay a Beginner forever. How about it? Want to try being a muscle-bound Warrior?
If you wish to become a more powerful Warrior, come see me. I'll be waiting at the #b#m102000003##k in #b#m102000000##k.
Sure, you can stay a Beginner if you really want to. But you're just making things harder for yourself.
You're shaping up into quite the strong Warrior. I think you're ready for the #bWarrior 2nd Job Advancement#k. So, how about it? Want to learn more?
With your 2nd Job Advancement, you'll learn a new way of fighting. There are many ways of the Warrior, and each way is distinct, so be sure to choose one that suits your fighting style!
Until now, you've just been fighting for yourself. With your 2nd Job Advancement, you must take your newfound strength and fight for justice, for your friends, and for Maple World.

It's real important, but I guess you'll wanna know the whole story. It all started back when #m120000100# was anchored at Victoria Island. #p1090000#, the #m120000100#'s captain, came down the dock and asked me to keep an eye out for an old piece of wood that gave off some real creepy ju-ju.

I wasn't really sure she was talkin' sense, but I'm a fisherman and a fisherman don't turn down any request that might put a little more food on their table. So I told her I'd do it. That was a long while back. I'd almost forgotten about the whole thing...

But a few days ago, I was out on deck, having my morning staredown with the sun. I started pullin' up one of my drift nets and there's this piece of wood just sittin' on top of a fish! Let me tell ya, I have never seen a sadder fish. That little piece of wood was givin' it the heebie-jeebies! I think this might be what #p1090000# was lookin' for...
You think you could take the Wooden Relic over to her? Go over to #m120000100# and just give it to #p1092007#. They probably won't let you see Captain #p1090000# in person.
Look, don't get me wrong, I'd love to take a little trip right now, but this just ain't the right time. The sea bass are runnin' pretty good right now and I don't wanna miss a good haul.
Nobody gets in to see #p1090000# without going through me first. You sayin' #p1002001# sent you? Show me what he told you to bring us first.
This thing is giving off some seriously bad sensations.
What're you still doin' here? You oughtta take that Wooden Relic over to #p1092007# in #m120000100#.
What do you want? If you came to see #p1090000#, you're gonna have to give me a pretty good excuse. If you don't have anything to show, I'll ask you to take your business elsewhere.
There's something really weird about this thing. It just doesn't feel right! Hey, there's something carved under all this sea moss! I think we oughtta clean it off before I take it to #p1090000#.
I don't want to damage the relic, so we'd better do this carefully. Let's step into this room and try to get this cleaned off. Sound good?
I was hoping you'd have an opinion, since you brought this thing all the way over here.
What in the world is this thing?! We took off a couple of strands of moss and WHAM, monsters! I feel more bad energy pouring off this thing now than when you first showed up!
There's still a little moss left on this Wooden Relic. Let's get back in there and try again. If you want to start over, you're gonna have to give up the quest and talk to me again.
I think this thing might have some connection to the Black Mage, but I just can't be sure. Take it in to #p1090000# and see if she can figure it out.
#p1090000# knows more about the Black Mage than anybody. She might know exactly where that relic came from.
Do you need something? I gotta clean this place up. Go see #p1090000# and leave me to my work.
This had better be urgent. You've got some piece of wood or something you're excited about?
Th-this is Guwaru's symbol! He's...he's one of the Black Mage's commanders!
What are you waiting for? #p1090000#'s just in the other room!
Are you lost? This is the #m120000100#. Did you know that?

I'm not surprised you haven't heard of the Seven Commanders. It's not exactly elementary knowledge. The Seven Commanders are the leaders of the Black Mage's armies. They proved themselves to be the most evil and vile of all of his minions, so he blessed them with a title and charged them with spreading his evil over the world.

This symbol belongs to Guwaru, the strangest and most wild of all of the Seven Commanders. The fact that this thing was just floating around gives me a really bad feeling. We're going to have to bulk up our defenses and prepare for the worst!
We'll take care of planning for #m120000100#. I need you to go to #m100000000# and tell #p1012100#. We're going to need her help if we're going to survive this attack.
Get a move on! The whole world is in danger if we don't prepare ourselves!
Welcome to #m100000000#. Are you looking to become a Bowman? Oh, #p1090000# sent you? It must be urgent. Let's see what you have, then.
Th-this is Guwaru's emblem! Where did you find this?!
What are you still doing here?! Go to #m100000000#!
Welcome to #m100000000#. I hope you will forgive me, but I must attend to my students.

If you remember #p1090000#'s story of the Seven Commanders, then you know what danger this could bode. I just don't understand how Guwaru's mark could be present in this day and age. What could it mean?
I pray that our fears are overblown. This may only be a relic from a time long passed, but we cannot afford to ignore it. If the Black Mage is truly nearing his resurrection, we are in grave danger.

I believe it would be best to purify this relic to remove the dark aura that surrounds it. Cover your eyes well when I perform the ritual, the light would burn out your retinas in less than a second. Are you ready?
As I feared, this symbol is a warning from Guwaru. The Black Mage is returning to Maple World!
I received a letter from Empress #p1101000#. She wants to form an Alliance across Maple World to repel the evil Black Mage. I appreciate her sentiments, it could be a great help to our citizens.
But I am concerned for the fate of Maple World's adventurers. This Alliance would certainly place a number of restrictions upon them and I do not think it is our place to do so.

That said, I cannot stand by and watch Maple World fall to chaos. Please return to Empress #p1101000# in #m130000000# and deliver my acceptance of her proposal. I hope that the adventurers across Maple World will back my decision and join in the fight against the Black Mage under their own will.
Welcome back to #m130000000#. I see you have #p1012100#'s letter. I will accept her decision no matter what it may be.

The continental conference will commence! We have nowhere left to hide. We must stand up and fight! I would ask your allegiance in this matter. I understand you are a free-spirited adventurer, but I hope that you understand the dangers we all face. Join us and battle the Black Mage at our sides!
This is a matter of extreme urgency. Please hurry to #m130000000# and deliver my message.
Welcome back to #m130000000#.

Took you long enough to come back and see me, #h0#! I bet you were excited when I wanted to talk to you. Well hear me out, cause I've got some news for you. My Crystal Ball told me that you, of all people, have a big part to play in the coming days of Maple World.
#bYou are going to play a big role in the future of Maple World!#k Not long from now, we're all going to be hoping you aren't just some flash-in-the-pan warrior.
Lucky for us, we've still got a little while before you're actually important. #rSo just leave us all alone and finish up your current duties.#k
A new dawn is coming for Maple World! It's going to be exciting and scary! I just wish you weren't the one we were all pinning our hopes on.

I have a crucial matter to discuss with you, #b#h0##k. You see, I received a letter from Empress #p1101000#. She wants to form a grand Alliance between all the factions and adventurers of Maple World to stand against the evil Black Mage. I know her heart's in the right place...
However, I am concerned for the fate of Maple World's adventurers. This Alliance would certainly place a number of restrictions upon them and I do not think it is our place to do so.

Of course, I cannot stand by and watch Maple World fall to the forces of chaos. I know you feel the same way, so please return to Empress #p1101000# in #m130000000# and deliver my...no, our acceptance of her proposal. I hope that the forces of Maple World will stand united as I intend to.
Empress #p1101000# holds court in #m130000000#. Go to the Victoria Platform and board the Airship to Ereve.
I'm not trying to force you into anything, but I feel that only by standing together can we protect the future of Maple World. Please consider the situation.
Welcome to #m130000000#. Ah, yes... Tell me of your decision. I will respect #p1012100#'s words, no matter what they may be.\r\n#L0##bI will lend my strength, for the sake of our world.#l\n#k
The continental conference will be held! Unity in the face of such evil is our only hope.

It's time for her to make an important decision. Before she does so, she seeks the counsel of each of her knights. You are to return to #m130000000# immediately.

Welcome, #b#h0##k.\rI have something important to ask of you. The Cygnus Knights have always battled the forces of the Black Mage alone. After all, I believed that we had to stand by our own power.
But now I realize that our power alone is not enough. I am weak, and I see that the world won't always be able to rely on us. We need help.
This won't be easy, but I see no other option. I've already asked the Explorers, Resistance, and awakened Heroes for help, and made a great deal of progress in making them understand the situation.
The time for action has come. I shall hold a continental conference, with the express purpose of forming a Maple Alliance. As a Cygnus Knight, you should prepare well for this event.

A continental conference?! And they want me to come?! That's so cool! I hope you don't feel overwhelmed when you meet all those important and powerful warriors. And don't feel bad if everybody's asking for my autograph, okay? We're going to make so many friends and beat up that stupid Black Mage!

Before she makes her decision, she would like to consult your great wisdom as one who once faced the Black Mage. Please do not disappoint her. Come to Ereve and council us in the hour of need.

Thank you for coming, Mercedes. As Neinheart mentioned, I require your advice. Please, I cannot do this on my own. You have faced the Black Mage, what would you do?\r\n#L0##bWhat are our options?#l\n#k

Nightmares have plagued me as of late. Our Cygnus Knights, strong as they may be, cannot defeat the Black Mage by themselves. No matter how much we prepare, we can not win this fight alone. The Black Wings grow stronger every day and the Black Mage's own commanders threaten our homes. We cannot save ourselves.\r\n#L0##bIt is a difficult position for us all.#l\n#k

But I have hope. On our own, we are strong, but with the might of all of Maple World behind us, I believe we would be unstoppable. If only we could harness that power and work together!\r\n#L0##bIf only...#l\n#k

I want to form an alliance. One that stretches across all of Maple World. Allow our people to protect themselves!\r\n#L0##bIt's not going to be easy. While it may sound like the best route for all, not everyone would agree.#l\n#k

I-I expected you to say that. Does that mean you think we shouldn't do it?\r\n#L0##bAbsolutely not. It means that it's going to be hard, but it's what this world needs! In the past, we watched the world fall to ruin because we couldn't get past our own petty needs. In this time, you can bring about a new era of strength and defeat the Black Mage! I support your decision with every fiber of my being, Empress.#l\n#k
Oh, oh thank you, Mercedes!
The continental conference is starting soon. Today, the Maple Alliance officially forms. Without you, I'd still be debating the whole decision. I hope you'll join me in celebrating this new era.

I am the great and mighty Haktorius, legionnaire supreme of the Maple Alliance. 
I am told you are a warrior of great potential, and that is exactly what I'm looking for!

Will you help us?

Take on the role of an Elite Guardian and protect Maple World from the Black Mage!\nYou will need grace in combat and a will of steel to take on the title, but a simple exam will qualify you for duty. I will send the time and date of your exam at a later... time and date.\n

Emergency Notice
Orbis Tower has been attacked! Please take caution when traveling in the region as the damage may cause the tower to topple at any moment.

#L0##bWhat?! Is anybody hurt?!#l
#k

For those of you who talk to messages like they are people, no, no one is hurt. According to a witness dubbed 'Mr. H', all nearby people were evacuated in time.\r\n#L0##bDid this thing just talk back to me? Wait, a witness? I should head to Orbis tower.#l\n#k
Currently, the 9th through 15 floors of Orbis Tower have been extremely damaged. The sole witness, 'Mr. H', is keeping watch at #e#bOrbis Tower <16th Floor>#k#n.
If I had 5 mesos for every reporter asking me about the tower... Of course I saw it blow up!

If you come back with some samples, I might be able to figure out what's going on. If you don't find anything after about 50 monsters, just come back. Surprised to hear from me? Don't be. Surprise is a weakness. I have heard that you received an Elite Guardian Training Permit from Haktorius. Come to Ereve so that I may give you orders.

You stand before Haktorius, greatest of all trainers! \r\nTell me little warrior, will you fight for the peace of Maple World?\r\n

The Black Mage is back, but he must have a herniated disc or something because he's not really moving around much. Take the #e#bDimensional Mirror#k#n to the #r#eBattle Square#k#n and help us fight off his goons!
Don't ever think that one person won't make the difference. If I went in there, this whole thing would be over in minutes!

I'm glad you're on our side. Now that Mr. World Domination is back, we're going to need all the help we can get. We've got one month to complete this #b#eGrand Battle#k#n. That means we've got until #eTKTKTK#n. It's going to take everything we can muster to win this one.\r\n
You are now my trainee. Keep your ears open and your head down.\r\nNow listen up while I explain the rules.

Your training will end on #bTKTKTK#k. Until then, you're responsible for your own training and battle prep. DO NOT MISS YOUR TRAINING SESSIONS. They take place from #e#b4PM to 10PM on weekdays#k#n and from #e#b1PM to 10PM on weekends and holidays#k#n. Use the #r#eGrand Battle#k#n to increase your skills by sparring against other trainees.\n
Did your weak heart decide to tuck tail and run, or is it just following your weak mind?

The Grand Battle is just like a real fight, only #r#eselect skills aren't permitted#k#n. Trust me, it's for your own good. You should be prepared. Open the Skill Window (K) and see what you're going to be missing. Once training starts, there will be no mercy.\r\nNow, obviously, some recruits are going to have an advantage in the HP department. To make up for that, people on the lower end of the spectrum will have their #e#bHP enhanced#k#n while in the Training Room.\r\n

Your primary goal in Battle Mode, besides irrefutable victory, will be to fill your Gallant Gauge. It will be the only way for you to earn Gallant Emblems and they will be the only way for you to earn the equipment you will need for the fight against the Black Mage. Trust me, you'll want to follow my advice.
Please come to the Battle Square right away.

You probably don't understand what I'm talking about, but we've been watching you, and we want you to work with us. Don't worry about the details for now; you can learn all that later. Here's the important part: Are you interested in using your talent to protect the world?
Excellent. Find #bBastille#k in Edelstein. He'll fill you in. He's the dapper fellow with the puppy. Don't make me regret this!
Don't pretend you don't care about Maple World. Think it over.
Talk to Bastille in Edelstein. Look for a dapper gentleman with a black puppy.

You've passed my test. I must say, it was quite a surprise and a bit of a disappointment. Coco is very expensive to feed. Nevertheless, our organization has gained a new face, if you would be kind enough to accept my offer.

Welcome to the Silent Crusade, my friend. We are a special branch of the Alliance, one meant to protect the people from the impending doom the Black Mage would spread across Maple World. Our current mission is to collect information regarding the Black Mage's return and the strange phenomena that appear across the land. We also handle any Master Monsters that may threaten our cities. In short, we are the secret protectors of the land, when it suits our goals.
Each member of the Silent Crusade bears this ring. Put it to good use. As you progress in our organization, you will have the opportunity to receive better items.
You must pass this test or I cannot let you join. I will allow you to retake it as many times as you'd like, but be aware that it's not going to get any easier.
We'll start you off with something simple, though I get the odd feeling that you are up for much greater challenges. Go see Starling.
Starling will act as your guide for a time. Silent Crusaders must be able to function independently, but she will assist you in getting on your feet. Who knows, you two might go together very well!
Do you regret joining our cause already? I thought you were tougher than this. Come back and see me when you're ready.
I knew you'd make it! I've got a real eye for talent.

Members of the Silent Crusade, I need your attention. Mystic Gates have appeared throughout Maple World. This is almost as awful as the fact that I've been rejected by Maple World Idol seven years in a row.

My name is Doctor Moon. I work with the Silent Crusade, researching Mystic Gates and the monsters within, but nuclear physics is only my day job. My real passion is singing. One day, you'll attend my concerts and scream my name along with the rest of my future fans.

In the meantime, I have to deal with these Mystic Gates. They were created by Arkarium, one of the Black Mage's commanders, to gather Mystic Energy and distort time. He already attempted it once. I've concluded that even he isn't foolish enough to attempt it again.
Which means he has some other foul purpose for these new Mystic Gates. Here's what I know thus far: the Mystic Energy being gathered in Henesys, Pantheon, and Leafre houses powerful boss monsters.

These boss monsters are cloned versions of existing boss monsters. I won't go into the specifics, but because they are clones, they can only exist for 15 minutes. Fifteen minutes is more than enough time to destroy a town...

This is where you come in. The monsters will return soon. Work with others nearby and save the towns. I would help, but I need to practice posing shirtless for when the paparazzi learn about my future fame.

How can anyone besides myself understand the technique behind cloning such powerful monsters? I hope I didn't leave my notes on a bus bench somewhere. Wait, I don't take notes because of my photographic memory. So where did Arkarium learn all of this?

Suddenly, out of nowhere, I heard a cat cry. I ran straight to where the crying occurred. There, I saw a striped cat, crouching down in a tree hole, staring at me.
