That is why we three have made a big decision. One of us will be offered to the monster as a living sacrifice to save our village people. What? Did King Clang ask for a sacrifice? Of course he didn't... but these stories are always like this, aren't they?

Go read some books. A beautiful, young maiden sacrifices herself to save her village. A brave girl that hasn't even blossomed yet. It's in every fairytale! If you read, you'd know how important this role is! Ah... how romantic!

However, we haven't decided who will be the heroine yet. #bRoel#k and #bRael#k say they want take the role. That's why we've decided to do this in a fair manner, and single out the sacrifice ourselves. We need to start quickly so would you mind... Huh? You're also interested?
Ah, very well then. Will you become the judge of this bet? See that no one is cheating and are doing their part in this bet. Then the job is yours!
Would you please leave? We have to start our bet.
... NOO...! Traveler! We've asked you to be fair as a judge, so how could you cheat?! And why did you go through the trouble helping all three and not just one person!
Now we have to change plans... what should we do? The bet is already over!
No! The bet is still on! Please help determine who will be the winning sacrifice!
Hmm. Adventurer, will you please come here? (Whispering)

Of course, this is the kind of challenge for a winner to surpass. Still, I'm too scared! I'd finish soon with the help from a strong and heroic adventurer like you! Will you please help me? Of course, this is between you and me.

We've started a bet on who will become the offering to King Clang. At least we did start... But plans aren't going as we thought it would. Oh my gosh...we need to defeat all those #rClangs#k crawling on the beach.
Ha! I knew you'd help me. Please take out #r50#k #rClangs#k for me. That will definitely show Rael and Roel who should be the sacrifice!
You mean you can't help me? ...NOO...! How can you not? Someone beautiful and graceful like me cannot stand up to an ugly Clang! You must help me!
Oh goody! I knew you'd help me! That was fast! You truly are my hero! You're the bravest adventurer I've ever met.

Huh? You want me to call this bet off? You don't seem to understand a girl's wish. A maiden is the most beautiful when she is in distress. I've dreamed of this role for as long as I can remember. I will never give up... I am already the winner! I know it!
You haven't defeated #r50 Clangs#k yet? I thought it wouldn't be so hard for someone like you to do the job. Try a little harder, please.

Hmm. Are you the adventurer #bRael#k talked about? Thanks for becoming the judge but... I hope you are honest, and that you won't help #bRael#k because you both know each other. I will never give this role up!
Still... this challenge is a burden. How can I defeat Lorang? I've never even given it a thought before. Nobody can succeed, except well... someone adventurous like you. Ohhh... what should I do...?

You actually don't seem to be busy right now. And you don't seem to have helped Rael, meaning that you aren't fond of her. Anyway, this dare is almost impossible for me to complete by myself. It's decided, then! You are going to help defeat the #rLorang#k!
Hahaha! You really are a brave adventurer! I was right. Then I'll leave the #r50 Lorangs#k to you to hunt down!
What? You're refusing? Hmph! But that doesn't mean you can go help Rael. Promise?
Oh good! You've already defeated the #bLorang#k? How wonderful! You really are courageous!

What? You want me to back out of this bet? Why would I do that?! Something like this doesn't come by often here in quiet Florina Beach! I can't back out now. Thanks for helping me, but I will not give this up!
Hmm... You haven't defeated #r50 Lorang#k yet? I might lose because of your laziness! Hurry up.
Hey... you... are you the adventurer who will be judging us? Glad to meet you. Thank you for all this trouble. I'm not confident in winning. What? You... you're asking why I'm not?
Well... I'm supposed to defeat Torties, right? How can a girl like me get even close to them? Of course, an adventurer like you would defeat them blindfolded. I'm just an ordinary girl.
Even so... cowardly and fainthearted I am, but I don't... I don't want to lose this bet. Adventurer... I'm sorry to ask you this, but... would it be possible for you to help me a little bit?
Oh? Ah... you really will help me? Really? I can't believe it! How can I ever thank you enough? Please take out #r50 Torties#k for me. I'll be waiting for you here.
Oh... I thought so. Oh well... I can't keep an adventurer like you busy with an ordinary girl like me.
Have you defeated all 50 Torties? Are you hurt anywhere? If not, then good... how can I ever thank you enough?
What? This bet... Give this bet up? Why are you saying this to me? You've already helped me through it! I will not take your help for granted, and will win this bet.
You haven't defeated #r50 Torties#k yet? I will lose if I'm late...

Oh my... I've lost the bet, and it's all because of you! I've always wanted to be the beautiful maiden that sacrifices herself to save her village. I will never forgive you! How could you disappoint me like this?!
What? No, no. All the endings of this kind of story include a brave and handsome #bwarrior#k that comes to rescue the beautiful maiden in distress and defeats the monster! There still is a way!
Adventurer! It's up to you to complete this story with a happy ending! A warrior throwing himself to save the damsel is always heroic! You must take this role!

I must admit, the story unraveling is somewhat different from what I planned, but this has its own merits to it too. Adventurer... no I mean, warrior! Please defeat #rKing Clang#k, and save the damsel!
No, how could you?! How can you turn down a great role like this! You are no fun at all!
You've come back, warrior! I, #bRiel#k, was worried sick over you and couldn't sleep at all! \r\n#L0# #b(Absorbed in the role already!)#l
Oh, I'm so happy to see you again. Thank you, thank you very much! How can I pay you for your deed? What? You don't need anything?\r\n#L0# #b(... I didn't say a word!)#l
You are brave but also modest. You truly are a real warrior! I will never forget your name!
I will sing a song of a brave young warrior who never hesitated to rescue the beautiful island girl from the dreadful monster! Oh, how could you be so courageous?
You haven't defeated #rKing Clang#k yet? If it's a burden to you... you may back out, warrior. You don't need to throw yourself to save little old me... sniffle...

Hey, you! Yes, you. What do you have in your hand there? I am 100% sure that paper in your hand is only used in the Captain's Room. What's that doing there in your hand?\r\n#b#L0# I picked it up from the trash can in the hallway.#l
From the trash can? Can you show me that? Hmmm... Just as I thought. I'm sorry I suspected you of doing something else. Now that I know you're okay... can I ask you for a favor...?

This letter is written by Kyrin to Athena Pierce in Henesys. The two have a complicated history going on there, and that's why I think Kyrin wrote it, but was never able to actually give it to her. I want you to take this letter, go to #bHenesys#k and give it to #bAthena Pierce#k.
I understand if you don't want to participate in this. It's a very personal matter, and I can understand if you don't feel comfortable partaking in it.
Did you say you have a letter to give me? I wonder where this letter's coming from...
She's back. I've heard of the rumors, but I guess she really is back.
I asked you to give this to Athena Pierce of Henesys. Have you not gone yet?
You told me you brought the letter, right? Now where is it?

I can't thank you enough for giving me this. At least I know how Kyrin is doing these days. I am just proud that she came back to Victoria Island all grown up. It does seem like she's still dogged by her past, though...\r\n#b#L0# Her past?#l
It's a long story. Care to listen?
Since you served as a messenger, I should tell you what really happened. Please give me some time as I try to recollect and make sure I remember what actually happened. It's been so long...
You must be busy with something.
I'll have to go quite a while back. Kyrin's father is Testonen, a savior of Victoria who battled the Black Mage when Victoria and Ossyria broke into two separate lands.

Once Victoria found some peace, he asked me to take care of his newborn kid Kyrin before he left to track the Black Magician once more. That's how she ended up growing up here in Henesys. She was full of courage like her father, and she was also very capable of inventing things. Some of her inventions did end up causing chaos in this town, though. Hahaha...

One day, during one of the meetings between town chiefs, she overheard what happened to her father, and disappeared all of a sudden. I went to Ossyria, Victoria, Maple Island, and everywhere else looking for her, only to find my search attempts futile. After all these years, I didn't think she'd come back to Victoria Island, all grown up.
I'd really love to see her once more. I am sorry, but can you help me facilitate this meeting between her and myself?

I think Kyrin had been feeling guilty all this time about leaving Henesys without telling me. She shouldn't have felt that way, though. Can you help me give this item to Kyrin? If she sees this, maybe she'll summon up the courage to visit Henesys after all these years.

Thank you so much. This is the orgel that she built when she was a kid. Her very first item, shall we say. She gave it to me as a present, and I've kept it after all these years. Please let #bKyrin#k know how much I miss her, and give this #borgel#k to her.
Ah... will that be too much for you? I'll have to look for other ways, then...
Hmmm? You're here to give me an item from Athena Pierce?

Oh... this orgel... I can't believe she actually kept it after all those years... this orgel was my very first invention. Back when I was child, I would spend countless hours making this just for Athena Pierce...
I feel ashamed to have not summoned up the courage to meet her first. I better go pay a visit to Athena Pierce really soon.
I would really appreciate it if you can take this orgel and give it to Kyrin. She'll like it.
You lost it? No wonder... you dropped the orgel right here.
It's an item I cherish, so please don't misplace it again, and give it to Kyrin this time around.
Uh... ummm... if you aren't too busy, then can you please help me? I really need your help... and I feel weaker by the second.

Thank you so much. I may look like a regular dolphin to you, but I am Sharyl, the prince of Whalians. It's hard for me to even stand right now because my mana has almost run out. Can you please get me one #bMana Elixir#k?
Ah... please...so...weak...
Thank you! I can feel myself already getting better. Yeah!
Please get me 1 Mana Elixir bottle.
You must be wondering why a prince would end up in a place like this. As the Prince of Whalians, my job is to stay here and control the Shining Stone.\r\n#b#L0# Shining Stone? What is that?#l

The Shining Stone is the source of power for The Nautilus. All the power that's required to move The Nautilus is generated from the Generator Room, where the Shining Stone is. Only the Whalians can control the power of the Shining Stone. We owe Kyrin a huge favor, and to repay the gratitude, we provide Shining Stone, and control its massive power. Now that you're here and all, do you want to experience the mystical power of Shining Stone?

The Shining Stone is located on the right of me, the #bGenerator Room of The Nautilus#k. Once you go there, you'll see my colleagues collectively controlling the power of the rock. Go down there, touch the #bShining Stone#k, and experience its powers. It'll be unlike anything you've ever experienced.
You're on board at The Nautilus. You might as well go experience the power of the Shining Stone...
Oh... you must have felt the power of the Shining Stone. How was it? Doesn't it give you a major boost to your body?
The Shining Stone can be found in the Generator Room. Haven't found it yet?
The Shining Stone can be found in the Generator Room. Haven't found it yet?

Ah hello there! You must be the one that experienced the power of the Shining Stone before. Doesn't it seem like it's a bit darker here these days? It's that the ones that light up The Nautilus, the Water Fireflies, are getting weaker by the day.\r\n#L0##bWater Firefly?#k#l

Yes. Water Fireflies are these mysterious creatures that emit bright lights by consuming the Vigor of the Sea deep in the ocean. Once The Nautilus reached Victoria Island, they have never had a chance to go back under the deep sea, so their lighting has dimmed little by little. If you have some time to spare, can you get us some Vigors of the Sea for the sake of Kyrin and the fireflies?
You can get the Vigor of the Sea from #bOlaf of Lith Harbor#k. Fill this Magic Flask with #bthe Vigor of the Sea#k.
Are you busy? Oh no... What will we do?
I've already heard from Sharyl, the Prince of Whales. Can you give me the Magic Flask that you received from the Prince?
It takes a little time to collect the Vigor of the Sea. Can you wait a minute?
You can find Muse at the Aquarium. Please get the Vigor of the Sea for me. Please....

What? You broke the Magic Flask? You'll really need to be careful with it, because it's made out of glass. I'll give you another one, so place fill up the flask with the Vigor of the Sea and bring it back to me.
The Magic Flask has been filled with the Vigor of the Sea. Are you ready to return to Nautilus?
Here it is. Take it to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.
Talk to me again when you are ready. The Prince is in a hurry, so we should probably prepare quickly...
Ahhh you brought it! The Nautilus will be dim no more!
I am sure Kyrin will be relieved of this. Hopefully she'll be happy with what's about to take place.
You still haven't left? Hurry up and give the Vigor of the Sea to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.
Not yet?
Oh no, did you lose it?
You have to put in a lot of effort to collect the Vigor of the Sea. It's very precious, so please be careful not to lose it again.
Ahh, you were the one that did me a huge favor the other day. I'm sorry I keep asking you this, but can you please help me out once more?
Thank you. A while back, I left a #bMother of Pearl#k inside the #bGenerator Room#k, and I am sure by now, it has a huge piece of pearl inside. I'd love to donate that pearl to Kyrin...

Please take the #bpearl#k and give it to Kyrin for me. I am way too shy to do this myself... and please let her know that Prince Sharyl picked it out because he thinks it'll look good on her. Thank you!
Before making your way to Kyrin, however, you should really watch out for #bMuirhat#k. He might stand in your way of getting this done.
I understand if you feel burdened by my constant requests. Who should I ask, then?
Wait, what's that pearl you have in your hand? \r\n#L0##b I'm here carrying out the Prince's order to give this to Kyrin.#k#l
Prince Sharyl?? Hmmm.... So you're saying Prince Sharyl ordered you to give that to Kyrin? \r\n#L0##b Is there a problem?#k#l

Hmm, the Prince should give it up right about now, yet he's still persistent. I bet even if Kyrin receives the pearl, she'll only get angry at him for that. Hand me the pearl. I better talk to Prince Sharyl about this myself.
The Prince will be saddened by this. For you to carry out a personal order like this, you must be very close to Prince Sharyl. Next time you see him, make sure to console him.
Please find the pearl and give it to Kyrin. I want nothing more than to see Kyrin smile. Just make sure not to be detected by Muirhat.
Ahhh, I'm so busy. Hey there, walking right past me. Are you busy right now? \r\n#L0##b Hey! Aren't you...???#k#l
Wh...what? Ha...haven't you seen a pe...person wearing glasses and a beard? \r\n#L0##b Hmmm... you just looked suspicious...#k#l

I am busy right now, so let's talk about that some other time. Right now, I am in a major pinch, and I need your help. I need to turn in this report to Dr. Kim, yet I have so much stuff to do that I can't possibly get to Omega Sector right now. Can you please help me?
Thank you so much. I'll never forget this. Please gather up these reports and give them to #bDr. Kim#k.
You must be really busy. I see...
You're here on Rolonay's behalf? Oh thank you for this... please send him my gratitude.
Rolonay is really a genius. Look at this graph that depicts the relation between the wave of the alien's powers and the power of the ancient magicians. This is perfection!
Dr. Kim is at Omega Sector.
It's a very important & confidential report, and you lost it? The information inside cannot be made public...
I'll give you another copy for now. Please don't lose it again!

Do you hear it? That strange noise that comes out of The Nautilus. Use this stethoscope, and you'll hear it. I've been working here for 10 years, and I've never heard anything like this. Can you find out what exactly happened?

Go to the #bharbor outside The Nautilus#k and walk towards East to find the #bobservatory tower#k. You'll find #bBart#k, there, and I have a hunch that he might have felt something. Please check and see if he's okay.
Maybe you don't hear that strange noise. Place your ear next to The Nautilus. Come on, just try it.
What? Baine noticed that, too?
I mean, I noticed something a few days back, too. Wait... there should be a document that contains the record of activities that day...the log...
You can find Bart at the observatory tower at the Nautilus Harbor. He spends his time with the seagulls.
Ah, here it is! Can you please give this to Baine for me?
This document is very important, and you must not lose it. Please give this to #bBaine#k.
It's not a hard task, but if you are too busy... there's nothing I can do.

What? Is that true? So Bart detected something strange as well? Oh no... This is serious now. If that strange being is indeed a spy for the Black Magician, then this is going to throw the world upside down. I better read the report carefully!
Hmmm... I better start reading this report thoroughly.
I told you to take it to Baine.
For you to lose such a valuable item like that... you must be subpar at keeping things around. I'll give you another copy, but don't lose it this time.
I have read through the report, and just as I suspected, the spies sent by the Black Magician seemed to have gathered some information about us. I believe this is only going to get worse.
I'll have to report this to Kyrin or Muirhat. I'll need some sort of concrete evidence that shows what Bart and I exactly saw... will you help us find it?
I am pretty sure they haven't left Victoria Island just yet. Based on their past actions, I think they are still around here...
The monsters nearby might have the proof dropped by the Black Mage's follower. Eliminate #r15 Ribbon Pigs and 15 Pigs#k, then bring the #bproof#k.
Is this too tough of a task to do? If you can help us out just a little bit, that would be... so helpful. Sigh... I guess I'll need to just report to Muirhat without them.
Ah, you're back already. That was fast. Did you find the Black Magician's Token?

I knew it... I knew they were still in Victoria Island. I have a feeling they may want to collect more information on us. Good thing we noticed them before it was too late. In order for me to write up a report on this to Muirhat, I'll have to start writing up a report on the Black Magician.
Were you not able to find the Black Magician's Token?
You must eliminate 15 Ribbon Pigs and 15 Pigs. You might obtain a clue about the Black Mage's follower.

Thanks to your help with the Black Magician's Token, I was able to complete the report much earlier than expected. I'll now have to give this report to Muirhat, but since you were the number one contributor with the Token and all, I think it's only fair that you hand in this report yourself. No?

If things end up working out because of the report, then you may become the hero of The Nautilus. Please hand it in to #bMuirhat#k. Muirhat can be found #bin front of the Navigation Room#k on the #bupper hallways of The Nautilus#k.

He can seem like a man of very few words, and you may feel like he'd be unapproachable. In fact, the opposite is true, so I suggest you summon up the courage and talk to him. I mean, you'll also take the lion's share of the praises if this all goes well. You have nothing to lose!
Did you just say the spies from the Black Magician? What? They are here, all the way to The Nautilus...?
Hmmm... If it is indeed as stated in the report, then this is a serious, serious issue...
Muirhat should be standing in front of the Captain's Room.
I can't believe you just lost that. I'll give you another copy of the report, as well as the token that someone else had picked up. Please don't lose them again.

Hmmm... This is a big problem. The spies sent by the Black Magician have been observing us for quite some time here. The problem is, this is not the first time they have been chasing our every move. I want this to be taken care of soon. Are you willing to do it?
Referring to Bart's report, the spies seem to be around this area. Hmmm... I'll send you to their hideout spot, and I want you to eliminate the #rBlack Magician's Disciple#k.

They are always in disguise, so they'll be very hard to detect. It's when they're tired that they transform back to their normal selves. I want you to really look carefully so you can spot the one and eliminate him.
I was hoping you'd be able to take care of this. Was I asking too much?
Ah, were you able to slay them?

That was incredibly fast. You're the kind of a prodigy that's hard to find in Victoria Island. I'll let Kyrin know of your outstanding job here. Everyone at The Nautilus will remember your job well done here.
Were you not able to eliminate the spy from the Black Magician yet? You may want to revisit the place I told you to go to.

Sigh... what's with all this dust! I keep cleaning and cleaning, yet I don't see any difference whatsoever! Now my towel's about to be completely torn off... and now, it is. Oh no... what should I do...\r\n#L0##b Is there something going on there?#k#l

Sigh... look at this cleaning towel. I wiped away so much dust that it's already ragged and torn off. I don't have any spare with me... and yet, look at all this dust! How am I going to clean all this? Where can I find a spare cleaning towel?\r\n#L0##b Do you want me to find one for you?#k#l
Oh, that's very nice of you! Will you do that?

I've heard that the Ribbon Pigs at Victoria Island have Ribbons made out of a very dense material that can clean and absorb dust very effectively. I'd really appreciate it if you could get me #b10 Ribbons from the Ribbon Pigs#k. That should be no problem for you, right?
Look at all this dust! Don't tell me I don't need a cleaning towel right this minute... well, but if you don't clean, this doesn't matter much to you.
Whoa! You're a quick one. You already brought 10?
1, 2, 3...10! Perfect! I don't know how to thank you. Since I'm so grateful, I'll let you mess up this place just a little bit.
I said 10 Pig Ribbons. Well...you can get me more if you'd like.
Ahhh, all the squeaking from the rats. I can't stand it! Hey, aren't you the one that got me some ribbons from the Ribbon Pigs? Haha, good to see you!\r\n#L0##b Is there something going on again?#k
Kids these days catch on pretty quickly. You've helped me last time, and... Can you help me once more?

The Nautilus usually was on the water, so you don't even sniff a rat around here... but ever since we came here, since the ship is in direct contact with the land, I see rats here and there, and that really bothers me. Shulynch saw one yesterday, and she almost fainted!
I hear that the Ratz from Ludibrium give out #bRat Trap#k, and if you can get me some, I will love you for it. I just need #b50#k.
Will that be too much for you? Sigh... what am I going to do with all these rats?
Whoa! You're fast, just like the last time!
Now how am I going to set up these 50 rat traps? Anyway, I like how young people like you take care of things so quickly. Hahaha.
Ahhh, did you forget your promise already? I need 50 rat traps, and you can get them from Ratz in Ludibrium.
Hahaha... hey there, kid. Can I ask you for one more favor? \r\n#L0##b Wait a minute... what's this smell???#l#k

Sigh... if you see Jack, you know how he smells. Seriously, I have never, ever seen him wash up once in my life. Jack has been on board for 10 years now, and even if I clean and clean and clean some more, Jack's disgusting footprints leave a mark everywhere. I need to wash him up... and I need your help. Can you help me one last time?

Ahhh, thank you so so much. If you go waaaay down to Sleepywood, you may be able to get some #bpure water#k... and I want you to get one bottle of it, and pour it on #bJack#k. Just so he can be a tiny bit cleaner than he was earlier today.
I know, I know, I keep asking you for favors. I understand if you are busy right now.
Hehe, who are you? What's that in your hand? Is that food?\r\n#L0##b Hi there, are you Jack? (OMG... he really smells...)#k#l

Sniff sniff... my hair itches. (Scratches his head) let me see what you have in your hand. It looks like something I can drink... \r\n#L0##b I am really sorry, but just stand still for a second! (Sprays water all over him.)#k#l
Whoa! That's cold!

Sniff sniff... what are you trying to do? Did... Mrs. Reade order you to do it? Hahaha... this will not make me do what she wants me to do! Why do I have to wash up? I mean, the nature takes care of me, and I'll be naturally clean after a while...
Man, you only got my shirt wet! Oh well, it's going to dry up in a bit, right? Hahahaha... oh man, my back's itching...
(Oh my... even with that impromptu shower session, there's no change whatsoever!)
Please spray that Pure Water over Jack. If that'll help him get JUST A BIT CLEANER...
Oh no! Our food! Those darn pigs came in late at night and ate our food again! Hey you there, help me out here. I don't see a lot of people crossing path, so that's why I'm asking you for help.

Hehehe. You're nicer than you look. Can you eliminate the #rPigs#k and the #rRibbon Pigs#k around this area. We might starve, because those hungry Pigs come every night and eat up our food in the Food Storage. Please show the Pigs and Ribbon Pigs around here a lesson. Just #b15#k of each will be enough. Hahaha!
Ah... young kids these days... sigh...
Ahhh... what should I make for dinner... hey, you're back!
You were able to eliminate it already. That's amazing! Oh, to be young again! Thanks to you, those pigs won't be sniffing around the food storage area anytime soon.
Just teach a lesson to 30 Pigs and 15 Ribbon Pigs. That should teach them not to mess with our Food Storage again.

Hmm hmm. Hey! I saw you just walking by! Thanks to your great work, those pigs haven't been sniffing around ever since. Thank you so much! Hahaha... I cooked something for you in return... and... here, try it.\n\r#L0##b Whaaaaaaat! (Is this really... the Dragon Special that I've only heard of in storybooks??? Oh my goodness...)#k#l
Hahaha! Isn't it delicious? That's what everyone says when they try my food. Now that you've tasted the heavens, can you help me out once more?
Yes yes, I like your attitude. I need to make food for everyone on board, and I am out of milk. Please fill this bottle up with milk.

For fresh ingredients, I raise a number of milk cows at the corner of this ship. Go there, and milk some from the cows. Lately, we've seen a number of baby cows being born, and those kids sure can eat, so please be careful. If you leave the bottle in front of them, they'll just drink it all...

Oh, and you can only fill up 1/3 of this bottle from one cow. If you try to milk more, there won't be any left for the babies, so... once you're ready to hit the stable, let me know. I'll take you there.
Were you not that impressed with my food?
Ohhh! Fresh milk! What do you think about the stable? Isn't it amazing?
Haha... thanks to your help, the crew will be feasting tonight. Thank you, and if you ever find yourself hungry, come by and I'll make you something delicious. Hahahaha!
Didn't I tell you to fill up the whole bottle with milk?
Hello, traveler? Are you here at the Generator Room to see this rock? Isn't Shining Stone amazing? And the Whalians that control the rock... they're amazing too, right?
Since you've made your way all the way down here, can I ask you for a favor? Not many people pass through this area, and we're in a bit of trouble right now.

The Whalians here don't eat what the normal people eat. They eat something that can only be found in the sea. They always ate that, but... now that we've spent a considerable amount of time here on land, the ingredients have run out.

My cousin Kenta, who lives in Aquarium, can make something for them. That's why I am here to ask you for a favor. Can you send this letter that I wrote about that food to #bKenta#k? You can find him at the Aquarium Zoo.
I guess you don't have time to help me. Who should I ask, then?
You're here to give me a letter? It's from Porchay?
Oh... so it's about the special food that the Whalians eat. They only eat certain things, so... let's see if there's any left.
You can find Kenta at the Aquarium.
Kenta is at the Aquarium Zoo, watching over the animals.
Did you lose the letter? Oh no... I'll write you another one. Don't lose it again, okay?
Now, please give this letter to Kenta.
Oh no... I am actually missing one of the ingredients... the Sea Horse Tails... what should I do...
Ahh, you're willing to find some for me? Thank you so much! The #bSea Horse Tails#k can be found through #bSeacle#k. You can find them all over Aquarium. Can you get me 40 of them?
You must be running out of time. I am just glad you made your way all the way here to give me this letter.
Ah, you are back! All I have to do now is to dump in the Sea Horse Tails in here, and the food will be ready.
Okay, now let's dump them in. See what happens.
I don't think you have 40 Sea Horse Tails. I can't cook this thing if I don't have all 40 of them...
Here's the feast. Can you please take this and go deliver it to Porchay?
Here it is! Give this to #bPorchay#k, and please let her know that if she ever runs out again, all she needs to do is let me know, and I'll make some for her.
I guess you don't need to go to Victoria Island yet. Yes, it is a long way from here.
Oh you're back! I've been waiting for you!
Wow! Kenta sure cooked up a feast! I can just imagine the Whalians smiling at the thought of eating this. Thank you so so much!
Please take this feast and give it to Porchay. She seemed to need it right this minute, so please hurry your way back to her.
What you lost it?? I have some spare, but please don't lose it again.
Hey there! Are you aware that Kyrin's birthday is coming up! Seriously, to see her all grown up now, that is just astounding. Seriously!

That's why a few days ago, the crew voted and we decided the best birthday present for her would be a dress. Yes, I've seen her for a long time, and I have honestly never seen her wear a feminine dress. That's why I asked my dear friend Mrs. Ming Ming for help, and the problem is, we don't have the materials! Can you get some for us?

Hahaha! Unlike other young people these days, you're a very diligent crewman! Of course, it's because you're a part of the Nautilus! In order to make a dress, a strong, white material is needed. Jr. Wraiths are the best for that. Get #b15 Table Cloths#k and take them to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k.
Hmmm... That was cold.

I heard it from Black Bark already. Seriously, he asks for favors first, and then thinks about it. Sigh... I am busy preparing for this festival... if he wasn't an old friend of mine, then the answer would have been no...
You brought 15 Table Cloths! Now, time to make a dress!
Mrs. Ming Ming is at Henesys.

Okay, good thing I have started on the basic stuff already, because I am done with the dress now! Please give this to Black Bark, and tell him... that I'll be charging him for this dress shortly. Hahahaha!
Please make sure that this dress doesn't get wrinkled, and since the fabric is very thin, it may get ripped. I suggest you deliver this to #bBlack Bark#k now. He hates waiting...

Are you avoiding Black Bark because he scares you? He may look intimidating, but... he hasn't even held a girl's hand yet. Hahaha... not even my hands back in the day... hey, what am I saying? Haha....
Ahh, you're back! Let's see the dress!
Oh, you're so talented. Pretty... Very pretty! All of our crewmen will be happy to see this. Hey, you want to come to my birthday party with that? Don't be shy...everyone should see it!
Please deliver the dress to Black Bark. You didn't forget it, did you?
Hey, did you forget something? Where is the dress you got from Mrs. Ming Ming?
Good thing I have an extra dress that I made with spare materials. It took me a lot of time and effort to make this. Don't lose it again!
My glasses... my glasses...\n\r#L0##b Is something wrong? Did you drop something on the ground?#k#l

Ahhh, please don't come near me! My glasses might have been dropped somewhere, and you don't want to step on them! Are my glasses around there? A black horn-rimmed pair of glasses...\n\r#L0##b No, I don't see any glasses around here...#k#l

Man... I told Bart so many times not to take my glasses. He likes shiny objects, so he'd take them while I am asleep... and each time that happens, the seagulls seem to take them from him. I am legally blind without them, so... can you go up to the Observatory Tower and find my glasses?

Thank you so much. My glasses are like another pair of my eyes. Without them, I can't see anything. Like I said, I am legally blind without them. I can't even recognize your face. It's just a blur to me.
Mine are a black, horn-rimmed glasses. My eyes are so bad without them that I can't see anything in front of me, so please find them!

You can find the #bObservatory Tower#k by #bheading right all the way#k. You'll see Bart and those seagulls in flocks, so it won't be hard for you to find my #bglasses#k. Please bring them back to me!
Don't you find me even a bit sad? You must be one cold-hearted person.
My glasses are horn-rimmed. Please find them for me.
My fingers are losing their grip now... I can't do this much longer... if I let my hand go, the ship will sink... please help...somebody...

You want to help? Then hurry up and get me #b30 Solid Horns#k. There is a hole in the ship, and it must be blocked. If we don't do anything about it, the Nautilus may sink. I'll clog the hole with my finger for now, so hurry up!
Ahhh... The Nautilus might sink, though...
Did you bring the Solid Horns? Yes! Thank goodness. Please give me those right now. I better plug this hole with the horn.
That should temporarily take care of it. We better fix this ship soon.
You need to bring me 30 Solid Horns. I have to block the hole in the ship.

Lately the mood around #m100000000# has been chaotic at best. A strange rumor has been swirling throughout Victoria Island, and a lot of people are concerned about it. If you are a traveler yourself, surely you must have heard of the rumor by now. That there's a #bgroup of suspicious people#k seen around the Eastern shores of #m100000000#.

From what I hear, the suspicious group of people roam around in weird costumes and carry unusual weapons. People say they hear sounds coming from the shores. It's really puzzling. Could you investigate this for me?

Henesys is the town located in the center of Victoria Island. Not only is #p1012100# keeping tabs on what's going on, so are #p1052001#, #p1022000#, and #p1032001#. Please go over to #b#m100030000##k and see if it's anything we may have to investigate further.
Hmmm...I don't think this is something we should take lightly.

Hey, who's that? I, #p1094000#, will protect #b#p1072008##k and #bThe Nautilus#k! Remember the name, the hero of the pirates, #p1094000#! Hahahahaha! Wait, this is not it. What are you trying to do there? Whatever you are trying to do, it won't fool me! Not #p1094000#!

Eh? What? You're just here to investigate because you've never seen us before? Why didn't you just say that from the get go? We're not aliens or anything like that! We're just Pirates. Fearsome, fight-to-the-last-man, potion-loving Pirates! Don't tell me you are thinking of Lord Pirate and those despicable bandits. They suck! We serve a cause much more true to the spirit of Victoria Island!

We ride around on our ship, The Nautilus, under the guidance of our captain, Kyrin, roaming around the coasts of Maple World, looking for the Black Magician. We use Knucklers and Guns to make sure that the root of all evil is vanquished--we want to make sure that the Black Magician never rises to the heights of power as he did before.

Just like the wise men in Victoria Island training for the day the Black Magician returns, #p1072008# is busy making sure that his followers stay in low numbers. She's so young, too. That's just so admirable!
So no more suspicious looks! We're not here to fight you! I swear on #p1072008#'s name! We come in peace!

We're not done with the fort's construction just yet, so I can't show you what's going on, but we'll be finished soon, so have no fear. If you want to join us and #p1072008# and become a mighty #bGunslinger or Brawler#k, come back later. By then, we'll be ready to accept you with open arms, and train you to live the life of a Pirate!
Haven't you gone to #b#m100030000##k yet? Please hurry. We need to find out what they're up to!
You have reached Level 30 already. Are you here to become the Brawler? Then you've come to the right place.

But I can't just give you a job advancement that easily. I need you to prove yourself worthy of it. Brawlers use brute strength, steel fists, and their full bodies' power to eliminate all opposition. In order to become a commendable Brawler, you'll need to be good with your fists! Prove to me that you are.

It's simple really. You'll just need to head to the test room where I'll send you, and fight #rOctopirates#k. Your task is to bring back #b15 Potent Power Crystals#k. You think it's easy? Then think again. These Octopirates can only be attacked with #rFlash Fist#k. Other attacks will be fruitless. It may be tough, but any honorable Brawler must go through this. Good luck...
Do you not wish to become a Brawler?
Good. You got all 15.

That performance in the testing ground was impressive. You look like you can become a legitimate force as a Brawler. Now tell me when you're ready to make the job advancement, and I'll go ahead and do it for you.
Bring 15 Potent Power Crystals.
You have reached Level 30 already. Are you here to become a Gunslinger? Then you've come to the right place.

But I can't just give you a job advancement that easily. I need you to prove yourself worthy of it. Gunslingers use Guns to eliminate oppositions. In order to become a commendable Gunslinger, you'll need to be good with your Gun, right? Prove it to me that you are.

It's simple really. You'll just need to head to the test room where I'll send you, and fight #rOctopirates#k. Your task is to bring back #b15 Potent Wind Crystals#k. You think it's easy? Then think again. These Octopirates can only be attacked with #rDouble Shot#k. Other attacks will be fruitless. It may be tough, but any honorable Gunslinger must go through this. Good luck...
Do you not wish to become a Gunslinger?
Good. You got all 15.

That performance in the testing ground was impressive. You look like you can become a legitimate force as a Gunslinger. Now tell me when you're ready to make the job advancement, and I'll go ahead and do it for you.

Is the whole Pirate job still foreign to you? That's because you don't have much experience as one. Right now, it may be a bit tough for you to gain experience on your own. I can help you a bit with that. Do you want to train with me? \r\n#L0##b Yes I will.#k#l \n#L1##b I can do it by myself.#k#l

Hoh... you must be looking for new types of delicacy. If so, then please help me here. I've been looking for ways to experiment with the basic menu. I know that the crew gets tired of the same old thing to eat. They've eaten so much Cold Shark coleslaw, I think they might grow gills!

So, I'm trying to cook food with ingredients that others do not usually eat. Since we are in Victoria Island, I want to make a cuisine with the unique ingredients of the area. Go get me #b10 Evil Eye Tails#k. I will create a new delicacy, to be sure!

Ahhh! I just made a hamburger made out of Evil Eye Tails. It's charcoaled, so the meat should smell really good! But you know... from here on out, I think I'll just use a regular meat for hamburgers.
Hahaha, and here's a hamburger for you! Thanks for getting the meat for me. Try it! Well, I'm going to try some other food now, but I'm definitely not using Evil Eye Tails ever again.
(Mmmm... this is weird. The meat tastes like... beef.)

All right, this time, the ingredient will be Curse Eye Tail. Evil Eye Tail was not that great...but I will make something great this time! Just you wait! So, yeah...get me #b10 Curse Eye Tails#k.

Okay! Shall we cook now?\n(Stir... heat... toss... toss... thwap!)

Whoa! This is amazing! I just made Unagi with Curse Eye Tails! Check out the smell... and the taste... this is practically indistinguishable from eels. Will this finally bring the day where Unagi is inexpensive and easy to eat? I am a cooking genius!

Hahaha, I know it was made out of Curse Eye Tails, but it looks exactly like the real Unagi. I'll give you this as my token of appreciation. Try it, but... I don't think I'll ever want to make this again. I did not like the feeling of the Curse Eye Tails.

(Mmmm... Wait, this is just a strawberry-flavored ice cream pop. Is this really made out of Cold Eye Tails?)
Get me 10 Cold Eye Tails.

Hey there! At the end of the hallway, you'll find the bedroom where the crews sleep. Have you ever been there before? Really? You have? Have you seen Calico standing in front of the door? Yeah, he's the one that always falls asleep on duty. Oh, so you know him! I'm trying to pull something hilarious on him. What do you think? Are you interested?

Calico always does something weird at night instead of sleeping, so whenever he's on duty in the afternoon, that's all he does, nod off. Maybe he doesn't sleep at night because he's asleep in the afternoon. I want to freak Calico out by tossing an Evil Eye Tail on his face. Don't you think he'll freak out like crazy?? Hahaha!
Sounds fun, right? Well then, get #b7 Evil Eye Tails#k and then try throwing them at #bCalico#k. You have to scream that the Evil Eye Tails are snakes, okay? Hahaha! This is going to be great!
Boooo, you aren't going to do it? Seriously, it's going to be fun! Don't regret it!
Zzzz... meat... meat... rice... yum... Zzzz...
#b(It's a snake! A snake!)#k
Hey, I didn't fall asleep! What was that all about? I knew it was an Evil Eye Tail. I was just pretending to be surprised...
Get #b7 Evil Eye Tails#k and surprise #bCalico#k.
Hey there! Do you need to make your way to Omega Sector by chance? I know of an easy way to get there... but of course, for a price. There's no such thing out there that's free.

Okay, so you still want to know what it is, right? I'll tell you of a great way to get to Omega Sector at once. Tada! This card is all you need to make a quick trip there! I carried out Muirhat's order once and he gave me this as a reward. Use this card, and you'll have access to the warp portal that heads to Omega Sector. How is there a portal like that, you ask?

Dr. Kim of Omega Sector has been lifelong friends with Kyrin. They both share a mutual interest in technology, and they help each other out. When Kyrin built The Nautilus, I heard that Dr. Kim helped out quite a bit. They still look to one another for technological help, and that's why they built this warp portal.

If you do me a favor, then I'll give you this card. Your basic trade of the goods, you know. What do you think? I have a list of items that I have to deliver to multiple places, and... if you can do it for me, I'll give you this Warp Card.
Wait, hold on. I need to organize this list. I need to see Shulynch, Muirhat, and Black Bark... hmmm... talk to me in a bit, okay?
This card is all that's needed to warp straight to Omega Sector. Are you sure you don't need it?
Awesome! Thank you thank you! Seriously, The Nautilus is much bigger than you think, and I didn't want to visit every corner of it. As promised, here's the Warp Card.

Use this to gain access to the machine located at the Navigation Room of The Nautilus and you'll head straight to Omega Sector. Without this card, however, this machine will not activate. Remember that, okay?

Ohh, and one more thing. This Warp Card is only available for one-time use. Once this card is inserted in the machine to activate it, the card will not be returned. Save the card until you really need to use it, you know. If you don't have multiple cards with you, then returning here will be a big problem.
Shulynch needs a lemon, Muirhat needs this Gold Pouch, and Black Bark needs the ripped map.
I knew you'd lose it. I saw you dropping one, and I had to pick it up for you. Here, take it.
First, please give this lemon to Shulynch.

Shulynch is usually at the training ground, so go see her there. The #btraining ground#k can be found at the #beast end of the upper hallways in The Nautilus.#k
Do the three favors I asked you to do, and you'll get the Warp Card. Keep going!
You don't feel like doing it anymore?
So you're here on behalf of Bartol? A lemon... that kid is so lazy, I swear.
Please tell Bartol thanks!
Can you please give Shulynch 1 lemon? If you do all this, then I'll give you the warp card. Fair deal, right?
What's going on?
First, give this Gold Pouch to Muirhat.

This Gold Pouch is from the box that Muirhat asked me to open a week ago, and... I totally forgot about it, hahaha! Muirhat is #bin front of the Navigation Room at the upper hallways of The Nautilus#k. He's always there...
Do the three favors I asked you to do, and you'll get the Warp Card. Keep going!

Can I help you with something?

This map was found in the treasure chest that was discovered yesterday, and... I think Black Bark would really love this. Who knows, this map may lead to lots of treasures you know. Black Bark is always at the #bmeeting room in the middle hallway of The Nautilus#k, so go see him.
Do the three favors I asked you to do, and you'll get the Warp Card. Keep going!
You don't feel like doing it anymore?
Bartol told you to give this map to you? Ohh, so this is a very old map.

In fact, it is so ancient that the way they used symbols and outlines here looks like this map is at least a few hundred years ago. This really is making me feel excited about the maps. Hahaha, thank you so much for the find, and tell Bartol I said hello, too.
Please give this map to Black Bark.
Are you here to learn how to read the map from me?
You lost it, right? I just picked these off the floor, you know. Don't lose it, because it's a very precious item, and give it to Black Bark.
Oh, so you want to become a Pirate? Are you ready for it?
Okay, being a #rPirate#k requires a delicate balance of #bStrength and Dexterity#k. If you want to become one, you may want to see #b#p1090000##k at #rThe Nautilus#k.
You're not here to become a Pirate? Well... whatever it is, if you feel like you're ready, let me know.
Did you come all the way here to become a Pirate?
Not everyone can become a Pirate. In order to become one, you must be at least at Level 10.
#b#p1090000##k has recently parked her ship The Nautilus in between Henesys and Ellinia, and is staying there.

...Hush. Keep your voice down. You never know who's hiding nearby... Are you determined to get to the bottom of the rumor you heard? Is that why you're here? You seem like an adventurer... yet a weak, scrawny one. It won't be that easy. Are you ready for it? Hm?

You've probably heard about the swamp region past the #m103000000#'s sewer system? That's where ferocious alligators live. But monsters have been making frequent appearances as of late. The #m103000000# are shivering in fear because of #r#o6220000##k with a vast mouth furnished with sharp teeth...

If we don't place these Charms on the Shaman Rocks, evil might awaken...
I, too, felt it. The force of the Shaman Rocks began to overpower the forces of evil. I think Sleepywood is safe now. The evil has been eliminated.
Please report back after placing the 6 Charms on the Shaman Rocks inside the dungeon.
There is a crumpled piece of paper on the ground. Would you like to pick it up and read what's written on it?

The words written on this piece of paper make absolutely no sense.\r\n#bPrince of Darkness. Underground temple, a bold young man, the key of the seal... My last breath'#k\r\nWhat's that supposed to mean? There is nobody around so finding the owner might be hard. Oh, maybe it belongs to Manji's apprentice, Mu Young.
Is this trash?
Hm? What is that? That doesn't belong to me.
Let's go find the owner of this paper.
Can I... help you?
Hmm, I don't know who the owner is, but it sure isn't me.
Hey! You!
Are you alright?
Hello, young adventurer.

I'm very impressed! I can't believe you were able to defeat the illusory Jr. Balrog I created. That was awfully brave of you. There, there, don't be shocked. You and I live in different worlds, so there is no reason to be afraid of me.

My name is Tristan. I took my last breath here a few decades ago. Balrog and I both died here, but the force of Balrog could not be consumed by death. Manji, who was an ambitious young adventurer at the time, sealed the force of Balrog with the help of my spirit.

But as time passes, the power of the seal is getting weaker and weaker. Balrog, the Prince of Darkness, is going to reemerge any day now. Oh, young adventurer, please save Maple World from evil. Please.
I really don't know who this note belongs to.
I know he wouldn't trust just anyone with something like this. If you were sent by my master, I assume you are one heck of an adventurer and I can really use your help. Will you help me?

I came here to investigate at the request of my master and discovered something amazing. Many decades ago, my master was able to seal Balrog in this area where Tristan the hero was buried. But I keep finding subtle signs of Balrog's impending revival.

So I went deep into the dungeon to stop Balrog from reviving, but that place was filled with powerful energy. I mean, the force of Balrog was tremendously strong even though he hasn't even revived yet.
I don't know if I'd be able to handle Balrog on my own, even if he hasn't awakened. #bCould you please form an Expeditionary Team to help me prevent Balrog's revival?
Please, think about it. I really need your help.

Ah, you're back! What happened to Balrog?

#b#L0#Hmmm... I don't know. The dungeon began to shake and he disappeared into the air.#l
#k
Really? Where could Balrog have disappeared to? Well, at least we were able to keep him from hurting anyone. Thank you so much.
My master was right again. You are one amazing adventurer.
Balrog is sealed behind that door. I don't recommend going in alone. I think it would be best if you entered with others after forming an Expeditionary Team.

Too much has happened since then. Could you let my master know that I'm still looking for Balrog's traces and will be staying here until I find more clues? I know I should tell him myself, but I can't go back to Perion now. Not like this. I haven't fulfilled my duties and I'd only let him down if I go now.
Please deliver this message to the master in Perion. Please.
Are you thinking about staying here a bit longer then?

Welcome back. I was starting to get worried... Thought I'd lose you like I lost Mu Young.

#b#L0#I have a message from Mu Young.#l
#k
Did you really find Mu Young? What message have you brought me?
Please deliver this message to my master. I can trust you with this, right?
Did you find Mu Young? Did he have any messages for me?
Mu Young tells me you were a big help. If you happen to head back into the Sleepywood underground dungeon, could you let Mu Young I understood his message?

Please tell him that he must stay alert every single second or else he'll be consumed by Balrog's evil forces. Balrog may have disappeared for now, but he will come back when you least expect it. Tell him to be prepared.
Do you have other places to go? Are you going to Ossyria or something?

Oh! You're back! Did you give my master the message?

#b#L0#Yup. And Manji also wanted me to tell you something.#l
#k

What is it?

#b#L0#He said to stay alert at all times because Balrog is an evil creature.#l
#k
I will keep that in mind. I'll always remind myself so I don't forget. Thank you so much for coming back to tell me that.
I'd love to see you from time to time. I'm going to stay in here and continue with my investigation, but if you're ever nearby, please feel free to visit.
Deliver my message to Mu Young in the Sleepywood Underground Temple.

Did you see a strange man on your way down here? I haven't seen a single person around here in ages, and it seems a bit odd that this person suddenly appeared out of nowhere. Isn't that weird? He even had chains around his ankles! I can't stop wondering who this person is. How do you feel about investigating him?
Alright. Could you talk to him and distract him while I investigate? Go on ahead and I'll be right there behind you.
Don't you think he's a bit strange? I'm so curious, I can't stand it!

What a beautiful day it is. I know you and that other man are here to see what you can find out about me, but I'm just a person like you. I have nothing to reveal, so stop wasting your time and energy, and just go back to where you came from.\r\n#b#L0#Who are you?#l\n#k

As you can see, I'm just an ordinary person. Ah, but I do have a special talent. Come back and see me later and I'll show you my trick. It'll be entertaining. I doubt your friend with the hat will come though. Hahaha.
I know a lot about rare treasures.
Start a conversation with that strange man and distract him. I'll be right there behind you.
Let me show you something amazing.
Bring me 20 pieces of Balrog Leather.
What? You don't want to?
Ta-da! Amazing, huh? The success rate is pretty low... I'm glad it worked this time. Haha.
Hahaha. If you ever want to test your luck in the future, come and see me.
20 pieces of Balrog Leather.

Brave adventurer, the aura of evil is spreading throughout the entire underground dungeon. Our job right now is to prevent Balrog from reviving until he finally gives up. This is easier said than done, but I know you'll be able to pull through if you are a true warrior. What do you say?

Your job is to stop Balrog from reviving. If you can stop him 200 times, you will be known as a true warrior of Maple World. If you can accomplish this mission, I will accept you as my successor. Believe in yourself. I am counting on you, young adventurer.
I appreciate that you're thinking things through carefully, but we don't have much time.

Have you seen the Horny Mushrooms lately? They seem to be much more enraged than usual. From what I hear, something happened at the Mushroom Castle. I plan on conducting a thorough research on the Horny Mushrooms. Can you help me with it?
Thank you. I'll need 30 Horny Mushroom Caps to start things off. Can you get me those?
This is just the tip of the iceberg. There's no way to tell what's going to happen next...
Thank you. These will help me with my research. Please wait for me for a bit, okay?
I need 30 Horny Mushroom Caps.

I've been diligently studying the Horny Mushroom Caps you have given me, but I keep getting reports that the Horny Mushrooms are causing major damage in the area. I think we'll need to put an end to this by hunting down a significant number of them. Can you please eliminate 80 Horny Mushrooms?
Great, thank you. I'll keep working on my research in the meantime.
Ah, really? I'll have to put my research on hold for now then and go survey the damaged area.
Oh great work. I just got done with my research, too. Please hold on for a bit.
I'm in the middle of my research on the Horny Mushrooms...

I just completed my research on the Horny Mushrooms, and... Well, it looks like some of these Horny Mushrooms are tainted. The tainted Horny Mushroom Caps look like this #v4032390#. If you can gather these up, it would really speed up the research. Can you do that for me?
Thank you. I need 20 Tainted Horny Mushroom Caps.
I am sorry. I must be working you too hard. I understand.
Oh! You brought them all! Great, now once I take this and do that, and...

I've been studying the signals that the Horny Mushrooms send to each other and figured out what some of them mean.\r\n#b'Danger'#k , #b'King Pepe'#k, #b'Level 30'#k\r\nThis is still a big mystery to me...
I'm currently studying the Horny Mushrooms...

I just completed my research on the Horny Mushrooms, and...I just feel like I'm missing something. So I was thinking, if Zombie Mushrooms send out signals similar to those of the Horny Mushrooms, then maybe it'd be easier for us to figure out their codes.
You know how mushrooms make a peculiar noise right before they die? Well, I think it has something to do with the communication signals they use. I know you have slain your fair share of mushrooms. What kind of sound do they make right when they die?
#b#L0#Kwaaak...#l
#L1#Arrgh..!#l
#L2#I have no idea...#l
#k

I guess this isn't the type of stuff you pay attention to. Could you find out what kind of sound they make when they die? Eliminate about 80 of them, and I bet you'll be able to duplicate the sound perfectly. Good luck!
Hmmm... sounds similar...or maybe not...
Hmmm... sounds similar...or maybe not...
Listen carefully to the noise the Zombie Mushrooms make right as they die.
I am sorry. I must be working you too hard. I understand.
Oh you are back! What kind of a sound do they make?\r\n#b#L0#Keck... Something like that?#l\n#k
Okay! I'll enter that into the equation now, and...
#b'K.Pepe', 'Swerve', 'Level 30'#k\r\nIt's still a mystery... if nothing else, it's even worse than the last set of information!
That's not it...

I was thinking... are you sure 'keck' was exactly how they said it? If I remember it correctly, it sounded a little different. \r\n#b#L0#I don't know... it's not something that I can really duplicate....#l\n#k

I thought that might happen, so I brought this. It's a container that holds and records sounds, but it's incomplete... It needs to be mixed with something that can soak up sounds. Zombie Mushroom Charms should do the trick! Get me 50 charms, and I'll convert them into something that can soak up sounds. Remember, 50!
I am sorry. I must be working you too hard. I understand.
Okay, wait for a bit while I make one for you.
That's not the sound...
Okay, now I need you to go slay some Zombie Mushrooms. The sound of the dying mushrooms should be recorded and that should cause them to drop Recording Charms upon their death.
Collect 20 #bRecording Charms#k for me. You'll be able to gather them by hunting Zombie Mushrooms.
I am sorry. I must be working you too hard. I understand.
Ah, this is the sound! Just hold on a second!

#b#e'Mushking of the Mushroom Castle is in danger. Watch out for King Pepe! Request help from the courageous heroes of Maple World who are at least Level 30.' #n#k\r\n\r\nMushroom Castle? I've never heard of the place...
That's not the sound...
I want to research the Mushroom signal. Will you help me?
Thanks. I'll need you to defeat 20 Horny Mushrooms and 30 Zombie Mushrooms for me.
I see. I understand...
Thanks. This is going to be very helpful for my research.
Please get me something that'll be helpful for my research.
I want to research the Mushroom signal. Will you help me?
Great. Now I want you to defeat 20 Irritable Zombie Mushrooms.
I see. I understand...
Thanks. This will help me with my research.
Please get me something that'll help me with my research.
Okay, I think I know what to do now. I'll send you to #bKarcasa#k right now. The only problem is that he's...quite the salesman. You'll know what I mean. Do you want to go over to see him right now?
Alright, now head over to see #bKarcasa#k and ask him about Mushroom Castle. Again, thank you for helping me out with my research!
Hmmm... I don't know if I've told you this, but at your level, it might be easier to level-up around the desert. It's your choice, though...
Eh? Who are you? I don't think we've ever met.
Haven't you gone to see #bKarcasa#k at the desert yet?
Are you interested in a special route that'll take you directly back to Victoria Island?\r\n#b#L0#Do you know anything about Mushroom Castle?#l\n#k

You know, I've been getting so many inquiries about the Mushroom Castle these days. Someone asks me about it every five minutes. It's really tiring me out. Making my brain hurt, you know? Thing is, I can't remember anything about the castle right this moment. I haven't the foggiest about a betrayal of the spores or anything of that sort... Hmmm... You know, I have a hunch that I do know something. Just can't remember what. Perhaps if I eat some carrots, say, 30 of them, it'll jog my memory. I hear they're good for the brain.
You can find carrots by defeating #bBrown Sand Rabbits#k, just saying. You know, making conversation. Though I'm sure 30 of them would definitely get my memory running again.
Guess you're not as interested about Mushroom Castle as you said you were...
Hmm? Oh, was I supposed to give you some information about the Mushroom Castle? Let's see... Mushroom Castle...
Still short on carrots? You know, the information about the Castle is on the tip of my brain...
Okay, now I remember! Mushroom Castle is a palace where mushrooms live. It's currently in danger, thanks to a mass betrayal. Do you want to know more?
Okay, then I'll need one more thing from you. This one's simple. I need you to head over to Ariant and get me a bottle of #bPure Water#k, since I need to fill up an oasis nearby.
Guess you're not as interested about Mushroom Castle as you said you were...
Ohh, nice. There's nothing that captivates the visitors of a desert quite like an oasis! Ah, anyway, what did you need me for again?\r\n#b#L0#Mushroom Castle! Come on!#l\n#k

Oh yeah. You're talking about the Mushroom Castle, right? It's part of the Mushking Empires. I've heard that Mushking is going through some troubles as of late. Do you want more on this story? \r\n#b#L0#You already told me this earlier!#l\n#k
Ah… Did…did I really?
What? You don't even know where you can find that? Buy it at a general store in Ariant.

I'm sorry... Actually, I don't know much about Mushroom Castle, just the rumors that've been floating around. Well, since I got most of this info from Camel Cab, maybe you should talk to him instead?\r\n#b#L0#If you're trying to fool me again...#l\n#k
Of course not... You should go see him. Do you want to know where you can find Camel Cab?

Camel Cab hangs out around the north entrance of Ariant as well as the Sahel region. The camel hears and remembers everything the passengers talk about during the ride so you should definitely go talk to Camel Cab.
I'm not lying this time!

Camel Cab hangs out around the north entrance of Ariant as well as the Sahel region. The camel hears and remembers everything the passengers talk about during the ride so you should definitely go talk to Camel Cab.
Why are you coming back? Keep defeating Meerkats!
This is not something we should discuss here. Meet me at 'Sahel 1.' It's safer there. Just keep going straight.
I don't want to say anything in front of Meerkats.
Your level is still a bit low; You should be at least Lv. 30 in order to handle the truth about this place!
You have yet to reach Level 30. Only those that have met the level requirement can handle the truth. You should train more diligently and get to Level 30. Would you mind if I offered you some help?
Okay, I want you to acquire 60 Gold Stingers from the Scorpions.
It's not a bad idea for you to train by yourself to reach Level 30.
Okay, did that help you with your training?
I don't think you have gathered up all the Gold Stingers yet.
You have yet to reach Level 30. Only those that have met the level requirement can handle the truth. You should train more diligently and get to Level 30. Would you mind if I offered you some help?
Okay, now I want you to go slay 50 Scorpions and 50 Sand Rats in 30 minutes.
It's not a bad idea for you to train by yourself to reach Level 30.
Okay, did that help you with your training?
I don't think you have eliminated them all yet.
You have yet to reach Level 30. Only those that have met the level requirement can handle the truth. You should train more diligently and get to Level 30. Would you mind if I offered you some help?
Okay. Every time you defeat a Sand Mole, the Sand Mole will drop a Sand Mole Hat. Can you collect 80 of them for me?
It's not a bad idea for you to train by yourself to reach Level 30.
Okay, did that help you with your training?
I don't think you have gathered enough Sand Mole Hats yet.

Hello, #b#h0##k. I called you here because I had a favor to ask. Since you've gone on many adventures before, you might have already been to this place... Have you ever been to the #bKerning City's Abandoned Construction Site#k?

There's an old station building that has ceased construction. Lately, I have received reports that a flurry of monsters have been roaming around the area. #e#bMr. Lim#k#n was sent there to assess the damage, but he just sent word that he needs another person to help and requests that I send someone dependable.
#b#h0##k, you're the most dependable person I know here, so I'd like for you to go and see what's going on. Will you help me?

Thank you so much for agreeing to do this without any hesitation. Please head east from Kerning City and follow the path to the #bAbandoned Construction Site#k.\r\n\r\nThe construction site is a huge area, but you'll be able to find an entrance to the #bAbandoned Subway Station#k somewhere. Please tell Mr. Lim that I sent you.
You must be busy helping someone else. That's too bad, because I can't think of anyone else who could do this job.
Only authorized personnel beyond this point! The area is still under construction, and it's very dangerous.\r\n#b#L0#I'm #h0#, and Jake sent me here to help you.#l\n#k

Jake sent you? Then you're here to help me investigate the platform, right? Awesome! I've been waiting for you. Now I can breathe a sigh of relief. It's nearly impossible for me to investigate this huge platform by myself.

Anyway, I'd like for you to stop by every now and then and see if anything's going on. Once you've successfully done that, I'll give you #b#t4001321##k as a reward. Train 999 is the area where you'll find a number of special Bubblings. Those Bubblings tend to gather up shiny, useful items, which means you might be able to get some of them through drops. I'll be seeing you often here. Good luck!

Thank you so much for agreeing to do this without any hesitation. Please head east from Kerning City and follow the path to the #bAbandoned Construction Site#k.\r\n\r\nThe construction site is a huge area, but you'll be able to find an entrance to the #bAbandoned Subway Station#k somewhere. Please tell Mr. Lim that I sent you.
Hiya! I'm #p1061019#. I'm traveling the land, learning the way of the sword.
My whole family is made up of swordsmen. It's a tradition. I'm going to follow in my brother's footsteps and break the Balrog, all by myself!
Um... do you have a moment to spare?

I got down to the #eCursed Temple#n entrance deep inside Sleepywood. It's really spooky down there! Anyway, there was this #badventurer who had collapsed#k! I wasn't strong enough to pull him out myself.
The adventurer was conked out in front of Another Door. You should probably take him this medicine.
Oh, okay, I guess we can just let him die then.
Ugh...W-who are you? I can't move my legs... do you have some medicine on you?
Thank you... my name is #bGwin#k and I think I owe you my life. I just need to rest a little longer. \r\nWas it that boy, Ilji, who sent you here? Then I have two life debts to pay...
Take this to the injured adventurer, quick! He seemed to be in a lot of pain.
Ugh... do you have a-anything for the pain?
You almost forgot the medicine!
I know I'm just digging myself a hole here, but I don't guess you could do me a favor?
I lost my #bbag#k when I got ambushed and I need it back. Do you think you could get it back from the Wild Kargos in the temple?
I get it, I get it. You've done enough already...
Did you find the bag?
I'm so glad you got it back. This thing has my whole life in it. Looks like nothing's...\n#b(Gwin suddenly shuts up.)#k
Defeat the Wild Kargos at the Temple Entrance and find my #bbag#k please.
The key! Where is it?

The Cursed Temple houses a dangerous being. I was watching the #o7130101# and #o7130100# monsters and they seemed to be guarding something. It led me to a Hidden Entrance deep within. As soon as I'd located the key, I got caught. That's when I lost my bag.
Don't you want to find out what's down there?
The #o7130101# or #o7130100# beasts must have taken that key back. I hope you're strong enough to get it back.
Are you... scared?
Any luck finding the key?
A dark evil lurks here.\r\nI just know the Cursed Temple holds more secrets. Thanks for helping me get back on my feet.
Retrieve the #bKey to the Forgotten Shrine#k from #o7130101# or #o7130100# monsters.
Are you heading back to Sleepywood?
Could you take this to #bIlji#k for me? It's my diary. I think a boy like that could use a little direction and I'd like to think my words will help.
It's about time I got going. Maybe we'll see each other again one day. Thanks for taking that diary to Ilji.
I'm doing okay now. Thanks again for saving my hide.
What happened to that injured guy? Is he okay?
Whoa, the diary of a great warrior! I'm gonna read the whole thing and get super strong!
You haven't gone back to Sleepywood yet? Please be sure to take my diary to Ilji.
Huh? I thought you were gonna give me something. No fair teasing!
You must be ready to get outta here. You almost forgot to take the diary! Please, take this to Ilji.

Hello, my name is Blake and I'm a public service worker in charge of Kerning Square's Lost and Found. Currently, my job is to find lost belongings and return them to their owners, but I have bigger and better things planned. Would you like to hear my dream?

My dream is to become a famous singer and perform at the new concert hall in Kerning Square! I had an audition with Big Hit Records, and I just know the CEO will give me a chance to perform there one of these days. I'm on duty so could you, #b#h0##k, talk to #bLana#k of Big Hit Records and put in a good word? She's out shopping today.
I have a dream!

Are you here to become a star? But your sense of style is all wrong. Tsk. \r\n#L0##b(How rude! If it weren't for Blake... Argh...) No, I am not here to be a star, ahem. I'm here for Blake, the public service worker at the subway station in Kerning Square.#l\n#k
Oh, right. Blake. That boy's got talent. \r\n#L0##bBlake says his dream is to perform in Kerning Square. Could you give him a chance?#l\n#k
Hm, I'll have to think about it. I'm not sure he's ready to make his debut just yet.
Give me some time to think.
You haven't talked to Lana, the CEO of Big Hit Records, yet? I'm sure you'll find her if you go up those stairs and enter the Shopping Center.

Alright. I've decided that Blake has what it takes to become a star. But he needs to put in a lot of work first, and I've got a ton of stuff going on. With your help, things would move faster. What do you say?

Okay. First you must convince #bRobby Fray#k, the seven star chef, to be in charge of cooking for the party after the performance. People who come to see my productions deserve nothing but the best, and that includes food.
Ah, I see. You want to become the star and make your debut instead of Blake, right? I could tell you were the conniving sort.

Are you here to taste, nay, to EXPERIENCE my art? Better get in line then.\r\n#L0##b(You explain that you're here on behalf of Blake.) In conclusion...I was wondering if you, the most famous and talented chef in the world, the one and only Robby Fray, would be willing to cater the party immediately following Blake's performance!#l\n#k
Ah, that boy's voice makes me want to do a little dance. He's really quite talented. I'd be thrilled to help. One talent deserves another, am I right? But I have a favor to ask.
Will you do a favor for me? Think about it and let me know.
I simply must have the best. If you don't convince #bRobby Fray#k to cater the reception, the deal's off.
You're back. Naturally, you are here to say you'll do me this favor, hmm?

All right then! I need #b15 Cherry Bubbles! 15 Melon Bubbles! And 15 Mango Bubbles!#k On the double! Then, my specialty cocktails will be ready for the party! They will be marvelous! Just marrrrvelous! Oh yes, er, take the escalator to the 1st-2nd floor of the Shopping Center to find the Bubble Teas.
I won't cater Blake's debut party if you don't agree to do this for me. I tell you, I won't. I refuse!
Here, quick! Hand those fresh ingredients to me. Heehee!
Superb! With this, I'll be able to whip up those fruity, delicious drinks I mentioned earlier. OH NOOO! Something awful, no, something just so utterly TERRIBLE has happened! Oh, tragedy!
Take the escalator to the 1st-2nd floor of the Shopping Center, and bring me #b15 Cherry Bubbles, 15 Melon Bubbles, and 15 Mango Bubbles#k by hunting Bubble Teas. Quickly now!
Oh no! If this secret is leaked... I can't even bear to think of it. Hey, you there! Don't just stand there, I need your help!

I lost my secret recipe! It was sooo yummy and now everybody's going to find out! I think I lost it when I was playing the Doll Claw game on the #r3rd - 4th Floors of Kerning Square#k. Please, please find it! I'll go out of business if this gets out!
If I don't find my Secret Recipe, there is no way I can continue living, let alone cater #bBlake#k's party...
Oh, please tell me you found my Secret Recipe! Please!

Oh, thank goodness! That's it! Oh, my precious recipe, my baby. Thank you so much. I will take care of Blake's party as promised. Don't worry about a thing. It'll be magnificent. Please let #bLana#k the CEO of Big Hit Records know.
Take the escalator to the 3rd-4th floor of the Shopping Center. When you get there, defeat the Dolls and bring me back my precious #b#t4032508##k! I beg you!
Are you serious? You really convinced Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to cater the party? Delightful! We're set for the debut party then. Ready for the next thing on the list?

Excellent. Next, we need a makeup artist. I'm sure you've noticed that Blake needs a miracle to make his face star-worthy. Don't give me that look...it's the way the business goes! Anyway, #bTina#k, who just opened a beauty salon in Kerning Square, can work makeup miracles. Convince her to work with Blake. Drop my name if you have to. She should come crawling then.
Weren't you the one that begged me to give Blake a chance?

Welcome, welcome! You must have heard people raving about what an amaaaazing makeup artist I am. What time was your appointment?\r\n#L0##bI don't have an appointment. I'm here to see if you'd be willing to work with Blake on his debut performance. The CEO of Big Hit Records recommended you.#l\n#k

Blake? You mean Blake at the subway station? Why, I'd love to help him. But I just opened my shop, and I have a ton of things to take care of... Hmm, if you help me on a few things, I'll do Blake's makeup. What do you say?
Think about it for a bit and let me know what you decide.
Convince #bTina#k the makeup artist to help us! If you tell her I've personally requested her, she'll beg to be allowed the job.
#b#h0##k. You wanted me to help with Blake's makeup, right? Will you help me with a few things first?

Great! I'd really like to give out some small gifts to get people into my new shop! I think some key chains and dolls would be perfect! Maybe I'll need #b20 Yeti Key chains, 20 Jr. Pepe Key chains, and 20 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k? The Doll Claw Games on the #r3rd-4th floors of Kerning Square#k would be your best bet.
Did you talk to me just to tell me you refuse to help? Strange person...
Have you brought all the things I've asked for? Let me see them.
Perfect. As promised, I will do Blake's makeup. Please let Lana, the CEO of Big Hit Records, know. Oh, and could you also thank her for the gig?
Please bring me #b20 Yeti Keychains, 20 Jr. Pepe Keychains, and 20 Orange Mushroom Dolls#k. You can find a lot of #rDoll Claw Games#k on the 3rd-4th floors of Kerning Square.\r\n
So? Did Tina agree to the job?\r\n#L0##bYes, Tina the makeup artist has agreed to take the job. She also wanted me to thank you for the gig.#l\n#k
I knew she'd agree, ha. Okay! Next on the list is...getting a hair stylist. You can do it, can't you?
I must have Marshall do Blake's hair. None of my stars get in front of an audience until Marshall's had his way with their hair. Please convince #bMarshall#k to help.
What, you don't think you can do it? This should be easy...
