If there is an eyewitness, the Dark Lord won't be able to deny his crime. Your mission is to find someone who witnessed the death of the former Dark Lord.

Since the incident happened awhile back, this task won't be easy. Your best bet is to talk with older people. Perhaps you can try Mr. Pickall, since his business involves dealing with lots of different people and he should be well aware of what goes on. Oh, and you can report the results of this mission directly to Lady Syl.
Why are you so nervous? Being nervous isn't going to help you with this mission.

I heard that you were handling this mission. Were you able to find any eyewitnesses?\r\n#L0##bI met and spoke with Manji in Perion since he knows Tristan, who was a friend of the former Dark Lord. I figured he might know something about the former Dark Lord.#l\n#k

Yes, I suppose that's reasonable. So, what did he say?\r\n#L0##bHe said that the former Dark Lord went to the Cursed Sanctuary upon Tristan's request to join in the battle against Balrog. Unfortunately, they were somehow separated, and by the time Tristan and Manji arrived, the former Dark Lord had already passed away.#l\n#k
So...did he see anything?\r\n#L0##bManji said that when he got there...he was there...covered in blood...#l\n#k
By 'he' you mean...\r\n#L0##bA boy named Jin...#l\n#k
Hmph! It really was him! Jin was the culprit behind the death... Now, the time has come for vengeance!
I need to be alone right now. Please leave.

Since the incident happened awhile back, your best bet is to talk with older people. Perhaps you can try Mr. Pickall, since his business involves dealing with lots of different people and he should be well aware of what goes on. Oh, and you can report the results of this mission directly to Lady Syl.

Since the incident happened awhile back, your best bet is to talk with older people. Perhaps you can try Mr. Pickall, since his business involves dealing with lots of different people and he should be well aware of what goes on. Oh, and you can report the results of this mission directly to Lady Syl.
Any updates on your mission? I hope to see some results soon.

Oh, hello! Long time no see! What brings you here today? Did you discover a treasure chest or something?\r\n#L0##bYou know how we spoke about the former Dark Lord before? Well, I was hoping you'd tell me more...#l\n#k

Hmm... Why so curious? It's not the most pleasing of subjects. But if you must... Well, to be quite frank, I really don't know much. I do know that the former Dark Lord was good friends with Tristan. In fact, Tristan came to Kerning City once in order to meet the former Dark Lord. Why don't you try talking to #bManji in Perion#k? He is close to Tristan, so he might also be able to shed some light on the former Dark Lord.
Manji resides at the highest cliff in Perion, so he won't be hard to find.
Besides Manji, I have no clue who else could help.
What is it? If it is not a matter of life and death, please do not disturb my meditation.\r\n#L0##bWell, in fact, it is... There is something I need to ask you.#l\n#k
Alright, since it is so urgent. What is your question? \r\n#L0##bAre you familiar with the former Dark Lord?#l\n#k
The former Dark Lord? Who are you, and what gives you the right to ask me?\r\n#L0##bI am asking on behalf of his daughter.#l\n#k

His daughter...? Very well. I will tell you what I know. I cannot, however, promise that what I reveal is accurate. Even I am not fully certain about the events of that day... \r\n#L0##bI understand.#l\n#k

As I recall, Tristan and I were headed on a journey towards the Cursed Sanctuary in order to seal up Balrog, who had resurrected. Knowing the gravity of the task before us, we decided to request aid from the former Dark Lord. We were to convene before the battle, but unfortunately, we were delayed in our passage through the Burnt Lands, as the Boars in the area had become more violent. Upon our arrival at the Cursed Sanctuary, we discovered that the Dark Lord had died...with a boy covered in blood standing next to the body. He held a sword in one hand. That is all that I know...

The boy didn't say a word about what he saw. He simply stated his name, Jin, before leaving with the former Dark Lord's lifeless body. And that was it. Since then, I have not heard a thing about the boy or the former Dark Lord. Tristan will always be remembered for sacrificing his life to seal Lord Balrog, and here I am... I've told you all that I know. Now go, I'm feeling tired... If you have anything else to say, why don't you go talk to that daughter of his...?
Manji resides at the highest cliff in Perion, so he won't be hard to find.

Ever since you told me Manji's story, I haven't been able to get any sleep. I've been consumed with thoughts of an all-out war against the Dark Lord! I will make him shed tears of repentance...! But before that, I must ask something of you. You won't refuse, will you?

Inside the Jazz Bar, where the Dark Lord resides, there is a secret room. Within that room lies the last remaining article left by my father. It's his #bDiary#k. Please go there and return with the Diary before the entire place is engulfed in war. \r\nTo enter the secret room, you'll have to enter through a small door towards the back of the #bJazz Bar#k counter. Be careful and make sure that the Dark Lord doesn't see you.
You seemed determined to oppose me. If I call for a war, this involves all Dual Blades. Don't you understand that?
I told you to come back when you're Lv. 30.

#e[Training Center 3], [Shadow Blade Lord], [70]

Hello, #b#h0##k... Ever since Sister Syl read the former Dark Lord's diary, she's confined herself to her room and won't come out. I guess she needs time to figure things out. Before the Dark Lord's passing, Sister Syl and Jin were very close... She was torn and confused when he suddenly became the object of her wrath.

Now, she's discovered that her anger was all based on false beliefs... I am worried that Sister Syl will lose all motivation for life. I'd like to help her by giving her a gift. Would you kindly help me?

Lady Syl enjoys Yellow Tulips as much as she enjoys taking care of potted plants. The Fire Boars that live in the Burnt Land are said to carry Yellow Tulips. Please bring me #b20 Yellow Tulips#k from the Fire Boars.
I'm so worried. Sister Syl hasn't been eating anything.
Wow! I'm sure these fresh tulips will help Sister Syl regain her energy. Thank you so much! If the opportunity arises, I'll do what I can to help you as well, #h0#.
Please let me know if you ever need my help. I really would like to repay you.
The Fire Boars that live in the Burnt Land carry Yellow Tulips. Please bring me #b20 Yellow Tulips#k from the Fire Boars.

I seem to have neglected my duties for too long. I'm still confused as to what I should believe, but I have been thinking about it much since you left. No, I'm not ready to meet the Dark Lord just yet, but I have been wondering about the future of the Dual Blades.

I've been so focused on the Dark Lord that I've ignored the Dual Blades who have stayed hidden in the shadows. I think it's about time that the Dual Blades received some proper recognition. Please go see #bArec#k at El Nath.
If we can earn his recognition, a new future will open up for the Dual Blades. Please go see him as our official messenger.
Do you need time to think about your life as a Dual Blade? Well, I trust that you will return in time...
I sense a strange connection. Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI've come as a representative of the Dual Blades.#l\n#k

Ah yes, the Dual Blades... I have heard about your group. A different type of thieves, a group born out of hate... So, what business do you have with me?\r\n#L0##bI have come that we might gain your recognition.#l\n#k

Gain my recognition? You stand in direct opposition to the current Dark Lord, the rightful successor. How is it that you expect my recognition?\r\n#L0##bEverything was based on a misunderstanding. We acknowledge our mistakes and will put an end to that. Instead, we look forward to a new future in a different direction.#l\n#k
A new future...interesting. If that is truly the case, then I will give you a chance.
If we can earn his recognition, a new future will open up for the Dual Blades. Please go see him as our official messenger.
If you pass my test, I will officially recognize you and the Dual Blades. Receiving my recognition will help you launch the new future as you so desire. Will you accept my test?

The #bWhite Fangs#k that live in the snow fields of El Nath are known as the white hunters, because they are dangerously violent. Many residents of El Nath have fallen victim to them. Go hunt #b100 White Fangs#k and bring back #b50 White Fang Tails#k. This will be your test.
If you refuse my test, I will not officially recognize you. You will regret denying this rare opportunity.

Well, you have done it. Syl is lucky to have people like you. I have no choice but to recognize you and the Dual Blades on behalf of your effort and determination. Just don't let this get to your pride...

The #bWhite Fangs#k that live in the snow fields of El Nath are known as the white hunters, because they are dangerously violent. Many residents of El Nath have fallen victim to them. Go hunt 100 White Fangs and bring back #b50 White Fang Tails#k. This will be your test.
Deliver this letter to Syl. You seem curious about its content. Be patient, as you will find out once you deliver it to Syl.
I wish you a safe return to Victoria Island. I suggest that you reach Lv. 55 before returning to Syl.
Are you refusing the reward of your effort?
Don't forget to level up to 55...
Please deliver my letter to Syl.
Have you received Arec's answer?
Did you lose the letter that I gave you? You are more careless than I thought. I will write you another, but be careful not to lose it this time.
Oh, and do you think you can do one more favor for me? The #bStumps#k are starting to cause some problems. They are typically docile, but once in a while they get themselves into trouble.

Please go teach those Stumps a lesson. If you go to #bCaution Falling Down#k, you'll see #bPower B. Fore#k, who helps low level Thieves. He'll let you into the Thief Training Center, where you'll be able to find the #bStumps#k.
I was just starting to feel comfortable with you. Now, I am quite disappointed.
Have you taken care of them already? You are stronger than I expected.
I look forward to your future development. Please continue to work on behalf of the thieves.
It looks like you haven't taken care of the #bStumps#k yet. Is this too difficult of a job for you?
It's still too soon to feel safe, as there are many more seals remaining. Are you ready for your next mission?
Okay, eliminate the #b#o1210103#s#k and bring back #b5 #t4032621#s#k. You should be able to find the Bubblings near the #bEllinia Chimney Tree#k.
Stop acting like a coward! You've done fine on the other missions, so Lady Syl won't accept your chickening out now.
Did you bring the #t4032621#s?
Good, you're doing very well. You're completing the missions faster now. I'm proud of you.
Recover #b5 #t4032621:#s#k. Hurry!
Thanks to you, our withdrawal plans are going well. Are you prepared for your next mission?
This time, you'll have to take care of the #bStirges#k. Eliminate them and bring back #b5 #t4032623:#s#k. You should be able to find the Stirges at the Kerning City Subway Transfer Area. Now, hurry!
What? You want to forfeit? Think about the future of the Dual Blades! You must complete this mission!
Aah, have you recovered all of the #b#t4032623#s#k?
You did a great job. To be quite frank, I didn't expect this much out of you.
You haven't brought #b5 #t4032623:#s#k yet. I know you can do it! Come on!
This is the last mission. If you are successful, we'll be ready for the withdrawal. Are you ready?
This time, it's the #bDark Stumps#k. You'll find them near Perion's #bNorth Rocky Mountain area#k. Eliminate some of them and bring back #b5 #t4032624:#s#k
Why are you so nervous? Being nervous isn't going to help you with this mission.
At last, we are finally ready. Please hand over the last seals.

Okay, let's split. I need to return the seals. You should be hearing some good news soon. ...What good news? Are you naive or just plain dumb? You'll be an official Dual Blade soon! Anyways, gotta go. See you later.
I told you #b5 #t4032624:#s#k. Did you not hear me? Hurry, there isn't much time!
I just wonder why he never comes out of the Jazz Bar. Maybe he's active only when everyone is asleep? \r\n#L0##bI don't really know.#l\n#k

His mysteriousness certainly adds to his charm, but it also makes me wonder if there is some secret that he is keeping. Not that it would bother me if he did, because I like finding out about other people's secrets. Say, do you think you can find out something for me?
People around town have been talking about the thieving Spores, and I'd like to know what that's all about... Could you ask #bJM From tha Streetz#k for me?
I've told you so much, and you won't even do this little favor for me?

Yo! Whatcha like to know? I've been around the block a few times, so I can tell when someone is sniffing for some info!\r\n#L0##bIt's really nothing big... I just thought you might know something about the thieving Spores.#l\n#k
For real? You came to me just to ask me that?
The thieving Spores were nothing more than a few scoundrels that used to go around pulling pranks.
I think you should ask #bJM From tha Streetz#k about the thieving Spores.

Then suddenly, they started stealing things. We're talking about five-finger discounts here and there. But it's weird, because no one seems to know exactly what they stole. Word on tha street is that they recently stole something belonging to the Dark Lord. That's probably the reason he's so eager to catch them....

I find it interesting, too, that the Dark Lord won't say what was stolen. Whatever the case, there are a few people around town who aren't too happy with the Dark Lord for not being able to catch them. They just wouldn't tell you face to face.
That's all the info I got for ya. What...? You want to know the Dark Lord's age?
Well, in that case, you oughta talk to #bMr. Pickall#k. He might know the Dark Lord's age.
Did I hear you wrong? If you don't need anything, go away!
You have something you want to say to me? What is it?\r\n#L0##bHow old is the Dark Lord?#l\n#k

The Dark Lord's age? Heh, funny thing is, you're not the first to ask. Well, before I answer, let me clarify. Some people from out of town think that there's only been one Dark Lord, but that's not the case. The Dark Lord, in fact, is a title that refers to the master of Kerning City.
I thought I told you to ask #bMr. Pickall#k for the Dark Lord's age.

The current Dark Lord is the eighth one appointed, if I'm not mistaken. This is the disciple who took over after the former Dark Lord disappeared. So, all of that means that the current Dark Lord isn't very old.

Come to think of it, the disappearance of the former Dark Lord still remains a mystery. He just suddenly disappeared one day. He also had a daughter, but she disappeared, too. It was really, very strange. \r\n
Hey, aren't you #h0#, the person that Ryden has been searching for?
I'm sure of it. You need to go see #bRyden#k. It seemed quite urgent.
I'm certain of it, #h0#. Ryden was looking for you!

Okay, great. So, what did the people think?\r\n#L0##bIn general, most people trust the Dark Lord, but there were some who seem to have doubts about the thieving Spore incident, not to mention the former Dark Lord who just randomly disappeared...#l\n#k
That's very useful information. Even the strongest wall can crumble because of a small crack. You've done a good job on this mission. Now, wait until you're assigned the next mission.
Let's act like total strangers in the meantime. People might get suspicious if they saw us conversing.
#bRyden#k has been anxiously looking for you.
Oh, what should I do?\r\n#L0##bWhat's wrong? Has something happened?#l\n#k

I'm really worried... Lady Syl hasn't been able to get any sleep these days, because of all the Wraiths that torment her dreams. I have to keep watch here, so why don't you go put those Wraiths to sleep?
The Wraiths seem to be giving Lady Syl nightmares. If you go deep inside Kerning City's Subway, you'll be able to find the #bWraiths#k. Go there and eliminate them.
If you can't make all of them fall asleep, maybe you should eliminate #r10 Wraiths#k to send them a message. Of course, that's your decision.
You must not care at all about Lady Syl.
Were you able to make all the Wraiths fall asleep? Of course, you could have just eliminated some of them, as well.
Well, thank you for your hard work. Have a nice drink of this potion.
If you can't make all of them fall asleep, maybe you should eliminate #r10 Wraiths#k to send them a message. You should be able to find them deep inside the Kerning City Subway.
#h0#! Have you heard the rumor already? All of the Stirges were eliminated, but Lady Syl is still not able to sleep. I think it's because she's grown so weak. We should prepare a tonic for her.

There is an old recipe for a tonic that's been used for generations by the people of Kerning City. It's a tonic made by boiling octopus legs. It's been said that this tonic, made by boiling octopus legs for three straight days and nights, can even make a dead person come to life!
Please bring me #b10 Octopus Legs#k, so that I can make her a tonic. Go to the Construction Site to the right and you'll be able to find a bunch of Octopuses.
If Lady Syl becomes ill, all of our efforts will be for naught!
You've collected the Octopus Legs already? Please give them to me.

Wow, I've never seen such fresh Octopus Legs! Now, all I have to do is to boil them for 3 days and 3 nights. Remember, the most important thing in making tonics is using fresh ingredients and putting a lot of care into it!
There should be a lot of #rOctopuses#k at the Construction Site to your right. Go get me #b10 Octopus Legs#k.
#h0#, I'm glad you're here. \r\n#L0##bIs something wrong?#l\n#k
I just realized that the most important ingredients in a tonic are herbs. Can you bring me some herbs while I keep my eyes on the tonic?

Take the portal at the right side of Kerning City and pass the Six Path Crossway to reach Perion's Dusty Wind Hill, where you'll find the Dark Stumps. Hunt the #rDark Stumps#k and bring back #b10 Leaves#k. You must do it before the tonic is finished.
But the tonic can't be completed without the herbs...
Oh, you've returned! I was busy stoking the fire, because the embers were getting too cool. Quick, give me the herbs.
Aah, this should do it. Now, I need to bring it to Lady Syl. I will have a new mission for you soon so come see me again.

Take the portal at the right side of Kerning City and pass the Six Path Crossway to reach Perion's Dusty Wind Hill, where you'll find the Dark Stumps. Hunt the #rDark Stumps#k and bring back #b10 Leaves#k.

I suggest you train a bit more at the Training Center, where you can become even more formidable. I'll teach you how to get to the Training Center. Are you interested?

That's great! Go outside, and you'll see a series of arrows pointing in a certain direction. Follow them and you'll see the entrance to the Training Center, where you can train to become even more powerful!
I suggest you go there before you reach Level 20, because you won't be allowed inside afterwards.
Ah, really? Well, the Training Center can be found nearby, so maybe you can find it on your own. Best of luck to you!

Did you need some information? Or...are you here to do me a favor?
My request is simple. I need a weapon. Don't worry, I don't need anything fancy. I just need to be able to defend myself.
The life of an information dealer is dangerous... In fact, I'm constantly getting attacked by this monster or that disgruntled client. I was hoping to learn how to at least protect myself.

I'm thinking of getting an #bAxe Pole Arm#k. It doesn't have to be especially good, but I'd like something better than what you can get in the shops. Something made just for me! Of course, if you're not a Blacksmith, you could always buy it from one.
Hmm...strange. Was my intel wrong...?
Oh, is that my new Axe Pole Arm? Let me see it! HI-YAH!
ACK! This...this is heavier than it looks! The person I saw using this earlier twirled it around with such ease... Ugh. I can't swing this thing! Well, thanks anyway.
Were you able to find an #bAxe Pole Arm#k yet? If you really can't find one, you can just buy it from a merchant.
*Huff...huff...* No matter how hard I train, I don't think I'll ever get the hang of this Pole Arm. How you adventurers can swing weapons like this around, I'll never know.

So, I've decided the Bow is the weapon for me. I haven't been able to train with it yet, though... I realized that there's something I'm missing before I can become a proper archer. Mind giving me a hand?
I need gloves if I'm going to use a bow. I tried it barehanded, but the bowstring hurts my hands! Maybe you could get me some #bRed Moon Gloves#k? If possible, I'd like ones that are custom made.
You're refusing me...? Dang. Maybe I should just hire a bodyguard...
Oh, those look great! Okay, let's see how they fit...
Ah, sorry, sorry! I wasn't aiming for your head, I swear! I was aiming in the opposite direction... Well, at least my hands don't hurt! Thank you so much!
Still no #bRed Moon Gloves#k? Hmm...

Whew... I can use my brain all day long, but my body is another matter. I gave up archery after I broke Jane's hair band. Maybe I should just settle for some good armor. Mind taking on another job for me?
Great! I'd like a #bBlue Oriental Helmet#k for my head. For my body, let's keep it simple with a #bBlack Royal Barone#k, and for my feet... I'm thinking about wearing #bSapphire Camel Boots#k.
Really...? Hm, I suppose you think I'm not even competent enough to put on a tin suit...
Oh, that's all the armor! Please, leave it right there. I'll try it on later...
*Huff...Huff...* Maybe I should ask Puo for training or something...
#b(Tru looks as if he's given up. Just let him be.)
You have the armor I asked for? It shouldn't be THAT hard to find...
Sure, it's true I can talk, but it doesn't mean I want to! People always stop to chat when they pass by, just because they're bored. It's so annoying!
They all talk down to me, no matter what I say. It's obvious, really: They look down on me because I'm so short! Maybe they'd leave me alone if I grew taller.
Well, I won't get any taller just sitting here. All the other trees block the sun. But you humans, you're always drinking those weird potions. Those should help!
Bring me 10 #bHealth Potions (1000)#k and 10 #bMana Potions (1000)#k. If you pour those over my soil, I'll get taller, and you pesky humans will stop hassling me all the time!
But where do you find such potions? I hear you can't find them in shops. Maybe you know someone who can craft them. If you don't, just make them yourself! What's a little Alchemy to a human like you?
Hmph. So, you're one of THOSE people.
Do you have my potions? Please, pour, pour!
*Gulp...gulp...* Well, is it working? Am I taller? No? But I heard they work right away... Could it be they only work on humans?
Hm, maybe it just takes longer for trees. Thanks for trying, anyway.
Where are my potions? I hear they aren't in General Stores. Maybe only Alchemists can make them.
So, potions didn't make me any taller... The other trees are so tall. Why aren't I growing? I've thought about this long and hard, and I figured it out.
I'm too smart! The other trees just stand there and can't even talk, but I can talk and think. That's got to be it, right?

Well, if I can't make myself taller, I'll make the other trees shorter! If I feed them Intelligence Potions, they'll become smarter, and then they'll be as short as me! Okay, I need an Intelligence Potion II.
I heard that #bIntelligence Potions II#k can only be made by an Alchemist... Surely you know an Alchemist, right?
Hmm... What's your theory then? Maybe you should leave the thinking to me.
Do you have it? Thank you! Okay, just pour it all over!
If there are more talking trees, you humans might leave me alone for once.
No #bIntelligence Potion II#k yet? If you drank one yourself, you might know that you need Alchemy skill to craft it. Why don't you just buy one from an Alchemist?
Hm. They're...not talking. Why? Why can't any of them talk? Why am I doomed to be the only intelligent tree?
Just...just forget it! No matter what I do, I can't grow taller or make the other trees shorter. I hate being a tree! I wish I was something else!

I hear that Alchemists can make all sorts of things. I hear they even make potions that can transform you into different kinds of creatures. I want to be a Green Mushroom! Bring me a #bGreen Mushroom Transform Potion#k!
Sure, that's easy for you to say, you...Walky McLeggerson!
Is that the Green Mushroom Transform Potion? Give it, give it! I'll drink it and shed this tortured arboreal existence!
I...I'd like to do this on my own. Thank you for everything. Now go away.
What, no #bGreen Mushroom Transform Potion#k? Get your Alchemist friend to help me out!
If you're not too busy, could you help me?
Thank you so much for agreeing to help. I hope I'm not bothering you too much.
The number of visitors to Florina Beach has decreased so much... I think the #b#o1210104#s#k that live in #bBlue Ribbon Beach#k are scaring them all away.
I was hoping you could eliminate about #b50 #o1210104#s#k. Thank you so much.
I'm really sorry to bother you...
You've defeated #b50 #o1210104#s#k. Thank you so much. Now the visitors will feel safe!
Thank you so much for your help. Now all the visitors will be safe on Florina Beach.
There are still some #b#o1210104#s#k left, and they're scaring away all the visitors. Please take care of them.
Hey human! I have some more work for you if you're interested. It's not hard.
Remember that mean teacher I told you about earlier? Well, that teacher assigned me some homework, and now I have to research #bFairies#k and #bRoyal Fairies#k.
But I'm so busy right now, I just don't have time to do it. Good thing that #bDr. Betty#k is actually researching Fairies right now. Go talk to #bDr. Betty#k and borrow her #b#t04032801##k for me!
Why don't I go her myself? I just told you! I'm busy!
Heh, whatever. That's fine if you don't want to help. I'll just find someone else!
What are you waiting for? Go borrow #bDr. Betty's#k #b#t04032801##k!
Thank you. I need #b#t4000068#s#k and #b#t4000620#s#k. Please bring me #b30 of each#k. Thank you so much.
Don't you need #b#t04032801##k?
Wing sent you? Oh no, I'm still working on my research, and I just ran out of Fairy samples. If you bring me some samples, I should be able to complete the research...
#b30 #t4000068#s#k and #b30 #t4000620#s#k. You haven't forgotten, right?
You've brought the samples? I'll be able to continue my research with these!
Please give me a moment. Let me complete the research and create a report.
Thank you so much for your help. I was able to conduct some interesting research regarding Fairies.
Here is the #b#t4032801##k. Please tell Wing to give it back to me after reading it. I'll see you later. I have so much more research to conduct!
I've completed the report. Will you deliver it to #bWing#k for me?
What took you so long? I'm running out of time! Give it to me quickly!
Shall I give it a read?
I don't understand this! Why is the human language so hard to comprehend? I can't make sense of this!
Oh well... I'll just have to do it myself...
Go away now! I'll return the report when I have time!
Please deliver the report to #bWing#k.
Report? What are you talking about?
You lost the report? Fine, I'll write it for you again. Please don't lose it this time.

There is going to be a festival at the Magic School, and I'm in charge of the mural. I'll need to use my #bSpecial Paint#k to draw the mural, since Regular Paint runs too easily.
Unfortunately, I'm all out of yellow and green paint. I really need them to complete this mural, and time is running out! I need to complete the picture before the other paint dries...
I need #b#t4000007#s#k and #b#t4000013#s#k. I'll need #b20#k of each to make enough paint. #t4000007#s and #t4000013#s can be found in the #bNorth Forest#k.\r\n
I guess I shouldn't have expected anything from a human.
You've brought all the ingredients! Please give them to me, so that I can make my paint.
Thank you, I can make my paint now. Please take this. It should help you in your adventure.
I'll have to excuse myself so that I can go make the paint. Thank you...

There are some things you must know before I can give you an airplane. Listen carefully.
First, airplanes are very new to Maple World. They are similar to mounts, but you can ride them to distant continents. Just not all continents, okay?

You can fly to #bVictoria Island, Ereve, Edelstein, Ludibrium, Ariant, Mu Lung, or Leafre#k from #bOrbis#k, using the airplane. You can also fly the opposite route, of course. Lastly, you can fly to #bVictoria Island#k from #bEdelstein#k, and vice-versa. These are the only locations you can take an airplane to... The others are a bit too dangerous yet...
If you want to head to another continent, you need to speak with a member of the Station staff first. If they have an available airplane, they will offer you that, or a space on a regular ship.

Right, introductions. Let's do this. I'm Cutter, shipwrecked pirate extraordinaire. Happened after a long stint as a master engineer on the fair #bNautilus#k.\r\n#L0##bYou're a pirate?#l\n#k

Indeed! Pirate by name, pirate by nature. However, I'm a perfectly civil sort of pirate. No walking planks or shivering me timbers or such around here. Nothing to fear from me, not at all.\r\n#L0##b(He certainly sounds nice enough.)#l\n#k

You want to know how I ended up here? Yes, I suppose there isn't too much else to discuss, is there? It's a long story, filled with action and drama. I suppose I could spare the time to tell it if you wanted... Okay, you don't have to twist my arm. Let's see here, it was a dark and stormy night...\r\n#L0##b(You never said a word.)#l\n#k
This is an extremely long story, so listen carefully.
Eh? What was that? Ghosts? Hm... Oh, are you not interested in my story anymore?

I was working aboard the Nautilus, at the time. I designed her, you know. That boat? All me, right here. I'm a weapons designer, you see. Best kind of engineering. Things blow up, but they're supposed to. Great excuse. I was serving under Captain Kyrin, working on a secret project for her.

She charged me with designing a new personal weapon that could make the pirates the most powerful fighters in Maple World. Can you imagine that? Pirates with a new super weapon? We'd have pirates everywhere, running the world. Free eye patches and rum for everyone! Good times.

I'll tell you, it wasn't an easy thing, but I never do things the easy way. Easy is boring. I challenged myself...and I DID IT! Oh, it was glorious. Perfect accuracy, high rate of fire, devastating damage. Thing of beauty. There was just one problem.

The darn thing was too heavy! All that perfection came at a price, and that price was all the extra plating and casing it needed. Strip that off, and it turns back into a regular pea-shooter. And let me tell you, pea-shooting does not make a super weapon.

But hey, I thought, I'm Cutter! I'm the best darn engineer in the fleet! So I got back to work, and sure enough, I solved my own problem. I got that sucker down to a tenth of it's original weight! Still a bit of a beast to hold, but better than nothing, right? So, says I, time for a little test.

I had to go out to sea to test it. I tried firing the first one at a brick wall and, well, there happened to be a barn about a mile past the wall... Anyway, sea's much safer. No sheep to explode. I hopped in one of our little boats and headed out into the deep sea.

The tests were beautiful. Glorious. It was the dawn of a new age of blowing things up. I was so excited...well, I didn't see the rocks until it was too late. I can only assume the boat was smashed to splinters.
I woke up on this island after...heck, I have no idea. Ahh, it's a cryin' shame, it is. I never even got to show Kyrin the working prototype. All that work... If I could only get off this island...

Right, that's my story! Now, how did YOU get here? You wreck your ship testing a new pirate super weapon too?\r\n#L0##bI was on my way to Maple Island for Explorer training, and... (You explain about Balrog, and skip the part about the monkey saving you.)#l\n#k

Hey, the island's not that bad. Plenty of food, no responsibilities... You're safe, too. I think the monkey's trained in first aid. Oh, come on, don't make that face! Look, I'll prove it to you. Let's have a pleasant first meal, eh? I just need you to head to the #bright side of the island#k.

When you go to the right side of the island, you'll see plenty of #rFloppy Starfish#k. Grab me a bunch of them, and we'll roast 'em up! Trust me, they taste better than they look. Or smell. If you whack #r10 Starfish#k, you should get at least#b3 Starfish Meats#k to bring me.
Look, you can get mad and pitch a fit, or you can chill with me. Either way, you're still stuck on this island.

You still don't have the #bStarfish Meat#k? How is that possible? #bRight side#k of the island! #rStarfish#k! Whack them!

Okay, so, we are without kindling to start a fire. I should have checked that earlier, but, ehh, whatever. Go get us some kindling, okay? Take #bthe portal on the top right of the cannon#k.\r\n#L0##bKindling? Where am I gonna find kindling in a place like this?#l\n#k

Well, if you stop fussing, I'll tell you. There are a mess of Oak Barrels washed up over there. The wood in the barrels is treated to stay dry, so it burn nicely. So, go smash 'em up and bring me the #b#t4032980#s#k you get from them. Makes sense, right? Good! Now go! This starfish ain't gonna roast itself! That would be pretty nice, though...

To obtain #t4032980#, whack the Oak Barrels with your #bRegular Attack#k. You bring me enough #b#t4032980##k, and I'll make you the best Roasted Starfish you've ever had while stranded on an island with a pirate and a monkey.
Look, we need kindling to roast the starfish. This isn't rocket science, kid. And trust me, you DON'T want to eat these raw. Tried that once. Not pretty.

Hey, you're here. Good for you. Y'know, I was probably too hard on you. I bet you could make a decent Explorer. Well, I'm sure you could, with my new weapon. That's okay, I've got just the job for you. Go see #b#p1091003##k, who's in charge of the ship's food, and see if she needs any help. She's probably in the #r#m120020000##k.
And you call yourself a Pirate? Shameful!

And who might you be? Oh, you're the newest Pirate, ain't ya? #p1090000# finally send someone to help me out? About time!\r\nLeave it to the cap'n to saddle me with a rookie like you. Still, I think I can put you to work.
Don't worry, I won't work you hard. Not too hard, anyway. And here, since you'll be helping me out, I want you to have this. I bet it'll look great on you.
Report to #b#p1091003##k in the #r#m120020000##k. And welcome to the Nautilus!

Now, I've got the perfect start job for you. I'm raising #r#o1210100#s#k to reprovision the ship, but the dang things won't listen to what I say. I think I need a strapping young Pirate to calm the #r#o1210100#s#k down. What do you say?
Make an example out of 30 #r#o1210100#s#k. That'll get the others to fall in line.
And don't slack off, or I'll report it straight to Cap'n #b#p1090000##k, you hear?
What do you mean, this ain't really an adventure? Beating up #o1210100#s is plenty adventurous, bucko!
Finished already? Heh. Maybe I took you too lightly, kiddo.
So you are a real Pirate after all. Of course, Cap'n #b#p1090000##k wouldn't took you on otherwise. Okay, the next mission'll really challenge you, I promise!
You gonna do the job, or ain't you? Don't bug me again until you've eliminated #r30 #o1210100#s#k!
I thought the pigs were a perfect match for you. Not that I'm calling you a pig! Har har!
This time, I want you to teach #r30#k #r#o1210101#s#k a lesson! See, those aren't just any ordinary pigs. They got ribbons, which makes them all kinds of classy! Now, get to it!\r\n
Those #r#o1210101#s#k are tougher than normal pigs, so look alive, or you'll be pig food. Complete this mission, though, and I'll give you a special gift.
You want me to tell the cap'n on you? She'll kick you off the Nautilus, rookie. A sad sight you'd be, a Pirate without a ship!
Back already? I hope the #r#o1210101#s#k gave you a good workout. Or were they still too easy for you?
Well, here's your gift! You like?
Remember, you're a Pirate now! We fight hard, and we loot hard! I got one more mission for you, when you're ready.
You gonna do the job, or ain't you? Don't bug me again until you've eliminated #r30 #o1210101#s#k!
We'll be eating good for weeks thanks to you! So, you ready for your next mission?
Great! Now, I bet you saw some pigs with pretty blue ribbons wrapped around them, right? Those pigs live on #bBlue Ribbon Beach#k, and they're the tastiest pigs you ever ate!
Hunt them down and bring me #r20 pieces of Pork#k so we can have a real feast!
Why not? It'll be fun this time! Really!
You got the Pork? Good. This'll fill the crew right up!
This is the stuff, all right. I can tell #r#o1210104##k meat apart from any other pork, easy.
You got me the Pork, but I can't just give it to the crew without any seasoning, right? Pirates are all about the seasoning!
Come on! It'll take at least 20 cuts of Pork to feed the crew.
Quality Pork like this needs the very best seasoning! Don't you agree?
I thought so. So, why don't you get me some?
I know just the stuff. Go to the #r#m120010000##k and get me #r1 #t04033063##k. You just have to harvest the plants there to get it.
Don't take too long, unless you wanna eat rancid Pork.
What, you wanna eat bland Pork? It's you're funeral! ...Somehow!
This Herb Leaf should do the task.\r\nYou pick herbs just as good as any Pirate I ever met!\r\n
I'd better get to cooking! Thanks to you, we're eating great tonight.
Just go to #r#m120010000##k and pick a #r#t4033063##k. Easy, right?
Hey, if you ain't too busy, mind giving me a hand? I was so busy cooking, I forgot to feed the cows. The PIRATE cows, that is\r\n
The Baby Cows get hungry real fast, too. If I don't get some food in their bellies soon, they'll probably stampede.\r\nSo, what're you waiting for? Get feeding!
All right, the ranch is just this way. All you need to do is collect Hay by hitting Haystacks with a #rRegular Attack#k and bring the Hay to the cows. You can handle this, right?
While you're at it, get #ba cup of Milk from the Mama Cow#k #rafter you feed the Baby Dairy Cows#k. Do a good job, and Ma will be happy to give you some milk.
Fine, be that way. It won't be my fault when you get trampled in a Baby Cow stampede.
Those cows really liked you. You ever think about changing your job to Farmer?
Good work! Here's a glove. What do gloves have to do with cows? Who cares, you're a Pirate!
Maybe you don't think this is an important job. I want to set you straight: Don't feed those Baby Cows, and your life is on the line!
Anyway, the pork dish was a hit. But #b#p1092002##k skipped the meal. Guy needs to stop working so hard...\r\n
I got important things to do. Why don't you bring #b#p1092002##k his lunch for me?\r\n
Bring this to #b#p1092002##k straight away. If I find out he had to go hungry, it's straight to the gallows with you!
Why you gotta be so disagreeable? We Pirates have to look out for each other!
What's that? Smells like #b#p1092000##k's cookin'! Who are you, and what're you doing with that lunch?
Thanks, matey. I thought I was gonna starve. #b#p1092000##k makes the best grub.
Take that lunch to #b#p1092002##k, fast! He's gotta be starving!
#b#p1092000##k sent ya, did she? So what's it about? I was hopin' for a #rPacked Lunch#k or somethin'... Man, I'm hungry...
Speaking of... Argh, they're so LOUD!\r\nSorry, not you! Ugh, it's a long, stupid story...\r\n
I'm listenin' in on the sea under the Nautilus. But I can't hear a danged thing over all those dratted #r#o1220000##k up on the beach!
Somebody needs to take care of those dang #r#o1220000##k, I tell ya...\r\nHey, you got a weapon! Want to get rid of them Starfish for me?
#r#o1220000##k breed so fast it's like they appear from nothing. But if you can just shut 'em up for a second or two, that'd be good enough. Maybe take out #b30#k #r#o1220000##k.
Yeah, yeah, I know. Everybody got their own problems...
Good news! There's a big ol' shock wave heading our way!\r\nOkay, maybe that ain't great news, but I wouldn't've been able to hear it if you hadn't shut up those Starfish.
Don't worry, this ol' beauty can take a shock wave or two as long as we're ready. Thanks. Ya might've just saved the Nautilus.
Nah, it's okay, matey. Not everyone can take on #b30#k #r#o1220000##k. You can give up if you like.
If only #b#p1094000##k weren't slackin' off, I wouldn'ta had this problem to start with...
#b#p1094000##k's the one who's supposed to keep the Starfish in check! Why don't you give him a visit and knock some sense into him?
#b#p1094000##k's probably lousing about at #r#m120000000##k. Remember, it's his fault you had'ta fight all them Starfish!
Hey, you want to keep doing his job for him, be my guest!
Who are you? What? No, I ain't slacking off! #b#p1092002##k's way off the mark here!
I mean, yeah, I'm supposed to keep the monsters in line, but somethin' came up! I asked #b#p1092004##k to take over for me. Blame him, not me!
#b#p1094000##k's probably hanging around #r#m120000000#. Teach that boy a lesson!
What's #b#p1092004##k doing, anyway? Go bug him about this!
#b#p1092004##k probably fell asleep at #r#m120020400##k. The boy's always driftin' off! If he's dozin', just toss him in the water or somethin'.
You even know why I'm here? It's 'cause #b#p1092004##k is bein' lazy! Teach HIM a lesson, not ME!
Zzz... Zzz... Steak... So yummy...
Ack! Wh-what was that for?! I'm all wet! ...Yeah, #b#p1094000##k asked me to watch the monsters, but I forgot...
Calico probably dozed off. If he's sleeping, just toss some water on him.
I don't wanna be in trouble! #p1094000##k will throw me in the ocean if he hears that I fell asleep on the job! I n-need to get something done, but what...?!
Y-you'll help me? Yay! Thanks! If you get rid of, like, #r50#r#k #r#o1220000##kes#k, I'll take care of the rest. Then #b#p1094000##k will have to forgive me, right?
W-wh-wh-what am I gonna dooo?!
You really saved me. Thanks!\r\n#b#p1094000##k won't be mad now, right?
Here, I want you to have it. I was gonna use it myself, but I owe you big.
Let #rBart#k know how hard I'm working, okay? He's probably still at #b#m120000000##k.
You take care of like #r50 #o1220000#es#k, and I'll get the rest.
Hm. #p1092004##k's workin' pretty hard after all, eh? Good kid. \r\nWith the monsters all gone, maybe #b#p1092012##k can finally get out on the beach and enjoy himself for once.\r\n
Ya know #b#p1092012##k, right? He's only the smartest monster on Nautilus! Don't worry, he's on our side. He's always in his room, fussin' around with his books and whatnot.
Hey, if you're not busy, why don't you tell #b#p1092012##k that the beach is clear? The guy's all pasty and such. He could use some sun.\r\n
#b#p1092012##k's on the bottom deck of Nautilus, I bet. Don't worry, ya can't miss him!
C'mon! Rolonay's been locked away in his room for weeks. He could really use the break!
What is it? I'm busy!\r\nThe beach is free of monsters? ...And?\r\n
Oh dear. I'm afraid our friend #b#p1094000##k is quite mistaken. I'm not afraid of the monsters on the beach at all.
Let #b#p1092012##k know the good news. I bet'cha he'll be thrilled!
And why should I be afraid of those little beasts? No, I've simply been too busy to go out. That's all.
Do you see this Shiny Marble? It's my duty to make sure nothing happens to it. Should I take my eyes off of it for even a second, it would mean disaster!\r\n
As a matter of fact, I'm running low on the Pearls that power this Shiny Marble. Might I trouble you to gather some for me?
I am indebted to you. #b5#k #rPearls#k should do the job. All you need do is jaunt on down to the #rGenerator Room#k and take Pearls from the Pearl Oysters.
I assure you, this is of utmost importance! Shiny Marbles are no laughing matter!
Have you the Pearls? You've made great haste. Thank you, young Pirate.
Tis a thankless task, but someone must tend to the Shiny Marble. If only Black Bark could see how hard I'm working.
Make haste, before the Shiny Marble loses its light! We need 5 Pearls to recharge it.
Please make your way to the Conference Room and tell #b#p1092006##k how hard I'm working. \r\nI haven't the time to see him yourself, of course. I can trust you with this task, can I not?
And do ask him to visit me, if you will. He makes such pleasant company. With that, I must return to my duties. Take care, #h0#.
Oh, dear... How else will #b#p1092006##k know the importance of my work?
You don't got to tell me what #b#p1092012##k! I know how hard he works!
You ain't really a Pirate, are you? You're too scrawny, kid!
Please let #b#p1092006##k in the #r#m120000201##k know how hard I'm working.

How you gonna sail the high seas with a body like that?\r\nTsk, not even a HINT of muscle. Disgraceful! If the cap'n wants you in the crew, fine, but you better see #b#p1092008##k and whip yourself into shape!
#b#p1092008##k knows how to get a Pirate in fighting condition. You want to survive on this crew, you listen to everything she tells you. Well, get on to the #r#m120000104##k!
Giving up, eh? Fine! Get out of here!
Yes, #b#p1092006##k said you'd be coming. Hm. This is going to be a challenge...
You sure you have what it takes? You'll be facing monsters unlike anything you've ever seen.
Go straight to the #r#m120000104##k and report to #b#p1092008##k!
Combat is the best form of training, I always say. Are you ready to begin?
The monsters inside won't hold back, so you shouldn't, either. When you're ready, go into the Training Room and eliminate #r30 OctoPirates#k. I'll be watching.
You aren't scared, are you? That's probably smart.
Still alive? I'm surprised. I may make a real Pirate out of you yet.
And now we're done with warm-ups.
If you can't even eliminate #b30 OctoPirates#k, just go home.
Are you ready for something a bit harder?
The next wave of monsters may look like OctoPirates, but don't underestimate them or you'll regret it! You're fighting for your life here.
Talk to me once you're ready to enter the Training Room, then eliminate #r30 OctoPirates#k.
Don't waste my time. Piracy isn't for quitters!
Yes, that's how a Pirate should fight! You're a credit to the job.
Remember, training never ends. When you think you're the best, someone else will show up to prove you wrong. As a Pirate, it's your duty to smash people like that in the face.
You can't even handle #b30 OctoPirates#k? A shame.
That's it for your training. It's been fun.\r\n#b#p1092006##k shouldn't give you any more trouble.\r\n
I expect you to be even stronger next time we meet.
What did we do all this for, then?
That's more like it, kid! You look like a real Pirate now! #b#p1092008##k knows what she's doing!\r\n
Aren't you itching for a real mission now? I bet you are? Give me a sec, and I'll have something ready for you.
Go on. Get back to #b#p1092006##k.\r\n
You know #b#p1094001##k? He's one of the toughest Pirates around. I got him on an important mission, and he needs a hand. Go see what he needs.
Ask #b#p1094001##k himself about it.
Abel's at #r#m120020500##k, last I heard.
What's a matter? You intimidated by him or something?
My glasses... My glasses...
H-hullo? Who goes there? #b#p1092006##k sent you? S-sorry, but I can't see a thing without my glasses...
Help #b#p1094001##k with his mission.
Sorry, but could you do me a little favor? I'm helpless without them, so could you look around for my glasses?
I took off my glasses to wipe sweat off my face, but I dropped them... The #r#o1220001##k must've run off with them. They love anything shiny, you know.
Eliminate the #r#o1220001##k around here, and I bet you'll find them. Okay, I'm counting on you!
Shoot... Okay, I understand. They've got to be around here somewhere...
Found them? Let me see. I sure hope these are mine...
These are mine all right! Thanks a lot.
I'm telling you, the #r#o1220001##k are behind this. Please find my glasses!

As I'm sure #b#p1092006##k told you, my mission is to welcome the Prince of Whales and escort him to the ship. Hm... Looks like he missed our meeting while I was looking for my glasses. Did you see him anywhere?
Something must have happened to him. Why don't you help me find him?
If something happened to him, he might still be nearby. Let's look around here for now.
You look around #r#m120020600##k, and I'll try the other direction. Let me know if you find Prince Sharyl!
I thought you were assigned to help me? Dang...
Oh, and take these gloves. You look like you could use a better pair.
We're in a hurry, so let's split up. I think I heard about an suspicious dolphin somewhere around here...
No luck with Prince Sharyl? He's got to be around here somewhere...
Hello... Could you help me, please? I'm running...out of strength.\r\nAh... I've run out of Mana... I feel so weak... Could you please bring me #b1 Mana Elixir#k?\r\n
My goodness, that was refreshing! Thank you. I know how I look, but I'm actually #b#p1092003##k, the Prince of Whales. That's whales with an 'h'. Confusing, I know.
Ah... Please... Mana is my life...
Ahh...my powers are returning. Thank you so much.
Please... I need just 1 Mana Elixir. The #bGeneral Store#k has them... But I'm too weak to flop over there...
Thank you... It's such an...embarrassing request...

While I was weakened, someone took the gifts I had for #b#p1090000##k and threw them in the ocean! I have no idea why someone would think they're garbage... Anyway, I can't meet #b#p1090000##k without those gifts...that would be rude. Could you find them for me?
It wasn't too long ago, so they shouldn't have drifted far. You know, the #r#o1220002#es#k I passed on the way here were eyeing my gifts... Maybe the #r#o1220002#es#k took them.
Well, I can't go looking for them myself, looking like this...
Ah, you found it! ...It's a little wet, but I guess that's to be expected.
I'm glad I came all the way out here now. You've helped make my trip worthwhile.
I'm sure that the #r#o1220002#es#k have the gifts. They had that look in their eyes.
I still have one problem, though. I'm, well, a little nervous presenting these gifts to #b#p1090000##k. I'm just not that good with...you know. People stuff. Could you maybe...?
Please, #h0#! This is the last favor I'll ask for. Please, #h0#?\r\n
Please deliver this gift to #b#p1090000##k. Of course, you must tell her that it's from me.
Should I just go back, then?
Ahoy there! Heard you've become quite the swashbuckler lately! Good for you. What brings you aboard?
Heh, I see. Prince #b#p1092003##k is here...he's just too shy to meet with me. Don't worry, I don't mind. I get that a lot, anyway. Thanks for helping the prince out.
Please deliver my gift to Kyrin.
Oh, if you have no business, I need to prepare. Prince Sharyl should be here soon.

I heard you've been helping my mangy crew out with their troubles. Good on you for that. I had a feeling you'd make a fine Pirate. Anyway, I've got a mission for you. Go see #b#p1092007##k for the details. \r\n
#b#p1092007##k has an important matter he needs help with. Report to him immediately.
This is an order from the captain, not some silly errand.
Did that sound like a request? No, because it was an order. Get your head on straight!
Captain #b#p1090000##k sent you, hm? Good timing.
Hurry up and go see Muirhat.
I just don't get it...

A few days ago, I caught this Strange Creature in the ocean, but for the life of me, I can't figure out what it is. It makes these weird noises, and vanishes if you attack it. If it can't be hit, I'm out of ideas...\r\n
Why don't you figure this out? You want to try?
All right. Approach it with caution, and do what you can. If you learn anything, let me know immediately.
When you're ready, let me know, and I'll toss you in the room where the Strange Creature is. Don't worry...I'll let you back out.
We need to do this for the sake of the Pirates. We can't let something like this go without figuring out how to destroy it!
Oh, you did it. Good. So, this is its true identity?
We need to study this. Studying is not one of my stronger skills, by the way.
You didn't see the Strange Creature? Are you blind?
Yeah...I doubt I can learn anything from this.\r\nYou'd better just take it to #b#p1096006##k. He'll figure it out.\r\n
Things like this are right up #b#p1096006#'s#k alley. I could never understand why #b#p1096006##k liked studying so much.
Cutter is in Nautilus Harbor. Make sure you give it to him soon.
You're supposed to help your fellow Pirates, not slack off like some lazy land-lubber!
Ooh, I feel all...gloomy. Was it something I ate? No, it's that weird thing you're holding! Hello, science!
Right, #b#p1092007##k said you were on your way. So, this is the mystery thing? Well, give it here. I didn't get that degree in Mystery Science for nothing! It's random experimenting time!
Go see #b#p1096006##k in Nautilus Harbor and give this Strange Energy to him.
What's up? Yeah, #b#p1092007##k said he sent you down here with some crazy energy something. Where is it? I was really looking forward to a new crazy energy something!
Hey, you got a minute? I need some #r#o1220003#es#k eliminated. Bring me their Cool Jellyfish Bodies when you're done. And don't ask questions...just do it!

Listen, I've got a problem. A few days ago, I heard Prince #b#p1092003##k arrived on the Nautilus. Apparently, he came to profess his love for #b#p1090000##k! Some boneheaded adventurer even helped him deliver his gift...
I'm sure #b#p1090000##k is too good for him, and I want to prove it. You down to help me, #h0#?
Most princes are raised in very sheltered environments, so I bet he's a coward. On my honor, I won't allow any coward to even touch our fearless #b#p1090000##k!
I want you to collect 30 Cool Jellyfish Bodies, and show them to Prince #b#p1092003##k. That coward will freak as soon as he lays eyes on those squirmy, gooey things!
Oh, what is this, #h0#? You think Prince #b#p1092003##k should just waltz in here and steal away our #b#p1090000##k? Wait a minute... I bet YOU helped him deliver his gift! Traitor!!
Oh, hello again, #h0#. I was so tired and stressed last time, I don't think I thanked you properly. I really appreciate everything you've done for me.
Oh, Cool Jellyfish Bodies! Did you bring these for me? Thank you.
What's that look for? I love these things! Back home in the ocean, we eat these all the time. They're great with a little honey mustard.
Collect 30 Cool Jellyfish Bodies, show them to Prince #b#p1092003##k, and watch him freak out.
By the way, what brings you by? Did you have something for me?
What? He wasn't afraid of those nasty, wriggly Cool Jellyfish Bodies? Bleh!\r\nOkay, I'll guess you'll have to try harder. How about you get some #r#t4033014#s#k to show to the Prince?\r\n
Hey, #h0#! You sure do drop by a lot.
Wow! These are beautiful! Are they for me? I'm touched, but...I think I would like lovely #b#p1090000##k to have these. They match her own beauty, do they not?
Collect #r#t4033014#s#k and show them to Prince #b#p1092003#. That'll have him crying for his mommy.
Did you have something else for me? I do so enjoy your gifts.

He said...#r#t4033014#s#k are beautiful? How... Prince #b#p1092003##k is the strangest prince I've ever heard of. #b#p1090000##k definitely deserves better than that weirdo! \r\nI can't stand him...but how can I get rid of him? \r\n

Okay, I've got it this time! Get some #r#t04000043#s#k, and pinch Prince #b#p1092003##k with them! Those #r#t04000043#s#k really hurt, and when he starts crying, his reputation around here will be ruined. Mwa ha ha haa!

Lorangs are all over #bFlorina Beach#k. 20 Lorang Claws should be more than enough to pinch the Prince. I guess you really only need one, but I want you to have lots of back-ups. Collect 20 #r#t04000043#s#k, and pinch Prince #p1092003# hard, okay?
Yeah, I know it's childish, but it's for a good cause! This is for #b#p1090000##k!
Yikes! Wha? You!\r\nYou know... I'm already in love with someone...\r\n
Oh, you don't know what that Claw means? In whale culture, we use those claws to pinch those we wish to marry. I really thought... Oh, #h0#...you're so funny!
Collect 20 #r#t04000043#s#k and pinch Prince #p1092003# with them. Make him cry!
Hello again! It's always a pleasure to see you. Did you have something to show me?
Oy, you need to stop doing those stupid errands #b#p1095003##k gives you. She's just a jealous mess right now. Give her time to think about her mischief.\r\n
Look, you don't have time to dilly-dally around here! We're responsible for the safety of the Nautilus and the nearby towns.\r\n
I'm getting reports that Florina Beach is getting overrun with Clangs and Lorangs. I know you've already had some run-ins with Lorangs, so I think you'd be perfect for this next mission.
Great. Go see #b#p1092013##k in #r#m120030100##k, and help the citizens with their burdens. Piracy isn't all looting and pillaging, you know.
Your duty is to keep the common people safe. You're not going to do that sitting around like a lump.
Is Florina Beach doomed...? Then where will people surf?
The Lorangs and Clangs are starting to endanger the people of Florina Beach. Third-degree pinchings are at an all-time high.
I don't understand how the monster population of Florina shot up so fast. Is it something in the water? Are all the monsters here on vacation?
I saw you taking down those Lorangs before, #h0#. I believe you can save Florina Beach from the pinchy crisis that faces us.
You can do this, right, #h0#? You have a high tolerance for pinching, don't you?
I knew you would accept my request, #h0#. I knew, because you are awesome.
Right then. Can you put a hurt on the #b#o3230102##k population? I think, if we want severe pinching incidents to go down, we need to take out at least #r50#k of them. You can manage that, right?
Remember, this is for the citizens. They didn't ask for this.
I had no idea you could do that so fast. You should work for a seafood restaurant!
Florina Beach is still crawling with #b#o3230102#s#k. I got pinched just a few minutes ago, and wow-WEE, it hurts! Eliminate #r50#k of those things, pronto!
Well #h0#, you've settled the Lorangs down all right, but there are other beasts out there, pinching the innocent. Could I ask you to handle the #b#o4230104#s#k, as well?
Excellent. As with the Lorangs, eliminating #b50#k #r#o4230104#s#k should send the message that we will tolerate their pinching no more!
This is for the safety of the people! No one should have to live under the tyranny of random pinching!
Fantastic! The Clangs are on the run, just like the Lorangs.
There are still so many Clangs scuttling around Florina Beach. If you could eliminate 50 of them, they should get the message.
#h0#, you've made a huge difference here in Florina Beach. Everywhere I look, the people are happy and safe and un-pinched. \r\n
I would ask that you continue your work, though, and eliminate the #b#o4130101#s#k living on the beach. They're not so dangerous...they just take all the best sunbathing spots.

I knew you would help us out. As before, clearing around #b50#k #b#o4130101#s#k should be enough. I almost feel bad about this, but they should have known better than to take all the best sunbathing spots. They were asking for it, really.
But, this is for the people! It's for their right to sunbathe wherever they choose!
Wow! Florina Beach looks totally different without all those lazy Torties hurting the property value. Good job, #h0#.
I still see too many Torties on the beach for my tastes. We need at least 50 of them gone.
Fantastic work, #h0#. Florina Beach is well on its way to becoming a world-class tourist trap! There's just...one little problem left...

Very well. I will tell you. Rex was once a human... a famous hunter, actually. He battled all sorts of evil in El Nath. That got him the attention of an evil organization called the Tarheeds. 
The Tarheeds were a menace that terrorized all of El Nath. One day, while Rex was out hunting, they attacked Rex's house and murdered his wife.

Rex vowed vengeance and stormed into the Tarheed base... alone. He couldn't take them all at once, and he barely escaped with his life. After that, he disappeared. Many years later, Hoblins appeared in El Nath. They attacked the Tarheeds and took their place. Rex was their leader.

No one knows how he became a Hoblin. All we know was that he'd lost all his humanity. He was full of hatred, and after he destroyed the Tarheeds, his next target was all of El Nath. The other Elders and I joined forces with Adventurers and fought a difficult battle. We won, but lost countless friends in the process. We sealed Rex in an ancient glacier by #bHeinrich#k, the great magician. Rex is as good as dead now.

And that is the end of it. Now go tell Shammos to calm down and keep quiet. I don't want him stirring people up with needless fear. Also, if I were you, I wouldn't trust everything Shammos says. There's a reason he's locked up like that...

I've lived in this town for about 50 years now... Not as long as Alcaster, but I know plenty of myths and folktales nonetheless. For example... Did you know the story of Battle Mode's Ice Knight started in El Nath?

There once was a small kingdom deep in El Nath. Not wealthy, nor powerful, but very peaceful. But as in any good story, there are always those who abhor peace. In this story, it was the Kingdom's First Knight. He had a strong arm, and he enjoyed showing off.

The Knight left the kingdom in boredom. After many years, he returned, all of his strength gone. No one knows what happened to him, just that the once-arrogant warrior had suddenly become a coward... No one knows why.
The cowardly knight wanted to regain his power. He snuck into the castle dungeon and stole a suit of enchanted armor: Ice armor that granted mighty strength, but along with it came a fell curse.

With his new ice armor, he gained all the power and courage he desired, but all that was left of him was the need to destroy. He turned evil and eliminated many innocents. The King had to step in and defeat the Knight with his own hand. The ice armor was returned to the vault, and the Knight's name vanished into history...
Maybe it's true, maybe it isn't. But I think it's interesting. And I have some small evidence that it really happened: the #t01072510#. I'm no warrior, and have no need for armor. Do you want them?

Did you bring 10,000 mesos? If so, then have your pen and paper ready. Here is some valuable information on #b#m261000000##k...
Long ago, after the Black Magician disappeared from Ossyria, a group of alchemists got together and formed #m261000000#. The motto of the town is 'Ultimate knowledge is only an experiment away.'

The town itself is flush with money, since various results from experiments conducted with alchemy have been sold for lots of money. Even with all that, however, the town seems very isolated from the world. That's because alchemists in general are very introverted, which makes brokers like me much richer. Especially in times like this, where the town is in conflict...

#m261000000# is currently split into two: #bZenumist#k and #bAlcadno#k. Zenumists are the ones considered pure alchemists that have successfully blended science and magic. Alcadnos are the ones that have added mechanical engineering to the already potent mix. They truly dislike one another, so if you want to get involved, you may want to think twice before going in.

Because of the current conflict, the already-insulated alchemists have withdrawn even further. I honestly think a traveler like you won't get anything substantial out of #m261000000#... it's much easier for you to do anything if you're affiliated with one or the other.

That's it for basic info. Too little, you say? That's why it's BASIC info. If you want more, then come see me. I guarantee that if you want to do anything at #m261000000#, then you'll have to come back and see me sooner or later.
You don't have enough mesos with you. It's only #b10,000 mesos#k... and you call yourself a traveler?

The days of scholars purely searching for the truth is long gone... well, that's perfect for brokers, though.\r\n#b#L0#Is there a big conflict?#l

Alcadno is always looking for ways to turn machines into a form of life. These efforts have yielded multiple forms of mechanical dolls, ready to be tested. Dolls like Roid, Neo Huroid, etc... Here's the question... which ore is used as the source of power to get the mechanical dolls to work?
#L0# #bBlack Crystal
#L1# Silver
#L2# Summoning Rock

#L0# #bBasic Mana by Grendel the Really Old
#L1# Robeira's Introduction to Magic
#L2# Jane's Guide to Alchemy for the Beginners!
#L3# Alcaster's Compilation of Alchemy<Beginner>

#L0# #b Gritto
#L1# Dr. Kim

Hmm... Fine. From here on out, you are #ban alchemist of Alcadno#k... Whatever adversities you may face from here on out, please fight through it for the good of mankind.
As a member of Alcadno, if you want to work with other members, it's imperative that you don the Alcadno Cape. Alcadno Cape is the best way to let everyone know of your allegiance.

This cape may not be much for now... that's because you're still a novice alchemist. Once you start making some valuable contributions to Alcadno... you'll be rewarded accordingly.
The Black Crystal has nothing to do with machines. It's a mineral that can only be controlled with a constant source of power from humans. That's incorrect.

That's incorrect. Silver has the power of instilling a certain spell, and allowing it to be accessed for later purposes. It's also used for various purposes with mechanical dolls, but it's used to control mana, not as a source of power.

The Summoning Rock is used to summon a target to wherever you are. It's not used as a source of power for the mechanical dolls. It just doesn't have enough Mana to fully operate it. I'm sorry, but that's not the right answer.
Robeira's book is good, but it's such a difficult book to read that most of the experienced alchemists can't figure it out, either. It's the wrong answer.
The book by Jane seems more like a novel than a scholastic book... that's not the right answer.
Wrong. Alcaster's book is great, but when he wrote this book, the mechanical studies conducted by Alcadno didn't even exist.
You know... Gritto? You don't look like someone that would know such a great being... anyway, he's not it.
Dr. Kim...? That's actually a name? Very peculiar, indeed... no, he's not it.

This will be the only time I'll make the cape for you this easily. A Zenumist Cape is a form of identification that proves that you're a member of Zenumist. As a proud member of Alcadno, you should handle the cape with utmost pride and care.

Since you're wearing a cape, you must be the new kid everyone's talking about. I'm #p2111008#, nice to meet you. I'm in charge of making the #bMana Rock#k for Zenumist. ...What? You want to know what the Mana Rock does? Well... it's a device that allows one to gather up mana.

Inside the Mana Rock, there's a core that allows one to register a spell in there. A Mana Rock with a spell registered in is called the Magic Rock. It allows even the ones that have never mastered spells to perform one. For example, the Magic Rock at Orbis is made out of the Mana Rock.

The most important items for creating Mana Rock are #t4011004# and #t4011008#. #b#t4011004# is used to register spells#k, and #t4011008# is used to store mana. Every Mana Rock features a core made out of silver, and a power device made out of Lidium. Yes, I made them all...

The thing is... #t4011008# is easy to find, since you can find most of them at #m260000000#... #t4011004#, that's a different story. Maybe it's because a lot of the mines in El Nath are abandoned and devoid of life... I don't know. Can you help me get some, if it's alright with you?

Wow, really? Then please get me #b5 #t4010004##k and #b50 #t4000352#s#k, which will be used to refine #t4011004#. I got to be honest with you, I made a mistake a while back making a core, and rendered #t4011004# useless... hmm, keep this on the hush hush.
Hmm... It might be tough for you, since you're a rookie here... Okay, let me know when you want to try this.

What, you brought all the items? That's... amazing! You must be a traveler instead of an alchemist! Haha, I was just kidding, you don't have to make a face like that. You're new anyway. Good work, seriously.
#t4011004# is a mineral that is always used in alchemy. It is a required item if we want to have the power of magic laden into a special item. It's basic alchemy. Never forget that, rook.
Hmmm... You still don't have #b5 #t4010004#s#k and #b50 #t4000352#s#k? I would appreciate it if you can get them for me before the President finds out.

Hey, aren't you the rookie alchemist that helped me make the Mana Rock the other day? What are you working on these days...? If you aren't that busy, then do you want to help out on this project? Go to the basement of the Alcadno Society building, and you'll see a bunch of devices that Alcadnos made. They are called #r#o5110300##k... Our 'job' is to destroy about #r200#k of them. Hahaha... I'm so ready to see how Alcadnos will react to this.

Ohh, how did it go? Did you really eliminate 200 #o5110300#s? Ahahahaha! That's awesome. I'm sure those Alcadnos are fuming right about now. Don't feel guilty about it. If you think about what they've done to us... this is nothing!
Hmm... You still haven't destroyed #r200 #o5110300#s#k yet? You don't have to feel bad about it... if you think about what the Alcadnos have done to us, this is nothing!

Rook, how's the experiment going these days? Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever asked you what you really worked on... is it a top secret? Well, if it is, then I won't ask anymore. I actually have a favor to ask you...

This might keep you busy, but...I want you to enter the Alcadno lab and get this document for me. Don't look at me like that! I actually really am curious to know one thing... The record regarding #bThat Incident#k... I think only Alcadnos have it, so... what do you think? Will you do it for me? Surely you're as curious as I am!

...Really? You're going to do it? I wasn't really expecting you to say yes, but... this is great. Then... I suggest you make your way to #b#m261020700# of Alcadno#k.
