Who is this? Hey, isn't that shrimp? What, my husband sent this for me? Oh no... he made you work. He could have brought them here himself... anyway, thank you for bringing them here.

I make pots here for the townspeople here, free of charge. Normally I do not make them for anyone outside this town, but since you have done our family a huge favor by carrying all that shrimp my husband asked you to bring, I'll gladly make a pot for you, if you wish to come back later. You may not be from this town, but I really appreciate your kindness. I'll see you around.
How can I help you? Oh, you must be an outsider... there's nothing to see here, so please go somewhere else.

Hello there, you must be new to this town; you don't look familiar. I live here in town with my younger brother, farming for a living. We harvested our crops a few days ago, but there's something that concerns me right now. I have split the Sack of Rice equally between my brother and me, but my brother raises more kids, and...

I'd much prefer giving my brother a little more of #t4031229#, but I know he won't accept it. That's why... can you please secretly put one #t4031229# on top of the stack of rice in front of my brother's house? My brother Chil Nam lives at the very east of this town.
I urge you, please make sure my brother doesn't know about this.
I'm sorry. I shouldn't have asked for such a huge favor to a stranger. I apologize for my mishap.
I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Nam's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.
This is Chil Nam's stack of rice.
I believe you forgot #t4031229#.
Hey, please make sure Chil Nam doesn't find out about this.

Umm, hi there. I don't think we've ever met. Someone told me a person from outside came by here, and I guess that must be you. This is great; I need to ask you for a small favor. My brother and I live here in this town, farming for a living. We harvested our crop a few days ago, but something's been nagging me ever since. I have equally split the #t4031229# between my brother and myself, but my brother takes care of my parents, and I seriously believe my brother deserves a little more of #t4031229#, but I know he won't accept it. That's why... can you please secretly put one #t4031229# on top of the stack of rice in front of my brother's house?
Please, please make sure my brother does NOT find out about this.
I understand. It's rude for me to ask for such a huge favor to a stranger. I'm sorry.
I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Sung's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.
This is Chil Sung's stack of rice.
I think you forgot to get #t4031229#.
Please make sure not to get caught by my brother...

Did you make sure my brother did not find out about this? Something's weird, though. It seems like my stack of rice didn't shrink one bit. Don't you think so, too? Well, that's why... can you go back to Chil Nam's house once more?
I urge you, please make sure my brother doesn't know about this.
I'm sorry. I should have known that I was pushing it by asking you to do this twice...
I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Nam's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.
This is Chil Nam's stack of rice.
I think you forgot to take #t4031229#.

Did you make sure my brother did not notice a change in the stack of rice? It's weird, though; my stack of rice hasn't changed one bit. Don't you think so, too? This is why... um... can you go back to my brother's house once more?
Please, please make sure my brother does NOT find out about this.
I'm sorry that I asked you to do the same thing twice.
I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Sung's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.
This is Chil Sung's stack of rice.
I think you forgot to take #t4031229#.

Hey, what's that sack of rice you're carrying right now? I asked you to leave it at my brother's house, and... What are you doing bring it back here? What? My brother was the one making the request? Ahhh... that's my brother there. No wonder my stack of rice hasn't shrunk one bit...

So you went through all this trouble thanks to us brothers... thankfully, this incident is bound to make our brotherly bond that much tighter. I think my brother may have noticed it by now, too. I know it's a lot of work, but please go visit my brother Chil Nam right now. I'm sure he wants to find a way to say thank you for your hard work.
Please don't say no. We are eternally grateful for your great work and generosity.

Hi, there. I've noticed it, too. I was wondering why my stack of rice didn't shrink at all, and I just got a message from my brother about what happened. I really don't know how to thank you for going through all this trouble...

I will never forget your hard work in this. I can't give you anything right this minute, but if you ever feel like feasting on some pork and buckwheat paste, please come visit us. My brother and I will make the best possible food you'll find in this town, just for you.
I don't think you met up with my brother. Please go see him; he's waiting for you.
Oh no... My wing must be clipped. I need to find the seed, though... please help me.

I'm the messenger from the God of Sky, and I am in a little bit of a tight spot right now. I was carrying a present from the God of Sky for this man that took care of my broken leg last spring, but while I was resting at the top of the mountain, I dropped it somewhere, and now I can't find it.

So I went into the woods looking for that lost seed, only to find a bunch of angry rabbits chasing me. That's how I clipped my wing, frantically trying to fly away from those rabbits. If the lord found out that I have lost the seed, then I'll be harshly reprimanded for this! Pleeeeeease help me find the seed. I have a feeling that it's one of those rabbits that have the seed. I am pretty sure of that!
Aww, you're not going to leave me here, are you? My wing just got clipped!

Hey, that seed you have in your hand... that's it! You really did find it! That's incredible! Thank you thank you thank you! Wait, oh no... Now I forgot who to give this seed too. I keep forgetting the most important things! Was it Hongbu or Nolbu?

I really cannot remember which one... I'm sure it's either Hongbu or Nolbu, but... I can't even fly there right now because my wing is clipped... please take this seed to either one of the two. I'll trust you to make the correct call.
Did you find the seed? If I ever tell the lord up there I lost the seed, then I will be scolded by him... sigh...

What? What do you want from me? If you want to ask me for a favor, then get lost! I don't have time to listen to your 'request'!
#L0# #bFine! I don't want anything to do with you, either!#k 
#L1# #bDid you fix a swallow's leg by any chance? 
Someone told me to give you this seed.#k

A swallow? Right, right. I did fix its legs before. You're telling me this seed is for me? Haha, alright, then. Okay, while you're here with the seed, can you do me a favor and plant it on my roof? And once it yields the gourd, open it and bring me whatever that's inside, okay?
Get out! Leave!
Haha... wonder what kind of expensive jewelry is inside the gourd... hey, what are you doing standing there? Go up there and plant the seed right now! What's taking you so long?
You're telling me that's too much? This is why the outsiders cannot be trusted...
Okay, so did you open the gourd? What came out of it? How big's the jewelry?\r\n#L0# #bJust this piece of paper.#k

What? That can't be! Give me that paper! What's this? Warrant of attachment? I need to forfeit my possessions to whoever brought this document? THIS CANNOT BE!\r\n#L0# #bSo I get to take all your possessions? What should I take?#k
NO! NO! This represents everything I have!
Oh my... I am RUINED! I am BROKE! NOOOO!
I told you to open the gourd! Why are you empty-handed? Go open it right now!
Hey, the seed dropped!
Hey! Plant that seed on the roof just right, okay?!

How can I help you? As you can see, our family isn't doing too well here, so I am really sorry, but I can't serve anyone right now, even a stranger from out of town like you.
#L0# #bWow, you really must be struggling here.#k
#L1# #bDid you fix a swallow's leg by any chance? 
Someone told me to give you this seed.#k

Well, I did find this swallow that broke a leg back in spring, and fixed its leg, but... you're telling me that Swallow told you to give this seed to me? That's interesting. Say, if you aren't really busy and all, can you please do me a favor and plant the seed on the roof of our house? I am sorry, but I haven't had anything to eat for the past few days, and I am too tired to go up there. If the seed turns into a gourd later on, then can you do me another favor and open it and give me what's inside? Thank you.
...yes, I know , but... I still feel very rich inside.
Thank you so much. Please be careful while climbing up there. The rope is really old and ragged, you know.
I am sorry. I must have asked too much from a stranger like you. If you are busy with other things, then please go take care of your business.

Did you open the gourd? Is it full inside? If so, then I better make a huge bowl of porridge out of it for my family. They missed a meal today, you know...\r\n#L0# #bHey, inside the gourd is nothing but jewelry and gold!#k

What?? All this?? Wow... it's a relief; now I can definitely feed my family until they are too full to eat. Thank you so very much. As a sign of thank you, I want you to take one of these jewelries. Please choose one.
I got lucky thanks to the seed you brought here. I can't thank you enough for this. Thank you so much. Have a safe trip.
Is it still a long time before the gourd opens? Was there anything inside?
Oh, the seed fell down.
Please plant it on the roof.
What's going on? What? You lost the seed?? How can you lose it? Okay, I'll give you another one right now. This time, PLEASE don't lose it, and give it to the rightful owner, okay?
I need to look for it, so please talk to me in a little bit.
Well, then you won't need the seed. Good bye.
Please get this to the rightful owner, although I still have no idea who should receive this.

You must be from out of town. When you reach my age, you get a general feel for a person just by looking, and you look quite strong. Listen, I'll tell you what's going on here. A while ago, a huge problem arose at the Helios Tower Library. I have no way of finding out the details, but apparently, a group of Goblins have popped out of the storybook and is hiding behind the Black Mountain at the back of the town.

Once the Goblins went into the mountain, so aptly named Black Mountain, it became dark 24/7. I'm sure it has something to do with them. The ones that control those Goblins are the 3 King Goblins. It is a necessity to defeat those Goblins in order to restore order in the Black Mountain. What do you think? Are you willing to accept the challenge?

I knew I had an eye for a talent; I also knew you'd say yes. It's not easy to defeat a Goblin, however. They are very adept at hiding themselves out of human sight. In order to locate them, you must use a bait to bring the Goblins out. The bait should of course be something they like.
Apparently Goblins love #b#t2022050##k, #b#t2022051#, and #t2022052##k. These can be obtained through the people in this town. Once you gathered them all, make sure to bring them all to me.
I must be really old now. I thought you'd take an interest in this matter. I must have seen something wrong.
Interesting; you got them all. People in this town aren't necessarily cooperative with the outsiders. You really must be someone special...

Is it hard to obtain that list of food I gave you? People in this town aren't necessarily cooperative with the outsiders, you know. I suggest you help them first. Help them, so they can help you in return.

Okay, now take these to the top of the Black Mountain. At the very top, you'll see an abandoned house with 3 King Goblins from the storybook hidden inside. It'll be near impossible to find them just by looking at them, you know; Goblins are very good at hiding from human sight. I'll ask you this one more time: Are you sure you can handle this? This is not going to be easy.

Very trustworthy. Hahaha... Okay, now I'll teach you how to draw those Goblins out. The #bYellow King Goblin#k is a Goblin that gets easily frightened like a chicken. It's the Goblin that once was so scared by the cracking sound of a hazelnut bite that it ran without picking up its own bat. Now, this Goblin is a big fan of pork, so if you head over to the abandoned house and place roasted pork on a stack of rocks near the house, it'll show up for sure.

Next up is the #bBlue King Goblin#k, who is prone to forgetting things here and there. This Goblin manages to lose things quite frequently, once even losing the Goblin Hat. Some petty thief picked it up and tried stealing other things, until he got caught by the people and got heavily punished for it. This Goblin prefers #bRice Wine#k. There's a #bStone Lantern#k around the abandoned house; pour the Rice Wine in it, and it'll surely come out of the house.

Last, but not least, the #bGreen King Goblin#k likes to engage in some Korean Wrestling. There are times in the middle of the night where it'd pop out in front of an unsuspecting soul in the middle of the night, and engage in Korean Wrestling, wearing the person out in the process. This Goblin is very fond of #bbuckwheat paste#k, and if you place it inside the #btree hole#k at a tree near the abandoned house, it'll surely appear.

Your task is to defeat all 3 King Goblins and bring back the items that they'll drop: Goblin bat, Goblin hat, and the Goblin cape. This may be too hard for you to handle alone, so I suggest you team up with a couple of your friends.
Yes, it's a tough task, and I totally understand if you're not ready for it. Once you gain the confidence to beat the Goblins, bring back the 3 baits and talk to me.

This is incredible! Just incredible! How did you defeat all 3 King Goblins? Thanks to you, we were able to send the Goblins back to the storybook. For your hard work, I'll let you take one of the three Goblins items you brought back.
You wanted that? I see... and as for the restored 'Goblin Story', Wiz the Librarian might be looking for it, so take it with you.
After defeating the King Goblin, you must pick up the item that it drops. If you have run out of baits, then please consult the people in town.
Have you defeated the King Goblin? You haven't? Well, it's understandable... if you have run out of bait, then please consult to people in town.
Hello, it's been a while. How can I help you? \r\n#L0# #bCan I get some roasted pork?#k

Roasted pork? Well, I can say with great confidence that I'm the best at making those. Since you have helped us last time, I'll promise to make you a plate full if you can help me out a little bit here.

I've been stacking up the crops and pounding them on the mortar, but the Pounder broke. If you can get me #b5 Pounders#k from the Moon Bunnies, then I'll make the roasted pork for you for only #b1000 mesos#k.
Didn't you come because you needed some roasted pork?
Oh my gosh, you really found it! Well, now that you brought the Pounder, here's the roasted pork.
If you ever find yourself in need of Roasted Pork, please come talk to me. It only takes me 2 hours to make a plate full of it.
I'll give you roasted pork after you get me 5 Pounder.

You are the one that helped us brothers out before, right? How can I help you this time? Please don't tell me you're here at the request of my older brother...\r\n#L0# #bCan I get some buckwheat paste?#k

Buckwheat paste? Well, you've come to the right place. We make the best buckwheat paste in Folk Town, no question. The thing is, I was just about to leave to get something, and... if you can get me the item, then I'll give you some buckwheat paste.
Please get me #b4 Tiger Stamps#k and I'll make the buckwheat paste for you for only #b1,000 mesos#k per.
Aren't you here because you need some buckwheat paste?
Wow, you really brought it! Since you have worked hard at bringing me the Tiger Stamps, I'll give you the buckwheat paste as promised. It really tastes good, you know.
If you want some buckwheat paste again, then by all means come see me. Please know that it takes me at least 6 hours to make one.
Please get me 4 Tiger Stamps and I'll make some buckwheat paste for you.
Long time no see. Have you made your way around town?\r\n#L0# #bCan I get some Rice Wine?#k

Rice Wine? Well, I have some leftover from my stepmom. My stepmom makes a very delicious Rice Wine, but I seriously cannot give them to you for free; she'll be very mad with me for that. She won't be mad, however, if you bring her something that she has been looking for.

My stepmom really likes foxtails, especially the ones of the Three-Tailed Fox. I heard it's very furry and warm, perfect for cold weather. If you can get me #b3 tails of the Three-Tailed Fox#k and #b1,000 mesos#k, I'll give you the rice wine, and I don't think my stepmom will be too angry with it.
Aren't you here because you needed Rice Wine?
Oh you really got it! So this is the tail of the Three-Tailed Fox. It's so soft and smooth. Thanks, and here's the rice wine. I'm sure my stepmom will love this.
If you need more rice wine down the road, please come see me! Just know that I can only make it #bonce#k a day...
Bring me 3 tails of Three-Tailed Fox and I'll give you some Rice Wine.

Oh no... the pot is cracked! My stepmom ordered me to fill up this pot with water by nighttime, and... What should I do? I already have so many things to do here that I don't have time to buy a new one. I'm sorry, but... can you please help me?

Thank you so much. You'll find a water mill somewhere in this Folk Town. Go there, and you'll find #bGrandma Yeon#k. She is known for selling her pots only to her closest and dearest. I'm not sure if she'll make one for a stranger like you, but... please help me get the #bnew pot#k. Thank you.

From what I've heard, Grandma Yeon has been wondering how her husband is currently doing. He's been out fishing all day, and I have a feeling that if you keep her up to date on his whereabouts, then she may indeed give you a new pot.
You must be really busy. Oh well... nothing can do. Anyway, how am I going to fill up this pot with water... ?
Wow, you received Grandma Yeon's brand-new pot. You must have a great personality! My oh my, look at this... it's so shiny.
I better go get some water right now and fill it up. My stepmom will be here soon, checking on the pot to see if it's full. Thank you so much for your help. Thank you.
Didn't Grandma Yeon make the pot for you? Well, then I advise you to go see Tae Gong, her husband. He left home at dawn to go fishing. He should be in the middle of the ocean enjoying his catches.

Hey, long time. How have you been? You might have guessed it, but I am still busy like no other. I need to finish all this laundry before the end of the day, you know. Despite all this, my stepmother wants some Artemisia Rice Cake. I don't even have time to extract some Artemisia to begin with... can you help me out once more?

If you want to find Artemisia, I suggest you go to either the deepest corner of the Folk Town, or climb up the Black Mountain. Can you extract #b12 #t4031231#s#k for me? I'll need that much to make the rice cake. Thanks.
Are you busy? I can't even think about the possibility of doing all this laundry, as well as extracting Artemisia before sunset...
Has the Artemisia grown quite a bit?
Thank you so much for your help each time. This should be enough for me to make rice cakes. Anyway, when should I start ...?
I need at least 12 #t4031231#s to make the rice cake. Please bring some more.

Sniff sniff... oh, hi... What should I do? My stepmother wanted me to plow the field, but the old wooden hoe snapped on me. I am afraid my stepmother might really yell at me if I don't finish this soon. I know you have been of tremendous help in the past. Can you please help me out once more?

I even went to the blacksmith's shop, but they told me they don't make any steel hoes. From what I hear, some Blins that reside in the Black Mountain possess steel hoes. Unfortunately, I am not strong enough to get close to them, nevermind going up against them. You look strong enough, though, so please help me acquire #b1 #t4031222##k through the Blins.
Sniff... sniff... what's going to happen to me...?

You're back! Did you find the steel hoe? That's great! I heard that the Blins are a bunch of rascals pulling out pranks from left and right, making them really hard to deal with! But here you are, with the steel hoe in hand... it's the third time you've helped me out already. I'll never forget this, much like the first two. Thank you sooo much.
If I can't find the steel hoe quick, then the sun will set, and my stepmother won't be too happy with me...

Have you ever heard of Hogul living in Black Mountain? Hogul is a tiger of monstrous size that used to ooze dignity and class. Lately, however, the Hoguls have transformed into ferocious monsters attacking the residents of this town. If we let this go on, then something catastrophic is bound to happen. This is why we have been recruiting people like you to hunt down the Hoguls for us. What do you think? Are you interested?

Hoguls usually appear at the mid-slope of Black Mountain, and that's why people usually call it the 'Tiger Valley'. Go up there, defeat #b8 Hoguls#k, and grab #b8 Tiger Skins#k as proof. It'll be a perfect method for you to test your courage!
You must be much more afraid than your looks may suggest. It's understandable: even the bravest will have a hard time facing Hogul.
Oh, you're back. Let's see... it really is tough defeating Hoguls, right? What do you have in your hand? Are those the tiger skins? Okay, 1... 2... 3... Oh, that's 8.
Incredible! Incredible! You're one courageous person! I sincerely hope you stay here for a while; people will feel safe with you around here!
You shouldn't just defeat Hoguls. You need to also bring tiger skins. I don't need many; 10 will suffice.
Eliminate 10 Hoguls and everyone will be aware of your immense strength and courage. Don't you think it'll be nice to be recognized by everyone in this town as a courageous hero?
Hello, it's been a long time. How have you been? \r\n#L0# #bI'm here to buy your pot.#k
Are you talking about pots? Well, people do come here every now and then for pots. I'll make it especially cheap for you.
For #b5,000 mesos#k, I'll make a new pot for you. Let me know when you're ready with the money.
Have you changed your mind? If you need a pot down the road, let me know. You'll always be welcome here.
I'll give you the finest pot I've ever made here, I promise. Okay, this one looks really nice...
Use it well.
Hey, it's you. How have you been? You seem to have gotten a lot stronger these days! Hahaha! What are you doing here? You look like you want to ask me something.

Did you really lose the storybook I gave you? Well, I can give you another one, but not for free. That book contains important lessons regarding the power of the brotherhood, and if you can work a little bit for us brothers once more, then I'll give you the book.

My brother is worried about something big these days. See. His storage has been littered with rats these days, and they have been busy eating away his sack of rice. Please get him #b5 #t4000095#s#k for me. I heard you can get those at the #bEos Tower#k. Thanks.
Aren't you here because you need the storybook? Rumors suggest that #b#p2040052##k is re-collecting the storybook.
Chil Nam told me about the story. So you're going to get me some rattrap? Thank goodness, because I have been worried sick about those rats these days. Did you bring them?

Ahhh... I've only heard of these; I've never seen these before. This is called a rattrap... I really hope this works, because those rats are literally taking food away from me. Thank you for helping us brothers out once more. This time, pleeeaaase hold on to the storybook.

This didn't happen before, but recently my storage has been invaded by a bunch of mice, eating away my rice. Chil Nam said he requested for the rattrap from this trustworthy person, but no word. Rattrap is a device that catches rats that can be obtained at Eos Tower, but I've never seen it, and I'm very curious to find out how it looks like.
Long time no see. What's going on? I can't thank you enough for your help last time! How can I help you today? Are you here to buy some stuff?
Did you lose the storybook that I gave you? Oh no... that's awful. My customers tell me that Wiz the Librarian is looking for that book. Is that the reason why came to see me?
Thankfully, I have an extra storybook. If you can help me out one last time, then I'll gladly give you the book. Will you help me out?

My stepmother told me this morning that she wanted some steamed shrimp, but I had so much work to do at home and I totally forgot about it. I went out later at night for some grocery shopping, but the merchants have all called it a day by then. I'll really appreciate it if you can get me #b5 #t4000166#s#k before dinner time, so I can prepare it for my stepmother. I'll give you another copy of the storybook then.
Didn't you say you needed the storybook? There have been rumors regarding #b#p2040052##k looking to re-collect all the storybooks... Aren't you here to help Wiz gather up the storybooks?
You came back just in time. I was beginning to worry about you. Did you manage to get #b#t4000166##k?
You must be really good at this. How did you do it? Not only that, but these are FRESH! Please take this storybook and go see Wiz.

Here's the second question. Back in the day, there was a foolish student here at Mu Lung who thought, if he could wield his strength, he will be able to defeat the Sage Cats and bring 'peace' to Mu Lung. Now, those Sage Cats were the disciples of me, the King Sage Cats. Rather than being totally unnerved by his actions, the King Sage Cat, mercifully, awarded him with a spell that soothes and uncomplicates his mind. Is this 'punishment' feasible? \r\n#L0# #b No, it isn't. #l \r\n#L1# #b ...#l

Ho ho ho... Of course I meant it. If you would have answered the questions RIGHT, then the crystal would have been yours, but no no no. You were unable to answer the question right! Ho ho ho... That's unfortunate. So unfortunate!

Ho ho ho! You're ALL WRONG! You didn't answer a SINGLE question right! What? None of the answers made sense? Ho ho ho! I told you the antidote was real; I didn't really say the questions were! No way will I ever give you an antidote for Do Gong!

Ahhh... only Master Goblin has the antidote...

Did you know the longest waterway in Maple World is the route that connects Aquarium to Herb Town. Today, we can travel via the Dolphin Taxi, but that was once a life-threatening route. Around the border between Mu Lung Garden and El Nath Mts, there is an area that's surrounded by fog all year long. It's known as the #bSea of Fog#k.\r\n#b#L0#What's the Sea of Fog like?#l\n#k

It's a place where the current is unpredictable and a thick fog blinds you. The place is surrounded in a mystique of frequent wrecks and countless terrifying rumors.\r\n#b#L0#What sort of rumors?#l\n#k

This is the most famous one: Once, there was a time when pirates roamed the seas, threatening Maple World. One nameless but courageous navy admiral hunted them all down. His fleet was undefeated, until one day it vanished into thin air. Decades later, his fleet reappeared in the Sea of Fog as a ghost ship.\r\n#b#L0#Eek! A ghost ship?#l\n#k

Have you met the Dolphin Taxi? You might need its help to get to the Sea of Fog.

I knew it. Your task is to steal the #bqueen's treasure#k from the #bqueen's accessory chest#k. It's placed in the deepest part of the palace, near the king. It'll be hard for you to get close to it, but this is for Sand Bandits. I am sure you're up to the task.

Security inside the castle is very tight these days. There will guards everywhere, ready to pounce. So once you enter, be careful where you walk. Use hidden portals to discreetly approach the chest and retrieve the jewel. I'll wait here.
Hmmmph! You're backing out now?
Welcome back! Did you get the #t4031578#? Ohhhh, just as I expected! Nice, this should fetch some money...
Thanks to you, the Red Scor...er, I mean, Sand Bandits have been doing very, very well lately. Thank you. Hahaha... I hope you keep helping us down the road.

Hmmm... I don't think you've obtained the #b#t4031578##k yet. It should be inside the #bqueen's accessory chest#k inside the #bpalace#k. Of course, you must be discreet and use hidden portals. Good luck.

Argh! I can't believe it! The jewel I stole just got stolen. I won't let whoever stole it get away with this! Oh! You're here. Thanks for coming. Someone stole the jewel you worked so hard to get us. I didn't even have time to store it safely in the cave. I just stashed it behind that rock over there. I think I know who took it, too. Can you help?

It was #b#p2101000##k, the dancer. How do I know this? Because besides #p2101000#, no one else ever come here! I should've been more suspicious when she started practicing her dance moves out here. It had to be #p2101000#! Please, get the jewel back from her.
What?! The Sand Bandits' precious stolen jewel just got stolen, and you aren't curious who did it?
What's going on? It's almost show time, and I'm practicing my new moves. I'll show them to you later... What? Did I steal a piece of jewelry that was hidden behind a rock?
Hmm, a jewel hidden behind a rock... Ohh, that! Yes, I took it and gave it away to feed the hungry. Why do you ask? What? I'm interfering in the work of the Sand Bandits? No way! What are you saying?

I, Sirin, know more than anyone how much the Sand Bandits help the people of #m260000000#, and I would never disturb their work. The jewel hidden behind the rock was stolen by real bandits. That's why I took it.
I'm just about positive #b#p2101000##k is the one who took it. No one else comes here besides me and #p2101000#!

Sigh... you look so clueless. Think! The Sand Bandits are based in #m260000000#. They hide their identities so no one suspects them of going against the queen. You really think they'd hide their treasures out in the open outside town?
And the guy you said you helped... It sounds fishy to me. Why would he stand in the middle of the desert when everyone else is here in Ariant, doing their best to defy the queen?

And the guy ordered you to steal the queen's ring, right out from under her nose? No, no, that's too risky. Imagine if you were caught! The Sand Bandits would be totally compromised. No, they'd never ask you to do that. You definitely weren't working with a member of the Sand Bandits...

Seriously, who fed you that junk? It's a mound of dung, my friend, one so large that a Mushmom could sprout out of it. Ah ha! I'll bet it was #p2101012#? I'm right, aren't I? He sounds like a member of the #rRed Scorpions#k. What? You don't even know about the Red Scorpions? Jeez... I'd better explain, lest you find yourself on the wrong end of a pointed sword. Will you listen?

The Red Scorpions are a notorious band of thieves based right outside #m260000000#. Unlike the Sand Bandits, they are in it for their own good, and they disturb the peace and take things from the innocent. I think you got duped by the Red Scorpions.

You've been tricked by the Red Scorpions all this time! You are quite gullible. Perhaps I should offer to sell you a rare and magical Flaming Sword for the low, low price of 550 million mesos... HA! I mock you, my friend, but I don't think you're a bad person. Hmm, are you interested in getting revenge on the Red Scorpions? They did play you like a trumpet, after all...
If you want some payback on the Red Scorpions, let me know. I'll tell you exactly what to do.
Hmmm... I've been telling you the truth, and you don't trust me? Quite a complex you have there, my friend...

You're back, so I suppose you really want to turn the tables on the Red Scorpions. The way to do that is quite simple. Take their stolen treasures and give them out to the residents here. You're not only hurting the Red Scorpions, but you're also helping out the good people of Ariant. Poetic justice, don't you think?

The Red Scorpion's hideout is in The Scorching Desert, so the treasures they've stolen should be there as well. A suspicious man stands in front of the hideout like a guard. The thing is, even if you find the place, you won't be able to go in. The door can only be open by yelling out the magic words.

So you need to discover the password, then go to their hideout and steal their stolen treasures. What's the password? Hah...#byou probably already know it#k. It is a bandit hideout in the middle of a desert, after all. Afterwards, drop those treasures at secret stash spots in various homes in town. That's what I'd call revenge, served piping hot in this case!

Oh, and if you see an X on any of the houses, then that means it belongs to a known thief, so stay away. Once you've robbed the robbers, let me know, alright? I'd love to hear details on how the Red Scorpions got a taste of their own medicine.
A huge treasure chest can be found containing an amazing amount of treasures. All of them stolen by the Red Scorpions. \r\n#L0# #b Take some to distribute among the people in town.
Remove the treasure from the chest and place it in a pocket.
#b(Now, to give these to the people in town who need it.)#k
Hahaha, looking at you, I can tell you took the stolen treasures from the Red Scorpions and gave them to the people of #m260000000#. Feel better now?
The silly queen was already a big enough headache for everyone in #m260000000#, and now the Red Scorpions... Seriously, why are things in #m260000000# are becoming such a mess?
A huge treasure chest can be found that contains large amounts of treasures. Let's give these out to the people in town.
Hmmm...you said you were going to exact revenge on the Red Scorpions. I guess you aren't ready yet.
Hmmm...you said you were going to exact revenge on the Red Scorpions. I guess you aren't ready yet.
A huge treasure chest can be found containing large amounts of treasures. I may have to take some more.
Take some more treasures so more people will be happy to receive them.

#m260000000# is a mineral-rich area with a lot of Lidium, an ore that can only be found at the Oasis and the Nihal Desert. But no thanks to the greedy queen, who charges ridiculous amount of taxes, everyone's struggling these days. Apparently the queen is a fairy from Orbis... She spends all the tax money to bring in unfathomable amounts of treasures.\r\n#L0##bWhat does the Sultan do?#l

The Sultan? #p2101009# is supposedly brilliant but I've never seen him act that way. He certainly sleeps brilliantly... He has virtually no power. The word is, the queen put a spell on him...\r\n#L0##bDoes anyone stand up against the queen?#l

Fortunately there are brave people who do. They serve as inspiration to the residents of #m260000000#. If this heroic group of bandits, called the Sand Bandits, didn't steal the queen's treasures and hand them to the people here, then the city would've been long dead by now.\r\n#L0##bThe Sand Bandits? I'd sure like to meet them.#l
You want to join the Sand Bandits? But you're an outsider! Hm, but you give off a good vibe. Want me to tell you more about them?
The Sand Bandits are despised by the queen, so they disguise themselves as common folk. Contacting them is not impossible, however...

I heard a story, just a story, you hear, that the Sand Bandits write hints #bon the walls of a house somewhere in town#k. It's the key to contacting them. Find the wall, meet some members, and maybe, just maybe, you'll become one of them...
Of course, the wall looks just like any other wall, from a distance... So you need to check every wall. Here's a clue. It could be closer than you'd think.
But even if you do everything right, it still might not work out. Don't get your hopes up. It's not an easy organization to join.
Are you afraid? The Sand Bandits go against the Sultan, so you could get in deep, deep trouble if you're not careful.
Did you find the wall?\r\n#L0##b I did, but I have no idea what it's talking about.#l

What did it say?
#L0##b 'If I had an iron hammer and a dagger, a bow and an arrow...'#l
#L1# 'Byron♡ Sirin'#l
#L2# 'Ahhh I forgot.'
If I had an iron hammer and a dagger, a bow and an arrow, eh? Think about this! A weapon is just an item...until someone uses it, right? That's the only clue I can think of...
Man, Jiyur wrote on the wall again? Arrgh! I'll get that kid...
Really? You forgot? Well, do you remember where it was written?
I guess you haven't found #p2103001# yet. Well, it's tough to locate the Sand Bandits...
What?! If you just want to chat, buzz off. What? You want to join the Sand Bandits? Hmmm, you must have seen the writing on the wall. Haha! That means #p2101000# sent you...

You are not from #m260000000#. You can't even begin to understand the pain the people in #m260000000# are suffering, so what qualifies you to become a member of our group? How do we know you're not a spy from the queen? You willing to do some work for us?

Alright, then I'll test you. You know the Sand Bandits collect goods for the residents of #m260000000#, right? I want you to get some food for the people here. Get #b50 #t4000325#s#k, #b10 #t2010002#s#k, and #b10 #t2010000#s#k.
Don't tell me this is hard, okay? Our real missions are much, much tougher than this. Gathering #b#t4000325#s#k by killing #r#o2100101#s#k is nothing.
Look at that, you refuse! You must be a spy sent by the queen!
Hmmm, did you bring all the items I requested? Let's see. One, two, three... Not bad. You got it all.
But this is nothing. Even spies from the queen can do this. If you really want to be accepted as a member of the Sand Bandits, you'll need to do more.
Hey, you didn't get it all! I told you, I need #b50 #t4000325#s#k, #b10 #t2010002#s#k, and #b10 #t2010000#s#k.
It's good that you brought the food, but you need to help distribute it to the people of Ariant, too. If you are not a spy, then you have no problem with that, right?

Here, take these food packages. Your task is to drop them off at certain houses. Do not, I repeat, do not just place them anywhere. You have no idea how many people do that... Find a safe, secure hiding place to store the food in each house, understand?

Oh, and one more thing. Ariant has more than its share of thieves and crooks. We don't need to give them any food, obviously. You only need to drop the food packages at the homes of innocent residents, marked by a #bsign on the door#k. So check doors before entering.

If you lose it again, you'll have hell to pay.
One of the most important qualities of a Sand Bandit is selflessness. True, Sand Bandits steal riches from the queen, but it's not for us. It's for the people of #m260000000#.
A selfish individual cannot contain his greed. He will inevitably want to keep the expensive items for himself. This is taboo for a Sand Bandit. Thus, I must test how selfless you really are

It's simple. I need you to donate #b10,000 mesos#k. Too much? Think about it, we'll need much more than that to save #m260000000# from the queen. Selflessly part with 10,000 mesos, and I will believe in you.
You've done well so far. Don't falter now... Then again, it is hard to let go of mesos...
You've decided to donate 10,000 mesos? I am sure there was much you could have bought with that money, yet you selflessly sacrificed it for the people of #m260000000#. That's commendable.

Who are you? What do you want? What? You want to join the Sand Bandits? How did you...nevermind. That's not important. Do you really want to be a member?

Fine. I want you to take care of #r30 #o2100106#s#k and #r30 #o2100107#s#k, and bring back #b20 #t4000326#s#k and #b20 #t4000327#s#k as proof. Experience the true hardship of being a member before you commit yourself to the group.
Too hard, eh? That's why we don't let people into our group that easily.
Whoa, did you already take care of all those #o2100106#s and #o2100107#s? Whoa, you also brought the #t4000326#s and #t4000327#s? You really did that? No way!
You're much stronger than I thought. I didn't think you'd handle #o2100106#s and #o2100107#s that easily. I think this...should be enough for you to join the Sand Bandits...
I guess you haven't slain #r30 #o2100106#s#k and #r30 #o2100107#s#k and brought back #b20 #t4000326#s#k and #b20 #t4000327#s#k yet. I told you it's not easy.
I guess you haven't slain #r30 #o2100106#s#k and #r30 #o2100107#s#k and brought back #b20 #t4000326#s#k and #b20 #t4000327#s#k yet. I told you it's not easy.

Wow! I don't think I've had that much fun battling in a long time. To battle the queen, who's overly zealous and uses weird spells, we need to place her against a very formidable foe. Someone as powerful as you is definitely useful for the Sand Bandits.

That doesn't mean you're a member just yet. You may have passed my test, but you still haven't taken all the tests required to join the Sand Bandits. You'll need to find other members and pass their tests, too. Personally, I hope you become one of us.
If you beat me in a battle, then I'll accept you.

Why are you looking at me like that? If you don't turn around right now, I'll take it as an offense! What? Sand Bandits? How do you know that name? \r\n#b#L0#I found you by looking at the writing on the wall that #b#p2101000# told me to look for.#l
#p2101000#?! She's still doing stupid things. I appreciate that she's trying to help the Sand Bandits, but... Argh. Anyway, what do you want from me?\r\n#L0##bI'd like to join the Sand Bandits.#l

No way. An outsider like you wouldn't understand the suffering of #m260000000# enough to join Sand Bandits? Do you even know anything about the queen? Tell you what. If you have the guts to break into the queen's storage room and steal some treasure, I'll accept you as one of us.

Hah! At least you talk the talk. If you're so confident, then go into the queen's treasure storage room and steal the most expensive treasure there, #b#t4031574##k. It's at the very top of the treasure storage room, so it won't be easy.

Hello, traveler... What kind of story would you like to listen to?
#L0##bA Story about the Cat's Eye Jewel#l
#L1#A Story about a Jewel forged from the Desert Heat#l
#L2#A Story about a Jewel with Heavenly Power#l

#t4031574#... She's a jewel with Heavenly Power. A jewel that is most beautiful when shined upon by the sun... But she now sleeps somewhere in the treasure storage room, deep in the palace where there is no light. She can only be reached by a secret path... #e#basleep under the lamp that's never lit.#k#n

A jewel that resembles a cat's eye, aptly called a Cat's Eye Jewel. This powerful jewel has the ability to mesmerize anyone that looks upon it. It is at its best when adorned by a beautiful woman. There's a saying that goes, no one is immune from falling head over heels for anyone wearing a Cat's Eye Jewel. Perfect for anyone trying to seduce someone...
It is known as the heart of the desert, rumored to be formed by the very heat of the desert sun. It's solid, it's beautiful, it's...Lidium. Quite a surprise, isn't it?
For #t4031574#, the palace is the worst kind of fit for her... I am glad to know that someone from a special group is trying to rescue her...
You... You brought the #t4031574#! I honestly wasn't expecting it. That's incredible! You just might be the kind of person that the Sand Bandits have been looking for...
I think there's someone out there waiting for your story...

Every member of the Sand Bandits has a deep hatred towards the queen. We just don't show it publicly. You can't achieve anything if you don't even have self control.
That is why the most important trait of a Sand Bandits is patience. Being patient enough not to be swayed by what's unfolding right in front of your eyes, but patiently waiting for the right time.

Ho! You brought 2 #t4011008#s. This can only be found in the area around Ariant, and it's hard to make. But once it's made, it lasts for a long time. It may look brittle, but it's actually much harder than a diamond.

Ohhhh, you're back. Did you get the order of silk from #p2101013#?
Brilliant. Instead of fighting our fellow residents to steal the queen's treasures, it's much better to steal like this, nice and quiet, with no one realizing exactly what happened.
Hmmm... Haven't obtained the #b#t4031571##k yet? With the money we'll earn from that, the residents of #m260000000# won't go hungry for a while.

Hmmm? You lost the #p2101013#-transformation potion? You didn't throw that away because it looked gross, did you? Don't worry. I made lots of potions using #p2101013#'s beard, so I'll give you another one.

Hey, aren't you being a little too unselfish? What you've done has been quite incredible. Thanks to you, the Red Scorpions are a mess. That won't stop them from stealing stuff in the future, but when that happens, you can steal back the stuff they stole.
I know you helped the Red Scorpions, but that's because you didn't know any better. You've done a lot of good, too! It wouldn't be terrible for you to ask for a reward... Why are you so selfless?

As you know, the people of Ariant can't afford to reward you, and of course, the queen won't do a thing. And you couldn't possibly expect anything out of a poor dancer like me, right? So...take care of your own reward!

You really don't understand what I'm hinting at? Seriously, there's a place with a ton of treasure just sitting there... Think about it. I'll look the other way this one time. You know what I'm talking about now, right?
Huh? You really don't want a reward? You must be an angel or something...
This giant chest is full of expensive treasures. Take a look!\r\n#L0# #b (It shouldn't be a problem to take just a little, right? Even Sirin said it's all right...)
#b(Well, this is probably enough...)#k
#b(Doing a good deed definitely pays off...)#k
You still haven't gotten a reward? Come on, you've got to help yourself on this. You deserve it!
Hey, how's it going? I've been watching your every move, and... you look like you're ready for an advancement... and I want to recommend you to #p1090000#. What do you think?
I've known #p1090000# for a long time. Please visit #b#p1090000##k on the Nautilus. He'll be help you advance your job.
Do you feel like you're not ready to make the leap? You're humble, which is great, but keep in mind that this opportunity to make a job advancement disappears after a while...
Do I know you? Are you here to deliver something to me?
#p2101005#'s recommendation, huh? You must be seeking job advancement. If you really want to change your job, you need to take the test.
Have you spoken to #b#p1090000##k yet?
Here, you can become a great Pirate.
Did you lose the recommendation? I can write a new one for you.
Please try not to lose it this time.

Hm? Are you one of us? Wait, it doesn't even matter...just find me my arrows. I usually collect them right after I shoot them, but a few days ago, I wasn't feeling well so I didn't. This morning, I finally got out of bed and looked all over town for my arrows, but couldn't find them all. Now I'm missing some. Can you help me find them?

I only use #b#t02060001##k. A true skillsman only uses the one type of arrow that fit them perfectly. Right now, I am missing #b10000#k arrows. Think that's a lot? In order to rescue Ariant from the queen, that's nothing. I use way more than that in a single day.
Bring them to me once you find them all. You're my only hope.
People who constantly change their mind can't be trusted. I'll be keeping an eye on you from now on.

Great. Now I can continue to fight for Ariant. I will never forget what you've done for me. But, you didn't just buy any old arrows at a store, right? I make my own, so I can tell if you're trying to fool me... If you're trying to trick me, you will regret it.
Mmm... These are it. All #b10000#k of them. Thank you.
Did you find all the arrows? Search carefully near town as well...
I decided go see my sister! I discovered a way to get into the palace.\r\n#L0##b A way into the palace? (Does he mean...#p2101004#?)#l

I talked to some grown-ups and they said I can pay a man named #p2101004# to give me a #t04031582#. Only thing is, I don't have any money. Can you buy it for me? When I grow up and make lots of money, I'll pay you back. I promise!\r\n#L0##bSure, I can do that for you.#l\r\n#L1##bNo way! Do I look like I'm made of money?#l

Wow! Thanks! With the #t04031582#, I can go see my sister. But, what should I say to #p2101004#? I've seen him from afar and he doesn't look friendly...\r\n#L0##bDo you want me to get it for you?#l\r\n#L1##bHe's not scary. Nice guy, actually. (Don't be lazy, kid.)#l
You would really do that for me?
Oh... You don't have any money? I thought adventurers were rich...
He's ni...nice? You're the first person I've ever hear say that...
Sniff. Thank you so much. I will never forget this. After you buy the #b#t04031582##k from #b#p2101004##k, please bring it to me. I'll be waiting here.
If you change your mind, come see me. I'll be here.
Wow! You really got me the #t04031582#?\nThank you so much!
So this is the #t04031582#? With this, I can get inside the palace, right? Hm...? What's this empty space for? Am I supposed to write my name here? *Scribble, scribble* Hehe, sister, here I come!
Did you go see #b#p2101004##k? #b#p2101004##k is the man who stands guard at the Ariant palace entrance. I heard he will give you a palace entry pass if you bring him 2000 mesos.
Sniff, sniff... Wahh! \r\n#L0# #b #p2101001#! Why are you crying? Didn't you get to see your sister?
#h0#! No, I didn't get to see my sister...\r\n#L0# #b What happened? You had a #t04031582#!

Tigun said...sniff...because I wrote my name in that empty space...sniff...that I can't use that entry pass anymore...sniff. Plus...plus, he said I have to pay a fine for scribbling on such an important pass! He said he'll throw me in prison if I don't! Wah! I want my sister!\r\n#L0# #b (Oh boy. How did this get so complicated?) Now, now, stop crying. I'll take care of this. How much is the fine?
Sniff... It's #b50000 mesos#k...\r\n#L0# #b(Whoa! That's a lot of money. What a mess...) Do I just give the money to Tigun?
I think so...sniff... Will you really help me?
Sniff, thank you so much. You know where to find #b#p2101004##k, right? He's probably still at the palace entrance. Thank you, #h0#.
Oh... Oh I see... Sniff, sniff... Thanks anyway.

#p2101001#? That little bratty kid?! Ha! I let people in the palace if they have the #b#t04031582##k, but I'll never accept a pass that's been scribbled on like that! Do you know the work I put into those entry passes!? Ha, if he doesn't pay 50000 mesos, I'll throw him in prison!\r\n#L0# #bSigh... Then I'll pay you the 50000 mesos instead.#l
Huh? Really?\r\n#L0# #bUnder one condition. Let that kid, #p2101001#, meet his sister, #p2101008#.#l
I can't do that! She's very important to the queen. She is the queen's storyteller... How about this? I'll deliver letters to her instead... Sound like a good deal?

Very well, hehe. Any time the kid brings me a letter, I promise on my sacred name to deliver it to his sister. If she wrote one for him, I'll give pass it to him, too. I'll collect #b50000 mesos#k as a small delivery fee though.
I'll explain it to #p2101001# when he comes to see me, so you can be on your way. What? Okay ,okay. I won't mention the delivery fee. Hehe.
Did you talk to #b#p2101004##k? He said to bring #b50000 mesos#k if I don't want to go to prison...
What is it? You want to scribble on a #t04031582# too? If you don't want to pay the 50000 mesos, then fine, go to prison.
Hey, there! I've seen you around quite often these days... Do you even know what kind of place this is?\r\n#L0##bYes, of course. It's a charming little forest.#l
You have guts. Do you know how many #o5100003# roam around this forest?\r\n#L0##bOh, #o5100003#? That's okay! I'm stronger than you think.#l

Sigh... As a protector of this forest, it's also my duty to protect ignorant adventurers like you. This place is too dangerous. You need to go back down to town. Please don't come back up here again.\r\n#L0##bOk, got it! I'll be on my way then.#l\r\n#L1##bWhat are you talking about right now? I'm really strong!#l
Mmm... And really stubborn. Fine. If you hunt #r50 #o5100003#s#k in 30 minutes, I won't say another word about you being in this forest. You want to try?
Sigh... Adventurers... They don't know how dangerous this world can be...
If it gets too dangerous, just come right back. If you get in trouble, even I can't help you.
Why did you come here if knew you it was dangerous? Anyways, return to town as quickly as you can.
You're finally here! I was getting worried.

You really hunted 50 #o5100003#s?! Judging by your appearance, you went through quite a bit. Earlier, you looked so neat and clean. Anyways, you are really strong! It hasn't even been 30 minutes! Alright then, with that kind of power, I guess you can roam around the forest as you please.
If you want to stay in this forest. You want to try? You must hunt #r50 #o5100003##k in 30 minutes.
If you're here to see the dance, wait until the performance... Oooooh. Are you here about the rumor?
Oy vey! How could the dance of the amazing #p2101000# attract so few people? Ah well, so it goes. I'll tell you about the rumor then. A bounty has put on #r#o3220001##k.

What? Who is #o3220001#? Are you serious? He's only the biggest threat in the desert, the ruler of all the Cactus, the most powerful monster in all the Burning Road! You should learn more about #m260000000# from Byron, honestly!
Anyway, a bounty has been put on #o3220001#. And the reward is quite generous. You've know about #m260000000#'s underground organization, #bthe Sand Bandits#k, right? That's where the rumor started.
You want to hear more? If you want details, find out on your own. Maybe you should look for the #bleader of the Sand Bandits#k or something.
Huh? Then why are you here? Oooh, are you another fan of the amazing #p2101000#?

Oh, #h0# is that you? What is it...? Huh? A bounty...? Oh, you're talking about a bounty for #o3220001#. That means you heard the rumor from #p2101000#? It's true. The Sand Bandits have put a bounty on #o3220001#.

#o3220001# is a dangerous monster out to destroy the desert. A group of merchants traveling the Burning Road has been attacked a number of times, but the sultan and the queen couldn't care less. Hence, the Sand Bandits took matters into our own hands.
But this is too much for the Sand Bandits to take care of on our own, which is why we have put a bounty on the monster... Why, you ask? Well...

#o3220001#is an ancient #o2100104# that evolved into a monster. He's very smart. He can even use magic! That explains why some people worship him as the guardian of the desert. It sounds foolish, I know, but a good number of people actually believe that.
We can't just go out and defeat #o3220001#, as that will turn many people against the Sand Bandits. We must first convince the people... Will you take on this task?

The spokesman for the people who believe #o3220001# is the guardian of the desert is #b#p2100001##k. He is as stiff and stubborn as #t4011008#. #bConvincing#k that old man will be our first battle, before we even hunt the monster.

Convincing him won't be easy. You might have to give him a #bLidium#k as a gift before you can get him to listen... Often, when you talk to someone that stubborn, it helps to #bbeat around the bush and change the subject to get him where you want him, then put your foot down and convince him when the time is right.#k
It seems you have not connected with #bthe Sand Bandits#k yet. The Sand Bandits are an underground organization. If you want to talk to them, only thing you can do is to #bbecome one of them.#k
Are you here to make an item? Huh? #o3220001#? You're not here to spout that nonsense about #o3220001# being a monster, are you?

#o3220001#? A monster, huh? What an absurd thing to say! How dare you speak of the guardian of the desert that way! Sheesh, no respect. If you're going to believe that nonsense, get out of here! I have nothing to say to you! How dare you come #bempty-handed#k and...
What a relief. I've been rather irritable because people keep spewing that ridiculous nonsense about #o3220001# being a monster.

You convinced #p2100001#? I'm impressed. No member of the Sand Bandits has been able to win over that stubborn old man... You're incredible. You are the pride and joy of the Sand Bandits.\r\n#L0##b(Er, was it that big of a deal?)#l
Since you were able to do something no one has been able to do, you'll also defeat #o3220001# for us, won't you?\r\n#L0##b(Hmph, what happened to convincing that old man being half the battle!?)#l
Now, go and defeat #r1 #o3220001##k for us. It shouldn't be too difficult. Not for you.
You want to know where #o3220001# is? Well, I'm not sure. Seeing as how he's the leader of Cactus, wouldn't he be in the #b#Dry Desert##k? I don't think he appears that frequently, so be patient.
Too much for you? Not something I expected to hear. But, come closer and listen to me... There is a bounty being offered...
You've defeated #o3220001#! You're incredible! You have what it takes to protect this Desert! What? You want a reward?

HAHAHA! The Sand Bandits offered a bounty to anyone who can defeat #o3220001#, but that doesn't include members of the Sand Bandits! It's your duty to protect the desert! It's only right that you helped. HAHAHAHA! Mmm...
You haven't defeated #r1 #o3220001##k yet? I'm counting on you.

Did you hear the story? Recently, a huge sandstorm swept across Sunset Road in Nihal Desert. The path that connects Ariant to Magatia disappeared completely for a whole week. Even the residents there claim it was the biggest sandstorm they'd seen in a hundred years.

After the sandstorm passed, I checked to see how it affected the creatures and discovered something amazing. A Pyramid! A giant Pyramid standing right before my eyes!\nI think it's a Pyramid that used to be buried underground but resurfaced after the sandstorm drastically changed the landscape. The local residents claim the Pyramid is evil and don't go anywhere near it.

But I disagree with them. An evil Pyramid? That doesn't make any sense! So I decided to enter the Pyramid and study the basics of the ancient burial process. But someone stopped me in my tracks, saying that I was not qualified and that I would only enrage some god known as Nett.
Only those who are Lv. 60 or higher are allowed to enter. What a bummer...I'm Lv. 59! That means YOU'RE gonna have to explore the pyramid for me. How about it?

Awesome! I want you to investigate the inside of the Pyramid thoroughly and tell me what it's like in detail. Head to #bSahel 3#k, and you'll find a new path that leads you to the Pyramid. I'll be here waiting. The man that stopped me at the entrance of the Pyramid is called #b#eDuarte#n#k. Strange name, don't you think?
A giant Pyramid has revealed itself out of the blue! Aren't you excited to find out what's inside?
Stop immediately, foolish one. Are you not afraid of death?\r\n#b#L0#I want to explore the Pyramid.#l\n#k

Fools. A sea of fools. Are all humans this foolish? Even one who called himself a scholar dared to venture here. But is not death something to avoid?\r\n#b#L0#I am here on behalf of that scholar, Byron.#l\n#k

I see. That fool. I was merciful enough to save him from the throngs of death, and instead he drags himself to another one of its doorsteps. So be it. Let us see if he can escape the breath of Anubis.

I hereby grant thee the permission to enter. However, we must see whether the pyramid itself will accept thee...should that be the case, thou shall receive Nett's Pyramid when thy exploration has ended. Bring that to me, and I shall give thee a rare treasure.

Head to #bSahel 3#k, and you'll find a new path that leads you to the Pyramid. I'll be here waiting. The man that stopped me at the entrance of the Pyramid is called #b#eDuarte#n#k. Strange name, don't you think?
Hey, did you hear the rumor? The one about the Wasteland at the end of the desert west of Ariant? They say once you go in, you can never come back...

I've heard there were huge clouds of sand and mammoth shadows stretching out over the Wasteland... the size of a building! And they say shadows of the dead walk around, just waiting to grab unsuspecting travelers! Aren't you curious?

I knew you would be! You're the kind of adventurer that'll trek right into that Wasteland and find out what's going on! You can select #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror Portal#k and go all the way to #bAzwan Obelisk#k. Come back... if you can!
Oh, you're not? Man, I thought that was a pretty good story.

I did not expect to find anyone in this barren place. Have you come to help our Cygnus Knights? We are lacking sorely in resources. No one could have guessed we would find an entire underground city in the Obelisk.
I thought you were all 'hooray' and 'let's go into the desert on a whim.' Just take the Dimensional Mirror Portal.
The Cygnus Knights were shaken to the core recently. I won't go into the details, but I'm sure it was because of Hilla, the Commander of the Black Mage's Army.
#rHilla#k... She may be beautiful, but she's a necromancer. She deals with the bodies and souls of the dead. We couldn't just let her run around unchecked, so the knights tracked her here.

We found this Obelisk... It's conspicuously huge to be in the middle of this barren desert. That's when we discovered the #bUnderground City of Azwan#k right below it. It's awash in Hilla's dark energies.
Hilla's set herself up here and she's got a strong foothold. We've sent a lot of people in to battle against her armies, but they just haven't found her. The place is covered in the undead.

Hilla's different from the other Commanders. Where they operate secretly in small numbers, she's amassed a huge army of undead. How do you fight an army that never runs out of soldiers? It's only a matter of time before she wins at this rate.
With your help, we might be able to turn the tides. What do you say? Will you stand beside the Cygnus Knights and fight in the name of Maple World.
Good. You're going to want to get acquainted with the situation. #rThere is no one alive#k in the city of Azwan, but #beven the dead can tell stories there#k. Good luck.
Enter the Obelisk and check out #bAzwan#k for yourself.
You're one of those creeps who doesn't trust the Empress yet, aren't you?
I wouldn't have even asked you if I didn't think you could make it through the #rwar#k.
I apologize, outsider. His highness is rather stubborn about new people stepping foot on his land, after the whole... Hilla incident.
Your aura is quite positive. Azwan was once full of people like me, women able to direct the flow of energy from one person to another. Our title was #bShamaness#k. Hilla... was one of us.

Among the shamanesses, Lady Hill... no, Hilla was the most beautiful, the most skilled in song and dance. She was a charismatic leader with phenomenal abilities. We all looked upon her in adoration... #runtil she presented Azwan to the Black Mage as a gift#k.
Thousands of people, all taken body and soul by a selfish woman to appease her fool of a master. It's hard to even think of this pile of rubble as the Azwan I once knew.

I think a visit around the city will give you more perspective. Take the #bportal on the right#k to look around Azwan. Observe what became of us. Witness the cruelty done by Hilla. Once you see it with your own eyes, you will understand our rage.
That portal was created so that his highness and other officials could quickly travel across Azwan. Taking it should help you get around the #rbattlefield#k without being spotted.
Was the respect and love of her people not enough?
Have you seen the devastation? Those monsters were once good people. Only those of us who were directly beneath the Holy Obelisk escaped with our minds. The rest...
It is too much to bear. Our sanity and our minds may remain, but we have no hope of stopping Hilla. We need a warrior like yourself to aid us. Please, I beg you!
I apologize. I get very emotional when I talk about about Hilla...
Hilla's reign of terror can not go on any longer. If we all join forces, we may be able to stop her!

The method is... rather crude. We need to free the souls of the people trapped here. That means destroying the undead bodies they are now trapped in. It will not be a permanent solution, though, since Hilla's power will just draw them back in.
My role as a shamaness will be to herd the souls to safety before she is able to recapture them. With luck, we may be able to save a good deal of them in time.
I would not burden a stranger with such a huge undertaking without pay. The people of Azwan may be mere ghosts now, but we still have our pride... and our possessions.
Azwan was once a flourishing civilization... Many were taken by Hilla, but their treasures still remain. The #bprime minister#k knows more about this, so please go see him.
I was hoping you would be more sympathetic to our cause...

I assume you heard everything from Medina. I hope she didn't send you on a goose-chase for treasure. Let me tell you first, the people of Azwan considered mental training far more important than physical possessions. As such, we discovered a power called #bInner Ability#k.
Fighting this battle will put you on the path to discovering your Inner Ability. The people of Azwan knew that honor brings strength.

We also prized a currency other than mesos. The coins you'll see are called #bConqueror's Coins#k and #bEmperor's Coins#k. These coins are used exclusively in Azwan. They'll be worth your while, if you keep it.
As you distinguish yourself across numerous battles, you may also come across items of great value from the Azwan royal family, or even a device we call a #bCirculator#k.

The Circulator will help you ensure that you unlock the Inner Ability that is most important to you. In other words, it allows perfect control over your abilities, so that you can receive the ones you want. Doesn't this object entice you?
This is all the strength that Azwan possesses. But ghosts have no need for treasures of the past. I will gladly give them to you, if you save our people.\r\n
Visit Prime Minister Longorias.
The rewards are high because this fight will be dangerous.
The Obelisk's protective aura only reaches us here. Most of the other areas of Azwan are still under Hilla's influence.
I assure you, the battle may be tough, but the treasures we have to offer will make it more than worth your time.
Are you prepared to fight? You might experience a humiliating defeat or leave with nothing but a grudge.
Surely you can see the reason in this fight.
Azwan thanks you for your help. I saved a lot of souls, but not as many as I would have liked. Most of them fell back under Hilla's control.
It's all my fault. My powers cannot match Hilla's magic. #rI just can't fully purify the souls before her power overtakes me#k. I wish I was stronger...
I can't get any stronger as a ghost, but I might be able to channel my strength through a #bShamaness Marble#k. I think His Majesty may have one. Could you ask him?
I'd talk to him myself, but he's not very fond of me...
You must also be tired from all the fighting. I apologize...
...What do you want foreigner? ...A Shamaness Marble?
You still haven't seen the king? He's right there...
......\r\n#L0##b(Iason looks displeased. Maybe you shouldn't have asked. Does he really dislike Medina this much?)#l\n#k
Take your request to Longorias if you want the Shamaness Marble.
What has become of my kingdom that I, the king,, must listen to the requests of a foreigner?
Are you in need of a Shamaness Marble? His Majesty handled them personally, but they were given to Hilla long ago...
I suppose they must be made again...
Who are you to demand so much of a king?
The Shamaness Marble isn't generally used outside of important rituals. The king was always in charge of keeping an eye on them...
But the king was quite fond of Hilla. He doted on her and gave her gifts without thinking. Don't get me wrong, it was never gratuitous. Hilla was a powerful shamaness who protected our kingdom...
No one could have seen that coming. But it's in the past now and this is the present. If you want me to make a new marble, I will try.
I'm going to need the right ingredients. You should be able to get them relatively easily.
Will you help these fools?
The king acted like a fool... but I am just as much to blame. I was his teacher. I drilled obstinance and self-righteousness into him from the day he was born.
Is this all that can be done right now?
Still missing a few things?
The Shamaness Marble is complete. It's not as potent as the ones I used to make, but it should still function.
Poor Medina... She was the first to notice Hilla's odd behavior, but no one believed her. They all believe her now...
Medina spoke the truth, but the king only offered her his hatred. His anger over Hilla's betrayal was unleashed on Medina... poor child.
We need your help...
You haven't talked to Medina?
You don't have the Shamaness Marble?
It seems like you dropped your Shamaness Marble.
This is a good start in alleviating the peoples' suffering.
Do you know the trick to succeess? Destroy the Guardian Tower...
...Fantastic! You might be able to rescue the people from Hilla with your abilities!
Do I have to explain again? Destroy the Guardian Tower on Normal Mode.
You've got some skills, but being a good fighter won't get you through Hard Mode. You'll have to show cunning and patience.
Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #Occupation mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in Defense Mode. We need them both destroyed if we're going to make any headway.
This won't be easy...
If only we had a hundred more warriors of your strength...
Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.
This battlefield is unlike any other. You will be risking your life just walking into this fight, but the people of Azwan still need you. Be brave, and you will survive.
Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k. This will be quite different than Hard Mode! I hope you're prepared.
You don't have to go if you're too scared.
You've lived through more than anyone else I've met. Hilla's soldiers get stronger as you approach her base, and the peoples' souls are in more pain. We must save them.
Destroy the #rGuardian Tower#k in #bAttack Mode#k or #bOccupation Mode#k and destroy the #rMega Ballista#k in #bDefense Mode#k.
Collecting supplies is just as important as fighting on the front lines. It should be somewhat safer, but you still have to watch your back.
Bring back #b100 Supply Boxes#k from Hilla's soldiers. We can make sure to supply our troops while we steal from theirs.
I guess you're looking for more fierce battles.
You haven't gotten all the Supply Boxes yet...
I want to tell you about the great treasures Azwan holds. Are you ready?
All right. I'll be gathering my thoughts, so talk to me when you're ready.
Talk to me when you're ready to listen.
Let me talk about the Supply Mode. Care to listen?

There is no specific strategy for succeeding in Supply Mode, but I will tell you how to participate. Join in the Supply Battle #rfrom QRQRQR to QRQRQR#k, using the #bQuest Notifier at the right side of the screen #i3800265##k, and the Supply Mode quest for the Fight for Azwan can be taken.
We've almost made it.\r\n#b#h0##k, will you take part in the liberation of Azwan?
Thanks to countless Maple Warriors, Azwan is finding hope. Only one hurdle remains. #b#h0##k, please defeat #rHilla#k and liberate Azwan.
A-are you just going to leave us in our time of peril? We've come so far!
I had dreamed of this day, but I never thought it would come. Azwan... is free! This is the dawn of a new era. Thank you, #b#h0##k.
Please don't give up. You must fight for Azwan!
Is it that difficult to defeat Hilla without sacrificing one's life? \n#b#h0##k, do you think you can defeat Hilla #rwithout being knocked out#k?

It won't be easy to beat her without falling, but I think you can do it, #b#h0##k. Take down Hilla #rwithout dying, even once#k. If you succeed, I will give you a seal that proves you are officially the most powerful hero in Maple World.
Ah...do you think it's impossible? I wonder...
#b#h0##k, you are unbelievable! I would hate to be on your bad list. Thank you for being an inspiration to all of Maple World.
It maybe difficult, but I don't think it's impossible. Please, try again
We don't know everything about Hilla's power, but anyone can be defeated with sheer perseverance. #b#h0##k, do you have what it takes to utterly crush her?
If you defeat Hilla #r50 times#k, come back and talk to me. I'll give you something to prove that you're officially the most stubborn Maple Hero ever!
Whew... It's really hard to find a warrior with perseverance...
Great job, #b#h0##k! Nobody can beat your perseverance! \nAll of Azwan will praise your hard work!
You're almost there! Please keep up the good work!!
Hilla's powers are immense, but I bet a warrior like you will make short work of her. Do you think you would be able to beat her faster than anyone else?
I know she's tough, but you are much stronger! I know you can #rtake Hilla out in 7 minutes#k.
