Well, I have something here called a #bNexon Prepaid#k. It comes in 2 kinds: #b100 points#k and #b250 points#k. These are available wherever you see the store that I work in, #rTarget#k. You will need your #bAllowance#k from Mom and Dad to get one, though. I can give you the Mouse you want for free if you come back later to get a #bNexon Prepaid#k. Keep the card, and in two weeks it will turn into actual Maple Points you can use. Here's the mouse you need. Hurry back!
I can see that you aren't going to change your mind anytime soon. That's sad. When you're ready to finish your chore, come back!
Ah, back already I see, ready to get your #bNexon Prepaid#k?
Excellent, well, here you go! Remember to keep it, after the Event ends, it will become #rMaple Points#k you can use in the Cash Shop!
Looks like you have some dirt, but not your #bAllowance#k. When you get your #bAllowance#k from Mom and Dad, be sure to return!
Hey, what are you doing here? Please don't tell me you are here to tell me you lost the Repaired Ring for Gary and Shatima, are you?

Oh my. You did lose the Repaired Ring... I knew it! I found these Rings on the ground the other day and it looked so familiar but I wasn't sure whose they were. Let me get it for you. Talk to me again.

Oh you got the Repaired Ring? I see. I found some rings laying on the ground and I thought you lost them. But I guess you didn't. Well, you don't have a thing to worry about. Say hi to Gary and Shatima for me.
Here is what you were looking for. Please don't lose it this time. This rings mean something to Gary and Shatima.
Just go straight to Gary and Shatima this time. No fooling around!
Easter is upon us. To celebrate, I'll be crafting Easter Baskets for everyone. Do you want one?
Good choice. Can you bring me #b100 Tree Branches#k, #b100 Squishy Liquids#k?
I see. I make the best baskets in town, so if you change your mind, I'll be here.
Great job gathering up #b100 Tree Branches#k, #b100 Squishy Liquids#k needed to make the #rEaster Basket#k. Now let me see here...
Here's your #rEaster Basket#k! By the way, I hear that the Easter Bunny's nasty cousin is trying to ruin Easter this year. Avoid that rotten egg. He is a disgrace to the season.
Are you are missing something? I need #b100 Tree Branches#k, #b100 Squishy Liquids#k to make an #rEaster Basket#k.

Yeah, you heard me right, I hate Easter. I come from a long line of Easter Bunny's, but I'm not down with all that painting and scavenger hunting nonsense.\r\nDon't get me wrong. I did my time at Easter Bunny School, but they told me I don't have painting skills. I got skillz... graffiti skillz that is!

Besides, you think I want to walk around all night climbing trees and looking for bushes to plant some stupid boiled eggs. Hells no! You should join my crew and take down Easter. If you do, I'll hook you up.

You just wasted my breath. Get lost!

My posse and I will be putting these to good use, if you know what I mean. Oh yeah...I always pay my debts on time. Talk to me later and we'll do it again.

MapleStory is having its second birthday bash, and we're going to celebrate it big time! We'd like to thank you, are you ready for the Birthday Quest?
Excellent! Here's the deal...bring me a #bRed Birthday Present#k, and I'll help you open it. Hurry back!
I see. Please remember that this event ends soon, so if you want to take a crack at it later, then please talk to me!
Wow, that was pretty fast! Aren't you ready to open up your present?
Tada. Here's your present! Hope you like what you see in it! Thank you so much for helping us celebrate MapleStory's second birthday!

I don't think you have a Blue Birthday Present yet. Please bring me one and I can open it for you!

Hey, what's going on? Can you believe it? MapleStory is having its second birthday! It's all thanks to great Maplers like you! Well, anyway, we plan on having a big party among the MapleStory staff, and I need your help, big time. Can you help me out?

Thanks! Well, we have the cake (and pie), the food, and everything else needed for a grand party, but I forgot to buy something very important-birthday candles! I mean, what's a birthday party without the candles on the cake, you know? We'll need #b10 Birthday Candles#k for the party, so please get them for me as fast as you can. You should try hunting the #bCandle Monsters#k for them. I'll be here waiting for you. Good luck!
Oh, I see... that's alright. You must be busy with your other quests. But if you ever have a spare time, then please help me out here! I'll be here waiting for you...
Oh my goodness, you really did bring all #b10 of the Birthday Candles#k that I asked you to get! Nicely done!

Thanks a whole bunch for your help! Phew, I could have gotten chewed out by my boss for this. Anyway, here's something for you. Hope you like it! Well, I'm off to tha par-tay, so I'll see you later! Happy Mapling!
I don't think you have the #b10 Birthday Candles#k that I asked you to get. The party is going to start soon, and I'll need those #bBirthday Candles#k fast! Please hurry!
Welcome traveler! I am Ames The Wise and I am here to tell you stories of Amoria. But today, I had a special request from my brother to explain him and his work. Are you interested?

Well, my brother Amos is the strongest member of our family. He's so busy training, he's never had time to really find someone special. So, rather than pout about it, he built a special challenge for married couples, in the name of Elias. As you know, Elias sacrificed himself to create a memorial to Cecelia, his true love.

The Amorian Challenge is a test of strength for married couples, where they must work together to survive. He can tell you more about it. He's at the far end of Purplewood forest, you can get there by traveling through the Purple Plains.
Ok, what else can I help you with?

You have a question about Amorian Challenge? You've come to the right place. The Amorian Challenge is the perfect way for Married couple to train together. You don't have to be with your spouse to train (although Amoria seems to reward both of you playing at the same time), you just need to be married. I built this hunting ground as a tribute to the memory of Elias, and there are plenty of dangers inside for you and 5 other.
Here is just a taste of the special items, I've placed in my Vault. Treasures you shall only see, use and wear should you triumph! When you are ready, see me!
Go to Amos The Strong and ask more about Amorian Challenge. If you are eligible, you can start the challenge and even if you aren't he might still have something nice to show you.
Hey! Nice to see you on this hot summer day. Makes me want to snag something to drink. Think you can help me out with a little barbecue?

Enthusiasm! Always good to see. Well, I'm preparing a barbecue for some of friends and we're running low on ingredients. It starts pretty soon, so I'll need you to gather #b10 #t4031664#s (#i4031664#), 10 #t4031665#s (#i4031665#) and 10 #t4031666# (#i4031666#)#k, after that I can finish the barbecue! Thanks a bunch. I'll be waiting!

If you give me the #b#t4031019##k, then I'll request it for deciphering to the expert at Omega Sector. I'll give you #b#t4031017##k in return. It's a mysterious box that contains an item, and no one knows what's inside. What do you think? Will you give me that scroll?

Hey... isn't this #b#t4031019##k? Hmmm... I have to say, I know a thing or two about this item. This is a scroll that contains parts of the ancient secrets that's been sealed to it. It is a very mysterious item, and if you try to open this without supervision, might put a curse on you to protect its contents.

Alright! I'll have to request it immediately! By the way, do you know how to open the #b#t4031017##k? You'll need an item called #b#t4031072##k in order to open that box. I used to have it, only to lose it one day at a place where monsters were aplenty.

Please defeat #b#o2230103##k, which can be found at Eos Tower en route to Ludibrium, and bring back the #b#t4031072##k with you. I'll open the #b#t4031017##k for you if you bring me that. I'll be here awaiting good news.
Hmmm... I can assure you that keeping the scroll won't do much for you. Talk to me if you want to change your mind!
You really did bring #b#t4031072##k! Now I can open #b#t4031017##k with ease. What do you think? Do you want me to open this for you right now?
Do you like the item you got from this box? Alright, if you ever find #b#t4031019##k again, please come talk to me!

I don't think you have found #b#t4031072##k, yet. I lost the #b#t4031072##k a while ago at Eos Tower near Ludibrium. Please defeat #b#o2230103##k, a spider look-alike monster, and bring the key back so I can open the box for you.

Hello there... are you about to embark on a journey? You look a bit too weak to take on such a task. When I was young, I was eager to prove my existence to the world by roaming around the world, experiencing everything... I miss those days. There's nothing quite like traveling around in different exotic places, soaking in everything I could soak in...
I was green and unaware of what exactly was in store for me, so I had my share of hard times. Seeing you right now brings back those memories...

You know, I am saying this because I think you have great potential, but if you prove me right by completing a task I'm about to give you, then I'll help you get started with your journey. Do you want to do it?
Alright. Please gather up #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b30 #t4000004#s#k for me, then I'll see what I can do to help you out.
Really? I was just trying to help... if you ever change your mind, come talk to me.
That was fast! I knew you'd be good, but this is better than I expected. I can safely say that you'll become quite a traveler around here. I truly believe that.

Did you get the money? I know it's not much, but this may be very useful to someone like you who has just begun the journey. It would be nice to run into you someday and see you mature into a complete package.

You haven't gotten all the items I asked you to get. Maybe I have overestimated your abilities. Please gather up #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b30 #t4000004#s#k as fast as you can. I know you are more than capable of doing so.
이봐...... 자네 모험을 떠나려고 하고 있나? 하지만 조금 약해 보이는데... 나도 젊었을 땐... 새로운 세계를 찾아 여기저기 여행을 다녔었지...그때가 그립구만. 멋진 모험을 하는 것 만큼 신나는 일은 없거든.
하지만 처음에는 경험도 없고 준비도 부족했기 때문에 너무 힘들었었지... 자네를 보니까 내가 젊은 시절 모험을 할 때 고생했던 기억이 자꾸 떠오르는군...
자네가 왠지 맘에 들어서 하는 말인데 말야. 모험가로서의 자네의 자질을 내게 증명한다면 내가 자네의 모험을 지원해 주겠네. 어떤가 해보겠나?
좋아. 그렇다면 #b#t4000016# 50개#k와 #b#t4000004# 30개#k를 모아서 나에게 다시 와~ 이것들을 다 모아오면 자네의 자질을 인정해주겠네.
그래? 도와주려고 했는데...... 마음이 변하면 다시 찾아와봐
이거 굉장한걸 그새 다 모아오다니. 역시 내 눈은 틀림없다니까. 자네는 앞으로 좋은 모험가가 될 수 있을거야. 난 그렇게 믿네.
돈은 잘 받았나? 비록 얼마 되지는않지만 지금 막 모험을 시작하는 자네에게는 유용하게 쓰일 수 있을거야. 머지않아 강해진 자네를 다시 만날 수 있으면 좋겠군.
음... 아직 다 모으지 못한 모양이군? 내가 자넬 너무 과대평가한건가?.........서둘러 #b#t4000016# 50개#k와 #b#t4000004# 30개#k를 모아오게나. 자네라면 충분히 할 수 있을거야

This is why MapleStory is proud to present #rBeat the Heat#k Challenge for the summer. Anyone that passes the three stages of the event will be provided with an opportunity to enter a ballot for prizes. Would you like to participate in this event?

Good choice. You'll find yourself forgetting how hot it is outside once you fully engage yourself in this event. This event has 3 difficulty settings designed to sufficiently meet your level, and I think you should participate in the #r<Easy>#k level.

The 1st stage of the <Easy> level will be a warm-up task. Your job is to head out to the field and defeat #b50 #o0130101#s#k and #b20 #o1210102#s#k. Easy, right? Complete the task for the 1st stage, and then I'll give you the instructions for the 2nd stage. Good luck!
This event goes on until September 2nd, so if you decide to change your mind, you should definitely participate in this event!

Here are some watermelons for you to forget the dog days of the summer. Please come see me if you want to tackle on Stage 2.

원로 그레이의 해킹 시도는 실패로 끝났군. 하지만 이 흔적들을 보니 마을을 쉽게 해킹 할 수는 없겠어.
하지만 이번 작전의 저지로 만족 할 순 없네. 혹시 김박사의 보안 센터에는 가봤나? 홈페이지에 있는 보안 센터에 가보면 당신의 계정을 보호할 수 있는 완벽한 대비책을 세워 놨네. 한번 가서 확인해 보게나. 잃고 난 뒤에는 후회해도 소용이 없을 테니까.....
공격 날자는 확인해 봤나요? 획득한 아이템은 슬리피우드의 '기억하고 있는 자'에게 가져다주세요.
공격 날자는 확인해 봤나? 홈페이지 김박사의 보안본부에서 확인 할 수 있네. 아직 해킹 시도의 흔적을 찾지 못한 것 같구먼.

#i1142134# Over 50 #t1142134#
#i1142135# Over 200 #t1142135#
#i1142136# Over 500 #t1142136#

아휴~ 궁금해. 궁금해요. 뭐가 그렇게 궁금하냐고요? 저는 달을 제대로 본 적이 없어요. 왜냐면 달에서 태어나 여태 그 곳에서 살고 있어서 제대로 볼 수 없었죠. 그래서 이곳으로 내려왔는데.. 도무지 보이질 않네요.
대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 여행자님께서 알려주시겠어요?
제가 드린 #b#t2430031##k는 소비창을 열어보시면 있을거에요. 마을 어딘가에서 밝은 보름달을 보게 되면 가까이 가서 #b인벤토리(단축키 I)#k를 열고 #i2430031:# #b#t2430031##k를 더블클릭하세요. 그러면 기타창에 #b달사진#k이 생길거에요. 달사진이 시간이 지나 현상이 되어 선명해 지면 그 때 저에게 가져와 주세요.
제가 불쌍하지도 않으신가요? (..훌쩍..)
꺄아~ 드디어 제가 부탁한 달사진을 가지고 오신건가요? 어서 제게 주세요!
와~ 정말 제가 제일 가지고 싶어하던 달사진이 맞네요! 달사진을 아주 많이 가지고 싶어졌어요! 내일 또 저를 찾아오셔서 달사진을 찍어주셔야해요!
달사진이 없으신거 같은데요? 아니면 아직 선명하지 않던가요. 달사진은 시간이 지나야 현상이 된답니다. #i4032433:# 이렇게 선명해지면 저에게 가져다주세요.
달사진을 찍는데 실패하셨나요?
걱정마세요. 달사진을 찍을 폴라로이드는 언제든 다시 드릴 수 있으니까요. 어라? 어디갔지? 잠시 후에 다시 말을 걸어주시면 폴라로이드를 찾아 드릴게요.
부끄러워 하실 건 없어요.
자, 폴라로이드에요. 꼭 보름달 가까이서 예쁜 사진을 찍어서 현상이 되면 저에게 가져와주세요.

Since long ago, a piece called the Moonlight Sonata has been passed through the generations here on the moon. This song brought peace to those who heard it and cleansed their soul. When I was young, I would sit on my grandfather's lap and listen it.

But one day, the sheet music to the piece disappeared. It's been slowly forgotten, and now there are no Moon Bunnies left who know the piece. I don't want it to disappear like this. I want to sing it to my grandson, Baby Moon Bunny, just like my grandfather sang it for me.

As you can see, I don't have much longer here on the moon. I heard that you travel all over Maple World. Perhaps you can learn about the #bMoonlight Sonata#k in your travels. For the sake of my Baby Moon Bunny, please find the sheet music to the #bMoonlight Sonata#k.

Hm... Ah. Ahhh, yes! Yes, I remember this one fondly.\r\n#L0##bYou remember now? Are you ready to come clean?#l\n#k

I can see how my lovely statue could pass for the real thing, but I cannot believe you think I would ACTUALLY have something to do with the REAL Zakum. Now, since you've brought me this little memento, I'll give you a commemorative coin. So, how about dropping this unhealthy curiosity and having some fun, hmmm?

Hi there, #b#h0##k. Have you been keeping up with the Maple Rising Star Contest? It's being held to celebrate the Maple 7th Anniversary. Countless people have competed to become the star of Maple World, but they're down to the final 3 contestants now.

The finalists include #bCygnus#k, who was born with natural grace and a lovely singing voice; the tomboy #bValerie#k, who has amazing moves and an even more amazing voice; and #bLilin#k, who is adorably sincere, full of potential, and impressively driven. #rDuring the 7th Anniversary Event#k, these three will be competing to become the #rMaple Rising Star#k.

So, #b#h0##k. How do you feel about joining #bLilin's#k fan club, and cheering her on to victory? This is an important decision for you, you know. #rYou can leave a fan club that you have joined, but your fan club progress will be reset#k. Are you going to stand by #bLilin#k?
You can take the #bDimensional Mirror#k in town to the #rRising Star Hall#k. There, you can meet the three contestants, including Lilin.
Meet Lilin and tell her that you will join her fan club!
Don't you care about the Maple Rising Star Contest? It's the biggest competition of the year!
Oh, #b#h0##k! You must be here to lend your support. Thank you so much.
As a member of my fan club, please keep me in your thoughts, and help me become the Maple Rising Star!
Okay, #b#h0##k. Let's get this done!
You met Lilin by taking the Dimensional Mirror in town to the Rising Star Hall.

The Maple Rising Star must be excellent in all areas, but the most basic one is #bsinging#k. Having a great voice is really the cornerstone of this competition, #b#h0##k. Will you help #rLilin#k develop her singing voice?

During the #rMaple 7th Anniversary#k, the fairies of music have taken the #bHandbells#k for the notes Do, Re, Mi, Fa, So, La, Ti, and Do, and have hidden them around Maple World. We have no idea why they do this.

Unfortunately, we need these Handbells. They look like this: #i03994271#, but in different colors. I was lucky enough to find the first one, Do. You should be able to obtain the other seven Handbells by hunting monsters. However, #bmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than your level do not have the Handbells#k, so hunt monsters close to your level.

After you have collected all 8 Handbells, take the Dimensional Mirror to the Rising Star Hall, and give them to #rLilin#k. The Handbells should help #rLilin#k practice her singing. I know you can do it, #b#h0##k!
I guess you think you have something more important to do. Let me know when you're ready to help.
Go to Lilin and give her the 8 Handbells.
Do you have all 8? I'm pretty sure you're missing at least one...

Well, #b#h0##k, it would seem #bLilin#k has really gotten interested in playing instruments, as well. I'm sure she'll want to master this skill as well. She's passed on a request to you. Are you ready to help?

Do you know about #bOrpheus's Sheet Music#k? Orpheus was a legendary bard, who was said to make the very trees and rocks dance to his music. No one knew the secret of his amazing melodies, but it is rumored that sheet music detailing his techniques is hidden somewhere in Maple World.

I've heard that monsters have found the sheet music, and are now running amok with it. There should be #b8 different sheet music pages#k you can collect and bring to Lilin. You can find these pages with #rall normal monsters#k, but not #bmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than you#k. Good luck!
I can't believe you would refuse her request like that... Are you not a true fan?
Go to Lilin and give her the sheet music.
You should check if you have all the sheet music.

We have a problem, #b#h0##k. I know you have been helping #rLilin#k with her practice, but she's in a slump with her dancing. She keeps practicing the same moves, but I don't think her heart is in it. Can you find a way to help her?

Lilin needs inspiration to come up with some new moves, and she want to use you for that, #b#h0##k. Put this Funky Machine in your Set-up Inventory, and it will record every move you make. Just carry on normally, #b#h0##k. Lilin wants to draw inspiration from your everyday moves.

The motion capture will be completed in #r30 minutes#k. After that, you have #b3 hours#k to take the Funky Machine to #rLilin#k. Oh, and if you #blog out during this process#k, you could lose all your recordings! Okay, #b#h0##k, go to it!

You can meet Lilin by taking the Dimensional Mirror to the Rising Star Hall.

So, how's the fan club going, #b#h0##k? I guess you heard that #rLilin#k has been having a hard time lately. I mean, the life of a star may be glamorous and all, but behind all the glitz, they can get really lonely sometimes. You think you could help me cheer her up?

See, here's the problem. I made 5 placards with inspirational phrases and stuff for her, but monsters stole them all. #rHunt normal monsters#k in Maple World, and find #ball 5 Encouragement Placards#k. And, when you give them to her, put your heart into it, okay?

Just so you know, #rmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than your level#k probably don't have the placards, so go after ones near your level. I'm sure #bLilin#k is waiting for you, so good luck!
Wow, really? You're just going to let her suffer through her fame and adoration all by herself?
Bring the Encouragement Placards to Lilin.
Huh? Are you sure nothing is missing?

We must get that picture back, before it's used to harm her image. There's no time to lose! You're ready to help, right?\r\n

Bring the Humiliating Picture Film to Lilin as quickly as possible!

I've heard you've been very busy with your fan club, #b#h0##k. That's good, and I'm sure you're doing a good job, but I think there's something you're neglecting. Stars have a very stressful life, and sometimes they need help with the things that cause them stress.

The stars going for the Maple Rising Star title are no different. In fact, they probably have to train and work harder than others, which leads to even more stress. We really need to help them out. Are you interested?

Self-image can cause a lot of unnecessary stress for stars, so I think this is where we can help them most. There's a new exercise trend growing in Maple World. They say that #rhunting monsters#k increases your muscle tone and burns fat at an incredible rate!

However, this method has not been scientifically verified, so I cannot suggest it to the stars yet. But that's where you come in, #b#h0##k. This is a #rCalorie Counter#k. When you hunt monsters, this measures how many calories you burn. I've set it to measure a full workout, so bring it back when the gauge is full. Based on how long it takes you, I can figure out if this is a good exercise method or not.

The types of monsters you fight don't matter, but their level does. For you, #b#h0##k, I think you need to #rbattle Level 13 - 30 monsters#k. I think about #b200 monsters#k should do it. Remember, once this gauge is full, bring the counter back to me!
I guess you just don't understand how stressful this all can be...
Are you sure you have the right Calorie Counter?
Remember, 200 monsters from Levels 13 - 30. Good luck!

Hello, #h0#. Congratulations on making your Job Advancement to Bowman. Special gifts are being given out to those who make their Job Advancement to Bowman before October 26. Would you like to accept the gift now?
May the Hunter's Star shine upon you.
You have #r#euntil October 26#k#n to accept the gift, so let me know when you want it.

Congratulations on making your 2nd Job Advancement! You were lucky to make your Job Advancement with the Hunter's Star at its peak. This is a special gift that will surely double your joy. Would you like it right now?

This is a #b#t2450032##k that increases your EXP by 1.5 times, and a #bScroll for ATT#k. These should be pretty helpful for a Bowman like yourself, I think. If you make your 3rd or 4th Job Advancements before the Hunter's Star rises on October 18, you could get another gift. Do your best!
#b#h0##k, have you heard the #rTale of the Knights of Virtue#k? If you haven't, would you like to hear it? It's pretty important...and Maple World kind of needs your help again...
Look, I'm not going to make you do anything. But please understand, #b#h0##k, Maple World really needs you. This is important!
So, are you ready for this? If so, I'll give you these. They'll help you join the ranks of the new Knights of Virtue.

There was once a kingdom called #bSharenian#k in the northern reaches of Maple World. The king of Sharenian, Sharen II, was known for his wisdom, but in his pride he made a terrible mistake. You see, Sharen II possessed a magnificent jewel, the Rubian. Fearing its loss, he summoned the most powerful creature he could to guard it. This was the demon #rErgoth#k. True to his nature, Ergoth broke his promise and destroyed the kingdom. It is said the kingdom of Sharenian itself now lies deep beneath the surface of the world.

Those who survived the disaster chose to create an order of #bKnights#k to prevent such an event in the future. They chose children with pure hearts and a special ability for this order.

Over time, the order grew and prospered on the site of the lost Sharenian kingdom, and became known as the #bKnights of Virtue#k. Their special ability is to draw out the dark powers of monsters, and seal them in special stones. They brought peace to their land and much of Maple World, and when they were no longer needed, they sealed their powers away in the High Stone of Virtue at the center of Maple World.\r\n\r\nHowever, just a few days ago, the unthinkable happened. The High Stone of Virtue exploded, scattering Virtue Fragments all over the world. We sought the reason for this, and discovered that it was caused by the return of Ergoth himself! He now threatens all of Maple World, so we need the Knights of Virtue once again. That's why I am now asking you, #b#h0##k, to join the new #bKnights of Virtue#k and save Maple World!

You should now have the #bStone of Virtue and title#k in your inventory, right? When you #bhunt monsters in specific places with the Stone of Virtue#k, their dark energy will be absorbed by the Stone. When it is full, you can unleash and control those powers as if they were your own. #rClick the purple Knights of Virtue icon in the left side of your screen to locate the hunting grounds#k. Good luck!
It does not seem like you are ready yet.
Hello, #b#h0##k. Thank you for agreeing to join the Knights of Virtue. We have a special gift for Knights between Levels 50 and 70. Would you like one?
I hope you don't miss out on this great opportunity. Come back soon, okay?

It's nothing big. The thing is, hunting grounds for Level 50 - 70 Knights of Virtue are really far away. This gift for them allows them to travel more easily.

I'm sick of building robots! Why won't anyone let me build a tree for once? Or a garden? Oh, you must be here because of the Mesoranger recruitment. Time for the old spiel... Anyone with enough #bcourage, will, and faith#K can become a Mesoranger, blah blah blah. Interested?
Well, I'm not interested in building machines, either, but we can't all get what we want, can we?

To obtain #bcourage, will, and faith,#K you just have to hunt monsters. Any monsters #rbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k will do. Of course, don't you think your time would be better spent planting flowers?
Besides courage, will, and faith, you'll also need high points in your Trust of the People Score, Bonus Score, and Interview Score.
Your Trust of the People score is based on your level, class, fame, and appearance. #bTalk to Dr. Pepper#k for advice on how to improve your #bGood Impressions Score#k
Your Bonus Score is based on how much extra courage, will, and faith you can build. A Bonus Score isn't mandatory, but it certainly helps.

You can obtain higher quality courage, will, and faith by hunting monsters in Mu Lung Dojo and Gonzo Gallery, by eliminating master monsters, and by completing party quests. You'll want to #bconfer with General Maestro.#k
Your Interview Score will be based on conversations between you and, well, me. I'll ask questions about becoming a Mesoranger, and you'll answer. You'll do well if I think you make a good fit.
To become a Mesoranger, you'll need a combined Trust of the People Score, Bonus Score, and Interview Score of at least 1,000. You may keep trying if you don't pass. You can retry even if you do well.

#h0#, did you hear about the amazing items you can purchase from the Tempest merchants, Wind and Spark? All you need are Tempest Coins. And that's not all...
By making purchases from the Tempest Shop, you're given opportunities to submit entries to the ongoing web event for a chance at even more goodies! You'll get one entry for every 3 coins you spend.

If you have more questions, check out details on the MapleStory homepage. Okay, well, I hope you enjoy Tempest!

All I know for sure is that the Black Wings are involved and the Seal Stone has been stolen. I don't know what they're planning on doing to Ellin Forest, but it can't be good.

Did you take care of all those #o7130010# jerks?

I'm going to need some time! Fight like, I don't know, 150 of the #o7130010# beasts in #m220070200#. That should be enough.

Listen up and I'll lay it out for you.
First up, we've got the suspicious guy in the black robe showing up on the bottom floor of the Clocktower.
Then, Thanatos starts going bananas and shows up in Origin of the Clocktower AND Helios Tower. Weird, right?
After that, the Ludibrium Clocktower blows up and breaks down.
What do you think? Starting to make sense, isn't it? That suspicious guy MUST be up to some majorly bad business!

Go to #e#m220060400#, #m220070300#, and #m220070400##n check for anything out of the ordinary... like that Mystic Gate at the Crossroad of Time. You should probably go ahead and beat up some monsters to make the trips worth your while.

Did you check the #m220070400#?

My hunch was right, Thanatos was the one that tampered with the Clocktower! But why would he do that unless he was being controlled? Hm? Well, that's because that suspicious guy I saw was controlling Thanatos! There weren't any Mystic Gates in the area, so he had to have been the one! And I can guarantee you he's one of the Black Mage's followers!

One of the doors in the Forgotten Passage leads to culprit behind the problems at the Clocktower!
Find that door and you've got our bad guy! If you can take him out, go back to Neinheart. I've got to make sure nothing else goes out of place. Hurry it up, okay?
What?! You're not going to do anything? But we have our culprit!

I see. One of the Black Mage's underlings destroyed the Ludibrium Clocktower? Interesting. I will see that you are taken care of.
Find the door that leads to the culprit in the Forgotten Passage and report back to Neinheart once you subdue him.
Do you have anything to tell me?

I have need of you again. Go to the Temple of Time and meet #bInformant #p1103006##k. She is collecting intelligence on the Black Mage and could use an assistant.

Oh, sorry. I'm laying my problems on you. Let me get to the point. See, another crack has opened up in the Temple of Time! I don't want to be presumptuous, but I think that's kind of bad.

I was snooping around in there and I think maybe I had gone into the past. It's not a big deal, but then I accidentally stumbled on to the entrance to an altar! You know who was in there? I bet you already do, but it was really scary to me...
It was Arkarium! I might have even seen Rhinne, the Goddess of Time! I'm not sure. My glasses aren't so good and then some monsters saw my hat poking out from behind a pillar and they chased me off.

So, since you're a big brave adventurer, I think your job is to go into the secret passage and see what Arkarium is up to! I mean, if you don't mind. I don't mean to tell you what to do with your time...

When I was getting chased out, I saw a place with three doors. At least, I think it was. I was really scared and my glasses were all fogged up, but there may have been a fountain, or a statue, or somebody standing very still? Does that help?
Did I come off as too pushy? I just can't tell sometimes. I'm so sorry.
Did you find the secret passage into the Dimensional Schism by the statue-fountain?
Ah, that's where it was! Now I remember... I think.
There just HAS to be a Dimensional Schism! I just know there is! Would you have time to check again?
I think it's too dangerous to get into that passage right now. Arkarium's a really powerful wizard and my hiding abilities don't really help much when a crazy old guy is throwing fireballs around.
Do you think you could break Arkarium's warding spells? If you can, maybe all his guards won't notice when we come down after him!

First off, I think we're going to need the Lambent Essence from Neinheart. That thing is really strong! Then, if we could get some Dragon Warrants from the monsters in Leafre, maybe we could combine them to break the wards!
Do you have a better idea? I'm not really the idea type.

You will find spirits there that we can use in creating the Lambent Essence. Weaken them to under 30% of their lifeforce, then use the Light Catcher to capture them. After that, speak with Shinsoo.

Capture the Spirits of Light at the Hallowed Ground, and take the Saturated Light Catcher to Shinsoo.

Wow, you're back and you got the Lambent Essence? That's crazy! What about the Dragon Warrants?
Great! These aren't for the spell, I just wanted them. Keeping them in my pocket makes me feel brave! Well, more brave. A little.
Anyway, here's the real mission!

If you can defeat all the corrupted guards in the Temple of Darkness Corridor, you should be able to use the Lambent Essence to break Arkarium's warding spells.\r\nDon't try to use the Lambent Essence before the guards are gone, but it should work just like any other item once the coast is clear!
Aww, are you mad about the Dragon Warrants? I really DID need them. I promise!
Did you break the barriers that were blocking the Dimensional Schism?

Do you think you can get into the Dimensional Schism and defeat all the corrupted guards? You'll have to use that Lambent Essence as soon as you can so the other guards in the area don't detect your presence!

The Dimensional Schism still seems to be leaking dark energy into our world. That means Arkarium is still in there! Can you take him down?
I am honestly impressed by your accomplishment. Arkarium was a fearsome adversary. I hope you'll understand that your work is not done. Are you ready for your next mission?
Arkarium's corruption lingers in the area. Return to the Dimensional Schism and bring me a Stained Soul.
The only way to obtain one of these souls is by defeating Arkarium. Withhold your outrage, Arkarium exists outside of time now. He will still be there when you return.

The corruption of this soul bears some investigation. Perhaps it will be the key to undoing the Black Mage, though I doubt it would be so easy. Regardless, I will teach you a skill in return. I call it, #bNoble Mind#k.
You may bring me up to six more Stained Souls, though my research will take a day to complete for each one. I will continue to advance your Noble Mind skill further with each soul you bring.

Go to #bRecruit Training Grounds 3#k and take down #e#b40 Strange Pigs#k#n. It'll build character, I swear.
Bad news! The Ereve Archives got ransacked by a bunch of monsters that got out of their pens. Everybody's pitching in to get the place back together. That means you need to help too.
Use the portal to the left to enter the Monster Pens. You need to get back #b10 #e#t4033197##k#n from the monsters.

You are a fool if you think you are not Chromile's child. I was uncertain myself, until the Empress set eyes on you. But you must understand that it is my JOB to make decisions about what is best for people. It is what I do best.

I kept the information about your father to myself because I thought it would wound you. Now I see that it has, and that it will only fester until it is cleaned and treated properly. If you will occupy yourself for a short time, I will find a way to provide the treatment you've forced me to administer.

I expect you'll want to go after him, but I hope you will heed this advice. Burdens like these will only serve to crush any future you may have. Deal with them, and do it swiftly. The world cannot afford to have knights who are so mired in their own selfish pursuits that they would ignore the needs of other. Go to Perion, find Chromile, and then return to your duties.

Let me introduce you to someone that can help you finish this as quickly as possible. When you get to Perion, look for a girl named #b10 Boogies#k. I know, it is a ridiculous codename, but one she insisted upon. She's still very green, but I am sure she will be able to aid you.
I've made arrangements a boat to take you directly to Perion. It's waiting for you at the docks. Speak to #b#eKiriru at the Sky Ferry#n#k and you can be on your way.
Did you change your mind? Or are you afraid to deal with your past?

Except, well... I'm kinda in a bind myself. I mean, it's nothing a knight like myself can't HANDLE, but... \r\n#L0##bWhat is it?#l\n#k

I lost the badge that shows I'm in league with the knights and I can't find it! I think it might've fallen off when I was taking down some of the Dark Axe Stumps around here. Do you think you could find it? I'm gonna be in a lot of hot water if that thing is gone.
Awesome! #bDark Axe Stumps#k live north of Perion. It's really close, promise!
Well, I'm not saying you have to help me but, well... it is how it is...
Oh my goodness, it's like watching somebody bring my LIFE back! Thank you! Thank you so much!

Oh, yeah! I sent that info over a while back. A lot of stories seem to point to Perion as his birthplace, but I couldn't confirm it. I met a scholar over at Boulder Mountain that said he knew Chromile; even said he'd seen him around Perion recently! I tried to get some more info out of him, but that old coot had a temper like a Horny Mushroom! \r\n#L0##bWho did you talk to?#l\n#k

There's a really mean old archaeologist named Winston that hangs around here. He claims to have the best memory in Maple World, but he's also got at least the second best temper I've ever seen. You might wanna go talk to him about it...
I usually see Winston yelling at passersby from a rock perch in the #b#eRugged Rocky Zone#k#n, up in the North Rocky Mountain. Follow the road north... you won't miss him. Nobody is that lucky.

I usually see Winston yelling at passersby from a rock perch in the #b#eRugged Rocky Zone#k#n, up in the North Rocky Mountain. Follow the road north... you won't miss him. Nobody is that lucky.

You are determined to be a pain in my backside, aren't you? Spit it out, whelp. Every minute I speak with you endumbens me tenfold. Wait, endumbens isn't a word! See what you did?!\r\n#L0##bThey tell me you know everything that goes on in Perion. I was hoping they weren't lying.#l\n#k

Well, THEY are right, whichever gossipy imbeciles you got your information from. I know everything that has ever happened and everything ever will happen in Perion! \r\n#L0##bThen you know who Chromile is...#l\n#k

Of course I know him. He was the famous 'Knight of Light' everybody used to fawn over. All a bunch of pomp and flash, if you ask me. He showed everybody his true colors later on in life.\r\n#L0##bI've heard he spent a lot of time in Perion. Do you remember seeing him?#l\n#k

My memory is better than any book or tome your clumsy melon could even comprehend! I remember. I even have a picture of him in one of my... MY ALBUMS! Where are they?! Those hideous thieving Ghost Stumps have been in my tent again! You there, go get it back on the double!
There will be some Ghost Stumps wandering around with their jaws dragging on the floor. Destroy them. Destroy them for stealing my things and then take my album back!

It's hard to believe he stayed in this torn up sack of rags. It looks like he left in a hurry, too. Winston seemed to think he was well-respected... Did mother's death lead him down this road? Is this the life he left me behind for?

Haven't you found the #b#t4032309##k and #b#t4032310##k yet? I stored those items in a box nearby, so all you'll need to do is break the box and bring back the items. You can break boxes by swinging at them like you're attacking a monster.

You must be confused in more ways than one. It's totally understandable, seeing that you just recently awoke inside the ice cave with no recollection of your past. Add to that my calling you a hero, and...I totally understand. I'll explain to you in detail exactly what happened.

A few hundred years ago, the whole world was under the reign of the evil Black Mage. Using his tremendous power, the Black Mage led Maple World closer and closer to destruction, and he almost succeeded.

Many people valiantly tried to keep the Black Mage from ruining their lives, but they were not strong enough. It reached the point where the whole world was on the verge of utter destruction, and that's when a few brave souls made a pivotal decision. They would battle the Black Mage head-on, all by themselves, to buy the rest of us time to find refuge in places far, far away.

No one knows the details of the battle, only the results: The Black Mage was sealed away while the heroes made the ultimate sacrifice and disappeared. Thanks to them, Maple World finally found peace and...that was that. Sadly, it didn't take long for people to forget the heroes.

A lot of time passed, then a Book of Prophecy appeared out of nowhere. According to that book, the Black Mage had cast one final curse on the heroes before he lost his powers. That final curse wiped the heroes of all their memories and abilities, and trapped them in ice for hundreds of years.

Everyone thought the book was a bunch of garbage, but one race thought otherwise and began conducting research on the Book of Prophecy. I am the last remaining member of the race, and that's why I've been waiting on this island, knowing that one day, the heroes would reawaken.

And here you are! One of the very heroes that the Book of Prophecy mentions. One of the heroes that saved Maple World, only to be tragically forgotten by Maplers over the years. And I am certain that you're the hero that will save us once more. Do you get it now?
Are you sure? Because you look a bit dazed. Hmmm, just to make sure you really processed everything I just said, I'm going to give you a pop quiz about it. Tell me when you're ready to start.
You must be a bit overwhelmed with everything that I threw at you just now. If you didn't catch it all, I'm more than happy to tell you the story once more. Tell me when you're ready.

#L1#Black Mage#l

#k

#b#L0#Defeated the Black Mage#l

What? In a relationship with the Black Mage...? Um, that wasn't even funny.

Alright, I've done enough explaining for now. Let's move on to the next stage. What's the next stage, you ask? I just told you. Train as hard as you can until you become strong enough to defeat the Black Mage with a single blow.

You may have been a hero in the past, but that was hundreds of years ago. Even if it weren't for the curse of the Black Mage, all those years you spent frozen in time have stiffened your body. You must loosen up a bit and slowly regain your agility. How do you do that, you ask?

Don't you know that you must first master the fundamentals? So the wise thing to do is to begin with #bBasic Training#k. Oh, of course, I forgot that you lost your memory. Well, that's why I'm here. You'll just have to experience it yourself. Shall we begin?

#k
So everything was caused by the Black Mage? Then what about all the things that we've been doing? I thought they were all for the good of Maple World! Were we wrong? Master! Let's go find out!\r\n
The things we did in #m200000000#, the things we did in #m211000000#, and the things we did in #m220000000#... All the missions the Black Wings gave us...\r\n
Let's look at the consequences of what we've accomplished. #bLet's go to each town and ask#k. If we were tricked by the Black Wings... I won't forgive them!\r\n
The Growth Accelerant that we thought would make the crops grow caused problems for #m200000000# by making the #o4230105#s grow abnormally.

We defeated a monster who was guarding an important treasure in #m220000000#, causing the treasure to get stolen.
This confirms it. The Black Wings were only using us. They made us perform evil tasks so that they could revive the Black Mage! I can't forgive them!
Let's check the results of the three missions we were given by the Black Wings. We can go to each town and ask the townspeople. We have to #bcheck #m200000000#, #m211000000#, and #m220000000##k!
All of the things that the Black Wings had us do...were for evil! We wanted to help people but instead, we ended up causing them more problems!
Master, let's go to the #b#m922030001##k in #m220000300#. The house where we met #p1013203# in person. Let's go there and teach #r#p1013203##k a lesson! How could he trick us like this?!
Master, I think you are too cautious at times. We have to right to be angry!

Darn it... We just about had him but he ran away. Then again, a guy who could trick us so many times is probably great at running away. He probably won't show up here again.\r\n#L0##bYeah, you're right. Geez... He was such a suspicious guy. We were so foolish to have believed him!#l\n#k
Well, we could've been more careful. But I still think the deceiver deserves more blame than the deceived! \r\n#L0##bOf course!#l\n#k

They said that their ultimate goal was to revive the Black Mage, the being that destroyed my race and trapped #p1205000# in ice... Master, if I said I wanted to take revenge on the Black Mage, would you help me?\r\n#L0##bOf course! Personal reasons aside, the Black Mage is an evil being who wants to destroy Maple World. It's only right that an Onyx Dragon and his master stop him!#l\n#k

Yeah! Master, you and I are on the same page! We lost to #p1013203# this time but next time we'll get him. We won't let the Black Wings revive the Black Mage! For the Onyx Dragons and for Maple World!
Master, let's hurry to the #b#m922030001##k in #m220000300#! #r#p1013203##k is probably still there! Let's make him pay for tricking us!

One of us has to try and better ourselves. If you want to find #p1013203#, ask some of the other Black Wings. If you act nice, they might just tell you.\r\n#L0##bI guess it doesn't hurt to ask...#l\n#k

It might hurt, but not me! Why don't you start off with #p2152016# in #m310000000#. He doesn't do anything but eat and stare into the distance. I bet he's got a fancy title!\r\n#L0##bThat almost makes sense. Do you think he'd let me ask him about #p1013203#?#l\n#k
He might! Hurry up and find out!
Don't chicken out! Are you afraid of #p1013203#?
Nom nom nom nom... What? The Black Wings are busy protecting this town. I don't have time for your nonsense.\r\n#L0##bI'm looking for a guy named #p1013203#. Do you know where I can find him?#l\n#k
Huck! *Cough Cough* Wha-what? You want to meet #p1013203#? What could a kid like you possibly have with him?!\r\n#L0##bI...owe him 30 mesos. It's really weighing on my shoulders.#l\n#k

You should have known that was a trap! #p1013203#'s way too smart to fall for the old "I owe you 30 mesos" routine!\r\n#L0##bYeah, yeah. Either way, it worked. But who was that lady? She didn't look like a Black Wing!#l\n#k

She fell for that trap, just like you, so you could probably be friends. I wonder who she is...\r\n#L0##b#p1013203# seems to have a lot of enemies. For now, I'd better return to #m310000000# and confront #p2152016#!#l\n#k

Master! I know who it is! That lady we saw in the mine is the doctor back in Edelstein! She's #p2152004#!\r\n#L0##bWhat?! You mean #p2152004#? No way, that lady in the mine was WAY scarier.#l\n#k
Women are great at pretending not to look scary! I'm absolutely positive #p2152004# is the same woman from the mine. Trust the eyes of the Onyx Dragon!
She thinks she can fool the Onyx Dragon, but that is not happening!
You could have gotten these from your commanders, but I feel like I can trust you. The Resistance is on your side, until the moment it looks like you're going to turn your back on us.
Lucky for you, we've liberated some intelligence from the Black Wings that mentioned your Onyx Dragon. I would have put you down the moment you came snooping around if it hadn't been for that.

But I can't turn down aid against the Black Wings and you've proven you're tough enough to take them on. I apologize if I seem mistrusting, but it's the nature of our movement. Unfortunately, we just can't fight this war on our own.

People all over the continent are looking for a chance to rise up and fight the Black Mage. A change is sweeping across the land and it's all stemming from the upcoming continental conference. I know we don't know one another well, but would you consider joining me in my trip there?
You're back and you don't have any of those Black Wing emblems? What are you trying to pull?

A continental conference?! And they want me to come?! That's so cool! I hope you don't feel overwhelmed when you meet all those important and powerful warriors. And don't feel bad if everybody's asking for my autograph, okay? We're going to make so many friends and beat up that stupid Black Mage!
I'm glad. I feel relieved to know you'll be on our side.
Tell #p2152004# that you'll join her!

Why, hello there, young #h0#. There's no school today, so what brings you here? Are you having trouble with your homework? Perhaps I can help. \r\n#L0##bI need to get to Level 10, and quick! I figured you'd know how, Headmaster.#l\n#k

(Headmaster Ferdi runs a hand along his bushy beard.)
Level 10, eh? You must be the one that-- Ah, nevermind. Sure, I can help. Leveling up is easy. All you have to do is gain some life and combat experience. 
#L0##bLife and combat experience? You mean EXP? Well, how am I supposed to do that?#l
#k
There are many ways, but I suggest you start by helping the citizens of Edelstein, #h0#. Talk to people who need help and offer them a hand. You'll level up to 10 in no time. How's that sound?

Very good, very good. Go talk to #bthe residents of Edelstein and see how you can help them#k. I think just about everyone in town could use a helping hand, but I recommend you start with #b#p2152001#, the Kindergarten Teacher#k, since he's nearby.

Well, if you don't like the idea of helping others, you can head left and find some monsters around your level. Eliminating them will reward you some EXP, but I heartily recommended helping the townspeople first. That will reward you far more experience.

Ah, you're back, young #h0#! And how do you feel? Did you enjoy helping others? 
#L0##bIt's such a rush to help people! Already, Edelstein seems like a brighter place to live.#l
#L1#Ugh, I don't know why people keep asking me for help. Read my lips: SO not interested.#l
#L2#Meh, whatever. I want to take a nap now.#l
#k
(The Headmaster smiles at you, a twinkle in his eye.) \r\nI suspected you might feel that way, #h0#.
Did you not find it rewarding, #h0#? Bringing other people joy is a reward in and of itself.
Yes, you must be exhausted. Why don't you get some rest and return when you've recharged your energy?
There are still folks who could use your help. Check your #bQuest Window#k to make sure you haven't forgotten anyone.

(The man gives a huge yawn and then suddenly notices you and scowls.) \r\nYou're #h0#, right? I've heard about you. What do you want? Eh? The Headmaster sent you to help the townspeople? Yeah, I'll take you up on that offer. I have plenty of work.
Shouldn't be too tough. I want to plant a garden here, to make the place more kid-friendly and the like. Grab me some #b#t4000595#s#k to plant in the garden. Got it?
Shouldn't be hard to find some #t4000595#s. Just exit left, hunt some #r#o0150000#s#k, and grab the #t4000595#s they drop. Get me #b5#k. That should be enough to start a garden.
Bah, you young'uns are so selfish. Think of the children!

You got the #t4000595#s, I see. Good. You know, Edelstein's gotten so dark and gloomy lately. This ought to lift the kids' spirits! Children deserve things like that. #h0#, what do you think the children of Edelstein need most these days? 
#L0##bPeace. #l
#L1#Robots!#l
#L2#Nothing.#l
#k
Yes, yes! Edelstein's so unstable right now. We have to protect our kids from all the turmoil. The sight of beautiful flowers is a start, but I'm sure there's more we can do.

You're helping the townspeople as a favor to the Headmaster, right? Then go talk to #b#p2152003##k in front of the #bPolice Station#k. She's a policewoman, but she jumps at the sight of her own shadow.
Eh, are kids still into robots these days? I didn't know that... But I don't think more toys will really make them happier.
Bah, kids need loving homes and discipline, not negligence.
You haven't collected all the #b#t4000595#s#k? Just head toward the #bpark to the left of town#k, hunt #r#o0150000#s#k, and bring me #b5 of the #t4000595#s they drop#k.

Oh no. Oh no, oh no, oh no! What should I do? If there's even a single worm in one of those potted plants, I'm going to faint, I just know it.\r\n#L0##b(She's muttering to herself very seriously. You approach her carefully so you don't scare her.)#l\n#k
Eeeeeeeek! IS IT A WORM?! Oh. Whew, it's just you, #h0#. You're the one who's-- Eh, nevermind. \r\n#L0##bWait, you can't just leave me hanging... The one who's what?#l\n#k
The one who's...agreed to help the folks in Edelstein. Yup! Uh huh! Isn't that right? Well, I do happen to need your help. I want you to eliminate a certain monster for me...
Great! What a relief. Just head left and get rid of #r20 Potted Morning Glories#k in #b#m310020100##k. They're causing a huge inconvenience to the people in town.
I know I'm a cop, but there's a good reason I can't hunt these monsters myself. It's because...because...Oh, look at the time! Gotta jet! Remember, hunt 20 Potted Morning Glories!
But this is really, really important. If you don't do it, Edelstein will soon face a terrifyingly terrible danger!

You've eliminated the #o0150001#s! Very nice. Say, you didn't, er, see any worms or snails or other creepy crawlies on the #o0150001#s, did you? No? Good, good. Now it'll be safe for the innocent folks of Edelstein to walk the streets again! Or, it would be, if not for the Bla... Ah, nevermind. Um...roads are important, right? What's the most important part to you? 
#L0##bHow clean it is.#l
#L1#How safe it is.#l
#L2#How wide it is!#l
#k
Yes, yes! If you feel unsafe walking down any road, then that road must be terrible! It's just like how we feel threatened when under strict surveillance...

You haven't eliminated #r20 Potted Morning Glories#k yet? Are you scared of bugs, too? But we have to keep the roads safe! Then again, I can't force you to do something I'm not even willing to do... Oh me, oh my!
Hello, #h0#. Is something wrong? Do you need me to take a look? Hm? The Headmaster sent you to help people. So you've reached that age already, hm?
Well, perfect timing. I could use an assistant. Please gather some #t2022712#s from the fruit trees around town. They don't taste like much, but they make quite effective medicine.
Thank you. When you hit the #rFruit Trees using regular attacks,#k they drop #t2022712#s. Please fetch me #b5#k of them.
Fruit Trees look like this.\r\n#i3800090# \r\nYou'll find them all around the town and in the park.
Thank you. When you hit the #rFruit Trees using regular attacks,#k they drop #t2022712#s. Please fetch me #b5#k of them.

Thank you. All of the city's medical supplies were confiscated, so I was running low. What are we going to do when we run out of #t2022712#s? Oh no... Anyway, what is the most important thing citizens of Edelstein can do to stay healthy? 
#L0##bMaintain a healthy diet and exercise regularly.#l
#L1#Take lots and lots of meds.#l
#L2#Surround themselves in an environment that minimizes their chance of illness and injury.#l
#k

Correct! Above all else, it's important to live in an environment that can prevent or minimize injury and illness. But Edelstein is far from that ideal right now. We never know who'll get hurt because of the blasted-- Eh, nevermind.
How about paying #b#p2152002##k the #bStreetsweeper#k a visit next? He's always swamped with work.
Of course that's important! But don't you think something else is even MORE important? Think about it.

(A man with a broom appears to be humming happily to himself.)\r\nAh, #h0#! Isn't it beautiful today? What brings you here? Shouldn't you be out playing? Hm? The Headmaster asked you to help the townspeople? \r\n(He gives you a knowing smile and a wink.)

Then I'll gladly accept your offer to help! Downtown Edelstein is sparkling clean because I sweep every day, but that's not the case for the outskirts of town. Would you be so kind as to clean the outskirts for me?

Okay! Take the portal to the left and head to #b#m310020200##k. Once there, eliminate the #r#o0150002#s#k and bring me the #b#t4000597#s#k that they toss all over the place. I think #b5#k should be enough to clean the streets. Thanks!
Ah, do you loathe chores and cleaning? A lot of people feel that way. But let me tell you, seeing the difference you make feels INCREDIBLE! Think about it, hm?

You picked up the trash! I'm sure the outskirts simply sparkle now! I wish I could've done it myself, but circumstances being what they are... Anyway, what do you think is the first thing we should eliminate from Edelstein, if we had the power?
#L0##bTrash.#l
#L1#Useless, old fliers.#l
#L2#Restriction on our freedom...#l
#k
You are absolutely correct. But if someone overhears, you'll be in a lot of trouble. So keep your thoughts to yourself from now on, okay?

Anyway, you said you were going around town helping others, right? Have you talk to #b#p2152005#, the guy in the bear suit#k handing out fliers? #p2152005# needed help with something. Why don't you go over there and talk to him?
Yes, it's important to keep the town clean, but I can do that easily, as long as I have the freedom to do so...
Oh, are there too many fliers around town? I better tell Checky to go easy on them. That's not quite what I had in mind, though...
You haven't collected the trash. Head to your #bleft#k, eliminate the #r#o0150002#s#k, and bring me #b5 #t4000597#s#k, okay?
Hey, #h0#. What are you doing here? I'm busy handing out fliers. The Headmaster told you to help people? Really? Then could I ask you for a favor?

Okay, near the entrance to Edelstein's Free Market you can find a bulletin board. It's just over to the right a bit. I want you to #bpost the flier I just gave you on the bulletin board.#k It should be a cinch to find. The big, bold 'Click' is a total giveaway.
I thought you were helping people. Were you lying? Hm... That's a shame.

Thanks for the help. I'd post them myself, but I'm...not permitted. THEY don't want us communicating freely, but they don't think of you, a kid, as a threat yet. What do you think would happen if we couldn't exchange information?
#L0##bWell, what you don't know can't hurt you.#l
#L1#You'd live life as a puppet without even realizing.#l
#L2#I don't know.#l
#k
Precisely. Without free exchange of ideas, life in this town will become stagnant. We'll all become puppets. I can't let that happen!
So, did you finish helping everyone, like the Headmaster suggested? Look around and double-check. If you've helped everyone, return to the #bHeadmaster#k and let him know.
That's not true at all. A lot of things you don't know or think about can still affect you. Think about it some more.
Use your brain, kid! Put yourself in the shoes of someone who's not allowed to share their ideas or thoughts. That should help come to an answer.
You haven't posted the flier yet. Please post it on the #bbulletin board in front of City Hall#k.
You haven't posted the flier yet. Please post it on the #bbulletin board in front of City Hall#k.
#h0#! You've reached Lv. 10! Marvelous. Allow me to reward you for doing such a great job. \r\n(There is a twinkle in the Headmaster's eye.)\r\nIt's something I know you've wanted for a while...
#bOpen the Use tab of your inventory and use the invitation I just gave you#k. Do so right away. You won't regret it.
You don't even want to know what the reward is? Are you sure? It's something I know you've been wanting...
Welcome, #h0#! Surprised to see me? Well, don't be. We've all been waiting for you... Look around. You'll see a lot of faces you recognize.

Yes, we're all part of the #b#m310000000# Resistance#k. We live normal lives in town and we pretend to be subservient and meek, but we're actually preparing to fight. The Headmaster is our training instructor.

Now, I don't think anyone has explained to you who our enemies are, though I'm sure you've seen them around. They wear black robes and they're called the #rBlack Wings#k. They've come to Edelstein to steal our resources...and our freedom.

We pretend to obey the Black Wings. Things are safer that way. But here, in secret, some citizens of Edelstein are preparing to fight them. We protect young residents like you by keeping you in the dark.
But we never planned to keep it a secret for you forever. So since you've found out about the Black Wings anyway, we'd like to invite you to join the Resistance.

But take heed. Once you join the Resistance, you will encounter endless challenges and danger. You will struggle. You could give it your all and sacrifice everything for Edelstein, and in the end...we may fail. We may not be able to defeat the Black Wings.

But the people you see here, we've chosen this path because we believe it is the right thing to do. Freedom and peace are worth fighting for, even if we end up losing. That is what it means to be part of the Resistance.
So, #h0#... \r\nWill you join us in this dangerous venture?\r\n
I knew you wouldn't be able to resist this opportunity. Good, next you must choose your path. Think about your strengths and personality before you make a decision.

Talk to each job instructor and listen carefully to their job descriptions before you #bchoose your path#k. Once you do, your new job instructor will advance you as an official member of the Resistance. Think of your job instructor as an extracurricular teacher.
Come see me after you advance as an official member of the Resistance. I will then explain to you the required training and missions you will receive.
You haven't used your #t2031010# yet? Many people are waiting on you... If you lost the invitation or if it didn't do what you wanted, talk to me again after #bforfeiting the quest#k.
You didn't use your #t2031010# before coming here? I can't complete the quest for you then. Please use or throw away the #b#t2031010# so that you no longer have it#k.

It is good to see you here. Allow me to reintroduce myself. I am #p2151001#, Magician instructor of the Resistance. It has been...difficult for me, playing a role that has no semblance of my own personality. Think of it! A Battle Mage who sweeps the streets? Ridiculous! But we must all make sacrifices for our cause.
Now, you are probably accustomed to Magicians who elegantly cast spells from a distance, but #bBattle Mages#k are...different.

Battle Mages are Magicians who like to get right up into the heat of battle and fight with #bquick, consecutive magic attacks#k. We are #bmuch better able to defend ourselves than regular Magicians, too.#k

So yes, we use magic, but we're more like Warriors than Magicians, really. We have an arsenal of #bsecondary magic skills, but they're for attacking#k. We stand on the front line, risking neck and limb to block enemies from getting through. We are fighter Magicians and we are vital to the Resistance.

Some accuse us of being unconventional, but who cares? The results are what's important, and if our unique set of skills help drive the Black Wings out of Edelstein, no one has a right to complain. So, will you join our ranks? Let me know, now or later, once you've made up your mind.

Let me warn you now that being a Battle Mage is far from easy. Short range and complicated controls are but a few of the difficulties we face. Are you sure you want to embark on the path of a Battle Mage?
Perhaps you can't visualize yourself as a Battle Mage. No matter. I am sure there is another job that will suit your personality. Talk to #p2151002#.

(Belle stretches her arms luxuriously behind her.) \r\nAhhh, it is such a treat not to have to pretend I'm frightened of every little thing that walks or crawls like I do back in town. I know we've met, but let me introduce my true self. I am #p2151002#, Bowman instructor of the Resistance.

You may think you know about Bowmen. You don't. The Bowmen of the Resistance don't stand at a distance, firing arrows like pansies. Ha! Far from it. OUR Bowmen are called #bWild Hunters#k, and we're fierce like none other.
Wild Hunters are #bmounted Bowmen#k. We attack while mounted on the back of wild creatures. And we fear nothing.

Our mounts allow us to travel fast and far, wind on our faces. It is what we live for! But don't underestimate our melee prowess, either. #bOur mounts are well-trained and can bite enemies who get too close#k. Wild Bowmen use mounts for both travel and combat.

Some accuse us of basking in violence and say we're barbaric compared to our poised, sophisticated Bowmen counterparts. \r\n(Belle snarls.)\r\nLet them talk! Edelstein is in the danger. Ridding the town of the Black Wings is all that matters. WE have no time for idle gossip. So. Will you join us? Say the word and I will turn you into a Wild Hunter.

I love your enthusiasm! But have you really thought about this? Wild Hunters can be very powerful, but they can also be hard to control. Commanding your mount while simultaneously using your attack skills require excellent reflexes. Are you sure that you'll be able to handle it?
Not interested? Well, perhaps you should think about becoming a Battle Mage then? Talk to #p2151001# for more information on Battle Mages.

You have been patient. I am the job instructor for the Mechanic, the secret Resistance's secret weapon. Now, before you can say anything, don't ask me to remove my mask. This is who I really am: cute and cuddly! It is the perfect way to catch the Black Wings off guard. And...don't mind the gun.
When you think of Pirates, you probably think of swashbuckling melee or gun fighters. Well, we're a little different. You see, as #bMechanics#k, our specialty is handling machines. Powerful ones.
One of those machines is a gun. So while Mechanics are #bessentially Gun Slingers#k, we've also invented and utilized #bmore advanced technology to give us an edge in battle#k.

We've modified our guns, so they shoot lasers instead of bullets. We've also invented robots that can perform various tasks. We have robots you can ride, robots you can summon to attack enemies or protect allies, you name it. One of our greatest strengths is #bthe variety of attacks#k we possess.

Some criticize us for our dependence on machines, but what does that matter? What's important is for us to fight the Black Wings. If you want to join us, I'll turn you into a Mechanic. All you have to do is hit Accept.

You didn't accept just to appease me, did you? Mechanics are powerful, but controlling them is kind of difficult. You'll have to quickly and smoothly control several different robots at once. Do you think you can handle it?

Not good with machines, eh? Well, it takes time. It's worth it, too, I tell you. But if you're interested in a different class, go talk to #p2151001# or #p2151002# about Battle Mages and Wild Hunters.
Hey #h0#, keep this a secret from the Resistance but I found a way to enhance Mechs.
All you have to do is... \r\nHEY! Where did that manual go?!
I swear, I put it RIGHT HERE!
Found it! I was so busy tinkering with these Mechs that I lost track of it for a moment, that's all.
So here's the deal... I've discovered how to change the color of your Mech!
Not only that, but your Mech will be more powerful while disguised in its new color! That'll make it even easier to push those Black Wings back where they belong.

There's just one small issue. I need something called a #bMech Disguise Swap Chip#k to make the whole thing work. They're extremely rare and cost a whooping #e#r1,000,000 mesos#k#n. Also, I haven't quite stabilized the process yet, so your Mech's new color will be...random.
But I'm ready to begin the process once you bring me 1,000,000 mesos to reimburse me for the chip I bought.
That's right. I already purchased a chip for you. I'm such a nice guy, aren't I? All you have to do is bring me the mesos.
Well, that's all I wanted to say. You ready to change your Mech's color now?
Where is it? WHERE IS IT?! Just give me a minute...
Hello, #h0#. You've already reached Level 30, I see. You must be diligently studying and working hard to gain experience. I'm proud of you.
We are planning to hold an #bafter school Special Training session#k for those who have reached Lv. 30. If you're not too busy, I'd like to invite you...
The after-school special training will be run by your homeroom teacher. Please #bhead into the school#k. I have reason to believe your class will be both enjoyable and productive.
Ah, tired of studying already? But there's still so much for you to learn. Please, think it over. This training can really help you.

Okay, ready now? This mission is...complicated. You know the Power Plant and the Mine outside town? They rightfully belong to the citizens of Edelstein, but the Black Wings have taken them as their own. We can't even enter anymore.

No one knew what the Black Wings were up to. Now it's too late. They've blocked access to the Power Plant, and re-directed the energy there. It wasn't until the random blackouts started that we realized what was going on.
The Black Wings have built a huge #r#o9001032##k at the Power Plant to transfer the town's energy elsewhere. I don't know why, but I'm sure it's not for a good cause.

I'm sure you can piece together your mission. Head to the #bPower Room at the Power Plant#k and destroy the #o9001032#. You won't have much time to destroy it and you won't get any back -up support. Do you know why?

Because the Power Plant is essential for the livelihood of Edelstein. So we must minimize the chance of it getting damaged. Furthermore, if the Power Plant were to explode, it would wipe out all of Edelstein, too...

Yes, the Black Wings knew what they were doing. They're holding us hostage with our own Power Plant. They'll blow up the town if we don't do exactly as they say. That's why the council president had no choice but to give the Black Wings full control of Edelstein.

This mission is one of the most difficult you will ever receive as a member of the Resistance, so back out now if you don't think you can do it. The well-being of the entire town is on your shoulders. What do you say?

Good to see you again, #h0#. I've been thinking about everything that happened and trying to figure out the Black Wings' motivation. #p2154009# presents himself as an ordinary scientist, but he is hiding a dark secret. If only we knew what he hoped to gain by experimenting on humans!

As for #p2151005#... I hate to sound crass, but I can only be happy that her loss is not one that affects the Resistance. Don't misunderstand, what #p2154009# did to her was unforgivable, but it may finally provide the answers we need.

I've read the diary. #p2154009# is trying to make some sort of a superhuman! I'm not totally sure what his purposes are, but it looks like he's using magic to make these people stronger. There's a passage from the Diary that I think you should hear:

Upon completion of the experiment, the subject appeared to be successful. Visually, it appeared to be an exact replica of The One. I named it #p2151005#, thinking it would be my greatest achievement. However, after multiple tests, I am now certain the experiment was a failure. It exhibits no extraordinary capabilities. It is, in fact, a quite ordinary human female. The subject will be purged during the next clean cycle. I must go back to formula.'
As awful as this is, I'm sure he's not operating on his own. Somebody must be feeding him orders. What I find more troublesome is his reference to 'The One'. What could that mean?

Do I have a sign that says 'lie to me' on my face? No, sir-and-or-madam, I do NOT! If you're innocent, collect #rMR Communicators#k from #r#o4230112##k, and then I'll know you're telling the truth. A-yup!
The #r#o4230112##k are near #b#m220030200##k. Anything less than 50 will mean you're guilty!
I knew you were one of them!
Golly, I've just been standing here a-waitin' for you. You got the goods yet?
Golly, I've just been standing here a-waitin', but looks like you've finally got the communicators. I suppose you're not with THEM.
You don't have 50! You are guilty!
Does the Black Mage have a new Commander?
If so, I must stop them. No one else should suffer through what I did.
If only I knew who the new Commander was. Who do I know that has the qualifications to be a new Commander?
Perhaps I should ask #b#p2151009##k.
I've been asleep for centuries. Everyone I used to know is gone. I should ask #b#p2151009##k.
#b#p2151009##k, are you there?
No, I will figure it out on my own. I must know someone who fits the bill...
#ho#, you called? \r\n#L0##b#b#p2151009##k, who do we know with the qualifications to become a new Commander?#l\n#k
Wait a second, are you telling me the Black Mage has got a new Commander? \r\n#L0##bYes, and they appear to be commanding the Demons as well...#l\n#k
I thought the Demons left Maple World after the Black Mage was sealed away! \r\n#L0##bYou are just as clueless as I am, I take it.#l\n#k
I lost my powers, remember? I'm not performing up to my usual par.\r\n#L0##bI see. Then, I must investigate.#l\n#k

To #h0#: 
I've heard that you're looking for information about the new Black Mage's new Commander. I can help. Meet me at West Leafre Forest, but come alone.

#k

With my strength restored, I should return to the #m270000100#, as #p2159310# suggested. The #m270000100# is the Black Mage's old stronghold. It is also where he was sealed. It is well worth investigating.

How did the pendant end up in...

Maybe I won't and maybe I will. Okay, I will, but only if you pulverize #b40#k #r#o4230106##k and #r#o5120000##k monsters. Each!\r\n
Good! You can find r#o4230106##k monsters in #b#m200040000##k and #b#m200050000##k, and #r#o5120000##k monsters in #b#m200070000##k and #b#m200080000##k.

#b#h0##k.\rI was asked to deliver this #t2431239# to you, so take it.

This must be the lab #p2159390# mentioned. #bSomeone's in charge here#k. I just need to find out who.

What are you doing here, bumpkin? There are to be no civilian trespassers near the mines while the Black Wings work. Go back to the city before I report you to my superiors. Unless...
You seem the type to be loose with a coin purse. I could be persuaded to be so loose with my tongue, for a price. Come speak to me in secret if you're interested in making a deal...
I won't force you to take a good deal. See how far you get without my services.
Very well, let us complete this transaction.
As you can see by my uniform, I am a distinguished member of the Black Wings. If you were to purchase my hat, you might have a slim chance of slipping by our security measures.
Obviously there would be a rather hefty fee. The #b#t1003134##k is a symbol of our clandestine organization. It's worth quite a lot.
And I will certainly not miss a thing so simple and... free. Do not concern yourself with my business. A man must make ends meet, especially one with such refined tastes as myself.
The price is #b100,000 Mesos#k. There will be no negotiations. You may return and speak to me when you have my payment.
Do not waste my time. If you are not serious, I will find someone who is.
Did you bring the 100,000 Mesos? Hand it over and let us be done with this.
Put on the hat and you may make it into the mines. Though, in the end, I could not care less whether or not you succeed. Never speak of this to anyone.
If you lose that, which I am sure you will somehow manage to do, you may return to me in secret. I would be glad to take some more of your money. Hehehe...
If you do not have #b100,000 Mesos#k, you are wasting my valuable time.
That was close. I'd better get back to #bPromathus#k.
My strength is coming back, but my memories still hang just out of reach. The child in Edelstein knows more about me than I do...

#p2300000# and #p2159391# seem content to live without their memories. Am I an anomaly? Wouldn't I be happier to just live as the Xenoroids do and throw aside this search for a past I may not even have had?

My apologies for the cold shoulder. Running a secret underground rebellion makes us... wary around new people. The members of the Resistance have seen more than their share of #binjustices#k in Edelstein. Be patient, and we will give you a chance to prove your loyalties.

#b#p2151004##k, the Mechanic instructor, wanted to speak with you. He's the one #bdressed like a bear#k.
If you need time to yourself, I understand, but our work must take priority.
I hear you've made quite an impression. Let me be the first to welcome you to the Resistance.
I am #b#p2151003##k. I hand out the mission assignments, and act as the doctor for this town. Your first mission is to go introduce yourself to the other instructors.
I would like you to get to know the people of Edelstein. It's impossible for anyone to protect people if they don't know who those people are.
Having a hard time? Each of us has a public position, allowing us to hide in plain sight. Most of the instructors will not even acknowledge you if they see you on the streets.
What is it, #b#h0##k?\r\n#L0#What can I do to help?#l\n#k
I am certain you will figure that out for yourself. I would like to ask you a question, though. #bWhat do you remember#k?
Give me a moment before we talk. I have one thing to sort out first...
Did I hit a touchy subject? I can wait if you need to collect yourself.
Now then, you told me your memories were clouded. What do you remember?\r\n#L0##bNothing. Nothing at all...#l\n#k
You must remember something. Think.\r\n#L0##bThe oldest memory I have is waking in the laboratory. I have no recollection prior to that.#l\n#k
Interesting. What do you know about #bGelimer#k and the #bBlack Wings#k? \r\n#L0##bWhat are the Black Wings?#l\n#k

Gelimer never spoke of the Black Wings? They fund his research... they built that laboratory. He even reports to their leader, #bOrchid#k.\r\n#L0##bI apologize. My whole life, I've only known the other Xenoroids and Professor Gelimer.#l\n#k

Don't be sorry. It's possible that we assumed too much about the importance of that lab. But I was sure #bOrchid or one of the other Black Wings#k would have paid you a visit. Something strange is going on... Tell me what you know about Gelimer.\r\n#L0##bVery little. Roo-D would know more about him than I do.#l\n#k
Rudy? Who's Rudy?\r\n#L0##bUnit R-0-0-D. She's the small Xenoroid that escaped with me. She has two protruding ears.#l\n#k
Oh, the robo-rabbit?\r\n#L0##bMy memory banks indicate that she shares a design with lagomorphic creatures, yes. She was Dr. Gelimer's lab helper, responsible for training and testing.#l\n#k
