Gelimer was aiming to make you into the perfect battle machine. Maybe he intended that for #bthe child#k as well...
Thank you for the information. We can discuss further at another time.
Hey there. I'm #p2151004#. I head up the Resistance Mechanic division. I'm sort of a gearhead, so I was hoping to get a look at #bwhat you can do#k. Hope you don't mind...

Can't wait to see what you've got. There's a portal to your left. Take that hallway down to the #b#m310010100##k and take out #b30#k of the #b#o9300409##k decoys I built. They've got a nasty little cloaking defense I built in, but I'm sure you can take them down with the right timing.
No? Need me to make some repairs?

Hmm, your systems sure aren't running at full speed right now. That control device Gelimer had on you must've been managing your implants. How do you feel?\r\n#L0##bWeaker, but the tests at the lab were much more difficult.#l\n#k
Oh yeah?\r\n#L0##bI was often thrown into battle against much larger opponents, some with herculean strength.#l\n#k
Huh... you must've been quite a fighter. Too bad all that power's gone now.\r\n#L0##bThat power made me one of Gelimer's pawns. It was a leash.#l\n#k
Yeah, I could see that when you came in here trying to wreck the place. Glad you managed to get yourself free.
Look at me prattling on like an old hen. You're one of us now. I've gotta give you a proper welcome. Here's a little something I give to the new recruits.

You still haven't smashed #b30#k of those #b#o9300409##k decoys? Take the portal to the left then you'll see another portal next to a big fella named #bElex#k. Head into the #b#m310010100##k and you'll find the #b#o9300409##k monsters on the 2nd basement floor.
#p2151003# filled me in. You're trying to figure out what happened to you, right?
I heard a good #bknock on the head#k can jog loose a stubborn memory. Sure works for my old generator out back.
How about you #bknock around some training robots here#k instead? Maybe a little warm-up will get your memories back. Heck, maybe you'll even get cracked over the head!
You know how to get to the Training Room right? Take that same portal down to the 5th floor of the #b#m310010400##k. Stomp #b30 #o9300412##k decoys.
Maybe I should knock your head around a little to get your memories back? Might not be that fun for you, though.
How's the noggin treating you?\r\n#L0##bNo memories yet, but I am beginning to find my strength.#l\n#k

You'll get your memories back someday.\n
Hey, #bElex#k was looking to talk to you. He's the big sweaty guy over by the training areas.

#p2151001# wants my advice, does he?

Allow an old man his ruminations, if you would. Edelstein is, and always has been, my home. It was once a peaceful and beautiful town, made prosperous by the hard work of its people and the good fortune of its location. You see, the local mine is quite filled with valuable materials. So full and so accessible, in fact, that a vicious group of opportunists came to take it from us. And when the Black Wings descended upon our little hamlet, they brought with them fear and intimidation.
I formed the #bResistance#k to restore Edelstein to its former glory. To bring peace back to its people. Liberty was to be our only goal.

But the passing of time brings the unexpected. We have lost friends, and gained others. We have fought and forgiven. We have faced the darkness within ourselves and forced ourselves to stare into the hearts of our enemies.

I would give you my trust completely, but I fear it is something I can no longer do. The loss I feel is still too near.\n\nThat's why we can't fully distrust or trust you. We know the pain of losing comrades and trust all too well.
But I would not turn you away. I feel you have a good heart. I will offer my acceptance if you will show your trust in us first. You must #bpromise to remain true to our cause#k.
Good. Please return to me in a moment. I am but an old man, and an old man needs time to ponder.
How can one trust if no trust is given?
I have decided that the wind feels right for acceptance. I will speak with #p2151001# and grant you my blessings.
I look forward to the day we may walk the streets of Edelstein openly, proud of the sacrifices we have made for peace.
It would do you well to take in the people and sights of Edelstein. Maybe it will even jog that clogged memory of yours!
Hey #b#h0##k. The others told me you're all right. Guess you won't mind if I ask you some questions.
I heard you saved #p2151003#, right? That's what got you a free pass into our HQ.
But here's what confuses me: I've NEVER seen old Cold-Shoulder #p2151003# act so emotional. She's also been staring at knives all day, which is super creepy when I'm microwaving popcorn.
That's why I want you to #bget something#k for me. Well?

I want you to go to the #b#m931060000##k, over by the giant mansion at the center of Edelstein. No one lives there now, but it used to be my friend's place. They left this #b#t4033636##k over there, and I want it back.
You're just going to turn me down? I thought you were in love with #p2151003#.
That photo bring back any memories?\r\n#L0##b(You tell her what you felt.)#l\n#k
Huh... Guess I was right...
That doesn't make sense though... Edelstein was at peace back then. The Black Wings weren't even around when...
You don't know where #b#m931060000##k is? Exit here and go to the mansion with the giant clock. You'll see the #bblue front door#k to the right. Bring back that #b#t4033636##k.
#b#h0##k, take this photo to #bClaudine#k.
If #b#p2151003##k seems depressed after looking at that photo, then... Eh, forget it. I hate making dumb speculations.
Just take it to her! I'll deal with her if she gets all grumpy on you.
Aren't you worried about #p2151003#? Y-you... forget it. I don't care!
What is it, #b#h0##k?\r\n#L0##b#p2151002# wanted me to give you this. To cheer you up.#l\n#k
This photo... I used to know this child. It was days before the Black Wings came, before they began to take people...\r\n#L0##bWho is your friend?#l\n#k

Back in the lab, you asked me where I got the dagger. It belonged to my friend. We were playing one day and I asked if I could see it. I was going to make a nice sheath, but the Black Wings... I held on to it, hoping to return it one day.\r\n#L0##bI want to ask you something, #p2151003#.#l\n#k
What is it?\r\n#L0##bWhat if your friend came back?#l\n#k
I'd like that very much.\r\n#L0##bEven if your friend was a completely different person?#l\n#k
I...\r\n#L0##bWhat if everything is different now?#l\n#k
I-It doesn't matter to me. Everything changes, even this town, but we make do with what we have. I know my friend was a good person, and that's all that matters to me.
As much as I'd love for things to go back to the way they were, everything's different now, and that's okay. I'll fight for the city and the people I love.
What was #bClaudine#k up to? Uh, you DO know where she is right? She's at the center of the Secret Plaza.
#b#h0##k, I think I know a place that could help you regain your memories. Would you like to go?
Exit left from Edelstein to #bEdelstein Park 1#k. You'll find the entrance to #b#m931060010##k in the corner. It was a popular place for children to play when I was young...
I can't make any promises, but it might work.
How long is this obsolete hardware going to take to restart?!\r\n#L0##bHow did you find me? I threw away the control device.#l\n#k
I followed your #bPulse#k.\r\n#L0##bWhat Pulse?#l\n#k
Typically uninformed. You can't hide from me, #rtraitor#k. I'll track you to the ends of time if I have to. That's a promise.
#b#h0##k! #b#h0##k! Are you okay?\r\n#L0##bI'm fine. How'd you get here?#l\n#k

I felt #p2159391#'s Pulse. It was weak... I think she's still pretty beat up from the last time you two fought. But I think Gelimer might be here soon enough with his Black Wings buddies.\r\n#L0##bWhat exactly is this Pulse that #p2159391# mentioned?#l\n#k

It's kinda like a #bheartbeat#k, only more robot-y. Every Xenoroid gives it off when we're active. I'm surprised you haven't felt it!\r\n#L0##b...You're right, I can feel it. Is there any way to stop my Pulse from transmitting?#l\n#k
Not unless you get turned into scrap metal. Your Pulse means you're alive.\r\n#L0##bThat means #p2159391# can track me down wherever I am.#l\n#k

I'm afraid so. Lucky for you, your Pulse isn't exactly a long-range transmitter. You wouldn't be able to feel another Xenoroid unless they were in the same town as you.\r\n#L0##bI'll try to take some consolation in that...#l\n#k
You're lucky she's still so weak from the last battle. You would not be ready for a fight like that right now. Speaking of which, we better get outta here!\r\n#L0##bYou're right, but...#l\n#k
What? Why are we not leaving?\r\n#L0##bI must let the rest of the Resistance know about this. If I returned to #m310010000# in my current state...#l\n#k
You walk into #m310010000# now, and you're going to bring the Black Wings down on the Resistance. \r\n#L0##bWhat should I do then? I can't just leave them!#l\n#k
You need an outside messenger! A non-Resistance-type-person.\r\n#L0##bThat sounds complicated.#l\n#k
There's a kid in Edelstein named #b#p2152009##k. Her older sister is #p2159390#, so I doubt the Black Wings are keeping an eye on her. She'd be perfect!
#b#p2152009##k is in Edelstein. She should be on the lower staircase.
What are you waiting for? All of Edelstein's gonna get in trouble if you don't get moving!
Who are you? My sister told me not to talk to strangers, and you are a stranger!\r\n#L0##bI'm a friend of your sister. I need you to give her a message.#l\n#k
Do I look like voicemail? Tell her yourself!\r\n#L0##bI-I can't! Please tell her that her 'friend' must leave town.#l\n#k
Where are you going? How long are you going to be gone?\r\n#L0##bI don't know. Please, just tell her.#l\n#k
Will you come back? You'd better bring me a souvenir.\r\n#L0##bYes, fine, okay. Just tell your sister, okay?#l\n#k
Fine, but I better get something good outta this.
You owe me!
#b#p2152009##k is in Edelstein. She's on the right staircase.
So, this is Henesys. I think we might stand out a little bit here. Maybe we oughtta go incognito. I mean, incog-neato!\r\n#L0##bHow do I blend in? I am covered in lights.#l\n#k
You do sort of look like the future... but just act natural. I'm sure these folks see protoype robot fighters all the time! Maybe somebody could even help us out.
I think you oughtta find the #bperson who's lived in this town the longest#k. I bet THEY'D know how to blend in and be ignored!
Nobody can live on their own. You gotta make friends to get along!
Oh great, another prototype robot fighter... \r\n#L0##b(Roo-D was right!) Pardon me, sir, but have you lived in #m100000000# the longest?#l\n#k
What? What kinda idiotic question is that? I'm the Chief! You wanna know about #m100000000#, you come to me.
This old man is obviously insane. I should find someone else.

You want to fit in here? The first thing you need to, if you want to be a respectable young person, is to work hard! And get rid of all those... speed lines or whatever they are.\r\n#L0##bWhat kind of work should I do?#l\n#k
Youngsters these days are so focused on adventuring, they don't know anything about working hard! Moving logs! Pushing bricks around! Smelting things!\r\n#L0##bR-right.#l\n#k
#bMrs. Ming Ming#k's my old lady. She always has a good handle on what kind of work you can get in town. Go talk to her. I'm getting a headache looking at all your flim-flam-flashy lights.
My wife should be in front of our house. Ask around for #b#p1012106##k.
I don't really care what you do, just get outta here!
Oh, hello there! I don't believe we've met.
You were speaking to my grouchy old goat of a husband, weren't you?
You still haven't found my wife? See? This is what's wrong with kids these days! She's in front of our house. Her name is #b#p1012106##k.
Don't mind his curmudgeonly act, he just enjoys terrorizing the locals. Perhaps you'd be kind enough to lend me a hand.
I wanted to pack some lunches for the people of #m100000000#, but the ingredients I ordered were mistakenly sent to the #bGolem's Temple#k. Can you believe it? There were #bfive packages#k total...
Oh, wonderful! There should be #bfive packages#k in the #bGolem's Temple#k. I'm just sure one of those rocky #bGolems#k would have taken them. How could they resist fresh-pickled mutton?!
You must be busy, but those people are going to be so hungry! It's a tragedy.
Did you find all five boxes? Oh, joy!
You don't know where the #bGolem's Temple#k is? Just keep heading right to get to the temple. Bring #bfive packages#k from the Golems there, okay?
Oh, #b#h0##k, what lovely timing.\rI just finished packing those lunches. Could you take one to #b#p1012108##k?
#b#p1012108##k should be in the eastern part of the town. I even made an extra for #p1012107#! Can you be a doll and take both lunches to #p1012108#?
I suppose you're busy then. I suppose #p1012108# will just have to be unhappy...
Um, hi? What's your-- Oh, did #p1012106# send you with those lunches?! She is so nice. And you're not nearly as creepy as I thought!
Will you take this as a token of my appreciation?
#bCamila#k is in the eastern part of Henesys. She's a cutie, if you're looking!
I've got more lunchies ready!! Would you be a sweetie and go hand them out?
Take this over to #b#p1012111##k, who's very likely deeply engrossed in some more of that silly Golem research.
I suppose you're busy, even though I know for a fact #p1012111# is starving to death.

My defenses were too powerful for common thieves! My locks are impervious to picking! One must have the key to... where is the key? I don't have the key.
Well, no matter. A master thief knows how to gain entry to anything, even his own extremely complicated locking mechanisms. I'll just hit it really hard with this stick!
Ah, whatever! My 2nd Job Advancement is way more important than a silly old #o9001045#. It's not like I'm running low on money! I'll just buy a new one!
Now is this the vault where the #o9001047# comes out to vaporize any would-be trespassers if the #o9001045# gets broken?

That wasn't too much of a fuss. I suppose Raven wasn't just blowing smoke when he told me, 'Learn a skill once, and you'll forget it next Tuesday, but learn a skill twice and you'll master it for a lifetime.'
Ah, master Raven... if only you had listened to your own advice and learned how to disarm a bomb more than once. It was a sad day for us all...

But, thanks to that crazy old coot, I am on my way to becoming the greatest thief in all of Maple World... again. I'm sure he would be proud, but he would also probably try to rob me, so I'm glad he's dead!
I remember documenting the advancement quite thoroughly, despite Raven's belligerent accusations of me 'going soft in the brain' for wanting to write things down.
I suppose I'll try the vault in #b#m260000000##k. I'm pretty sure that's the one where I left my favorite pair of socks.
I remember a vault behind #b#m260010600##k, where few people went...
Let's see, I made a list of the vaults I kept and stored that... in one of my vaults.
The people should grovel in awe now that I've reached level 60, but I don't know that the Black Wings will be so easily impressed. I'll need a 3rd Job Advancement to really put a pin in their seats.
Hundreds of years and not a thing changes. #m260000000# is the same desolate wasteland full of rich creeps. The same place I left it all behind to become something more...
Maybe after I find that vault, I'll pay some of them a visit.
Something's fishy here. I smell dust. There should never be dust in my vaults! They're air tight!
I'd better head inside.
This vault brings back so many memories. It feels like only yesterday that I was watching nouveau riche snobs buy themselves positions of power.

Nothing but a bunch of well-off wolves, taking whatever they could from people who needed it. I can't believe I used to call it home before I devoted my life to taking people like them down. And now they're all gone...
I threw away my old name for them. I became Phantom for them. And now I'm here and she's gone...
No time like the present. Just a quick jet over to #b#m240000000##k to the vault behind #b#m240010101##k, and I should be able to get that old journal back.
I bet nobody expected me to make it this far. I'm pretty great.
Level 100, the big time! Time to get my 4th Job Advancement done and become the master everybody knows I am. Pickpockets in the street are going to be chanting my name!

The vault at #m240000000#... that's where I kept all my favorite things. A robber wouldn't even know what to do with most of those old keepsakes. Why, oh why, did I decide to leave that #o9001047# to guard the place?
Wait a minute. I left a really nasty #rGuardioso#k here. I wonder if it still works. It was supposed to last a thousand years, but things don't seem to be holding up to this new world.
I remember it being a real piece of work. I'd hate to have to fight it just to get inside, but I need to get those journals.

I can't believe that thing was broken! And the warranty expired YESTERDAY, I can't even get it replaced! That company probably doesn't even exist anymore! I have had the worst luck since I came back...
I'm really going to have to tell Gaston to get a tally on how much all these broken locks and guard-bots are costing me.
Let's see, there should be a journal of all my greatest secret techniques around here... somewhere. This place is a treasure trove of old memories and I was never one for organization...
Maybe that #o9001047# rattled my brain a little bit...
Aria's Portrait... Of course. I remember sending her that letter, saying I was going to steal her precious gem. It was to be my greatest achievement.
She looked like such a pushover back then. I was sure that taking Skaia would be a cinch. She sure did prove me wrong.
Can you believe what I've become, Aria? Just another lost soul talking to an old picture.
Hello Mr. Phantom. I would humbly like to request your audience in #m130000000#... if you wouldn't mind.
Recently, I was organizing the things left behind by my aunt, the former Empress Aria, and I found something that I thought you should have.
I have heard that you and my aunt had a sort of special relationship and I would like you to have it. Even Neinheart said it was of little consequence. I hope you will come soon.
I was sure you would want to meet, but I can understand you wanting to leave the past behind you.
You came! I'm very glad to see you! You look very... well you're fitting in, I think...
Anyway, here's the keepsake I told you about. It's her diary and its rather damaged, I'm afraid. Some of it is still legible though...
Empress Aria was surrounded by people that loved her, but I believe you were the only one who ever really cared for her as a person, not an Empress.
I mean, I'm not saying, I read it, but... well, um... Please just take it, will you?
Aria thought of you as something more than a friend because she trusted you. I hope you will give me that trust as well.
Throughout my many luxurious travels, I've come to realize that I am far too metropolitan a person to spend my days wandering around with my own two feet.
Walking around is just not the most majestic way to get around.
I really want a mount! In my day, mounts were confined to horses and very large monkeys, but the mounts these days are just amazing! I must to tell #p1401000# to get me one!
I don't NEED it, per se, but...

Hello, master. It has been some time since you've set foot upon the #m150000000#. I assume you're working to live up to those rather ample promises you made. \r\n#L0##bThat's not important right now, #p1401000#. What IS important is that I need a ride!#l\n#k
A ride, master?\r\n#L0##bI'm talking about a Mount! An awesome Mount to show the world what a high-roller I am! Have you seen the things these people are cruising around on?#l\n#k
Of course, master. I've already taken the liberty of ordering a ride suited to your particular tastes.

I ordered you a rather flashy convertible automobile. I thought it would suit your image. It is a custom model, much like the #m150000000#, being built by a very capable alchemist in #m261000000# \r\n#L0##bA lot of those words sounded made-up, but I'm very excited!#l\n#k

Of course you are, master. Your vehicle is being crafted from the finest materials. The delivery date was today, but there have been some delays. \r\n#L0##bSeriously?! I hate delays! I want to see it!#l\n#k
Well, you could go there yourself if you're feeling that impatient. It might save us a bit on the delivery fee.
There is a Zenumist alchemist named #p2111008# in #m261000000#. He is the one working on your vehicle. You should take this Order Request along as well.
Alright then. I can wait if you can.
So busy! Whaddaya want? You interested in joining the Zenumists or something? New recruits need to check in with Sir Carso-WHOA!
Oh, uh, hey. Nice Order Request you got there. The convertible, yeah? Well, uh, it's... you know... we're workin' on it.
You haven't gone to #m261000000#? I sent the order to #p2111008#, a Zenumist alchemist.
Man oh man, of all the things to break, why'd it have to be a Lidium Engine?! I can't afford that! I'm gonna have to sell my organs!
You lost the Order Request? Well, I do have a replacement, but this is very unlike you, master. Are you feeling well?
Okay, so it's going to be a little longer on that convertible. It's really technical stuff, you wouldn't understand...
Look, I'm sorry! I was trying to get that Lidium Engine put together, b-but then it just fell out of the mounts and...
You gotta understand, I could reconstruct the engine, but Lidium costs an arm and a leg! I just can't replace it...
I tried to buy refined Lidium with the paychecks I saved up, but the price went up and I just can't buy it... I'm s-sorry, but... If it's possible... you could give me a bit more...
You are so generous, you really are! I just need about 10 million Mesos to get the Lidium back! I've got a broker ready and everything! I'll have it when you get back!
Please, I'm super duper sorry! If Sir Carson finds out, he's going to sell me like a donkey!
Y-you didn't get the money?! But I already ordered the Lidium! What do I do?!! They're going to turn me into a lab rat!
I am all-powerful once again! It feels so good to be back! What should I do to celebrate? Kill Horntail? Pink Bean?
Actually, I'm in too good of a mood to be violent. On occasions like these, one must indulge in luxuries of all kinds... I need a new car!
Break open the vaults, #p1401000#, you have some ordering to do!
Well, it's not like I hate my old car. It's a classic. Maybe I should think of something else to celebrate with.
That she-witch Hilla will think twice about crossing paths with myself or the #p1101000# Knights for a while. Not a bad debut for this new generation either...
It's a good thing it was only Hilla. If any of the REAL commanders had been there, I would have been in some serious trouble. The Black Mage's curse had some nasty effects on my strength.
I can't take all the credit for that performance. I should go say thanks to #b#p1401000##k for putting together that little light show with the skill effects.
What am I thinking? That was his job! I'll just buy him a new egg timer later. He loves those.

Congratulations on a successful mission, master. Hilla will not be so fast to concoct another scheme when she realizes she was fooled by a level 10 thief. \r\n#L0##bWhat goes around comes around, my good man. Tricks are a legitimate strategy in any battle.#l\n#k

Perhaps next time, you will think to be a little less flippant with your life. Provoking a commander of the Black Mage at this time could easily turn into a one-way return ticket to the grave. \r\n#L0##bI had to look good! It was my big debut! I needed some cool flashy effects and a tough spiel...#l\n#k
Your love of flashy things is quite obvious, looking at the #m150000000#, but take care not to risk your life so frivolously in the future, will you? My position here relies on that.

Shaking Hilla was a good step, but the #p1101000# Knights must continue to believe that you are as powerful as you once were. At your level, you could barely handle a mushroom... \r\n#L0##bThat hurts, Gaston. You know I used to be level 200. It's not my fault the Black Mage cursed me!#l\n#k

Master, please, you are making me laugh...\r\n#L0##bDon't you dare! Don't you dare laugh at my plight! I will make the Black Mage rue the day he cursed me!#l\n#k
Master, you have been given a new chance at life. Do not sit here and wallow in the fact that you'll have to do a little bit of hard work to make it more enjoyable.

Ah, my dear master, you are living in the past. Please drink this.

This potion was created for a special event some time ago, but I purchased it from a local ruffian. It will come with the accumulated power of that amazing traveler. Come now, give a cheers to victory!

Taking a training break already, are we? Well, the lovely #b#p1401001##k did mention that she wanted to see you about an assignment you'd given her. \r\n#L0##b#p1401001#? I believe I asked her to get some more information on the Black Wings for me. I'll swing by.#l\n#k

If you think that's for the best, but I still believe you should be training. Perhaps if the information is not of great urgency... \r\n#L0##bThe value of information is not based on its quantity, but on its timing, my dear Gaston. I didn't hire #p1401001# just for her looks, you know?#l\n#k

Forgive an old man his questions, master. I am sure your decisions are in the right. \r\n#L0##bNo need for all the grandstanding, Gaston. I am just trying to be certain that the Black Mage does not catch me off guard again. #l\n#k

Did your stint as an ice cube not suit you, master?\r\n#L0##bI can't say that it did. I was expecting a lot, but even Freud didn't see that last little piece of work coming. When I think of all those levels I lost!#l\n#k
It's a good thing you've still got your wealth.\r\n#L0##bA great thief hides his stash well. A master thief doesn't need to hide it at all.#l\n#k

That almost made sense, master. Tell me, why didn't you go to the #p1101000# Knights immediately when you awoke? Wouldn't this be easier with strong allies?\r\n#L0##bA weakling claiming to be a hero is of no use in a battle with the ultimate evil. This way I can help them when they need it and empower myself at the same time.#l\n#k

You are quite a character, master. Scoundrel and hero wrapped into one never-ending bag of witless one liners.\r\n#L0##bAria would have liked you quite a bit, Gaston. I'm glad I have you at my side to take down the Black Mage.#l\n#k

Now I see how much you value information.
Have you changed your mind and decided to train instead?

You haven't gone to the #bIntelligence Center#k yet? I guess the #m150000000# is quite large...

I know I've told you this before, boss, but there are a lot of folks who look like Black Wings. They're not even a very big organization. \r\n#L0##bYou're right. I've seen a lot of those hats around town. I wonder if they're just using innocent people to make their numbers look bigger.#l\n#k

Or maybe someone in their organization is making a little money on the side. I did some looking and I found a place where you could actually buy #rBlack Wings Hats#k. \r\n#L0##bThey're using fashion trends for evil? Those scum!#l\n#k

Totally agree, boss! My source tells me there's a Black Wing member in #m310000000# doing the selling. \r\n#L0##bMaybe they really aren't paying their people enough. Either that, or they're just desperate for money.#l\n#k

I think it's closer to the former. The heads of the Black Wings don't seem to know about his little hat scheme. \r\n#L0##bWell, at least we know it's an authentic hat, and THAT means that we can make a perfect disguise!#l\n#k

Ding, ding! You put on one of their hats, we get all the intel we want.\r\n#L0##bI expected nothing less from you, #p1401001#. I am serious about that, if you do anything less, I will cut your pay in half.#l\n#k
You're all talk, boss. Put this thing on your noggin and get ready to start acting like a heel. Are you ready to go right away?
Ready for action!
Fine, but I'm keeping the hat for now. I kinda like it.
Here's your hat. We didn't put any special super spy stuff in there. It's just a hat.
There's only so much information you can buy off of people. You want more, you do your own dirty work.
This hat isn't exactly the BEST disguise, but I'd look very silly in a mustache. At least the air's fresh and I don't have to train...
The monsters around #m310000000# seem pretty manageable too. Maybe this won't be a complete waste of time.
I just have to hide my identity and get back to the #m150000000# if things go south.
#m310000000#, a phantom is coming to haunt you... as soon as I go talk to #p1400003#!
Maybe I'm not ready to jump into this. I've already got the hat, I could just go get stronger for a while...
As always, the Lumiere is at your command.
If you're ready to take her out for a ride across the wind, come talk to me.
I'm sure you've noticed, but #bthe Lumiere follows above you wherever you go#k. If you ever want to reboard the ship, you can #breturn to the Lumiere with that skill of yours#k.
This place is alright. Clean, well-maintained... a little too nice.

There are three watchmen in total: #p2152017#, #p2152018#, and #p2152016#. #p2152016# is in charge and #p2152017# is the lowest on the totem pole. It will be easier to start with #bthe lowest ranking watchman first#k.
Time to put on my infiltrating hat...
#b#p2152017##k first. She looked like a real pushover. I believe I saw her by the lower western side of the town.
Actually, I should take a look around first. This place IS pretty nice and I get the feeling they sell excellent clocks.
First up, #p2152017#. Her duty - analyzing #o1150000# recordings. Looking over her dossier, it doesn't look like she gives it her all. In summary, lazy as can be.
Second, #p2152018#. His duty - town regulation. He joined the Black Wings to save his lady friend, but ended up another Black Wings hostage. In summary, might be talkative.
Third, #p2152016#. He's in charge of all the other watchmen. He sends full reports on all goings-on back to the top Black Wings. In summary, mildly dangerous.
It doesn't seem like any of them are even worth looking into at this point, but they might have information on the people above them.
That #p2152016# character looked like he knew a little something. Maybe I should talk to him.
Did they finally hire another watchman?! Thank heavens. We've been understaffed for months! I could barely get my quests done. Let me see if I can find you some work...
Oh, I got it! I lost my #bring#k and I want it back! Don't talk to me about your problems, just go get it!
I told you to get to it! I lost it when I was checking a #r#o1150000##k data log a couple of days ago. Just go out to the field and start knocking those machines around until you find it.
I'm going straight to the managers about you!
Not bad, not bad. I was sure you were just some joker PRETENDING to be a Black Wing when you came up here earlier. What kind of idiot would do that, am I right?

I'm glad to have this thing back. It's caused me a lot of grief. Had to join the Black Wings just to get away from the people who loaned me the money to buy it. I don't even know what we do here, I just know those loan sharks never bother me a bit!

It's easy work. Takes about 30 seconds to look over a #o1150000# and file the report before I get back to my shopping. In fact, the only person I've met is the one who gives me my paycheck, #p2154002#. I bet you've met her.
#b(Leonore seems to be a dead end. Time to head over to the next watchman.)#k
I told you, I lost my ring in a #r#o1150000##k! Go get it!
Never seen you around before. Guess the Black Wings are pulling in recruits by the dozens. If you're gonna be one of us, you should get to work.
Go tell #bOfficer #p2152003##k to take care of those signs. They're acting weird. It isn't much of a job, but it needs to be done... according to the officials upstairs, at least.

I thought I told you to talk to #p2152003#. The Police Station is on the #bwestern side of the town#k.
Look, I'm sorry to ask, but I really don't like those signs. They give me the heeby-jeebies! Please, as long as SOMEONE takes care of it, #p2152018# won't say anything.
That's what I wanted to hear. Just report back to #b#p2152018##k when #r50#k of the #r#o1150001##k monsters are gone!
I, uh, okay I guess...
You went and did #p2152003#'s work for her? That lady... \r\n#L0##bAre you and #p2152003# close?#l\n#k

Yeah, you could say that. I've lived here forever and I've seen good people get turned into things they weren't. Watching you help out that brat makes me think you're not too much of a Black Wing yourself.\r\n#L0##bWhat does it mean to be a Black Wing?#l\n#k
It means being a real fink. It means kidnapping innocent women and tearing peoples' lives apart. Being a Black Wing means being a scumbag.\r\n#L0##bKidnapping women, you say?#l\n#k

If I could just get her back...
#b(Wonny was forced into joining the Black Wings. He won't have any important information. It's time to move on to #bWatchman Bavan#k.)
I thought you were going to tear down all the #rsigns#k for me. You only have to beat up #r50#k. Just do it and tell #bWonny#k for me, okay?

Nom-nom-nom, who are you, with your fancy sleek clothes? You look a little well-off to be one of the new recruits. Perhaps you're one of the officer's children, working your way up!
Maybe I'll tell you a little secret on advancing through the ranks. You'll have to help me first. It's a little thing. Just bring a #b#t4033122##k from a #r#o1150002##k.
You'll find a #o1150002# or two if you just head #beast#k. It's called the Serpent Path after all. You'll find a nice bag if you keep whacking those snakes.
Have it your way, rookie. You can wallow as a lowly watchman forever.

Look at the luster on that #t4033122#! Lady #p2154002# is sure to love it! Oh, your tip. Yes, the fastest way to get ahead is through bribery! Just give money and gifts to your betters until they give you what you want!

I was a skinny little street rat like yourself before I started bribing my way to the top. Just look at me now! I report all of the town's happenings straight up the chain, no matter how trivial they may seem. I'm on my way to the top!

I've heard that the upper echelon of our organization are rolling in benefits! Money, honor, UNDERLINGS! Think of the chefs I could hire! You never have to do a day of work in your life and they just keep paying you!
I'd even get to leave #m310000000# and travel the world. I don't know all the details, but I know it's great! Money is all you need, no?
#b(Bavan's mind is on his own promotions. I should find another trail to chase.)
I hear you can get a #t4033122# from a #o1150002#, if you are lucky...
Shouldn't you be spending some time to better yourself? You're just loitering around. There's a fellow named #b#p2153000##k outside of the town that shares your enjoyment for doing nothing.

To mind your own business! You think you should even be let near one of the commanders? They would tear you apart with their laser beam eyes! That's only a euphemism, but I believe a few of them actually do have laser beam eyes.
Take my advice. Scrape together the small remaining fraction of wealth you have and devote yourself to making money. You'll find nothing with the Black Wings.

In fact, the only person you MIGHT have a chance to run into is the founder of the Black Wings! I've heard he or she was working to #bextract a great deal of energy from #m310000000##k, but you'd have more luck finding a fairy under the rocks.

If you really want to continue your foolish search, speak to someone higher up, like #bSecretary #p2154002##k. But do not let your guard down for a second. She is no more friendly than a cornered badger.

First, the Black Wings watchmen are just everyday people. The know nothing about their employer, only that they have to keep doing their jobs or bad things start happening. Fighting them would be nothing but cruel.

The only thing left for me to do is find an officer. That means I need to talk to Secretary #b#p2154002##k and give her a bit of the old Phantom charm.

I do hope the secretary can speed this along. I'm getting tired of dodging around after small fries.
Hello to you. I don't believe we've met yet, but I feel like I've seen you somewhere before. You have a very memorable face.
