Keep calm and train. I'll let you know when I find them.

(#p1404005# floats inside the cold glass chamber. His body appears frail and peaceful. Only his soul roams free.)\r\n#L0##b#p1404005#, my dear boy, you look pathetic. Quite different from the days when you and your sister ransacked #m130000000#...#l\n#k
(He doesn't seem to be able to hear you. Where could that troublesome spirit of his be?)
Why are you running around so crazy? That's not like you.
Th-this is my chance to avenge Aria. To hurt the people that hurt her...
Maybe that's why I didn't want to join the alliance. I knew their goals were different than mine. I knew they wouldn't approve...
In the end, I'm not the kind of fighter they fancy themselves to be. I don't deserve to be called a hero.
But... Aria still trusted me.
I cannot betray that trust.

How could you?! You're off giving fancy bags to ladies in Edelstein, but you don't give a single one of your employees a nice treat?! You're so cheap!\r\n#L0##bWhat are you ranting about? I didn't give anyone a gift. I had to trick a woman while I was investigating her...#l\n#k

We work all day and night to make sure you have the best airship in the world and you go giving presents to people you don't even like! I'm going to... I don't know, organize a strike!\r\n#L0##bI'm telling you, that's not how it is! Look, is your salary too low? You can have a raise. Whatever you want, just stop yelling.#l\n#k
I don't WANT a ra-I mean, okay! But that's not all. You have to get me a bag too. I'll turn the Lumiere into a big floating pile of garbage unless you get me a bag!
I thought you'd see things my way. Just go back to Edelstein and beat up a Serpent and bring me a nice new Snake Leather Bag. That's easy enough, isn't it?
You wanna play hardball, do you? Well say goodbye to clean sheets FOREVER!
This is a good start. Don't forget your employees next time you're running around town.
I felt bad about all the yelling, so I took some of that huge raise you gave me and got you a chair! Isn't it nice. It'll look so good on you. Or, you know what I mean...
I want a GENUINE Snake Leather Bag from the Serpents in Edelstein. No substitutes!
You're not quite ready to balance Light and Dark. Why don't you get some more practice in?
You're not quite ready to control your darkness. Want to try again?
Luminous... Luminous...!\r\n#L0##bHm? Who goes there?#l\n#k
Can you hear the sound of my voice?\r\n#L0##bI know that voice... Vieren? Is that you?#l\n#k

That's right! I knew you'd remember me, even after all these centuries. Come drop by and we can catch up. I'm in Harmony these days.\r\n#L0##bHarmony, our old sanctum? I would if I could, old friend, but I've lost my way. I don't know how to get there.#l\n#k
Psh, no problem! Here, take this. You can use it to get to Harmony.
I already charged that sucker up, so come on over whenever you feel like it.
Come now! That's no way to treat an old friend.
Luminous! Luminous, I've gathered the power of the Auguries for you!\r\n#L0##bVieren? Of what do you speak?#l\n#k
Don't worry about it. Just use the #bAurora Prism#k to come see me in Harmony!
I'll be waiting for you.
Don't be like that! This is your best shot at really controlling that dark streak of yours!
Luminous, we need to talk.\r\n#L0##bAre you all right?#l\n#k
I'm fine, I just... I remembered a bit of my past. Please, come to see me.
I'm just a little disoriented. I think our connection is getting deeper.
Sure. Fine. It's not like you almost blew me up or anything.
How come you only visit when I invite you over? Don't you miss me?\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
I know, I know. You're busy fighting your war with the Black Mage. I just wish you'd drop by more often...
I've been remembering Lucia lately. We used to stroll through Harmony when you were little...
I want to give you something. From back then. Think of me whenever you look at it, okay?
Ah, the one who ventured into the darkness. Welcome back.
You must continue your struggle to control the Dark inside you.
You've finally conquered the darkness.
The Dark holds nothing for you to fear anymore.
Light and Dark are one.
Congratulations. You're finally gaining control over Light and Dark.
Cast away your fate and walk your own path. Let no harm come to those you love!
I must never turn from the Light again. My full power is not yet restored, but it is only a matter of time.
But Lania will be easy prey to the monsters here when I'm gone. I should see to them before I leave.
My enemies await on the other side of that portal. My Light will cleanse them from Maple World!
Then again, the girl can fend for herself.
That will do. Now I must plan my next step.\r\n
Hello there, stranger! What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bI'm a newcomer to these lands. Might I trouble you with some questions?#l\n#k
Hee, you talk funny. What do you want to know?\r\n#L0##bDo you know the way to Elluel? I could have sworn Mercedes's city was nearby...#l\n#k

What're you talking about? I've never heard of an 'Elluel' before. Mercedes, though! Wasn't that one of the five heroes who sealed away the Black Mage? Legend has it that he put a nasty curse on the heroes that put 'em all to sleep forever.\r\n#L0##b(Mercedes... The seal wasn't enough.) What of the Elves? Don't they have a town nearby?#l\n#k

What's an 'Elves?' Trust me, there aren't any other towns around here. I know every inch of the forest.\r\n#L0##b(I wish we'd had a proper farewell, Mercedes, my friend.) I see. I don't suppose you've heard of a place called Aurora?#l\n#k
Sorry. 'Fraid not.\r\n#L0##b(Master... Vieren... Lucia...) Then I am truly lost. Thank you for your time.#l\n#k
Wait, wait! Not so fast!
Talk to me again in a second. I'm remembering something...
What's the big hurry? I want to help!
Right, right. I bet I know who knows about Aurora!\r\n#L0##bWho is it?#l\n#k
There's an old human-y guy named Grendel the Really Old. He knows EVERYTHING!
He runs the Magic Library at the center of town. You can't miss it!
No? Well, I don't have any other ideas. Sorry.
Hullo. Can I help you?
The Magic Library's at the center of town. Good luck!
Hullo. I'm Lolo. Can I help you?\r\n#L0##bGreetings, child. I seek the man known as Grendel.#l\n#k
Sorry. Master Grendel just stepped out.\r\n#L0##bWhen will he return?#l\n#k
Boy, I should have asked him when he left. That would've been a great idea! Oh well. I can take a message, if you like.\r\n#L0##bPerhaps you can help me. What do you know of Aurora?#l\n#k
Aurora. Aurora Aurora Aurora. That DOES sound familiar. Where did I hear that before...?
Hm. Maybe this will help you.
Okay. Thanks for visiting your local library!
The master made me read every book in the library when I first started here.\r\n#L0##bAnd you read of Aurora?#l\n#k
Not quite. I saw the name next to a weird emblem. It was kinda warm...\r\n#L0##bIt must be the Aurora seal. Where did you see it?#l\n#k
On some dirty old scroll. To be honest, I was too afraid to even touch it back then.\r\n#L0##bShow me the scroll.#l\n#k
Shoot. Where did I find that old thing? Hold on a sec.
It'll take me some time to track the scroll down. Maybe you could do me a favor while I look for it?
If you don't want to see it, I've got other work to do.
It's nothing tough. I just need some cleaning tools I lost a while ago.\r\n#L0##bI shall take on your quest. Where did you lose them?#l\n#k
Stolen is more like it. I think those #bRoyal Fairies#k at #bChimney Tree#k nabbed 'em while I was on break! Can you get them back for me?
I'll find that scroll. Just get me my cleaning tools back.
Dang. If I don't finish cleaning before Grendel gets back, he'll light my guts on fire.
You got 'em? The tools, I mean?\r\n#L0##bI have retrieved your tools and dispatched the villains who stole them.#l\n#k
Good, I thought those Fairies could use a good dispatching!
Anyway, I got what you were looking for. Just give me a sec.
Please get my tools back from the #bRoyal Fairies#k. Pretty please.
I found the scroll on the second floor. It's so old, I thought it'd turn to dust in my hands!\r\n#L0##bShow me.#l\n#k
Here. See this weird emblem?\r\n#L0##bThis is from Aurora! May I?#l\n#k
Sure. Just be careful with it, okay?
Come on! If anything happens to it, the master'll turn my hair into a toad! You ever have frog hair before? Huh? Not pleasant.
This is it. I pray it holds the answers I seek.\r\n#b<Double-click on the #r#t2430872##b in your Use Inventory.>#k
Maybe I should wait. My resolve may not yet be strong enough to face my inner darkness.
I've never seen this before. Perhaps it was used when selecting Aurora members.
According to this, I can reach the sanctum of #bHarmony#k even if I don't fully recover my powers of Light. But how?
I gotta get back to my cleaning. Did the scroll help?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. I am indebted to you.#l\n#k
In THAT case, I've got another favor to ask!\r\n#L0##bWhat would you have me do?#l\n#k
I found some old, beat up books when I was cleaning. If I had some Polishing Sap, I could fix 'em up good as new.\r\n#L0##bThe Polishing Sap will be yours.#l\n#k
Great! The Evil Eyes outside Ellinia are loaded with the stuff. I think their eye goobers are made of Polishing Sap.
Thanks! I owe you one!
What? Is it too gross?
Great. That's all the Polishing Sap I need.
Oh, Grendel's back! I bet he can help you out.
The Evil Eyes are scary. If they weren't, I'd get the Polishing Sap myself.
Lolo told me about you. What do you want, kid?\r\n#L0##bI seek knowledge of Aurora.#l\n#k
Aurora? That's a name I haven't heard in a long time. It vanished centuries ago.\r\n#L0##bIf it still exists out there, I must find it.#l\n#k
Very well. Whatever your reasons, they must be important.
To be honest, my memory isn't what it used to be. But I know this library better than anyone alive, so I can find what you're looking for.
You're free to look around. Let me know if you want any help.
In exchange, I have a request for you.\r\n#L0##bWhat do you need?#l\n#k
I'm not asking for much. You see, I make a point to help the people of Ellinia from time to time. But if I'm to find this information for you, you'll have to help them in my place.
Let's get started! I'll prepare my research, so give me just a second.
I'm afraid that the people of Ellinia are too important to me.

Yes, yes. I found some documents related to the emblem Lolo found, but I'll need some time to go through them. Is there anything you found out on your own that I should know about?\r\n#L0##bThere's a sanctum called Harmony in Aurora. The scroll mentions how to get there, but not in detail.#l\n#k
That is where I'll focus my research, then. I leave the people of Ellinia to you.
Talk to Anne first. She's Dr. Betty's daughter. Her mother's too busy to play with her these days, so try to find a way to cheer her up.
Dying...of boredom...\r\n#L0##bYou must be Anne. I've been sent by Grendel to solve your problems.#l\n#k
Mom told me not to talk to strangers!\r\n#L0##bYou've nothing to fear from me, child! Now, how may I be of service?#l\n#k
If you say so... Mom made some teddy bears, but the mean old monsters stole 'em. Now I don't have anyone to play with...
The #bCurse Eyes#k in Ellinia Forest took them. You'll get all 3 back for me, won't you?
Go away! You're mean!
Did you find my dolls?\r\n#L0##bYour bear dolls are safe.#l\n#k
Yay! Thank you so much!
Shane seems upset. He's strange, but he's not a bad guy.
Where are my teddy bears? They were my only friends...
What're YOU looking at? Huh? HUH?!\r\n#L0##bI'm here to help.#l\n#k

Ha! You think you can help me? You know what it's like to have the best rare herb garden in the whole wide world? To have herbs so awesome that even Sabitrama from Sleepywood wanted some, and then lose it all?\r\n#L0##bWhat tragedy befell your herbs?#l\n#k
Those #bCold Eye#k jerks are to blame! They busted into my garden and tore everything up, then ran off with the seeds. If I can't get those seeds back, I'm ruined. RUINED, you hear me?!
20 seeds! That's all I ask for. Just 20 seeds!
I thought you were gonna help me!!
Gimme! Gimme gimme gimme!\r\n#L0##bTake good care of these seeds.#l\n#k
Yeah! I won't forget this. Thanks forever!
Have you talked to Dr. Betty? She looks like she could use some help.
If you don't hurry, the Cold Eyes will eat all my Herb Seeds. Hurry hurry hurry!
Yes, what is it? I'm a little busy.\r\n#L0##bI'm here to assist you.#l\n#k
Hm. I suppose I can find something for you to do. I could use some extra samples for my experiments, in fact.
I need about 20 Surgeon Eye Tails for my current project. You can get them for me, can't you?
If that's all, then leave me alone. I have work to do.
Do you have my samples?\r\n#L0##bI do. Now you should have time to spend with your daughter.#l\n#k
What? Yes, yes, of course. Just as soon as I'm done here...
Wing the Fairy seems pretty upset lately. I wonder what happened...
Please hurry. My experiment is very time-sensitive!
Buzz off! Scram! Get outta here! I don't feel like talking to your dumb face!\r\n#L0##bCalm yourself, friend. What has you so upset?#l\n#k
Don't you 'friend' me! You're just like those stupid monkeys!\r\n#L0##bWhat are these 'monkeys' of which you speak?#l\n#k
If you really gotta know, I went out to play with the Lupins and they threw a bunch of bananas at me! Those bananas are deadly! I wish I could teach those idiot apes a lesson.
You're gonna help? Really? Beat up 50 of 'em, and I'll feel way better!
If you aren't gonna help, then SCRAM!
You beat 'em all up, right?\r\n#L0##bI promise you, those Lupins rue the day they crossed Luminous.#l\n#k
Great! Well, I'm gonna go play, then. Thanks a lot!
You'll make those Lupins pay, right?
This should satisfy Grendel the Really Old. Now to return to the #bMagic Library#k.
Hopefully Grendel has found what I'm looking for.
I have precious little time to waste. If I don't find Harmony, the darkness may consume me.
I was wondering when you'd be back. How was it, helping others?\r\n#L0##bHelping others truly is the greatest thing in life.#l\n#k
Yes, it is pretty nice, innit? Now, I have something for you. Are you ready?
I hope this is what you were looking for. If you have any questions, go ahead and ask.
Did the scroll have what you needed?\r\n#L0##bSo it would seem.#l\n#k
Great! Then you'll be off to Harmony now, I suppose.\r\n#L0##bNot quite. I seem to be missing some necessary items.#l\n#k

True. It's always a good idea to pack a toothbrush.\r\n#L0##bToothbrush? No, I... There's a certain ritual I must perform, but I don't quite understand the items I need for it. I'm certain a toothbrush isn't one of the items, though.#l\n#k

Boy, aren't you a serious one? But you've piqued my interest. Tell me more about these mysterious items.\r\n#L0##bThe items are all paradoxes. I need cold flame, dry moisture, dark light, and bright darkness.#l\n#k
Oh, a puzzle! I love puzzles! Give me a moment...
Yes, I read something about this in a book somewhere.
I just need a moment. Are you in that much of a hurry?

The cold flame is obvious enough. Head to the Golem's Temple south of here and find the burning golems. You can start a fire using their cores, but they feel cool to the touch.\r\n#L0##bHow peculiar! I wonder if all the paradoxes are related to monsters.#l\n#k
You're probably right. Anyway, head to the Golem's Temple. I'll look into the other paradoxes in the meantime.
Here, take this lantern. Keep it with you and defeat #b50 Flaming Mixed Golem#k, and it will capture their light.
You do want to find your way to Harmony, don't you?
You get all of that sweet golem light?\r\n#L0##bIndeed.#l\n#k
Oh, yes. Feel the cold flame in that lantern? Perfect.
You'll need to defeat more Flaming Mixed Golems before we can move on.
The next paradox was dry moisture, correct? I think your answer lies in the swamp north of Kerning City.
Muddy Sprout Monsters live in the Deep Mire. I've read that their breath is as dry as a desert breeze. Doesn't that sound like what we're looking for?
You'll need to hunt #b50#k of them to fill the lantern with their breath. #bDouble-click#k on the lantern like before.
What? Don't you trust my wisdom?
My, my! I can feel all the dry moisture in the air.\r\n#L0##bI wouldn't have believed it if I didn't feel it myself.#l\n#k
Yes! It's a wondrous thing.
I'm know those Muddy Sprout Monsters aren't the best company, but you need their breath.
We're halfway done, and I think I know what dark light and bright darkness are.\r\n#L0##bImpressive! You are as wise as you are aged.#l\n#k
You flatterer! Now, let me explain what dark light is.

Have you ever been to Florina Beach? Beautiful place. Just lovely. Anyway, the Torties on the Warm Sand have an incredibly bright light trapped in their shells, but you can't see it because it's hidden. This must be the dark light from the scroll. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k, go to the Warm Sand, and #bdeshell 50 Torties#k.
Did something come up? Return to me when you're ready.
Did you see the light?\r\n#L0##bIt was brilliant! When I peered into the shells, I saw a glorious light unlike any other in its turtle-itude!#l\n#k
I see. I would love to see this turtle-itudeness light someday, myself.
It's time for the final paradox. Tell me when you're ready.
Tortie shells are tough, but I think you're up to the task.

Let's get back to it. The final paradox is fairly straightforward: it's about the Maladies of the Cursed Forest near Ellinia.\r\n#L0##bMaladies? The little witches I see flying around the forest?#l\n#k
Yes. Those Maladies used to be fair maidens, but all of that dark magic they hurl around cursed them. They live in the secluded forest because they're embarrassed.
This is it! #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the Forest of Evil Energy 1 and defeat #b50 Maladies#k. Then all that will be left is to finish your ritual.
What? Is it something I said?
Now THAT is a Vampiric Lantern.\r\n#L0##bThe power of this lantern flows through me!#l\n#k
Er, right. Well, I appreciated this chance to satisfy my curiosity about your paradoxes.
The Maladies are a danger to Ellinia, too. Think of this as community service.
Well, go on! Do your ritual!\r\n#L0##bIn due time! This is a delicate ritual. One mistake, and I could level the town. No, I need somewhere nice and secluded to do this.#l\n#k

In that case, I know just the place! There's a small room east of the #bGolem's Temple Entrance#k. The Black Wings uses it for secret meetings, but nobody cares about what they want. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to go near there.
Good luck.
That's the only place I can think of. Why not give it a chance?
This place will do. I owe Grendel a debt of gratitude.
It's time I got underway.
The room's off to the right of the Golem's Temple Entrance. Look carefully; there aren't any signs.
The room's off to the right of the Golem's Temple Entrance. Look carefully; there aren't any signs.
The four energies are responding! The way to Harmony should open soon.
Home is finally in reach. All I need do is use the Vampiric Lantern.
I shouldn't dawdle. If I don't use the Vampiric Lantern quickly, I may miss my chance!
You're here! You're here! Happy day! I knew I'd see you again!\r\n#L0##bVieren? Is it really you?#l\n#k
In the flesh! Well, not literally, but it's still me!
This Dark power... I shall sharpen it into a deadly weapon to use against my enemies!
I'll begin by testing my new powers against #b10 Bubblings#k.
No... No! I must resist the temptation!
Mwahaha! I was a fool for clinging to the power of Light for so long!
Hello there, stranger. Can I help you?\r\n#L0##bTell me everything you know about the Black Mage. Quickly!#l\n#k
The Black Mage? Isn't he that old villain who was defeated by the 5 heroes centuries ago?\r\n#L0##bCenturies? It cannot be! But what of my hometown, Aurora?#l\n#k
Aurora? Never heard of it.\r\n#L0##bHm. There were only two people left there when I departed. I'm sure they're long gone.#l\n#k
What are you going on about? You're kind of weird, you know that?
Get out of here. You're giving me the creeps.
Good riddance. You were giving me the creeps.
I said go! Get out of here!\r\n#L0##bNot so fast. I have more questions for you!#l\n#k
Get out of here, or I'll...scream! I mean it!\r\n#L0##bBe my guest.#l\n#k
P-please, no! I'll tell you anything!\r\n#L0##bIs there anyone in this pathetic excuse for a town who knows about magic?#l\n#k
Th-that's all you want? Go to the Ellinia #bMagic Library#k. Grendel the Really Old knows everything there is to know about magic!
Th-that's all you wanted, right? You'll let me go now?
That's all I know. I swear! The Magic Library is the place you're looking for!
Wh-what did you do to me?\r\n#L0##bUgh... I apologize. I did not mean to...mean to... FEAR ME, MORTAL!#l\n#k
What brought you here?
Hello! I'm Lolo. Is there a book you're looking for?\r\n#L0##bWhere is Grendel, whelp?#l\n#k
Sorry? You just missed him.\r\n#L0##bWhen will he return?#l\n#k
He didn't say. If you'd like, I can pass on a message for you.\r\n#L0##bI've no time for your foolishness. I'll search the library myself!#l\n#k
Uh, that's not allowed. Let me help you, at least.
I don't know what you're looking for, but I'm sure I can find it for you.
While Grendel's gone, I'm in charge of the library. Listen to me!
Y-yes?\r\n#L0##bYou don't intend to stand in my way, I assume.#l\n#k
Me? H-hiding something? N-no! In fact, here. Take a look at this!\r\n#L0##bThis scroll bears the Aurora emblem... You're more useful than I thought.#l\n#k
That's all you wanted, right? Gosh, Grendel will kill me when he sees this mess...
I h-haven't found anything yet. Please, just give me more time!
I-I'm sorry! I'll do whatever you want!\r\n#L0##bPlease, don't be alarmed. I did not mean it. It's the darkness inside of me, attempting to come out.#l\n#k
Scrolls like this were used to determine who was worthy of entering Aurora. If I want to get to the sanctum of Harmony, I'll need to figure this scroll out.
Even if I don't regain my Light powers, I'll be able to enter Harmony... Wait! This scroll is incomplete!
But for now, I need to vent some of my rage...
I don't care for the way those #bEvil Eyes#k look at me. I'll just slay 40 of them or so.
Perhaps I will simply bottle up my anger forever. This seems like a good plan.

Unbelievable! Have I so little control of my Dark powers? Am I such a grave danger to those around me? I don't even have the power to bring the child back from where I sent him! For now, I must reach Harmony, where I will be alone. I'm a danger to everyone around me...
Ah, that feels better.
Now to return to the Magic Library for some more research on Aurora.
That's close enough. I do hope you aren't here to cause trouble.\r\n#L0##bOut of my way, old fool. I have business here.#l\n#k
What did you call me?\r\n#L0##bHas age robbed you of your hearing as well as your senses?#l\n#k
The things I have to deal with in my old age... Give me just a moment.
All right. Here we go...
Then leave. You're not ready to face the likes of me.

So much for doing this the nice way. A pity. I'd hoped to study your Dark aura more closely.\r\n#L0##bYou can sense my darkness? Perhaps you can help! I lost control and sent your student to...another place. For his sake, stay your hand!#l\n#k

You think you're the first mage to ever dabble in Dark magic? Little matter. Let's channel some of that power of yours into something good, shall we?\r\n#L0##bVery well. But take care you do not forget your end of the agreement!#l\n#k
Of course. Now, what are you researching, exactly?\r\n#L0##bI wish to learn more about Dark magic and Aurora.#l\n#k
Very well. I've got a list of monsters I want you to hunt. I'll search the library while you're gone.
Begin by hunting 50 Curse Eyes. It shouldn't be a problem.
If you don't like the deal, you're free to go. But if you harm anyone in town...
Let me guess. After you sent him away, you realized you couldn't bring him back. Is that right?\r\n#L0##b...How did you know?#l\n#k
Just concentrate on holding up your end of the bargain.
The darkness within howls... Is it because I've been given such petty tasks?
Now I must slay Cold Eyes.
I can defeat 50 of them easily.
Do I really have time to waste?
Some training may be just what I need to rein in my darkness.
I'm halfway done. Now I hunt the Surgeon Eyes.
I must slay 50 of them, as well.
Do I really have time to waste?
If Grendel is leading me on, I'll turn him inside out! ...No, I must calm myself. I must finish his errand.
Now I hunt Lupins. The man has me fighting monkeys.
All I need do is hunt 50, then I'm free to return to #bGrendel#k and demand he uphold his end of the bargain.
Do I really have time to waste?
You haven't fulfilled your end of the bargain. Go hunt some more Lupins.
That was quick.\r\n#L0##bTell me what you discovered, quickly! The darkness threatens to take hold of me again.#l\n#k
You can't rush a good thing! I've searched the library up and down while you were gone.
Of course it isn't. Anyway, you got back faster than I expected, so I wasn't quite done...\r\n#L0##bDon't try my patience, old man! I did as you asked!#l\n#k
I'm only speaking the truth. Ah, and I did manage to find this.\r\n#L0##bThis scroll is from Aurora! But did you find anything about darkness?#l\n#k
Hold your horses! Take a look at the scroll, first.
I'm not sure if it's what you're looking for, but...
You did all that for me, and you don't even want your reward? Perhaps you're not so bad, after all.
You got back faster than I expected, so I wasn't quite done...\r\n#L0##bDon't try my patience, old man! My darkness could strike you down at any time!#l\n#k
If the scroll is what you're looking for, that means you're ready to leave, correct?\r\n#L0##bNot quite. This scroll is gibberish. What are these paradoxes?#l\n#k
Already solved.\r\n#L0##bAm I supposed to be impressed?#l\n#k
All you have to do is hold on for a moment.
Has the Dark eroded your sense of patience?

Let's see. Cold flame, dry moisture... I do love a good riddle.\r\n#L0##bI haven't the time or energy to solve a riddle. You will have to guide me through it... Should I lose control again, do not hesitate to put me down.#l\n#k
This little baby is called a Vampiric Lantern. It sucks up light--any kind of light--and stores it for later.\r\n#L0##bWhat of it?#l\n#k
Take this and hunt #b50 Flaming Mixed Golems#k at Golem's Temple 3rd floor. The cold flame is referring to those golems, I'm sure of it.
#bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport to the Flaming Mixed Golems. Double-click on it to return when you're done.
If you don't believe me, then leave!

First you must promise to leave Ellinia when we're done here. I don't think this place can deal with you at your current condition.\r\n#L0##bTrust me, I have no intention of staying in this backwoods town.#l\n#k
That should be enough.
Don't just hang around here. You have golems to hunt, and the less time you spend in my library the better!

Muddy Sprout Monsters like to suck in the moisture and bask in the sunlight. The second riddle is probably talking about these monsters. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to reach the Deep Mire and hunt them down.
Hunt down #b50#k of them.
I hope you aren't planning any more trouble...
Hm. Perhaps you do have what it takes to control the Dark.
If you can't even face a little humidity, how do you hope to control your darkness?
So, what do you think dark light is?\r\n#L0##bI'm in no mood for guessing games. Just tell me.#l\n#k

Light and Dark are two sides of the same coin. They can't exist together, yet they do. I think you'll come to understand this later.\r\n#L0##bDo you have the answer, or do you intend to keep me here with your babbling all day?#l\n#k
My words are wasted on you. The dark light you're looking for is hidden within the shells of the Torties at Florina Beach.\r\n#L0##bAh, a straight answer. Was that so hard?#l\n#k
Yes. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k and hunt #b50 Torties#k at the Warm Sand.
Remember to #dDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to return.
I hope you aren't planning any more trouble...
Just one paradox to go. Let's get this over with.
Torties have hard shells, but you should be strong enough to crack them.
The bright darkness must refer to those who once had a bright light within them, but were corrupted by the darkness. Sound familiar?\r\n#L0##bWhy do you look at me like that?#l\n#k
It's nothing. There are witches who live east of Ellinia. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport to the Forest of Evil Energy 1 and defeat the Maladies.
You have to hunt #b50 monsters#k again. You know how to return, right?
This is the last task, remember?
And that's your last paradox. I believe our business is done.
I can't tell you how happy I am to see you go!
Maladies have the power to fly. They won't be so easy to catch.
What is it now? I've helped you enough!"\r\n#L0##bCalm yourself, old man. All I need is a secluded place to do my ritual. Preferably someplace with an ample supply of magical energy.#l\n#k

Hm. I know just the place. The Black Wings used to hold their meetings there; seems like a good fit for someone like you. Head to the #beast end of the Golem Temple Entrance#k and take the portal. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport nearby.
Heed my words. The power of darkness is much more dangerous than you think. Learn to control it before the worst happens.
Do whatever you want. Just LEAVE!

Now get out of my town! But I want you to come back when you are able fully control both light and darkness. Didn't you acquire everything you needed?\r\n#L0##bDon't be so hasty. There's one more thing I need.#l\n#k
Time to begin the ritual...
This place will suit my needs.
I haven't felt darkness in centuries... Who goes there?\r\n#L0##bThis voice... Is that you, Vieren?#l\n#k
Is this where the first Augury lies?
Why does this crowd gather so far from the castle? They look too well armed to be commoners.
Perhaps that person up ahead has an answer for me.
I shouldn't be so hasty. Perhaps I should make sure my hair is in order first? Where did I put my mirror...
Once my business in the Mushking Empire is done, I'll return to the sanctum.
Luminous! How'd it go? Did you find the Augury?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. It was hidden in the royal seal.#l\n#k
In the royal seal, eh? What a crafty hiding place.
The second Augury was inside the Spirit of Rock.
The Augury is a force of Light, but it was still able to manifest such darkness. I still have much to learn...
I must never allow my own powers to be twisted like this. Light is a double-edged sword, indeed.
It's time I return to the sanctum. I'll use the Aurora Prism as soon as I'm done here.
I have no further business here.
What happened?\r\n#L0##bThe Augury's Light twisted to become a force for evil.#l\n#k
A darn shame, that. If Aurora weren't a ghost town, we could've stopped it from happening. Good thing you were there to put an end to it.
That's half the Auguries collected. Three more to go!
They'll see. I'll be a great warrior, and... Huh? Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI seek someone who is undergoing a warrior's training.#l\n#k
The path of the warrior isn't for everyone. I'm the one you're looking for!\r\n#L0##bHmm... Perhaps. I seek a warrior who has a magical family heirloom.#l\n#k
Yeah, my family has one of those. At least, that's what my brother says.\r\n#L0##bI would see it.#l\n#k
I can't just show it to any old stranger! But maybe if you do me a favor, I could help you out.
You just have to help me with my training a little.
Then I can't help you. Now, I better get back to training...
Thanks. Now I can be a great warrior, just like my brother!
This letter's for my brother in Perion. Thank you!
Help me out!
Hm?! I didn't sense you coming... Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI bear correspondence from your younger brother.#l\n#k
Ilji sent you? I wonder if something's wrong in Sleepywood... Let me see.
Is this some kind of joke? I warn you, I have no sense of humor.
So you want to see the family heirloom? Why?\r\n#L0##bMy old master entrusted your family with the heirloom long ago.#l\n#k
I see. We've held onto this for generations, waiting for the day a stranger would come looking for it. Tell me, who are you with?\r\n#L0##bAurora. Is that the name you wanted to hear?#l\n#k
All right. The heirloom is yours.
Take good care of it. I'll be taking my leave now.
That family kept a promise through the centuries. Admirable. It's time I return to Vieren.
That didn't take you nearly as long as I expected.\r\n#L0##bFortunately, the warrior who had this had a strong sense of family values.#l\n#k
I suppose he'd have to. Our old teacher left the Augury with them for a reason.
Anyhoo, we'd better get cracking on the fourth Augury.

And what do YOU want? You aren't just another human here to take and take and take and not even say thank you, right? RIGHT?!\r\n#L0##bI've merely come to claim something that is mine by right. Are you familiar with the Aurora Augury?#l\n#k
That pretty crystal? Yeah, I've been holding onto it. It's yours?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. May I have it?#l\n#k
Of course! You're welcome to it...
...just as soon as you run some errands for me!
Not so fast! Hear me out first!
A bunch of monsters have been clogging up the Sky Road, and I absolutely HATE traffic. You just need to kick them out for me.
Beat up #b50 Jr. Grupins, 50 Jr. Cellions, and 50 Jr. Lioners#k at the Road to Garden. Easy, right?
Hmph! Fine, then! I'll just hold onto your little crystal.
Those monsters won't eliminate themselves, after all.
Are you going to beat up the monsters, or aren't you?
Great! I've got your crystal for you...just as soon as you get rid of the Luster Pixies at Cloud Park. Those stupid Pixies made fun of me last time I went to play there!
Great! Wipe out #b100#k of 'em!
I'm not asking for too much, am I?
Ah, I feel so much better. Thanks.
Are you going to beat up the monsters, or aren't you?
While you're at it, could you go beat up #b50 Grupins, 50 Cellions, and 50 Lioners#k at the Garden of Light?
They aren't like the Jr. monsters you fought earlier. Be careful!
You're just like all the other humans. So ungrateful!
You're pretty nice. I'd say you earned the Augury.
Are you going to beat up the monsters, or aren't you?
Just as soon as you beat #b100 Lucidas#k at the Stairway to the Sky!
Great! It's only fair you fight all these monsters, since I'm doing you a BIG favor.
You're really rude. Anyone ever tell you that?
Okay, now I want you to... Fine, you've done enough. Here's your Augury.
Are you going to beat up the monsters, or aren't you?
Now for the fifth Augury. Vieren will know its whereabouts.
You were gone a long time. Couldn't you find Kriel?\r\n#L0##bFinding her was no difficulty. Her requests, on the other hand...#l\n#k
Either way, you got the Augury. Good job.
The Augury has fallen into terrible hands... They must be using its power for evil!
Huh? Who's that? I'm too busy for guests!\r\n#L0##bI shan't take much of your time. Have you heard of the Auguries?#l\n#k
Auguries? Huh. Yeah, I heard about 'em when I was younger. Why don't you ask the elder about it?
That's all I know. Sorry.
If that's all, get out of here. I've got too much on my mind...
What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bI'm told you may know of the Auguries.#l\n#k
I may know a thing or two. You'll have to excuse the chief--he's got a lot on his plate. As for the Augury, the previous elder passed it down to me.\r\n#L0##bI've come to collect it.#l\n#k
About that... I don't have it.\r\n#L0##bWhat? Where might I find it?#l\n#k
Xerxes has it now. You could ask him, but he's not exactly listening to reason these days.
Elder Titan is to the left.
I hear you took care of Xerxes. Sorry you had to go through all that.\r\n#L0##bNay, it is I who should apologize. Xerxes's state of mind is due to the Augury.#l\n#k
Don't trouble yourself over it. None of this would have happened if I wasn't careless. I'm glad you got your item, at least.
Once my business in Chryse is complete, I should return to Vieren.
What's eating you, Luminous?\r\n#L0##bThe Augury caused much trouble for the people of Chryse. Is this not our responsibility, as the last remnants of Aurora?#l\n#k

It's a real shame, but you can't take all the blame yourself. Any great power can be used for evil. We should just be happy the Auguries didn't cause more trouble.\r\n#L0##bYou speak true. We must collect the final Augury!#l\n#k
That's the spirit. Just one Augury to go!
The final Augury is in a storybook. No wonder Vieren couldn't find it!
...But if it's in the Korean Folk Town, then...\r\n#L0##bExcuse me, good librarian! Do you know the meaning of this phrase: The 8th story holds the final light?#l\n#k
...A stranger with a random question? Wait. This could be the answer I'm looking for!
Never fear, Wiz--Wait, where are you going?
Never fear, Wiz the Librarian is here! The light you're looking for must be in the legendary eighth storybook!\r\n#L0##bTell me more of this eighth storybook.#l\n#k
I've never seen it myself, of course. Legend has it that the eighth storybook is a magical tome of light, filled with the original versions of all the stories in the world!

Wait, my librarian senses are tingling. Yes, the book MUST be somewhere in the Korean Folk Town! The Dimensionial Crack must have mixed it in with all the other storybooks there.\r\n#L0##bExplain.#l\n#k

Don't you see? If the eighth storybook contains all stories, then all stories contain the eighth storybook!\r\n#L0##bI shall put my faith in your librariomancy for now. How can I find the storybook?#l\n#k

The animals around the story distortion are probably the most affected. If you hunt them, you might find some clue about the eighth storybook. Bring me, say, #b50 Pounders#k from the Moon Bunnies and we'll see what we can find.
Think of all the good we could do if we found the eighth storybook!
Would you have me leave my secret hideout? No, I must stay here and remain vigilant!
Excellent, excellent. I'll take these Pounders to my secret laboratory right away.
You'll find the Moon Bunnies near the Entrance to Black Mountain. Don't worry, they're vile villains worthy of a good pounding!
While I study these Pounders, would you fight the Hodoris and collect some Tiger Stamps from them?
I'll need about #b50#k stamps.
No? But we're so close!
The Pounders have shown me so much...\r\n#L0##bWhat have you learned?#l\n#k
That would be a spoiler! Besides, I still need to examine these new clues you've brought me.
Hodoris aren't your average kitty cats. Be careful!
Yes, if I crossreference these Tiger Stamps with those Pounders, then...\r\n#L0##bHave you located the eighth storybook?#l\n#k
Not yet, but soon. I am the world's greatest detective-librarian, after all. Now I just need some Tiger Skins from the Hoguls.
I only need #b50#k.
Very well. I shall fight the Hoguls myself! *Gulp!*
How goes the good fight? Do you have the Tiger Skins?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. On this day, I have skinned many tigers in the name of literacy.#l\n#k
That ought to teach those tigers to read more! Now, let's see here...
See, I can trace which story each of these creatures comes from... Great Scott, they're all from fables!
Hoguls are a superstitious cowardly lot. I trust you'll make quick work of them.

The stories of the Korean Folk Town are being twisted and warped. If we can right things, even for a moment, the eighth storybook will reveal itself!\r\n#L0##bI will untwist every story myself, if I must!#l\n#k
That's the spirit! In that case, exorcise #b50 Samihos and 50 Blins#k!
These monsters are creepier than your average villain. Take care!
Don't you see? This is the only way!
There you are. I knew you were on your way.\r\n#L0##bHow?#l\n#k
I was meditating on my crime-fighting techniques, and the eighth storybook appeared before me in a flash of light!\r\n#L0##bI must see it!#l\n#k
You've earned it, fellow hero.\r\n#L0##bThe final Augury, at long last!#l\n#k
I never imagined the eighth storybook would be a crystal. See that light? It's shining for truth and justice for all!
Take this light and do good deeds. Fight crime! Save lady reporters! You know, hero stuff!
You won't let a few Samihos and Blins slow you down, will you?
With the final Augury in hand, now is the time to return to Vieren.
Then again, perhaps it can wait.
How'd it go?\r\n#L0##bThe final Augury was hidden within a storybook.#l\n#k
Oh. I thought the clue was a riddle, but I guess it was the literal truth. Well, now that we have all the Auguries, we can do something about all that darkness in you.
Well? How you feeling?\r\n#L0##bIt was a shock, but I feel better.#l\n#k
A shock? That's all? Haw! Don't you realize no one's ever done this before? You're a first!\r\n#L0##bYou expected more than a shock? Is my life so trivial to you?#l\n#k

You may have conquered your darkness, but you still need to lighten up.\r\n#L0##bEnough jest. I seek to understand what happened... The Dark is not gone, but rather under my control. In fact, it seems to be even more a part of me than before.#l\n#k

You aren't wrong. I reckon you've unlocked the power to balance both Light and Dark magic together.\r\n#L0##bMore importantly, I no longer need worry about losing control. I can finally return to Lania...#l\n#k
I don't see why not.
What are the Black Mage's minions doing here? Is Lania safe?!
I must act with haste!
Are you sure you can't stay?\r\n#L0##bI wish I could. But fear not! I shall be watching over you. And I will visit you again soon.#l\n#k
You'd better! It's too empty here without you to keep me company.\r\n#L0##bI'll return as soon as I know how to keep you safe. I'll be as quick as I can! (Vieren might have some ideas.)#l\n#k
I'm okay, really. But if you insist...
Did you change your mind? It's safe after all, right?
Well? Was she happy to see you?\r\n#L0##bI believe so... I hope. More importantly, I encountered the Black Mage's minions in the forest near her home.#l\n#k

Drats! If they're up and about already, the big guy himself won't be far behind.\r\n#L0##bI must track down the Black Mage, but first we have to see to Lania's safety. If the Black Mage realizes that I care for her...#l\n#k
Right, right. Well, I've got a few ideas...
As I recall, Sentrobos are made largely of Toy Trojan Swords.
#b50#k should be enough.
Wait, is that right? Are Sentrobos really made of toy parts?
On to the next material.
Vieren will want all of the materials at once.
The Robos down here run on Cheap Batteries. Those will make a suitable power source.
I will need #b50#k batteries.
Wait, is that right? Are Sentrobos really made of toy parts?
I'm nearly done.
There's one last material I need. The Mechanical Hearts of the Master Robos.
Once again, #b50#k will do.
Wait, is that right? Are Sentrobos really made of toy parts?
That is all I need. I pray Vieren has the energy crystal ready.
Hey, you got the parts... But did you really need to bring me 50 of everything?\r\n#L0##bI wanted to ensure you had enough materials to work with.#l\n#k
All right, all right. Anyway, let me hammer all this junk together...
This will be the best Sentrobo ever!
Trust me, I know what I'm doing! You're always so serious...
Shoo. Go away. I'm no one important.\r\n#L0##bI wish to ally with your organization.#l\n#k
I don't know what you're talking about. I'm just a normal guy. Now get out of here, before they notice us talking!
You really don't take a hint! Fine, you caught me. I'm a secret agent. So, what do you want?\r\n#L0##bI wish to borrow your information network.#l\n#k
Ha, is that all? Why don't I just hand you all our secrets in a briefcase, while I'm at it?\r\n#L0##bIs there no way you will consider an alliance?#l\n#k
Well... All right. Maybe I could make you useful.
You do some things for me, and we'll see what we can work out.
Changed your mind? Then leave me alone!
We're in the middle of a super top-secret war with the alien menace, but we're lacking in manpower. You help us with the aliens, and I'll help you with your information.
Good. First we must fight the Mateons. Bring me #b50 Mateon's Tentacles#k from Boswell Field.
What? Aliens too much for you?
You're just in time. I'm starving!
The Mateons won't de-tentacle themselves.
The Mateons are just the scouts. The REAL threat is the Plateons. They're your next targets.
Bring me #b50 Plateon's Helmets#k.
That's fine. I don't want your help, anyway.
Excellent. R&D will have a field day with these!
Nothing short of 50 Plateon's Helmets will do.
Now we can face the alien menace head-on. The Mecateons have dug their heels deep into Boswell Field. We need to take them out if we're going to hold this planet!
This is it. Bring me #b50 Mecateon's Laser Guns#k, and you'll have your alliance.
Oh, you don't care about the planet? You aren't one of THEM, are you?
All right. You held up your end of the bargain. Just let me contact my superiors...
Better to collect Mecateon's Laser Guns than to be shot by them, don't you think?
The boss gave the okay. You now have access to our intel network.\r\n#L0##bYou have my thanks. With whom should I speak about getting information?#l\n#k
We'll dispatch an agent to act as your contact. Where is a good rendezvous point for you?\r\n#L0##bThere's a forest, not far from Ellinia...#l\n#k
Yeah, I know the place. That won't be a problem. We'll send #bAgent O#k to go undercover as a merchant and keep an eye on things there.
Agent O should be in place now. Go see for yourself.
You have a problem with Agent O?
Even with Agent O's watchful eye, I worry for Lania's safety.
Perhaps Vieren has more guidance to offer.
There must be something more I can do.
Do I worry too much?
How'd it go with the secret agents?\r\n#L0##bWe've come to an agreement.#l\n#k
Great. TheBlack Mage won't be getting the jump on us now!\r\n#L0##bPerhaps, but I fear we have not yet fully secured Lania's safety.#l\n#k
Always the worrywart. Okay, what else can we do...?
How can I help you, citizen?\r\n#L0##bGreetings. I'm looking for the crystal mine.#l\n#k
Verne Mine? The Road to the Mine is just past Edelstein Strolling Path. The Black Wings have closed the entrance to the mine, though.\r\n#L0##bBlack Wings?#l\n#k
You aren't from around here, are you? Here, take this hat. If you show it to Bunny Large at the Mine Entrance, he'll think you're a Black Wing and let you through.
The Edelstein #bpolice#k might be able to help you.
Halt! The Black Wings are using this mine. No outsiders allowed!\r\n#L0##bI am no outsider! Do you not recognize my Black Wings hat?#l\n#k
Oh boy, you talk fancy! You must be one of the higher ups! What brings you here today, boss?\r\n#L0##bI seek crystals from the mine.#l\n#k
Then you should talk to Cory. Bet he can help you.
Oh, and boss? Don't forget to actually put your hat on your head next time. Doesn't do much good, hanging out in your inventory like.
Honest, I don't know anything. Cory's your man.
What do YOU want? I'm a little busy!\r\n#L0##bI require crystals from the mine.#l\n#k
Crystals? You doing an experiment, too? Hold on a second.
Cory's probably in the First Square of the mine.
Okay. So what do you need, exactly?\r\n#L0##bAs I said, I require crystals from the mine.#l\n#k
You don't say. I can help you out in that regard...in exchange for #b50 Big Spider Tentacles#k.
Big Spiders usually hang out in the Shaft. Happy hunting!
Good luck finding crystals on your own, chump!
About time! You're holding up my experiments, taking so long. Hand 'em over.
Chop chop! I need those Big Spider Tentacles pronto!
Great. I need something fluffy to act as a reagent to these tentacles. Get me #b50 Racaroni Tails#k.
Hurry up. My experiment's very time sensitive.
I guess you don't want those crystals, after all.
Hand them over, hand them over!
Get me those Racaroni Tails, before my experimental mixture loses its fizziness!
Right. Crystals. You'll want to head to the Ore Trail for those.\r\n#L0##bOre Trail?#l\n#k
That's what I said. Hunt down some Big Boulder Munchers and take their Crystal Fragments. As for putting the crystals back together again... That's your problem!
Crystal Fragments look just like Ore Fragments, so keep your eyes peeled.
I don't care what you do. I've got experiments to run!
Perhaps this is enough.
I hope Vieren knows how to process these fragments.
Yet these fragments glitter with such beauty. There's no harm in holding onto them, is there?
Howdy. I'm Grant, the elder of Ardentmill. What can I do you for?\r\n#L0##bI seek he who can craft a Lambent Crystal.#l\n#k
A Lambent Crystal, eh? I haven't heard that name since I was first starting out as a craftsman. Speak to Intaglio at the bottom of town. He's your man.
Intaglio is probably the only man in Maple World who can craft that crystal.
Hello, gorgeous! Don't you have the most divine eyes I've ever seen!\r\n#L0##bI understand you can craft a Lambent Crystal.#l\n#k
A Lambent Crystal...?
Head to the bottom of Ardentmill and go right. Intaglio's the fella standing by the big jewel.
Wherever did you hear that name? Wait, more importantly...you want me to CRAFT it?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. I have need of one.#l\n#k
You have need of it. How darling. What would you even use it for?\r\n#L0##bI will use it to protect my loved one.#l\n#k
Oh... Oh! What a SWEETHEART! For you, darling, I will do this. You have the materials?
Hold onto the seat of your pants! This is really going to be something!
You DON'T? Well, you'd better go get them, you silly goose!
Here we go! Tres magnifique, no?\r\n#L0##bYou have my thanks.#l\n#k
Now go protect your loved one, you big softy!
Vieren will be ready by now. I'd best return.
Yet this glitters with such beauty. There's no harm in holding onto it, is there?
Barrier's almost ready! You get the thing?\r\n#L0##bI present you with this Lambent Crystal.#l\n#k
Great! One Lambent Crystal, a pinch of cinnamon, and... Ta-da!
What's going on? A weird robot and a stranger showed up at my place. The robot keeps hiccuping and the man tried to sell me some kind of weird bean sundae!\r\n#L0##bI sent them.#l\n#k
You did? How come?\r\n#L0##bI'm about to undertake a dangerous task. My enemies may go after my loved ones...after you. I must do everything in my power to keep you safe.#l\n#k
Well, okay. But you should have told me first!
Don't you dare ditch me again!
Hey. I'm Agent N. I may look just like Agent M, but we have nothing in common! Got it?\r\n#L0##bUnderstood. If that is all, I've business to attend to. It was a pleasure to meet you.#l\n#k

Hey! Hey hey hey! I'm not done talking here! I've got some intel for you. It turns out most of the monsters in Maple World are under the Black Mage's influence!\r\n#L0##bHis reach has grown further than I thought.#l\n#k
This may be even worse than the alien invasion. But the Black Mage is your deal, right? Maybe you can find Traces of the Black Mage if you hunt monsters.
If we can get 100 Traces of the Black Mage, our lab can do some hardcore analysis. Just hunt ordinary monsters around your level.
HEY! I'm trying to help, here!
Can you find more Traces of the Black Mage? The lab needs them, and fast!\r\n#L0##bUnderstood. The traces will be yours.#l\n#k
Thank you.
You aren't even the least bit curious about the Black Mage?
Hey. I get that you're busy, but you're going to want to hear this.\r\n#L0##bWhat news do you bring?#l\n#k
Have you ever heard of the Silent Crusade?\r\n#L0##bA crusade that is silent? Explain.#l\n#k

It looks like they're a secret organization that hunts down monsters. We don't know the exact details, but it sounds like they only go after the Black Mage's personal pets.\r\n#L0##bThen they are friends as far as I am concerned.#l\n#k

Ah, Kaiser. I have an important announcement, so listen carefully. As you already know, Magnus's army was decimated in the battle at Pantheon. Based on this, the Heliseum Council has decided to advance on Tyrant's Castle at our capital of Heliseum. This is our big chance to retake our capital, and we have a specific task for you in this.
Good. If you indeed call yourself Kaiser, you must act the part. Your task will be to gather allies to aid us. While Magnus may be a conquerable foe, Darmoor may very well not be.

We have decided to look far and wide for new allies, and you will be traveling farther than anyone before. You know about the Interdimensional Portal at Pantheon, yes? This is one of the doorways to other worlds left when Darmoor sealed Chronica, the Transcendent of Time. We sealed the portal then, as we did not know where it led.

But now, we think the risk is worth taking. We have decided to send you through the portal to find new allies. However, it cannot be denied that you are far weaker than the previous Kaiser. We expect you to hone your skills as you explore the new world we send you to.

You and the Angelic Buster will take the portal and proceed with the mission. However, we must break the seal first. I have already ordered #p3000001# to work on this. You are to go see #p3000001# immediately.
You call yourself Kaiser, and yet you refuse to serve Nova? Disgraceful.
Kaiser. I have heard of your mission from the Council. You will be departing with the Angelic Buster?
You are hear to break the seal on the portal, but such things must not be rushed. Do not let the war-hungry Council push you into action.
Do not waste our time! Go see #p3000001# immediately.

I am preparing the catalysts to break that seal and reactivate the portal. Let me finish up, and we'll talk about what you need to do.
#p3000003# is at Pantheon Interior.

Great. In order to break the seal, we need to remove the magic power that was put into it. For that, we need lots of #t4033346#. We don't keep Anti-Magic Stones at the temple, so go to #m400030400# to defeat #o2400013# monsters and bring back 50 #t4033346# items.
Hmm. I thought you came here to help me.

Excellent! We're almost ready to break the seal. Now, we only have to reactivate the Interdimensional Portal.
We still do not have enough Anti-Magic Stones. Go to #m400030400# to defeat #o2400013# monsters and bring back 50 #t4033346# items.
Oh, come on. We're so close! Help me out.

Now, to reactivate the Interdimensional Portal, we need lots of Magic Stones. However, we used up all of our Magic Stones during the last battle to create the Magic Amplifier. Defeat #o2400014# at #m400010400# and bring back 50 #t4033345# items.
If you're busy, finish up and come back. I want to get this done!

That should be all I need from you. Prepare for your trip while I make ready to open the portal.

Kaiser... Before you enter the Interdimensional Portal, I want to tell you something.

It is true that the decision of the Council is more than what we can handle. However, all the people of Nova want to free Tyrant's Castle and retake Heliseum. Our hope lies with you. If you can find the Transcendent and use their power, we may have a chance.
And...let me give you one additional mission. Bring any unique materials that you find from that world to #p3000003#. It will help us to understand that world.

All right, then. Please come see me after you are done with your tasks.
Everything is ready. Let's go!
This is going to be awesome...I hope.

I should warm up on those #o6230100# things. They're pretty weak, so 50 is a nice, round number to shoot for. I think those #o6230100# things are at #m105030100#, #m105030101#, and #m105030102#.

Those #o7130100# monsters are a little stronger than the #o6230100# things, but I can still take 50 or so down. I think #o7130100# critters appear at #m105030200#, #m105030300#, and #m105030400#.

Ugh, this thing is pumping out raw evil. I think I'm going to be sick. What do I do with this...?

Well, it's definitely different from the Specters. I'm sure it didn't come from Darmoor, so we're good there. Thanks for bringing this by.

I heard a being called #o6160003# in Chryse possesses a special necklace with unique powers. I should get that to boost my own awesome powers.

Greetings, mystic adventurer. I am #p1101002#, the strategist of the Cygnus Knights. I have some important matters to discuss with you. Shall we?\r\n#L0##bCygnus Knights? I heard you guys used to rule this world back in the day. I'm Kaiser. What's on your mind?#l\n#k
I've heard of your exploits, and I believe you are the right person to help Maple World face our troubles. Would you be willing to come to #m130000000#?
Superb. I will be waiting for you.
Very well. Until next time.
Welcome to Ereve. I'm glad you could make it.\r\n#L0##bYeah...what's with all the knights? Is this a trap? I don't like traps.#l\n#k

Oh, goodness, not at all. Hah. Please excuse us...we take our security very seriously, but you have nothing to fear.\r\n#L0##bHm...you guys don't feel evil. Fair enough. So, what did you want to talk about?#l\n#k

As you know, we are the Cygnus Knights. Our organization opposes the ultimate evil of Maple World, the Black Mage. Recently, the forces of the Black Mage have grown greatly, inspiring us to form a world-wide alliance.\r\n#L0##bBlack Mage...?#l\n#k
We've asked you here to invite you to join our alliance. You are clearly powerful, and appear to be a champion of justice.\r\n#L0##bAn alliance? Hmmm...#l\n#k

Is this a difficult decision for you?\r\n#L0##bWell, I've never heard of this Black Mage guy. Also, I represent Nova here on Maple World, so I need to really think about things like this before I decide.#l\n#k
Indeed. In that case, I apologize for rushing you, and encourage you to consider our proposition. We both have much to gain.
Just a moment. It seems #p1101001# has something to tell you.
Eh? You...look like Magnus. What are you doing here?\r\n#L0##bMagnus? Magnus! Who are you? How do you know Magnus? Speak!#l\n#k

Relax, relax. I thought you had some ties to Magnus. He was a commander under the Black Mage long, long ago. It's quite strange, how much you look like him...\r\n#L0##bMagnus was here?! Hmmm...with the portals between Grandis and Maple World, I suppose it's possible...#l\n#k

I don't know much about Magnus, but I recall him being terribly arrogant...he cared only about his power, and smashing his foes. He vanished after the Black Mage was sealed.\r\n#L0##bWhen was the Black Mage sealed?#l\n#k
It was a few centuries ago. I don't know exactly when.\r\n#L0##bHuh... We still don't know much about Magnus, and he only took Heliseum a few decades ago...the timeline doesn't fit.#l\n#k

You keep talking about Magnus...how do you know him?\r\n#L0##bOh, right. My name is Kaiser. I am a warrior of Nova, from the world of Grandis. Magnus was an exiled warrior of Nova, but he returned to conquer our capital. He is the great disgrace of our race, and my eternal enemy.#l\n#k
Ohh...so, you're not from around here. \r\n#L0##bIt looks like the Cygnus Knights and Nova have a mutual enemy in Magnus. He served your Black Mage, just as he does our Darmoor...#l\n#k
Darmoor?\r\n#L0##bHe is one of the Transcendents ruling over Grandis. As the Transcendent of Life, he's trying to seize control of all life on Grandis. Nova fights endlessly against him.#l\n#k

The situation on Grandis sounds dire indeed. We could help you, if you wish.\r\n#L0##bOh, that's good to hear! I need to take your offer to the Council, but I'm sure they'll be interested. I'll return soon with our response.#l\n#k
Then, I will be looking forward to it.
Do you need anything else?
Welcome, Kaiser. How has your journey been?\r\n#L0##bOh man, where should I start? When I first arrived...#l\n#k

Interesting. So, these Cygnus Knights wish to ally with us. But are they trustworthy? And, more importantly, are they powerful?\r\n#L0##bI'm not sure about their power, but I think they can be trusted. They have a good aura.#l\n#k
That's not enough for us. You didn't find any Transcendents?\r\n#L0##bEr, no.#l\n#k

Blast. I am certain there is a Transcendent on this Maple World. Still, we can use any help we can get...\r\n#L0##bWell, I DID hear about a Transcendent...one like Darmoor. The people of Maple World are fighting their Transcendent, the Black Mage. If we ally with them, they'll need our help in return.#l\n#k

What? This is unexpected. I had hoped to ally with a Transcendent, but not one that has fallen to evil. Kaiser, what is your assessment of the situation?\r\n#L0##bWe can't join with anyone as bad as Darmoor. I think the Cygnus Knights would make great allies. I like them.#l\n#k

We had hoped to launch our attack on Tyrant's Castle as soon as possible, which means we need reinforcements quickly. This might just be the break we need. Good work, Kaiser. I'll gather the Council, and we'll have a response ready for you to take back soon.
You didn't leave for Grandis yet? Did you mention your hometown before? Was it #m400000000#?
Kaiser. The Council has reached a decision.
We have agreed to ally with the Cygnus Knights, despite the dangers of going to war with two Transcendents. Please inform the Cygnus Knights of our decision.
Wait, don't you want to hear the decision?
Welcome. I trust you have brought good news?
Excellent. This is a golden opportunity for both of our worlds. I will inform the Alliance and begin formalizing the arrangement. Thank you for your part in this, Kaiser.
Didn't you need to talk to #m130000000#? Oh, was it #p1101002#? Well, let them know what we've decided.
Aliens appeared in #m221000000#. #p3000003# might like it if you take their mystical item to him.
According to rumor, the alien #o4230119# appears at #m221030100# in #m221000000#. I should beat them up and take their mystic stuff.
If it is an alien, it might be dangerous. I should go a little later.
This item has a very unique shape. Surely it is a remnant of another civilization.
Thisi is hard to analyze. But I will keep it for now.
You must be very exhausted.
#m260000000# is a scorching desert. However, there's a tale that the lizards there wear scarves. Why would that be? Obtain it and take it to #p3000003#.
#o2100107# appears at #m260010500#. Defeat them and obtain their #t04033380#. Then, take it to #p3000003# at #m400000001#.
I need to prepare myself for a desert romp first.

Were you able to get anything?
You haven't studied the oceans of Maple World yet. Defeat an aquatic creature near #m230000000# and obtain a sample.
What should I do to go underwater? Do I need some kind of tool? I need to figure this out.

Now we have plenty of samples. After we form our alliance with Maple World, I can exchange data with their scholars directly, so you won't have to gather samples anymore.
Would you like to take a break?
Kaiser... I know you are busy, but I have something to say.\r\n#L0##bWhat's the matter?#l\n#k

The Black Mage Laboratory has been discovered at #m261000000#. The investigation team has already completed their sweep, and found something you might be interested in. Would you like to hear about it?
There were many interesting documents. We sent a copy on to Nova, but I wanted to show you this myself.
Later, then?
This is it...information about the Transcendents.
Let's go through this.

Eh, I'll do it later.
If I organize this better, maybe it will make more sense. Where are my scissors?

Oh, here we go. So, the Black Mage cut off a part of him that was imbued with light, and embraced his darkness. This put him at odds with...Rhinne and the World Tree? Hmmm...these must be the Transcendents of Maple World.
It says Rhinne is the goddess in charge of time, and the World Tree is Maple World's origin of life. Hey, according to this, the Black Mage doesn't know the location or identity of the World Tree.
With the Black Mage's enhanced power of darkness, he then went after the power of time. Huh...just like Darmoor, he's taken on two powers at once.
Darmoor took over Chronica's power after sealing her, and the Black Mage took over Rhinne's power after sealing her. Hmmm...
There should be something about a Transcendent using 2 different powers.
Anyways, I think I know enough about the Transcendents of Maple World. It's giving me a headache.
Tell #p3000001# about the Transcendents.
#p3000001# might already know about all this, but we should probably talk it over before my brain pops. #p3000001# is at #m400000001#. Off I go!
I think I need to organize this a little more.
Greetings, Kaiser.\r\n#L0##bHey, did you get that huge document on the Transcendents from Maple World?#l\n#k
Yes. The big takeaway was how something strange seems to happen when Transcendents use each others' powers.\r\n#L0##bYeah. Stealing the Transcendent of Time's power seems to be the big one.#l\n#k

When Darmoor confined Chronica and used Chronica's power, the Interdimensional Portals began appearing all across Grandis. One of those also appeared here at #m400000001#. And Magnus disappeared from Maple World when the Black Mage took Rhinne's power, right?\r\n#L0##bSo, the Interdimensional Portals appear when other Transcendents uses the power of the Transcendent of Time?#l\n#k

I believe that is the case. Maybe Magnus returned to this place through the Interdimensional Portal created when the Black Mage used Rhinne's power. That might also account for the time gap between him leaving Maple World and arriving here.\r\n#L0##bBut...they didn't find the Interdimensional Portal on Maple World until now.#l\n#k
That must be because that power was sealed along with the Black M...oh. Oh, no.\r\n#L0##bHm? What is it?#l\n#k
If...if the Interdimensional Portal has appeared just now on Maple World...\r\n#L0##b...The seal on the Black Mage has been broken!?#l\n#k
That's the only explanation I have. I don't know how it broke, but you can't explain the portal otherwise. We must let the Alliance know about this.
