You don’t know ME?! I’m #p3000148#, the Great Magician! I also happen to be the boss of the Black Wings! Or, at least, one of the bosses... \r\n#L0##b(Black Wings? Who was talking about that?)#l\n#k
You seem like Black Wings commander material. Especially with those pigtails... \r\n#L0##bMy hair makes me a qualified leader? #l\n#k
You need to join up. I’ll give you my SPECIAL recommendation. \r\n#L0##bEw... can you... give me a minute to think it over? #l\n#k
Okay, but this kind of opportunity doesn’t just wait around, no matter how pretty you are.
Don’t tell me you’re going to reject #p3000148#, the Great Magician!
I’ll give you some time, cutie pie. Just tell me when you’re ready to be join me in Black Wing bliss.
What do you think? You ready to get on the Black Wing train?\r\n#L0##bActually, I just remembered where I heard about the Black Wings, little guy.#l\n#k
L-little guy? Nobody calls me that! I’m not going to take it easy on you, just because you’re pretty!\r\n#L0##b*Thwack!*#l\n#k
O, OWWWWW... W-W-W-Why did you HIT me?\r\n#L0##bI dunno, it was super fun, and you’re a CREEP.#l\n#k
L-leave me alone!\r\n#L0##bToo bad for you, I’m a Nova. And Novas don’t play nice with people that hurt other people. We DO play nice with the Alliance though...#l\n#k
The A, Alliance?! I-I’ll crush you! I’ll defeat you all!\r\n#L0##b*THWACK!*#l\n#k

I'm so sorry! My mother never paid attention to me when I was a child! Can I leave now?!\r\n#L0##bYou can go sniveling back to your cave, you little punk. And tell your stupid bosses they’re about to get an Angelic Buster-sized footprint in their rear ends!#l\n#k
Yes ma’am! May I go now?
Ugh, you will pay for this!
Sooo, what did you think of that super cool emblem I gave you, #h0#.\r\n#L0##bHonestly, I thought it was tacky it at first, but now I think it's great!#l\n#k
Y-you have got to learn some manners. But I’m glad you enjoyed it. So while we’re on the subject of liking things, I have some very strong opinions about Essence Stones. \r\n#L0##bOkay! #l\n#k

Really?! No sassy comeback? No cutting down my male ego? \r\n#L0##bYou’ve been really nice to me Eskie, most of the time. I like doing things for you. That’s how friendships work, even between men and women. #l\n#k
I KNEW that gift was a winner. Go get me a stone from Omega Sector on the double, dragon-slave! There is an alien called #o4230117# there that I would most like to consume.
I am going to eat a rock from space! If only mommy could see her boy now...
Oh, now you’re all against me.
Wow, this Essence Stone looks really delicious. I'll eat it with relish!
Surprisingly piquant! I think I just ate a space worm, though.
Go to the #m221040200# near the Omega Sector and bring me a #t4033442# from one of those #o4230117# alien... things.
#h0#. Hello!\r\n#L0##bHaha, #p3000018#. You must be getting soooo hungry again, huh?#l\n#k
What? I just thought you might want to go to Mu Lung and see the sights! You need a vacation. Annnnd while you’re there... maybe get me a #t4033448#?
Mu Lung is so nice... I hear... I think. I don’t know, I’m sort of making this up.
GO GET ME AN ESSENCE STOOOONE!!
Gonna eat! Gonna eat! Gonna eat!\r\n#L0##b(It’s nice to see old #p3000018# so happy.)#l\n#k
What? Don’t look at me while I eat. I get self-conscious.
Why is everything tasty so fattening? Oh well, chicks dig love-handles, right?
Go find one of those #o4230504# creatures at the #m250010400# near Mu Lung and get me my #t4033448#.
Good day, Angelic Buster. I am #p1101002#, chief tactician of the Cygnus Knights. Your associate Kaiser requested I speak with you. Do you have time?
Kaiser’s information on the Black Mage has been invaluable to our efforts. It is a shame that none of my own troops were able to provide this sort of insight.
Take a look at this. It’s why I came.
I was told your people were very polite...
The Black Mage, Rhinne, and the World Tree... If #p3000001# approved this, it must be true.
But... it’s kinda confusing. Maybe I better ask #p3000018#. He’s super old...
Oh, hello there. Need a little dose of my charm?\r\n#L0##bNo! I need your old-man brain. Read this report.#l\n#k

Ugh, I hate thinking. I enjoy fighting! And smooching! I really enjoy that last one a lot. This better not be about the Overseers and the Transcendents. Those are lessons you were supposed to learn in the third grade! \r\n#L0##bI was busy in the third grade! I played a lot of kickball... #l\n#k

That would explain a lot. Now then, you know the Transcendents watch over Light, Time, and Life, yes?\r\n#L0##bYeah! And the Black Mage, Rhinne, and the World Tree are the Transcendents of Maple World. And the Black Mage is a jerk... kinda like Darmoor back in Grandis! Why’d they let them be in charge?#l\n#k
The Transcendents don’t have to be good. They only have to bring about harmony.\r\n#L0##bWell, that sounds like a pretty stupid system. #l\n#k

Well, I suppose it is, but so is gravity! Stupid gravity keeping me on the ground... Anyway, the Black Mage, the Transcendent of Light, is evil here. Well someday, the light is going to even itself out and he’ll be defeated by somebody who isn’t a colossal jerk.\r\n#L0##bWhy do these Transcendent guys even care what’s going on in the world? They should just butt out!#l\n#k

The Transcendents can live forever, or they can perish, but they have to maintain a balance. When one of the three elements begins to falter, so will the Transcendent that watches over it...\r\n#L0##bIs that why Darmoor awakened as the Transcendent of Life when the High Flora fell?#l\n#k
Who the heck is Darmoor? \r\n#L0##bI thought you knew everything! #l\n#k

Look, babe, I’m all-powerful, but I’m not omnipotent. I only remember what happened before I jumped into this relic.\r\n#L0##bDon’t call me babe, toad-breath. Did you take a look at this report Kaiser made yet?#l\n#k
Yeah, whatever, MADAME #h0#. I’ll look.
My goodness, he knows a lot more words than I thought he would. Give me a moment...
You have to give it to me first. Unless you want to snuggle up in my lap and read it to me...
This is pretty interesting. The Transcendents seem to have a sort of fascination with each others’ powers. \r\n#L0##bLike, a crush on each other?#l\n#k

Noooo, hehehehe. It sounds like both Darmoor and the Black Mage stole the powers of the Transcendents of Time. \r\n#L0##bOh, yeah, that mean old guy in Pantheon told me that the Interdimensional Portals appeared after Darmoor used Chronica’s powers. #l\n#k

It sounds like that’s a common theme. When one Transcendent uses another’s powers, their seem to be a lot of negative side-effects. It could be as simple as a physical backlash, or it could disrupt the space-time continuum... \r\n#L0##bAwww, #p3000018#...#l\n#k
What?\r\n#L0##bYou are totally nerding out on this, huh? #l\n#k

This is important, you little strumpet! Besides, I wouldn’t have to be the smart one if YOU studied a little more. Because, if you did, you’d know that WE need to go borrow the power of either the World Tree or Aeona.\r\n#L0##bWhaaaat?! How are we even gonna find them?! #l\n#k
I don’t know. I remember Aeona was supposed to be around the Sanctum of Light, in my day, but I never saw her. The legend was that she was in a place only light could reach...
By the way, if you if you find any other, bawdier reading materials in your bag, just ignore those. They’re dragon stories for dragons only.
Hey, you want to know how much I value your time and your attention?\r\n#L0##bAre you finally going to pay me a real compliment?#l\n#k
No! I’m going to tell you where you can get TWO Essence Stones at ONE time! The first one is from this #o3110303# in Magatia. How nice is your dragon-lord?
I am going to eat all of the stones.
B-but it’s so efficient! There’s another one in the same area!
Haha, this Essence Stone looks tasty!
Ugh, too much salt on this one...
Go to the #m261010003# near Magatia and get me a #t4033449# from the #o3110303# you find.
Are you ready?? The next monster is the #o5110302#.
Go back to the #m261020500# near Magatia and beat up on the #o5110302# this time. It should drop a #t4033446#.
C’mon! You’re already here!
Hahaha, when I look at you through this Essence Stone, it almost looks like you aren’t wearing... nevermind.
It tingles on the way down!
Go to the #m261010003# near Magatia and get me a #t4033446# from the # o5110302# you find.
Essence Stone!\r\n#L0##bSeriously? You JUST ate one! #l\n#k
It’s not my fault that Maple World is a veritable cornucopia of deliciousness. \r\n#L0##bYou can’t just eat this whole world. #l\n#k
You don’t tell me what to do. You’re going to march your adorable little rear end right over to Herb Town and find yourself one of the #o5120501# monsters.
This one is supposed to encourage clean intestines. Do you want some?
You should not be disobeying me. Ever!
Eeee-hehehe, gimme!
I-It’s like someone took the worst parts of broccoli and mixed them with patching caulk...
I’m also brewing up a little special something for you with the by-products of the Essence Stones I’ve been eating. I know you’re looking forward to what comes out...
Defeat the #o5120501# monsters at the #m251010200# near Herb Town and get me a #t4033444#.
How have you been able to ignore the mighty roars my stomach is making?\r\n#L0##bMaybe if you just saved a little bit of each stone instead of gobbling them all up at once! #l\n#k
Have you seen these muscles? They'll shrivel up without a regular shot of go-juice! \r\n#L0##bWell, I’d hate for you to run out of stupid muscles to flex at me...#l\n#k
Don’t be like that, do you know how hard it is to find these things?
The next monster hangs out on a pirate ship near Herb Town. It’s called the #o6130208#.
Do not make me flex at you until you give up. I WILL DO IT.
I hope this doesn’t give me scurvy...
Yaaar!! It tastes like grog!
It’s getting more and more difficult to track down Essence Stones that will satisfy my gourmand palette.
Defeat the #o6130208# monsters at the #m251010401# to get a #t4033443# for me.
However, there’s a monster called the #o7130601# that lives near Leafre. Its essence is mysterious and intoxicating. I bet it will have a delightfully fruit-forward stone...
I’ve almost got your gift ready! Just don’t look over here for a while.
Fine! Just take me over to McBurgerland and let me get fat on greasy stupid fries.
What a strange and mysterious aroma, complex with hints of champagne and garbanzo—OH MY GOODNESS THIS IS THE WORST THING I’VE EVER EATEN.\r\n#L0##bDon't be so picky...#l\n#k
I was just trying to be more refined in my eating. I watch a lot of that food channel while I’m waiting for you to do your thing...
Rich people have the worst taste in food. I wish I just had a big old greasy chicken-fried Essence Stone.
Defeat the #o7130601# monsters that live around the #m240010200# and get me my #t4033445#.
#h0#, I am soooo close to having a gift for you, but my tummy hurts. Won’t you rub my achy tummy?\r\n#L0##bNot after last time, pal! #l\n#k
That was entirely accidental! I get nervous... Aren’t you even looking forward to my new present? \r\n#L0##bUgh, just tell me where your rock is. #l\n#k
Well, luck you, there are another two monsters in Ellin Forest! What do you say?
I knew I could manipulate you into being my puppet. Go find the #o5250004# inside the #m300010410#.
Come on... Present?
Wow, this one is really pumping out a lot of energy!
Power... UNLIMITED POOWEEERRRRRR!!
Defeat the #o5250004# inside the #m300010410# and get a #t4033450# for me.
Hey! Remember, you promised to get me both of the Essence Stones from this area. YOU PROMISED.
That’s the spirit! The next monster is the #o5250007# at the #m300030310#. My sources tell me it’s pretty tough.
I’m hearing a lot of excuses, but I’m not hearing 'thank you for making me the coolest superhero on the planet.'
This looks a lot less exciting than I thought it would...
Wow, don’t judge a rock by its luster! That thing was amazing!! I’m going to be full for a while, I guarantee. And I think it’s about time for you to get an adorable little present...
Defeat the #o5250007# at the #m300030310# and get me a #t4033447#.
Are you ready to bow down in worship?\r\n#L0##bYou better not have made me another silly outfit. #l\n#k
An outfit from me is more than a mere gift. This is something different.\r\n#L0##bI really don’t trust you, mister.#l\n#k
W-well, whatever. Just, gah, do you want the stupid thing or not?!
This gift is waaay better than the one I got you last time. I’ll get it ready, just come back in a minute, okay?
Why? Is this because I scorched one of your shoes a couple of weeks ago? I was sleep-burning!
Well, how did I do? \r\n#L0##bI-It’s beautiful! This is SO much better than that piece of junk you gave me last time! #l\n#k
Hey! Hehehe, well, it’s made up of pure Essence Stone... by-products.\r\n#L0##bEwww, did this come out of your bum?!#l\n#k
N-no!! This is just like... dust and stuff. From my belly. Look, it’s not poop, okay? \r\n#L0##bOkay, okay. Thank you. This is really nice, Eskie.#l\n#k
Hmmm, maybe I really SHOULD make you a new outfit. That one looks a little warm...
Yeah, I’m totally going to get to work on your new uniform.
The Guild supplies have arrived. \nHere, take them. Goodness, complaints every time...\nDon't complain about the amount. If your Guild Level goes up, you will receive more.
Then good luck this week.\nSupplies will arrive again next Monday, so see you then.
I don't even get any thanks... If you need more, wait for Monday.
Hey there! I'm giving away #bMagi-Stone Boxes#k to celebrate the new years. Do you want yours now?
Great! Check out your #bMagi-Stone Boxes#k!
Really?! This item's really awesome, but okay! I'm giving one of these away per day so come back when you change your mind.
Hey there! I'm giving away #bChaos Boxes#k to celebrate the new years. Do you want yours now?
Great! Check out your #bChaos Boxes#k!
Really?! This item's really awesome, but okay! I'm giving one of these away per day so come back when you change your mind.

Hey, #h0#! Have you heard about Hephaestus, the god of blacksmiths? He's taking challengers t0o become the next Maple World star. You only have until #rTKTKTK#k, for a total of 5 days. Do you want to know how?
Time is running out! Let me know when you change your mind.

The event takes 5 days and will only be available until TKTKTK. You'll get Hephaestus's amazing #rlevel 140 equipment set#k and a medal if you use the #bMiraculous Equip Scroll#k to make #blevel 13 equipment#k! Not only that, but between #bQRQRQR and QRQRQR#k each day, you'll have #rdouble the chance to enhance your equipment#k!\n\nThere are a few things you should know though. The #bequipment has to be at least level 110#k and you MUST use #e#rMiraculous Equip Scroll#k to reach level 13. If you use anything else between levels 1 and 13, then you won't qualify for the event, okay?
You should take on Hephaestus!
Hi #h0#! #bRebecca#k prepared a really fun PC Cafe monster arena. Are you interested?
You sure? You're missing out!

Talk to #bRebecca#k in #bMonster Park#k while you're playing from a #rPremium PC Cafe#k to check out PC Cafe monster arena. Just take the shuttle to the Monster Park.\n\nAnyone #bover level 40#k can form a party of 1 - 4 to enter. Yous hould definitely check it out because Rebecca's waiting for you.
I have good news for everyone! Happyville is holding a grand party to celebrate Maplemas! Are you interested?
Haha, I knew you would. For more details, you should go talk to Rooney.
Oh really? It's going to be really fun! That's too bad, but... if you want to change your mind, just let me know!
You must be eager to know what the party is all about. Here are the details. Ready?
It's a dress-up party that takes place in Happyville during the whole Maplemas period.

Go to Happyville, and you'll find a house with a huge chimney. The only way you can enter the house is actually through the chimney. The way you're dressed up right now, however, you won't be allowed in at all. You must be transformed into a new state.

You can get the transformation potion from Cliff in Happyville. I hear that if you give him 50 #t4032176#s, you'll be able to trade in for that potion. It'd be a good idea for you to have it prepared before seeing him.
Now hurry before you miss out on the party...
Please go see Rooney for more details on the Maplemas party.

Ho! You must be here for the party. Yes, it's one of the bigger parties I've ever seen around here. In order to enter the party, however, you'll need something. Will you help me with one thing, so you can get that item you'll need to enter the party?

Then please gather up 50 Rascal Snowpieces from the monsters. I have a feeling someone that despises Maplemas decided to pull a prank on everyone with that. The monsters have gotten much worse these days...
I guess you are not interested in the party. I understand the older you get, the less interested you become with the parties.
You brought everything I need. Great! Let's get this started.
Here's the potion. Drink this, and you'll be transformed into a completely different state for one hour. Of course, you can also switch back to your original state midway through. Enjoy the party!
You may want to hurry up and get me those snowpieces... if you don't want to miss the party.

Hey there, #b#h0##k. My name is Snow Spirit. It's that time of the year again here in Happyville. Maplemas is coming, and the whole town is eager to enjoy the festivities. One person, however, seems intent on ruining all that for us. Have you heard about Scrooge and his plans? He is trying to take away our Maplemas, and he is currently holed up somewhere hatching a plan to do just that. I don't understand why he'd want to do such a terrible thing... but since I am the protector of Happyville, I am here to ask you for help in our mission to defeat Scrooge and save Maplemas. Would you like to join me?

Great! I knew you'd volunteer to help out. Now allow me to explain to you what we do for Maplemas here in Happyville. Every year, the residents of Happyville get together and hold a festival in preparation for Maplemas by creating one giant snowman. On the eve of Maplemas, the residents will gather up in front of the snowman, Say their prayers, and make new year's resolutions as well. (Shhh... this is just between you and me, but while the residents Say their prayers, I cast a spell on them for good luck.) Anyway, the good people here have been very busy making the giant snowman in hopes of successfully celebrating the biggest holiday of the year, but... there's this man named Scrooge... he lives a world away here, and he's trying to hatch a plan to ruin our Maplemas. He had already been banned from Maple World for various offenses, he once tried to cook the Easter Bunny, and even got in a fight with Cody. The problem is... he somehow found his way into Happyville, without anyone knowing. His plan is to remove the giant snowman and ruin the holidays for everyone here. This is why we must alert this to Alcaster in El Nath! He's very wise, and he will figure out the best way to handle this crisis. Unfortunately, I can't leave this place, but El Nath isn't too far from here, so I am sure you can make your way there and let him know in place of me. Good luck.
Ahhh... #b#h0##k, without your help, Maplemas this year will be ruined for everyone here in Happyville. Please reconsider!

Hmm... how can I help you...?... What do you have in your hand? That must be from Snow Spirit. Something did not seem right the past few days, and... unfortunately, I may have been right. Okay, please hand me the note immediately.
Thank you. Now let's see what's written here.
Oh no! Please hand the note to Alcaster immediately! He's in El Nath, and we don't have much time! Thanks!

Oh, this is not good. Scrooge is back?! We cannot let him steal the hopes and dreams of the good residents of Happyville... That just cannot happen... now hold on for minute... here's the letter I want you to give to Snow Spirit. Please help us one more time by seeing her immediately and hand her this letter. Will you?
Thank you. I'll be counting on you. The fate of Happyville and Maplemas lies in your hands. Good luck.
Hmmm... I did not expect you to say no, but... since you're already here to help us, wouldn't it only make sense to help us once more? Please reconsider.
I have been waiting for you, #b#h0##k! How was Alcaster doing? Oh... okay... yes... I knew he would write back! Let me see what he wrote.

Thank you so much for your help. We will be able to protect Happyville with this. Let me see what it say. (After finishing the letter, she starts thinking for a bit...) #b#h0##k... I want you to listen carefully to what I am about to say. First, take this Force of the Spirit. This is the key to defeating Scrooge.
Did you not go see her yet? Happyville is rather easy to find. Just find Rooney and ask her to take you to Happyville.

...Woe is me... I promised to make my wife this flower called the Red Dahlia, but I can't gather the materials-the creatures are too strong. I need someone to head out and gather them for me. It's very special flower, and I'm sure you could do it.
Excellent. Bring me back #b30 Stiff feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k and I can give you something I found that may help you...
That's unfortunate... if you run into anyone who's brave and wants to help someone in love, send them my way.
Wow! You got them all! I can't wait to see the look on my wife's face when she sees the flower. Thank you so much! As promised, I have something for you, I hope you like it!
Thanks again for all your help, the Red Dahlia turned out great!
Hard at work, I see! I'll need #b30 Stiff Feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k. You're almost there, keep going and return to me when done!
Hi there! If you have a moment to spare, could I ask you for a favor?

Thank you...my husband, Richard, is a sailor on Tae Gong's ship over in Aqua Road. He works all the time and I do love him, but I barely get to see him. I would like to send a few things to him, but I don't know how to fight. I'll need you to gather #b25 Soft Feathers#k and bring them to him on the boat along with the letter I wrote for him. If you do so, I'll have something nice for you when you get back.
Darn... oh well. I guess I'll have to find another brave fighter to help me then...
Howdy, I'm working, so I only have a second to talk. Oh... are you from Angelique? My buttercup always loves to send me things. Let me see what you've got there.

Awesome! Angelique always sends me the goods. And what is this... a letter? Ah... such a romanticist even after all these years. It's things like this that brings joy to my otherwise mundane life at work. Thanks!
Thank you so much!
That's funny, it looks like you haven't got everything yet. Could you hurry? I want Richard to get it soon.
My wife would want me to have more than what you have in your bag... come back when you've got everything!
I've been working on this love letter for Angelique, could you do me a favor and deliver it to her?
Thanks again! Don't get hurt!
Oh, really? Well, okay then. I need to get back to work now, but if you need me, I'll be right here.

You're back! And he got everything ok? Fantastic. And... what is this... oh a letter? Awww... whenever I write him a letter, he always follows up with a sweet letter of his own. Great. As promised, here's your reward. It should come in handy during your adventures.
Again, I thoroughly appreciate your help. I hope you have a safe journey. Here's wishing you good luck!
Haven't you met my wife yet? Go ahead... Hurry up!
You must be miss something, right?

Hiya Sport! I'm the new sheriff in town. You ready for some law and order? 

#L0##bOnly if I get to help enforce it!#k
#L1##bLaw? Order? Please. You couldn't tame a fly. I'm leaving!#k#l
That's the attitude that got me where I am today! Ok, I'm Lita Lawless, and with your help, I'm going to corral this town into a crime-free zone.
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?

I know how the devious monster mind works, having trained as a pirate for many years. So, you're going to have to wipe out #b200#k of two types-I believe #bElectrophants and Gryphons#k should prove a suitable test of your skills! Take your time and report back when you're done! I've got something just for your class!
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?
OUTSTANDING! I knew you were special the second I looked at you. \n\n#L0##bI have a question. So... you were a Thief?#k#l

Here's your class reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!
Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!

In a way, yes. He showed me that my destiny is here, in New Leaf City, and to a greater extent, Masteria. It's a brave new world out there...and I want to know where my fate lies. Ok. End of the story. It's time to get paid for your work!
Here's your class reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!
Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!

Hello, Maplers! I am part of a band of heros, sworn to protect the Maple World from outside threats. There are only a few of us, but we've stopped countless plots in the shadows...until now. I arrived to tell you about a madman known as 'Mal Volance', or for short,'MV'. He used to be a part of our group, and was a fine hero, but he has betrayed us, and seeks to cause anarchy rather than order. We're not sure how it happened, he seems to be under the influence of some strange, even demonic force. He conspires to attack the Maple World, only to cause anarchy and chaos. I'm positive that he's plotting something nefarious, and I need your help to stop him.

The thing is... I first need to test if you are ready to encounter him. He's no pushover, after all. As a simple test, you must search for the secret letters that contain information about 'MV'. After completing the search of secret letters, you will obtain a #bMap to MV's Lair.
Can you get those items for me please? You will be rewarded, of course.
Excellent! Then, please find and bring me a #bMap to MV's Lair.#k You will need to find the #rsecret letters#k from the piles of stones. I will move you to the first stage. Good Luck!
Are you sure? I mean... If I were you, I wouldn't have missed this chance, but I get what you mean. Feel free to come talk to me anytime if you change your mind.
Congrats! I knew you wouldn't let me down. I will give you a reward.
Here's your reward. Let's move on to the next stage!
You don't have what I've asked you for. Please get me a #bMap to MV's Lair#k. I think you will be able to find it in a pile of stones. Good Luck!
Hello, Maplers! Good to see you again. For this quest, you need to eliminate the madman called '#rMV#k'. You'll need at least 3 friends to tackle this formidable foe. Do you want to do it?
Great! I will move you guys down to the place for the quest soon. Get ready and good luck!
Are you sure? I mean... If I were you, I wouldn't have missed this chance, but... anyway, I get what you mean. Feel free to come talk to me anytime if you change your mind.
Oh my! You guys really eliminated #o9400589#! I mean.. I knew you wouldn't let me down. I will give you a reward as I promised.
Outstanding! Here's your reward. You have earned my trust!
Did you eliminate #b#o9400589##k? I understand that he's a very powerful monster.. but.. I know you guys can do this!
Sparkle-twinkle, Bling-bling, the glitter of treasure always fascinates me! Hello there, I'm the famous treasure hunter, Lara. What am I up to? I came here in search of the treasure, #rMV's Sabre#k.
Well, now I'm currently looking for a person who can find it. It is in the #bMV's Treasure Dungeon#k. Are you the brave traveler who will help me?

I knew you would! Now listen carefully, I will tell you about the treasure dungeon. The place is well known to house notorious monsters that guard the treasure. I suggest you prepare enough potions and healing items before you go inside.
You will be able to see the treasure boxes from the vault on the top floor. I just need you to bring me one Sabre. Take care of yourself and good luck!
Don't be ridiculous! I promise I will give you something in return, so talk to me when you reconsider my offer.
Oh yes! That looks like #rhis sabre#k! Thank you so much. Just a second! I will give you one item from my personal collection.
There you go. Do you like my gift? I have many more gifts, so be sure to come back before you enter the treasure dungeon!
Eh.. I don't see any sparkle-twinkle, bling-bling on your hands. Are you sure you brought me what I asked for?

Hello there, I have a severe headache these days and you know what's troubling me? The guard dogs of the treasure dungeon! Huskies and Brown Puppies might be a Mapler's best friend, but the guard dogs down there are everyone's enemy! So, are you going to help me? Please?

Alright, soon you will understand why I'm making such a fuss about those fleabags. I still have the bitemarks on my butt! It hurts! Nothing like kneeling down to pick up a nice shiny object and catch a pair for fangs for your trouble! Now I've had enough! I've used all kinds of bait--meat, fish, and even doggie treats but none of them worked! This is a job for someone strong...you!

Heh, I'd heal faster if you defeat #r50#b Skel Guard Dogs#k, #r30#b Mummy Guard Dogs#k, and #r10 #bAngry Guard Dogs#k. They are guarding MV's treasure in the Treasure Dungeon. Get yourself prepared and jump into the portal above. Good luck!
You will be sorry if you hear the reason why I'm only standing here. Talk to me again if you want to help!
You've done a great job for me! Thank you! Thank you! Don't be shy, take your rewards. You've earned them!
Many treasure hunters shall be thankful to you, but come back soon, you never know when the monsters will return.
Not enough, I want you defeat more monsters! I hope you understood me correctly this time.
#b\r\n#L0#Hey Icebyrd. Got a second?#k
For you? Always. I can't thank you enough? Masteria wouldn't exist without you!#b\r\n#L0#Thanks Icebyrd, but I want to know something.#k
Fire away.#b\r\n#L0#What does all this mean? You mentioned so many things the last time we spoke...I have a feeling there's something you're still not telling me.#k

Perception can always sense an unseen target. Sometimes I wonder about the paths we take, the decisions we make. Is our fate something we can truly change? Or are we merely doomed to repeat the actions of history? This question is what originally led me here...and I received an answer that led to my sacrifice in establishing New Leaf City. I was sworn to secrecy until the truth could be revealed. As you have proved yourself time and time again, you have earned my trust as well as someone else's. I will tell you why I established New Leaf City.

I remember waking up in a different place...and a being of light spoke to me. It called itself #b'Subani'#k and offered me a chance to help stop the coming reign of terror. #bSubani#k told me that a mystic anchor was needed to bring a fabled lost continent back from the realm of #bVersal#k, a world which could not be helped, as the being was too powerful. The one condition was that I could never leave the continent. Ever. I agreed without hesitation.

I remember way back, when I still lived in Kerning City; I had a dream...or perhaps a nightmare. I saw everything working in a twisted sense of order, everyone in the Maple World had a vacant look upon their face, and the sky itself had turned black. I saw a terrifying beast, large, powerful, with endless arms. I saw pure misery - nothing could match its strength. It had taken over the Maple World. I remember seeing my friends as slaves to this horrible beast, and I remember the voice which told me I could stop it.

The next thing I knew, I stood in this very spot. Subani helped me construct the city, the spirit's light growing dimmer with each task of strength. Finally, when the city was finished, Subani told me that I could not tell a soul of what I knew, until the time was right. I had to let things happen as if I knew nothing. Then, Subani was gone...vowing to return when most needed. To see you standing here before me proves that you have the strength, courage and honor to be a new hero of Masteria. The storm is still coming, but I like our chances with you around.
So relax for the time being, you've certainly earned it. I have a feeling our adventures here are just getting started!

I want to thank you. You've been pushed to your limits in helping us, and shown you're a true Urban Warrior. As my way of saying thanks, I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you! \n\n#L0##bSo, about that favor you mentioned...#k#l
We're tight, but not that tight yet. I'll tell you in time though... \n\n#L0##bI've noticed the city has quite a bit of diversity!#k#l
Yes. I felt it'd be best to be a little different. Masteria is a big place, and while we're only just starting, I have a feeling we're in for one wild ride! \n\n#L0##bWhat's up with you and Lita?#k#l
We're very good friends, but nothing more. She's a tough one, though! \n\n#L0##bJohn and Elpam both mentioned another world, Versal. What do you know about this?#k#l
Well, there's a rumor that a portal can be opened somehow from within the city, but I'm not sure how that's possible. \n\n#L0##bWhat do you mean? You built this city.#k#l

Correction-I rebuilt this city. The foundations are still there, as is some of the technology; you've probably seen some of it when you were outside the city. There's some stuff that just works, and I don't mean the Foxwit Doors themselves-I mean the energy that powers them. Foxwit is a genius and some of that is way beyond even his understanding. I'm a bit wary of using it all, just because of the old tales of Masteria-the immortal warriors, a mad scientist, a threat from the stars, some of their legends are pretty heavy stuff. In addition to that, this is where Subani and Naricain are originally from. Not the city, another region of Masteria. John probably mentioned that. \n\n#L0##bJust level with me, Icebyrd. Tell me what you know.#k#l

Ok, but keep this a secret, don't want people panicking. The Masteria of old was a sprawling utopia, one far advanced in technology. However, their ambition far outstripped their control of the technology, and there was an accident. Masteria, the great land, finally fell into the sea, its secrets lost forever. Until now. I made a deal with someone to raise the continent, and establish the city in the ruins of Olde Sapp Village. He brought my dream to life, and it cost me next to nothing. And that's where we are now. However, the city has many, many secrets that even I don't know about. Tread carefully; you never know what can open up... \n\n#L0##bOk, I know what how it was raised, but who raised it? What did you have to do?#k#l

That's a bit personal, but I will say this-if there's ever a time when you need to know more, I'll tell you. Until then, don't worry about it. That burden is mine alone to bear. For now, just let me give you a gift for the appreciation of helping our city.
Where did I put it... Just give me a second and talk to me, ok?
I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you!
Looks good! Just give it a try and sit on it sometimes!

Hey! If it isn't my favorite deputy. Ready for some hunting?

That's the attitude that got me where I am today! Ok, let's do this again! I'm going to corral this town into a crime-free zone. I know how the devious monster mind works, having trained as a thief for many years. So, you're going to have to wipe out #b200#k of two types-I believe #bElectrophants and Gryphons#k should prove a suitable test of your skills! Take your time and report back when you're done!
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?
OUTSTANDING! I knew you were special the second I looked at you.
Here's your reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!
Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!

Hello, I'm Kopee. Toh Relicseeker and I are looking for the Miwok Artifacts. I think someone found out the secret place where my ancestors hid the artifacts because they are now missing.
We must find the person who stole our Miwok Artifacts... Would you like to help us out?

Oh, thank you a whole bunch! First, I want to find out whether the artifacts are nearby or not. We are suspicious of the monsters, so will you bring me the #bMiwok Artifact Piece#k if you happen to discover it while you hunt the monsters? I'll be counting on you.
You're busy? Oh well. If you find some time to spare in the future, come back and help me, okay? We can't stay here forever, you know.
Oh, you're here early. Have you found anything that will trace back to the artifacts? Oh, what's that in your hand? That seems like a fragment of our Miwok Artifact! May I take a look at it?

Oh my, I don't believe this! It is a part of our Miwok Artifacts. I've been searching for any remnants that would help me find the artifacts. So Toh was right. It was the monsters who stole the artifacts. It saddens me to know that our ancestors' artifacts are now in the hands of those monsters.

By the way, Toh Relicseeker has a very special gift. Toh Relicseeker can use the scroll written in our esoteric tribal language and release the seal on the #bMiwok Artifact#k. You must visit the #rcash shop#k if you want to acquire the #bEnchanted Scroll#k.
Have you found out who it was that stole our Miwok Artifacts? We're assuming it was those monsters. If you happen to find the artifacts, please make sure you bring them to me.

Oh, my dearest friend #b#h0##k, I've been thinking about how I could repay you. And since you seem like an adventurous person, I'll make a unique gift just for you using my special ability. Aren't you curious what it might be?

I have the ability to make a ring using the artifacts that my ancestors have left behind. It's a marvelous ring I make which all the other adventurers will be jealous of! Only I, Kopee, know how to make that ring. But I can only make you the ring if you bring the required materials.
What do you say? Would you like me to make you a legendary #bCircle of Ancient Thought#k?

Alright! You'll be able to find the belongings of my ancestors in the Miwok Artifacts. I need the belongings of my ancestors to make a #bCircle of Ancient#k Thought. Bring me #b3 Bluejay Feathers#k, #b2 Red Bird Feathers#k, and #b1 Old Tree Branch#k.
As you may be aware already, the monsters have the #bMiwok Artifacts#k, and you must ask Miwok to retrieve the sealed treasure using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k. Hurry!
Oh, hm, it's truly a special ring. Are you sure you don't want it? Toh Relicseeker and I are planning to leave here sometime soon. Make sure you come back and see me if you change your mind later.
Ah! you've brought back all the materials I need! Alright, it's time for me to show you my special ability. Now, hand me what you've brought.

OOOOAAAAAH! Here, a #bCircle of Ancient Thoughts#k has been made just for you. What do you think? You like it? The effect of the ring differs depending on my condition at the time of making the ring. I hope you like it! If you bring me more materials, I can make you another one.
Too bad, but you haven't brought me everything I need to make the ring. I need #b3 Bluejay Feathers#k, #b2 Red Bird Feathers#k, #b1 Old Tree Branch#k in order to make the ring.

Too bad, but you haven't brought me everything I need to make the ring. I need #b1 Cat Eye#k, #b3 Buffalo Horns#k, and #b2 Puma Bones#k in order to make the ring.

Hello, #b#h0##k. How goes recovering the Miwok Artifacts from the monsters? I have some good news for you. Toh and I are planning to give a special chair to those who release the seal on the #bMiwok Artifact#k many times.
Are you wondering how many times you have to release the seal?
Well, you only have to release it #b20#k times. What do you say? Won't you try? This special chair is only for the Chief of a tribe to sit, but I'm specially offering it to you.

Good! Find the #bMiwok Artifact#k from the monsters and take it to Toh Relicseeker. Ask Toh Relicseeker to release the seal on it using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k. If you release the seal on the #bMiwok Artifact 20 times#k, I promise to give you the #bChief Chair#k.
Why not? Let me know if you change your mind.

Hello there. I am #b#p2040050##k. You know I love to travel around the Maple World. Since I have been to so many places in Maple World, I was fortunate to learn some new skills that others couldn't even find!
For example... using scrolls on unequipped items to increase their power...and perhaps make a bit of extra mesos. Hey, would you like to learn this skill? I can teach you.

Well, well, well... I am sure that it was quite uncomfortable for you so far, because you were only able to use scrolls on equipped items. No more worries! With this new skill, you will be able to use the scrolls on items even if you are not wearing them. How cool is that?
Shame. I'm sure you would've enjoyed being able to experiment with items like I do...
That was fast. You already got what I asked for? Please give me the items so I can finish packing for my trip.
Thank you very much. To show you my appreciation, I just taught you the 'Legendary Spirit' skill.

Please press 'K' to open up your skills window and you will find the 'Legendary Spirit' in the Beginner section. When this skill is clicked, you will be able to use scrolls on unequipped items. I bet it will be a useful skill for you. Farewell now, I'm off! I've heard rumors of a mythical creature in the Leafre region...supposedly more powerful than Zakum. I have to see if the rumor is true...

The Spirit Week Event! I, Cassandra, am casting a magic spell on regular scrolls every Monday in October, which will increase the Success Rate by 5%. But once I cast a magic spell on your scroll, you won't be able to trade it. What do you say? Would you like to try?

I'll #rcast a magic spell and increase the Success Rate by 5%#k if you bring me a scroll with 10% or 60% success rate. So, decide on a scroll you'd like and come talk to me. You can trade in a scroll of your choice by selecting #bCast a Magic Spell#k. Make sure you make the right decision, though, since you can only trade 5 times.
Casting magic on scrolls is harder than it looks, which is why I'm only offering it every Monday of October. Come and see me on a Monday in October if you change your mind.

Then, bury it and let it sit in the ground for a day.'

20 #rOrange Mushroom Caps#k

2 #rSlime Bubbles#k.

Wowee! This #rCold Medicine#k really gets the job done quick!\nI'm all better already! Tee hee.\nYou appear to be a person from Ellinia who is studying magic. I know it was quite a travel to get here. Thank you so much for coming to deliver this to me.

But it's yours, right? I promised her I'd take out Iron Hogs and fetching #b50 Metal Hooves.#k No big deal to someone of your caliber, right? You probably won't even break a sweat.
*gasp* What? You won't help me...? Oh. T-t-that's okay. I'm sure you're busy. *sniffle* Can you leave? I don't want you to see *sniffle, sniffle, sob* a grown man cry.

I knew if I stayed here too long my genius would go to waste! Seriously, a great chef like me needs inspiration! But nooo, all these seamen want are simple meals that are beneath someone of my expertise!
For two years now I've put up with this! No more! I'm working on a secret dish to blow the socks off of these people. And you know what? You're going to help me.

This secret dish I'm working on is rather complicated. And no, I can't tell you what it is. Then it wouldn't be a secret, right? But I will tell you this much. The main ingredient is #bGreen Mushroom Caps.#k Yup, I said #bGreen Mushroom Cap#k. Could you grab me #b50 Green Mushroom Caps#k?
You don't want to be part of culinary history? Fine. There are other fish in the sea.

Since you are not a Cygnus Knight, I'd rather not sully the grounds of Ereve with your footprints. Therefore, go to Aqua Road and get #b50 Sea Horse Horns.#k Return when you are done.
Then we have nothing more to discuss. Good day.

Hi there. Did you miss out on any of the below events? If so, I can send you to the right person to talk to. You can go back to that event and earn your Celebration Tickets.
I see. Then I'll take you there now. Well, good luck!
So you didn't miss anything? Good for you!
Oh my! Oh no! Things have totally spiraled out of control! You see, Cake Boss Daniel and Pie Lord Tiara have never gotten along. But I never imagined things would spiral so out of control!
I'll let you know your side.
No dessert for you then. Oh, come on. It'll be fun! You can win some awesome prizes, too!

Geez! I can't seem to do anything because of those stupid monkeys! I should have gotten rid of them a long time ago! Why are the village elders so against it? ...Oh, welcome to the #m950100000#! Location guide? Lost and Found? Local product purchase? I have everything you need. What can I help you with?

Is there a problem? Oh, it's not that big of a deal. It's just that the #o9409011#s are giving me a headache. Many tourists visiting the #m950100000# have been slipping on the #t4000561#s they've been throwing all over the place.

After turning this place into a tourist attraction and even asking #p9010010# to publicize it, I'm finally starting to see some tourists coming in. But these monkeys are ruining everything! I wanted to rid them from this place, but the village is against it... Sigh, it'd be nice to have some help with this.
You'd really want to help me? You're that confident, eh? Well, I'll take all the help I can get! Please eliminate #r100 #o9409011#s#k and bring back #b50 #t4000574#s.
They should be in the Monkey Temple near the Golden Temple. You'll be able to enter by bringing a Golden Ticket to #b#p9000080##k. Thank you!
Not up for it, eh? I guess people only do things for rewards nowadays.
You defeated the #o9409011#s and brought the #t4000574#s! Alright! The #m950100000# certainly looks a bit cleaner, thanks to you! I wish I had something to give you in return...

Despite all that you've done, there still seems to be a lot of #t4000574#s lying around. There are just too many #o9409011#s! If you would like to help me out again, can you come see me #bin 1 hour#k?

Have you not eliminated the #o9409011#s yet? If you defeat #r100 #o9409011#s#k and collect #b50 #t4000574#s#k that they've thrown away, the #m950100000# is sure to look spick and span! Please go see #b#p9000080##k to enter the Monkey Temple.

Argh, I've traveled such a great distance to get here, but now I won't even be able to call anyone or take any pictures! ...Oh, hello. Are you also here to tour the #m950100000#? Then you should be careful of the big monkeys! They stole my personal items!

There was a #o9409012# carrying a baby on her back, so I tried to take a picture of her. Then suddenly, she grabbed my camera! I was in the middle of calling management when the monkey grabbed my cell phone as well! What a crazy monkey! Oh, my cell phone and my camera... I wish I could get those items back.

What? You'll retrieve my cell phone and camera for me? Well, I'd suggest you beware of the monkeys, who look pretty strong... Well, if you're serious, can you talk to #b#p9000080##k to enter the Monkey Garden and recover #b5 cell phones#k and #b5 cameras#k for me?
Why do I carry five of each? Well, isn't that normal nowadays? You seem so surprised!
Aww, great. You won't help. And the manager, who said he'd help, claims that it's my fault and that he can't do anything about it. How two-faced! What should I do now?
Hey, that's it! Those are my cell phones and cameras! Wow, you really did it! Now, say cheese!

Well, I'd really like to continue my tour, but I'm clumsy about my belongings and I worry about the monkeys. I have a feeling they will try to steal my things again if I tour the place for #b1 more hour#k.

I guess you haven't found my #bcell phones#k and #bcameras#k yet. There are #b5#k of each. You can find the #r#o9409012#s#k that stole them by talking to #b#p9000080##k and entering the Monkey Garden.
Uh-oh, it got dirty again...what will I do now? Oh, hello teacher! What? You're not a teacher? Well, we're all teachers and students of life. Don't you agree?
I apologize for the mess here. There are some that have been causing havoc inside the temple. I really wish that there was someone who would get rid of them.

What? You'll help? Thank you! The #o9409013#s are responsible for destroying and breaking things in the temple. They weren't like this before, but they've been acting very strange recently. It might be due to their fear of the tourists.
But still, I can't let them defile the temple! Can you please defeat #r100 #o9409013##ks? That should calm them down a bit.
The White Baby Monkeys live in the Monkey Temple. You can enter by talking to #b#p9000080##k.
That's unfortunate. Well, I better clean this mess up.
I was waiting for you. Did you teach those #o9409013#s a lesson? Thank you so much!
This should keep the #o9409013#s in line for awhile. But they are not the type to remain quiet. They will probably return to their crazy antics in about #b1 hour#k. Could you help me again then?
You haven't taken care of the #r#o9409013#s#k yet? Just fighting #r100#k of them should settle them down. Please talk to #b#p9000080##k to enter the Monkey Temple.

Sheesh! What's the point of having these tourists if I can't sell a thing?! Huh? You want to buy some #t4032636#s? No! I can't sell them even if I wanted to! The #o9409014#s stole them all! And here I thought I was finally going to make some money... Sigh, I wish someone could help me.

Huh? You want to help me? Well, do you think you can handle it? The #o9409014#s aren't as weak as you might think... But if you're willing to help, just eliminate the #r#o9409014#s#k and recover #b20 #t4032636#s#k for me.
The ones who stole the limes went to the Monkey Temple. You can enter the temple by talking to #b#p9000080##k. Good luck!
That's what I thought. Well, it's my life and I got to deal with it...
You retrieved the #t4032636#s! Thank you! I'll be able to run my business again with these limes!

I used to practice kung-fu... But there's not much you can do with kung-fu in this town. I was wondering how I would make a living, when #p9000078# suddenly came up with the idea of turning the village into a tourist attraction. So, I started selling fruits to the tourists. Little did I know that I would encounter such problems...

The #o9409014#s never used to steal things from the village, but maybe they are acting this way because of the tourists. I'm starting to wonder if #p9000072# was right... #p9000072# was against turning the #m950100000# into a tourist attraction.

Ah, I shouldn't be blabbering, anyway. The #o9409014#s have their eyes on my cart. Who knows when they'll try to make an attempt at my #t4032636#s? I should keep my eyes on the cart for at least #b1 hour#k.
You haven't recovered the #b20 #t4032636#s#k yet? I told you the #r#o9409014#s#k weren't going to be easy... You can enter the Monkey Temple by talking to #b#p9000080##k.
(Prayer mumble...) Please, please let my wish come true...! Why isn't my wish coming true?\r\n#L0##bIs the prayer not having any effect?#l\n#k

Oh, hello there. Are you here because you heard that praying at the #m950100000# will make your wish come true? Well, that's why I came, but nothing has come true!\r\n#L0##bMaybe you're missing something? Like devotion...?#l\n#k

Hmm... of course! I haven't offered a single thing all this time while I've been praying. Maybe if I offer a really good item, my wish will come true! So... what should I offer? \r\n#L0##bWait, what I meant by devotion was...#l\n#k

The more expensive the item, the better the chances of my wish being fulfilled, right? Yes, that's it! Perhaps I can offer crowns... They can be obtained by defeating the #o9409015#s around here. Oh, please help!
Please eliminate #r100 #o9409015#s#k and return with #b50 Crowns#k! If I offer those up, my wish is sure to come true!
What? Where are the Blue Goblins? They are found in the Goblin Cave, which you can enter by talking to #b#p9000075##k, the Goblin Cave Guard who's standing right over there.
I only asked because you thought you were strong, but I guess I was wrong...
Wow, you brought the #t4000577#s! Oh, look how shiny it is! Please give me the crowns and I'll give them as an offering and pray again.

(Prayer mumble...) If there is no effect after #b1 hour#k has passed, I'll have to offer something else. I'm sure that the chance of my prayers being answered will increase with the more items I offer.
(Faint mumbling...) Fat go away... Fat go away... Fat go away...

It looks like you haven't been able to defeat #r100 #o9409015#s and bring back #b50 crowns#k yet. Please talk to #b#p9000075##k and enter the Goblin Cave. I know my wish will come true if I offer these crowns!

Sigh, what can I do? Is there no one who can rid the world of this evil? No... If evil exists in the world, then that means good must also exist. There must be someone who can oppose this evil. That person is...you!\r\n#L0##b(Huh? What?! What is this guy talking about?)#l\n#k

Yes, you have been chosen to protect the people from the threat of the #o9409016#s! After many years of meditation and discipline, I have learned to recognize the powers and abilities of people. I am sure you are the one. Now, go stop those dangerous #o9409016#s from tormenting the people in #m950100000#! \r\n#L0##b(But why me...? Argh... I guess I'll have to do it.)#l\n#k
Ha! I knew you would believe.
If you defeat #r100 #o9409016#s#k and recover #b50 axes#k, which they use as weapons, they will begin to see that hurting people will not be condoned. I will be waiting for you here.
Just in case you're unaware, #b#p9000075##k knows the way to the Red Goblin Caves. Talk to him and he will send you there.
You still don't seem to understand your true mission. Meditate, and you shall find the path you must travel...
Ah, you've eliminated the #o9409016#s and recovered their axes. I knew I was right about you... Heh.
Maybe the #o9409016#s will back off for now, but they will return to their violence again after #b1 hour#k has passed. I'm sure another brave warrior will come along to stop them...
I see that you haven't yet been able to eliminate #r100 #o9409016#s and recover #b50 #t4000576#s. Do not worry. I trust that you will accomplish your mission. Now, go see #b#p9000075##k.

How could this be?! How could this have happened in the #m950100000#? This is all because of #p9000078#, whose idea was to develop #m950100000# into a tourist attraction. Look at all those tourists who've come at his beckoning! What? You want to know what I'm talking about?

All those tourists are corrupting the morals and culture of the holy #m950100000#! I have evidence... Just take a look at the outfit of those #o9409017#s! They are so vulgar... I can't stand looking at them! Something must be done now!

Oh, so you'll help? It's good to know that there are some sensible ones even amongst the outsiders... In that case, I won't refuse your help. Please go defeat #r200#k of those lewd #r#o9409017#s#k! You can get to the Goblin Cave by talking to #b#p9000075##k!
Fine. I guess I better tell #p9000078# to stop allowing tourists to enter. Then I'll have to deal with the #o9409017#s myself!
Oh! It looks you've returned from eliminating the #o9409017#s! Thanks to you, the town seems to have somewhat returned to normalcy.

But those #o9409017#s are so persistent that they will probably return to normal once an hour has passed. I would like to ask the same favor of you again at that time. Please come back to me after #b1 hour#k has passed.

Have you not defeated the #r200 #o9409017#s#ks yet? Then again, it must be pretty hard to do while looking at their vulgar outfits... Still, this is a very important matter. Please talk to #b#p9000075##k and enter the Goblin Cave.
You're the one who received a Lucky Gift from me last time, right? Well, I want to give you another gift if you'd like.
Great! Looks like I better start making it. I'm not sure what I have in mind, but come see me in 2 to 3 days and it'll be ready by then. Isn't this exciting?\r\n
What? You don't want it?
Oh, you're here! I've been waiting for you. Now, let me give you your gift!
Do you like your gift? Please continue to enjoy your adventures in Maple World!
It hasn't been 2 days yet.
Have you found a friend yet? Open the Friends window (hotkey: R) and press the Find Friends button to search for friends...or use the Friend Finder Megaphone!
Hello, I am a Maple Admin. What is that small reddish light in your pocket? Could it be the Gachapon Stamp?!
A Gachapon Stamp event with more awesome and incredible trade items is currently in progress! Are you curious about the event?
You're curious about the 2nd Gachapon Stamp event, you say? Well, let me answer all of your questions right now!
From #eJune 16 to July 13#n, you will automatically receive the same number of Gachapon Stamps as you do for tickets every time you make a Gachapon purchase. So, what can you do with the stamps?
You can come and see me to exchange them for various items you've always wanted!
Whether it's the Terrifying Horntail Chair, +3 all stat Aura Ring, or Maple Flag for the dedicated Maplers, just name it and it's yours! I even have miraculous medicine to enhance your strength!
Stamps can be exchanged until #eJuly 20#n, but you should come see me in town as soon as possible.
If you are interested in the Gachapon Stamp event in the future, please come and see me. I'll be waiting in town.
I became interested in a region called Neo City and began my research about the monsters who reside there. It didn't take long before I noticed a peculiar monster called Iruvata.\r\n
As I labored in my studies regarding Iruvata, I discovered something almost unbelievable. Are you curious?

Yes, what I witnessed through my thick lens made me think twice. It was Iruvata, a monster whose speed was incredibly fast. My burgeoning interest in the creature led me to conduct in-depth research.\r\n

How is Iruvata capable of such speed? That was the question I sought to answer. I would spend countless long nights researching until one night, when I finally discovered something amazing... The speed and strength of Iruvata are derived from its android gears!\r\n

I don't know which programmer invented it, but it was really something else! I didn't stop there, though. I continued my research to determine whether anyone can move as fast as an android, only to realize that...\r\n
I had discovered a way to build a memory chip that can replicate the android gear! And I'm not going to stop now. I'm thinking about conducting more research.\r\n
If you want to make android gears, you should talk to T-1337, who isn't too far from here. I'll email him and let him know that you'll be coming to see him.\r\n
If you are interested in the results of my unique research, come talk to me again.\r\n
Contact me when you are ready.

To celebrate the arrival of spring, I am handing out special Evolving Rings. Stop by and grab yours today!
Stay logged in for an hour each day to evolve your ring and enhance its stats. You can evolve it all the way to Lv. 17, which means you'll have a very powerful ring by the end!

Hello! El Nido, the new world, has finally opened. Starting a new character in a new world feels like drawing a new picture on a blank piece of paper. Well, something like that.\r\nAnyway, since you are starting a new adventure, I will give you an interesting proposal. Do you want to hear about it?
If you reach Level 70 in El Nido, you can acquire the #b#t1003188##k! There is not much time left, so you should be diligent! Hurry up! There's no time to sit around!\r\n#i1003188# #t1003188#
It's really an interesting proposal. Are you sure you're not interested?
Wow! You really reached Level 70? Honestly, I did not expect that. All right... A promise is a promise. I will give you the #t1003188#.
I will admit you have great spirit. I only wonder if you will become the hero the El Nido world needs...
I told you I would give you the #b#t1003188##k when you reached #bLevel 70#k... I, Cassandra, always keep promises, so don't worry about that. Just come see me after you have reached Level 70.
Hey! Are you about to start an adventure? But you look a bit weak. When I was younger, I also used to roam the world. I miss those days.
At first, it was difficult because I was so ill prepared. Seeing you reminds me of all the hardships I faced as a young adventurer.
For some reason, I like you. If you can prove that you have the makings of a great adventurer, I will support you financially. Interested?
All right. Please gather #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k for me, then maybe I'll admit you are talented.
I was only trying to help... If you change your mind, feel free to come back.
Wow, this is great! You got all of them so quickly. I definitely have an eye for talent. You'll become a great adventurer. I'm sure of it.
Did you get the money? It's not much but it should be useful for someone just starting out. I hope you get stronger and come back soon.
Hmm... You haven't gotten all the items I asked you to get. Maybe I overestimated you. Hurry up and gather #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k. I know you can do it.
#b#h0#!#k It's good to see you again. How have your adventures been? I'd like to test just how strong you've become. Will you accept?
Okay, then please gather #b80 #t04000024#s#k and #b100 #t04000020#s#k. If you can do that, I will acknowldege that you have truly become stronger.
I guess you're not confident enough yet. If you want to prove your strength, feel free to come back anytime.
Wow, that's amazing! You gathered them so quickly... You've definitely become much stronger.
Did you get the money? It should be very useful to you in your travels. Take care of yourself.
Hmm... It looks like you haven't been able to gather them all yet. Did I expect too much of you? Please gather #b80 #t04000024#s#k and #b100 #t04000020#s#k. I know that you can do it!
#b#h0#!#k It's good to see you again. How have your adventures been? I'd like to test just how strong you've become. Will you accept?
Okay, then please gather #b80 #t04000024#s#k and #b100 #t04000020#s#k. If you can do that, I will acknowldege that you have truly become stronger.

Greetings, traveler. My name is Hannah and I'm currently organizing a Festival of Lights for the Holidays. If you could help me out, I'd greatly appreciate it!

Excellent. I'd like to build an altar for the festival, so we'll need 25 Altar Pieces. Some others attempted to help me, but their axes got stuck in the wood. Fighting those monsters should give you the needed pieces. Thank you and hurry back!
Truly a shame, I suppose that I will have to find another good soul to assist me...Fare thee well!
Wonderful! These should be enough pieces to build the Altar. Thanks for your help! I've got one other thing for you when you get a chance...
Ok, I'll start building the Altar.
Oh my, it looks like you don't have enough pieces to build the altar yet. Be sure to hurry back when you do!

Ho! You must be here for the party. Yes, it's one of the bigger parties I've ever seen around here. In order to enter the party, however, you'll need something. Will you help me with one thing, so you can get that item you'll need to enter the party?

Then please gather up 50 Rascal Snowpieces from the monsters. I have a feeling someone that despises Maplemas decided to pull a prank on everyone with that. The monsters have gotten much worse these days...
I guess you are not interested in the party. I understand the older you get, the less interested you become with the parties.
You brought everything I need. Great! Let's get this started.
Here's the potion. Drink this, and you'll be transformed into a completely different state for one hour. Of course, you can also switch back to your original state midway through. Enjoy the party!
You may want to hurry up and get me those snowpieces... if you don't want to miss the party.

Valentine's Day is coming, and love is in the air. So what do you think of the Heart Chocolate that I made for you? With it, you won't lose any EXP even after dying in the middle of the battle. This item is used up when you die and goes bad in 3 days, so make sure to put it to good use! Got that?

And who's the man that brought you that tasty treat? Me, the #bAce of Hearts#k! Well, this time, with my magic touch, I can actually extend the expiration date for that chocolate. Would you like to gather up the necessary materials for it?

Just follow my lead, and you'll be fine. What I do is... I'll first wrap up the chocolate in two layers, and I'll package it up nicely to make sure it doesn't spill. To do all that, though, requires a number of extra materials.

First I'll need #b1 #t4140100##k. You have it with you, right? Then, in order to wrap it up in two layers, I'll need #b1 #t4031110##k and #b1 #t4031109##k. Of course, with the enhanced power of love on the chocolate, the packaging will also have to be different. You'll need to buy #b1 #t4031113##k and #b1 #t4031114##k through #bCoco#k, who's next to me.

Oh no. I extend the life of #b#t4140100##k once per person, and you said no to it! It's hard to get a deal better than this... oh well, if you decide to change your mind, then please see me before Valentine's.
So you HAVE gathered up the necessary ingredients for #t4140200#, right...? This time, it'll require a lot more of my work, so I'll need #b2,500 mesos#k to make it. Do you still want it?

Tada! Isn't it pretty? Take a look! #bYour name#k is inscribed on #t4140200#. This will protect the owner of #t4140200# for #b5 days#k. Oh, and I also made a chocolate out of leftovers, so please take it. Have a lovely Valentine's Day with your special someone!
Hmm? Are you sure you're not lacking any materials or mesos? Please check and see if you have all the items I asked you to get.#l

Have you ever heard of a place called the #b#m950100000##k? It's a small village located deep inside a tropical rain forest. Visitors were previously prohibited so it remained largely unknown. But for some reason, they decided to open the village to visitors. I'm not sure everyone agreed with that decision, though.

It's a place that has maintained its own unique culture and history without any disturbance from the outside world. Aren't you curious as to what it's like? It's been said that it features its own boss monster and other unique monsters. Sounds like it'd be a great experience. What do you think about making a visit?

You can get to the #m950100000# by going through the #bDimensional Mirror#k. In order to publicize their village and attract new visitors, they are giving out free Golden Tickets that will allow you enter the mini dungeons near the village. Be sure to ask #b#p9000078##k the PR Manager about it!
Hmm...not even a little bit curious? I, #p9010010#, would definitely make a trip there myself, if there weren't so many people that needed me here!

Welcome to the #m950100000#! Please come this way! Thank you for traveling so far! I hope you make several lasting memories here in the #m950100000#! ...Oh? A #t4001431#? Yes, of course! I haven't forgotten.
Here is the #b#t4001431##k that will allow you enter any #bmini dungeon#k nearby! However, it will only allow you to enter just once.

If you want to enter the mini dungeons again in the future, you can do so through several different ways. 

1. Purchase a Premium Golden Ticket.
2. Hunt the monsters in Maple World to obtain a Golden Ticket.
3. Obtain a Golden Ticket by completing a quest that is given out once a day.

It doesn't matter which method you choose.
Have you not gone to #b#m950100000##k yet? You can get there by using the #bDimensional Mirror#k located in town. Be sure to meet #b#p9000078##k the PR Manager!

Oh, what should I do... If I allow this to continue, there might be more victims. But if I try to do something about it, the confusion that might occur will cause even more danger. Sigh... If I knew this would happen, I would've stopped Mr. Yoo at all costs... Is there anybody that could help...? \r\n#L0##bWhat's the problem?#l\n#k

Well, do you see that golden building? Lurking inside there is a creature named #rRavana#k. It's a very dangerous monster that was sealed inside a long time ago by ancient masters... \r\n#L0##bIf it's sealed up inside, then it shouldn't be a danger, right?#l\n#k

It was safe before, but now things have changed. As more outsiders come to the Golden Temple, its holy energy is diminishing, while the power of Ravana seems to be growing. At this rate, the Ravana may be able to break through the seal in no time. \r\n#L0##bThat sounds horrible! What can be done about it?#l\n#k

That's my dilemma. I wish I can just enlist help from the villagers to eliminate Ravana, but doing so might just cause more confusion and chaos in the village. But if I do nothing, Ravana will eventually reawaken. Is there anyone that could help...?

What, really? You think you can defeat Ravana? It might be sealed up right now, but it was so powerful at one time that it nearly conquered the world. If you want to attempt this, I think you will need some help.

Nevertheless, Ravana is still weaker than it used to be after being sealed up for such a long period. If you enlist others to fight with you, you may stand a chance. Fighting in a party is the only way you'll be able to defeat Ravana.
Now what? There is nothing else I can do. I must tell Mr. Yoo that all the tourists must leave...

Oh wow! You defeated #o9101005#! Unbelievable! How could I ever thank you enough? Now, the #m950100000# should be safe from danger. I don't have much to give you as a token of my appreciation, but please take this...
This should come in handy. Please use it well.
You haven't been able to defeat #r#o9101005##k yet? Please #bform a party and enter the Golden Temple#k.

Hello, #b#h0##k! How's it going?\r\n#L0##bEverything's pretty good. Hey, I heard you have some Mini Maple Trees.#l\n#k

Nothing gets past you, huh, #h0#? Yeah, I was thinking that fall is a good time for some nice Potted Mini Maple Trees. They make great decorations! Would you like to try to grow one yourself, #h0#? If you get a #rMini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal#k, I'll give you a tree of your own.
You must have a Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal before I can give you a Potted Mini Maple Tree. How else are you going to record your cultivating adventures?

If you click the Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal in the ETC tab, you can check your rewards received, and how many entries you've made. Every day that you grow your Potted Mini Maple Tree and get a #bGolden Maple Fruit from it, you can make one entry in the Cultivation Journal#k.
Right, so, I'll get you set up with a Potted Mini Maple Tree, #e#b#h0##k#n. Talk to me by #bclicking the Event Notifier on the left side of your screen#k when you are ready!
Shouldn't you see if you have an Etc slot free?
Hello, #b#e#h0##n#k! You lost your Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal, didn't you?\r\n#L0##b Huh? Oh...I guess I did. How did you know?#l\n#k
Someone found your #bMini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal#k, and dropped it off with me. See, your name's even in it, #h0#!
Huh, that's weird. I was certain this was your journal, #h0#. Oh, well. It's good you didn't lose it after all. If you ever DO lose it, come check with me, okay?

See? I told you so, #h0#. Try to hang on to this thing, okay? And, if you ever lose it again, check in with me either by #bclicking the Event Notifier on the left side of your screen#k or just coming to see me. I'm sure I can find it for you.
Shouldn't you see if you have an Etc slot free?
Please check to see if you have a #b#i4033100##t4033100##k.
Good work, #b#e#ho##n#k! That's a lovely Potted Mini Maple Tree. I'd say that earns you the Cultivation Journal Day 1 gift, a Power Elixir. Would you like it now?
I guess you have to prepare mentally to receive the Power Elixir. That's okay. I can wait.
Great. Keep on growing those #bPotted Mini Maple Trees that I give out everyday.#k A #rContinent Transportation Scroll#k is waiting for you as the Day 3 reward!
Are you sure you have an empty Consumable slot?

Great job, #b#e#ho##n#k! You've got a talent for growing Potted Mini Maple Trees. Three days of cultivating gets you the Cultivation Journal Day 3 gift, a Continent Transportation Scroll. Are you ready for it?
Yeah, I guess this is a little overwhelming for you. No worries, I'll wait 'till you're ready.
Great. Keep on growing those #bPotted Mini Maple Trees that I give out everyday.#k #r3 Mysterious Recipes#k are waiting for you as the Day 5 reward!
Are you sure you have an empty Consumable slot?

Wonderful, #b#e#ho##n#k! You've grown so many lovely Potted Mini Maple Trees! This has been five days of cultivating, right? That means you get the Cultivation Journal Day 5 gift, 3 Mysterious Recipes. Want them now?
Sure, sure. Take your time. Such an amazing gift requires preparation, after all.
Great. Keep on growing those #bPotted Mini Maple Trees that I give out everyday.#k An #rAdvanced Equip Enhancement Scroll#k is waiting for you as the Day 7 reward!
Are you sure you have at least 3 empty Consumable slots?
Amazing, #b#e#ho##n#k! You grew a Potted Mini Maple Tree every day, and completed your journal! For all your hard work, here's an Advanced Equip Enhancement Scroll. Are you ready for this?
I understand. This is quite a scroll, so you need to prepare mentally to accept it. Take your time.

I'm going to give you this lovely Golden Statue. All you have to do is hold it for 30 minutes and give it back. If you can keep yourself from running away with it or selling it, you pass the test. Do you think you can do that?

*Sigh*... It's Valentine's Day once again, a day for star-crossed lovers and matches made in heaven... *Sigh* Hm? Oh, don't mind me... I'm just...well....I never thought that I would be one of those love-struck dreamers, but... Look, can you help me out?\r\n
I knew I could count on you! The thing is...I'm in love with the Maple Administrator!\r\n

Seeing her dedication in running all these events over the years has finally made me go ga-um, crazy for her! I want to confess my feelings, but I've gotta do it in style, just like she runs her events. So, I need 100 Gift Wrapping Papers. \r\n
Really? Oh. I guess...our love just wan't meant to be...\r\n
Do you have all 100 Gift Wrapping Papers? I can't afford to go halfway on my love!\r\n

Thank you so much! With your help, XX, I can work up my courage, back it with a mind-blowing gift, profess my love, and live happily ever after! If you keep bringing me sets of 100, I can do this!\r\n
You don't have 100 Gift Wrapping Papers yet? Wh...what about my dream of true love?\r\n

Goodness, it seems like all of Maple World is abuzz over Valentine's Day this year. It kind of makes me wish I had someone to share it with... *Sigh* I remember when I had my crush on Gaga...he's such a sharp dresser, after all. In the end, though, I don't think we're a good match. The man I'm interested in is... Say, do you think you could help me?\r\n
You see... I'm in love with Inkwell!\r\n

Inkwell might seem too laid back, but he volunteered to help me when I was swamped with the Maple Awards. I guess his suave, understated charm and support won my heart... Now, I just need a way to tell HIM that! Chocolates might make it easier, hm? Could you bring me 100?\r\n
Maybe you're right... I'm probably better off just sticking with work.\r\n
You brought 100 Chocolates? Just for me?\r\n
Thank you so much! My preparations are going much more smoothly thanks to you, XX! If you bring me 100 more, I should be ready to profess my love in no time.\r\n
That's not 100 Chocolates, is it? Please hurry, so I can enjoy this Valentine's Day to its fullest!\r\n
I never thought Valentine's Day would mean anything to me besides cheap candy, but there's someone that I just can't get out of my mind. If I tell you about this, you gotta help me, okay?\r\n
I just can't stop thinking about Cassandra!\r\n

Haven't you seen her, gazing into her crystal ball with that coy grin of hers...not to mention her mysterious allure and incredible fashion sense. I just know that if I don't confess my feelings to her now, I'll regret it all year. Can you help me give her something that will touch her heart? If you hold onto this Melted Chocolate for 30 minutes, it will congeal into a Heart Chocolate. Bring that to me, okay?\r\n
Well...all right. I guess I can do it myself...\r\n
Do you have the Heart Chocolate yet? Love like mine can't wait forever!\r\n
This is great, but to make the gift as big as I want, I'm going to need more chocolate. Bring me as much as you can, all right?\r\n
I need that chocolate as soon as possible. My heart is bursting here!\r\n

Oh, Valentine's Day... The ONE perfect day of the year for confessing love is here! Of course, I always receive a mountain of chocolates every year, and yes, I know Inkwell is after me this year, but... Honestly, there's someone who's caught my eye. Wanna know who?\r\n
Hee hee. You see, I'm really into Gaga!\r\n

I'm all about sharp-looking, intelligent men. Who else could fit that bill than Gaga? That suit, that smile... Ooooh! Isn't he so hot? I really want to give him something this year, but the Cake Monster took all the chocolates I saved up! Can you beat that thing up and get my chocolate back?\r\n
Hmph. I thought you would care more about me than that...\r\n
Did you eliminate the Cake Monster?\r\n
Thanks! This is just what I need to finish my gift. I could use more help, if you have time...\r\n
I've seen that frosted fiend stomping around still...hurry up and beat it!\r\n
Everyone is so busy trying to prepare a gift for their crushes on Valentine's Day! I saw what you did for them, and figured you deserved something for yourself, you little Cupid.\r\n
Here, take this Valentine's Day Buff! I'll keep on giving it to you each time you help everyone that needs it. Happy Valentine's Day!\r\n
Giving up on the Maple Awards already? Well, let me know if you decide fame IS for you, after all.
Remember, I need 30 Shiny Light Bulbs.
