안녕하세요! 이번 해에도 어김없이 사랑을 고백하는 발렌타인 데이가 찾아왔어요. 저한테는 남들의 얘기인 줄만 알았는데, 이번 해에는 왠지 다른 때보다 더 특별하고 마음이 두근거리네요. 사실 조심스럽게 부탁드리고 싶은 게 있는데, 저를 도와주시겠어요?
역시 친절한 XX님이시군요! 제가 좋아하는 사람은 사실… 운영자 님이에요!
메이플의 여러 행사들을 진행하면서, 항상 성실하게 모든 일들을 적극적으로 진행해 주시는 운영자님의 모습에 마음을 빼앗겨 버렸어요. 이번 기회에 운영자님께 제 마음을 고백하고 싶은데, 그러기 위해서는 선물 포장지 100개가 필요해요.
이번 해는 슬픈 짝사랑으로 끝날 것 같군요
The whole area around town is in shambles, and half of our town's residents are missing! It's all because of these earthquakes! We gotta get to the bottom of this!
The whole area around town is in shambles, and half of our town's residents are missing! It's all because of these earthquakes! We gotta get to the bottom of this!
다들 발렌타인 데이 준비에 바쁜가봐요! 저는 선물해줄 사람이 없냐구요? 글쎄요. 사실 예전엔 샤프한 모습의 가가님께 끌렸었는데, 그분은 너무 일만 하고 연애에는 관심이 없으신 거 같아요. 사실 제가 요즘 신경이 쓰이는 분이 있는데, 저를 도와주시겠어요?
사실 제가 마음이 끌리는 사람은…벼루님이에요!
저번 레전드 어워드를 준비하면서 제가 많이 바빴었는데, 무심한 듯 하지만 세세하게 챙겨주는 모습에 반해 버린거 같아요. 하지만 제가 그분께 고백할 수 있을지.. 작은 선물과 함께 마음이라도 전해볼까 하는데 저에게 초콜릿 100개를 가져다 주시면 큰 힘이 될 거 같아요!
그래요. 전 역시 일이 체질에 더 맞나 봐요.
Any luck with the quakes?
Aliens?! Like, real, outer space travelers?! That's gonna make us so much money-- I mean, that's terrible! I'm going to get my egghead researchers on this right away!
I don't think earthquake investigations are that quick. Go to the map shown on the #b#t2430680##k.

My eggheads are telling me the alien base is causing these quakes! Something about the pillars of the world and strip mining. I only read the first paragraph of that report. It's 300 pages long! There's no time to sit around calculating! We need to find out why they came here!

The aliens roaming the fields seem to be working on something. If you could eliminate the aliens and bring back a #b#t4033189##k, we could figure out what they're doing. Actually, bring back 10. The eggheads always want extra samples.
Masteria is in danger. You must help us!

They're after our ore! Those planet-snatching, rock-loving space-jockeys! They didn't even apply for zoning permits! The ore they're taking is super-conductive. They're converting it into a power source!

That explains the earthquake too! It must be their digging machines!

\ Those ore veins are foundation of Masteria! If they dig them all out, Masteria will collapse in on itself like a big souffle! We have to stop them!
We need 10! We need a good sample of the alien #b#t4033189##k if we're going to solve this puzzler!
사랑을 고백하는 일년에 단 하루뿐인 날, 발렌타인 데이가 돌아왔어! 물론 나는 매년 산더미 같은 초콜릿을 받기만 했었지만, 그리고 이번 해에는 벼루도 나에게 초콜릿을 주고 싶어하는 눈치가 보였지만, 내가 주고 싶은 사람은 따로 있다구! 뭐? 주고싶은 사람이 누구냐구? 그건 나를 도와준다고 약속할 때만 알려 줄게.
내가 주고 싶은 사람은 사실…가가님이야!
난 샤프하고 지적인 사람이 이상형인데, 가가님은 딱 내 이상형인거 같아. 수트를 입은 멋진 모습에 선해 보이는 미소! 정말 매력적이지 않아? 가가님께 이번에는 꼭 선물을 드리고 싶은데, 내가 써야 할 초콜릿을 케이크 몬스터가 다 가져가 버렸어! 필드를 돌아다니는 케이크 몬스터를 처치해줘.
날 도와주지 않으면 내가 주고싶은 사람이 누군지 알려주지 않을거야.
고마워! 선물을 만드는데 많은 도움이 될 거 같아. 앞으로도 계속 부탁해!

You must be new! Adventuring is tough, isn't it? I'll fill you in on what to do, so listen up. #bDouble-click#k on people like me to talk. Press the #bleft and right keys#k to move. You can jump by pressing the #bleft alt key#k.\n\n#b(Do you really look like a newbie? This feels strange... Maple Island feels familiar, but wrong.)
You can jump diagonally by pressing jump with a direction key. And sometimes you have to climb ropes or ladders to get around. #bPress the up key#k to climb.
By the way, the sun's really burning me up! Would you mind borrowing a #bmirror#k from #b#p9201213##k for me? I want to see how bad I'm burned.
Press the #bQuest Notifier#k after opening the #bQuest Window#k by pressing #bQ#k to check your quest progress.
Thanks! #b#p9201213##k is on the hill doing her laundry. Her mirror looks like this: #i4031003#.\n\nOh, yeah! Just press #bQ#k if you forget what you're doing and need a reminder.

Eat the #r#t2010010##k I gave you by opening your Item Inventory and clicking the #bUse tab#k. Double-click the #t2010010# to recover some HP.
A new Explorer, eh? Want to learn how to hunt? You already know? Come on, there's no way a newbie like you would know. You don't have to lie to me. It's okay!

The Jr. Sentinel's you see are normally too powerful a monster to be here, or for you to handle. The ones you see here, however, are devoid of any power, thanks to Grendel the Really Old, the head of all magicians who sealed up their power. These are here for the sole purpose of training. Here's your task: Take one down, pick up its dropping, and go see #b#p9201193##k, who should be up there somewhere. It's that easy.

As you can see through the Minimap (#bM#k), located on the left corner of the screen, you'll see something green blink on the northeast side of the map. That's where #b#p9201193##k is. You'll run into a Jr. Sentinel on your way to seeing #b#p9201193##k. Defeat it, pick up 1 #t4000142#, then see #p2002#.
Are you the one that #p9201194# is training to hunt? He said something about you having the potential to be a great hunter. Let's see ... let's see if you've trained right.
You'll probably get to fight unsealed Tutorial Jr. Sentinels when you get stronger. \n\n#bI already fought them before...
oh, and ... when you level up, make sure to press #bS#k and check out your #bAbility Points.#k\n\nTo move on to the next map, either press #bup arrow#k in front of the portal on the right.

Huh? I don't think you have #b#t4000142##k. When you defeat Jr. Sentinel here, #t4000142# will be dropped right there on that spot. When that happens, make sure to press #rZ#k to pick up the item. Please hurry!

Hmmm ... you should have seen a small Jr. Sentinel at the bottom of the map. Maybe you missed it. All you need to do is attack it by pressing #rCtrl#k and kill it. Once you pick up the dropping, then come back to me.

Ahh...I'm getting worried...because I need to get this letter to #p9201203# fast. It's an urgent matter so I need to let him know of this ASAP. Too bad I have things to do here for a while so I won't be leaving this spot anytime soon...
If you're not too busy, could you deliver this #bletter#k to #b#p9201203##k in #b#m690000018##k? I have things to take care of here.
I'm not asking Explorers 'cause I'm lazy or anything! This is a good way for you to learn the ropes! Besides, how could I possible go that far with my fragile body?
You're gonna do it? Thank goodness. Now I can breathe a sigh of relief. Here's my letter, and please get this to the town chief that's at #b#m690000018##k.

...You seek strength, do you? To strive for power is admirable, but I wonder...do you have true Ambition?

Ambition means chasing your goals in earnest, no matter how difficult the road becomes. It has nothing to do with pride, or empty boasts of 'I eliminated this monster' or 'I defeated 200 of that monster.' But true Ambition, if you have it, will earn the respect of others without you having to say a word.
I've been hunting the nearby monsters. I get little from it, but I see it as my duty to help the defenseless townsfolk... Why don't you join me in this effort and help the people of #m102000000#?

Yes, good. Eliminate some of the #r#o4230103#s#k? They've made travel to and from town difficult for most people... The people of #m102000000# would be appreciative if you eliminated about #r200#k of them.
Hmm... So, you do lack Ambition, after all...

You've taken care of the #o4230103#s? Ah... You do have some honor. I don't dislike people like you. Continue to stand at the forefront of battle, focused only on self-improvement...that is what it means to have true Ambition.
Have you not eliminated 200 #o4230103#s yet? Do not place words before action.
Here to ask about my beard, are you? Haha, I get that all the time. So, let me tell you what I tell the rest: my beard is a mark of my Ambition.

Don't believe me? It's true. This beard is testimony to my history and my experience. Without the kind of Ambition that carried me through harder times, I'd never have the strength of character to grow such a full and manly beard.

When I was younger, I was well known throughout #m211000000# for my strength. Not even Scadur could match me as a hunter. It's through the hunt that I learned the true meaning of Ambition. Why don't you try a little hunting yourself?
Back in the day, I always used to hunt #r#o6130103#s#k and #r#o6230200#s#k. Why don't you try hunting 300 of each?
How can you say no to this beard?
Hm, not too bad. You look a little more grown up than before. Of course, you haven't sprouted a magnificent beard like mine, but you can't have it all. Hahaha!
The beard is symbolic, of course. You understand, right? If you do, then you already know true Ambition.
Still tracking the #r#o6130103#s#k and #r#o6230200#s#k, eh? Hmm... It's really not that hard of a task.

You've a question about the King? I'll tell you what I can, if it means the King may return to his former self. Ah, long ago...the old King had great Ambition, though it was different from the twisted Ambition he has now.
He was a great warrior, but more importantly, he had Ambition that came from his dignity. Aye, he had the dignity of a King. We were loyal to him, every one of us, because of that dignity.
You have the same sort of dignity, yourself. It comes from the Ambition you've developed over the course of your journey. I believe you might be able to defeat the #rTransformed King#k.
Ambition can also be used to cause terror and destruction. This is not true Ambition, however. True Ambition comes from a selfless heart... When you defeat him, you will understand.
What good is your power, then? Power that is not used for good is itself a tool of evil...
True Ambition, true leadership... It only comes from fighting for others. Never forget that.
Please defeat the #rTransformed King#k. I have full faith in you.
Oh, looking to learn about Insight? Haha, of course you'd want to talk to me, of course. I'm not called #p1101007# for nothing! Why, I can see through anything with these eyes of mine!

What's that look for? Don't believe me? Hmph, how disappointing! Fine, I'll prove myself to you. How about this...I'll share with you secrets about the other Chief Knights. But you can't tell anyone! I can trust you, right?

Then...what happened?#l\n#k
According to Perzen, they succeeded in sealing the Black Mage.\r\n#L0##bOh. Where I come from...#l\n#k
Stop! Your world is our future. Knowing our future might change things for the worse... Right now, we need people to help explore and develop this place. Would you be willing to help us?
Thank you. Most of the young people are working outside of the camp, so Perzen is working on his Barrier Stone alone. Please see if he needs help.
I see. Return if you are inclined to help.
Athena Pierce sent you, yes? I have been waiting for you.
You can find Perzen next to the Barrier Stone on the right side of Altaire Camp.

My, my, don't you look familiar! Oh, but don't worry. Your secret's safe with me. No need to excite everyone here at the camp, eh?\r\n#L0##bSure, sure. But I have to ask... Who is Kao? Everyone talks like they know me...#l\n#k
Kao's one of the fine folks who ended up here with us. You two look just alike. Kao's quite popular, so don't go ruining the reputation, all right?\r\n#L0##bSo...where is Kao?#l\n#k

Well, that's the funny part. Kao disappeared suddenly, and then you showed up. I'm sure nothing suspicious happened, though. You look trustworthy. Just like Kao!\r\n#L0##b(You want to ask more, but maybe it's better not to...)#l\n#k
Would you help me?

The Barrier Stone protects the camp from dark energy. There's a LOT of dark energy, though, so my barrier's getting weaker every day. I can reinforce the barrier with life energy from the monsters attacking us. Fight fire with fire, right? Get me 50 Forest Stones from the monsters in this forest, and we're set.
Sure, sure. I know you'll help eventually. Just have to wait until you're in the right mood, right?
Did you bring them?
Thank you so much. Your help has assured the safety of the whole camp. For today, anyway...
Please bring me 50 Forest Stones. They're the extra-evil stones.
Oh...stressful situations like this make me crave something sweet! But to calm down, I need something sour! Can you help me?

I became friends with a fairy named Ellin some time ago. She's one of the original inhabitants of this forest.\r\nI think she could get me some fresh fruit! Something sweet AND sour, to satisfy my cravings! I need to work on this machine, so could you go talk to her on my behalf? She should be in #r#e#m300030100##k#n.
Hmm, you busy now?
(Gotta save the forest...) What's up?
Please hurry and ask Ellin where I can get some sweet and sour fruit! You can find Ellin in #e#m300030100##n.
Yuris? Oh, the machine-crazy one? What about her? What? Friends? With who? We just met once... Please... I have no time for this. Can't you see how worried I am?
All right, all right. I will get you some sweet and sour fruit... But you have to help me with something.
I will give you some fruit if you bring me 50 Moss Snail Shells.
Nothing's free...especially in a place like this. You want fruit, I want help.
Did you bring me 50 Moss Snail Shells?
Hey, you came through. Give me a moment, then... That's such a weird craving...
Where are the #t4000436#s? You can find Moss Snail Shells at #r#m300010000##k or on the #r#m300030000##k.\r\n
Here, take these. You don't want to know how I get them out here. And be sure to give them to Yuris!
Oh, and please...tell Yuris to mind her own business. We're not friends like that.
What, now you're busy all of a sudden? I thought Yuris needed this fruit!
Oh man...I'm so close to getting this Airship off the ground!\r\n#L0##bHey! I brought you some sweet and sour fruit.#l\n#k

Oh, yeah, that... I remember. I don't feel like eating it now, but I'll save it. Might want it later. Thanks anyway.\r\n#L0##b(What?! She wanted that so bad! What's her deal...?) Where will you go once the Airship is ready? #l\n#k
Who cares? Away. More importantly, this ship needs a new name. Got any ideas?\r\n#L0##bHmm... Falcon? Enterprise? Pearl?#l\n#k

Ha! Those are terrible! I'm going to go with my original idea. We'll call her the "Kyrin". Isn't that pretty? When my daughter is born, I'm going to name her Kyrin. Oh...don't tell anyone I'm pregnant, though.
Anyway, thanks for the fruit. I should finish up the Airship. Oh, and go see #eAthena Pierce#n in the Camp Conference Room. She was looking for you.
Take these to Yuris now. Don't lose 'em!
I want it! Want it so bad! Something juicy, sour, and sweet!
You lost the fruit I gave you, didn't you? I told you, it's really hard to get! You're lucky I found it. Take this to Yuris. And DON'T LOSE IT!!
Hey there, Kao. You can do me a favor, right?

As you know, my duty is to keep Altaire Camp safe from the lurking horrors of this place, so I can't leave my post. However, I am in need of #bTree Trunks#k. Maybe about #b100#k of them? You will run into a lot of Tree Rods in #m300020000# and #m300020100#, so could you shop some up for me?
Kao, you've changed! How could you turn down my request? I'm...I'm hurt.
Did you bring the #t4000438#s?
Wow, this is great, Kao. Thank you so much! I will take these to Loha. Maybe now she'll get off my back about helping out... Ahem, thanks again!
You know what a #t4000438# looks like, right? Get them from the woodsy monsters in #m300020000# and #m300020100#.
It rains too much in this forest. If the dragons hadn't attacked the Airship when they did...\r\n#L0##bYou look worried.#l\n#k
I'm wondering if we should start looking for another place to move to, such as a plain with better weather... Ephenia worries me, too.\r\n#L0##bWho's Ephenia?#l\n#k
Ephenia is the ruler of the fairies in this forest. She's...not that friendly to us, you know. Oh...I guess you don't know. Well, forget I said anything. Anyway, do you think you can do me a favor?

As you know, the young people are searching for new land for us to move to. One of them, #b#eShadrion#k#n, should be in the #rSouthern Region of Mossy Tree Forest#k. Could you go find him and find out what the situation there is?
I guess this isn't a good time for you. Honestly, though, it isn't a good time for any of us.
Kao! Over here! What brought you all the way out here?
Oh, Athena Pierce sent you... I see. Give me a moment.
Go talk to #b#eShadrion#k#n in the #rSouthern Region of Mossy Tree Forest#k.

The South Forest is endless. I keep exploring...and it just keeps going. If we were to settle here, it would take years to cut down enough trees. Or we could just live in treehouses. Ha! Imagine that...\r\n#L0##bI see. I'll let Athena Pierce know.#l\n#k

Hey, before you go, could you give me a hand? The forest is crawling with Tree Rods, and they've kinda got me backed into a corner. I wanted Lohd to help me, but since he's not around...\r\n#L0##bLohd? Who's that?#l\n#k
He's the most powerful... Oh, come on, Kao. Don't act like you don't know who Lohd is. Anyway, are you willing to help?
Okay, just take out some of the Tree Rods that show up in #m300020000# and #m300020100#. If you can eliminate #b#e150 Tree Rods#k#n and tell #eAthena Pierce#n about this place, we should be set.
Really? Wow. Thanks for nothing.

So, the forest just keeps going. Where can we live, where we'd be safe from all the dangers of this place?
Eliminate 150 Tree Rods and report back to Athena Pierce.
How's the situation in South Forest? I'm sure Shadrion could use some help. He's still young.
I am curious about the land past the Mushroom Forest. That was the first place we thought of settling. I sent #b#eLohd#n#k to check the area again, so please see how he's doing.

Not bad! But remember, you must be confident in yourself. Depend on your own strength. I respect Athena Pierce for what she's done, but we disagree on many things. You cannot follow someone blindly...you must remain true to your own convictions. I will go tell Athena Pierce myself, so you do what you must.

Then get going. Babies are very, very demanding, but she never complains. Sion is like an angel.

Hurry, hurry! Tell Perzen about Crawls with Balrog's symptoms, and ask how to reduce the fever.

Please wait a moment.
Hurry! Ask Perzen about how to bring down his fever.

Crawls with Balrog has a great future ahead of him. A little thing like a fever will not interfere with that.\r\n#L0##bHow could you know about the future, unless... Are you from the future too?!#l\n#k

Poison can be neutralized with another poison. Please eliminate Mossy Mushrooms and bring me #b#e50 #t4000437##n#k items. You should be find a lot of Mossy Mushrooms at #m300020200# or #m300020210#.
Looks like mushroom poison was the cause. We'll need an antidote to cure him, and I'll need your help to make it.
Did you gather the antidote ingredients?
Good job, but I'll have to save these for another time. Crawls with Balrog beat out the fever on his own! If you are still worried about him, go see for yourself.
You haven't found the #bBlack Mushroom Spores#k yet? I need 50 of them for a potent antidote! You can find many Mossy Mushrooms at #m300020200# and #m300020210#.
Crawls with Balrog is okay now. He really is an amazing child, beating his fever like that. Thank you for helping us.
Since you're so kind...could I ask for one more favor?

My soulmate Rius is exploring the western part of Mossy Tree Forest. He used to contact me every day, but I haven't heard from him in several days. I'm sure he's fine, out there in the dark forest...with all the monsters...but I'm a little nervous. Please find him and see if he's okay.
I see...you must be quite busy, helping everyone around camp.
Kao! Long time no see. What bring you to these parts? I thought you liked bumming around the camp! Ha!
Hmm? Oh, Sion was worried about me, huh? Yeah, I got kinda caught up in my work...
I heard he was headed to the western side of Mossy Tree Forest. Please find #eRius#n for me.
Initially, I thought it would be great to use these enchanted stones to protect the camp. However...I became very curious of how life energy gets trapped inside them.
I got so caught up in studying #o5250001# that I completely forgot about contacting Sion. Shame on me!
Kao, do you think you could help me out?
Thanks. Bring me the Rubble from those Stone Bugs. With enough of them, I think I can figure out how these stones really work.
Look, this is important. If you don't want to do it for me...do it for Sion.
Did you bring me 100 #t4000439# items? Serious research calls for a lot of materials!

This should be enough. And don't worry, I'll be taking these back to Altaire Camp, and studying them there. Don't want to worry Sion any more than I already have, huh? Thanks for your help, Kao. You should get back to camp, too.
I really need that #t4000439#, Kao. I just know there's some secret locked away inside...
Thanks for your help earlier. I set aside that antidote in case anyone else decides to poison themselves on local cooking. I have a new task I need your help with, though.
You know what happened to Duru, right? After being wounded by a boar, he's been helping out by managing our supplies.

I honestly didn't believe him when he first told us about the giant boar, but since then, others claim to have seen it! #eKanderune#n at #b#e#m300010400##n#k has been investigating, and I'd like you to find out what he's learned. If such a thing really exists, we must do something about it!
Are you too busy right now? You don't look busy...
Hello, Kao. What brings you all the way here? Boulder Mountain is quite dangerous, you know.
Go see #eKanderune#n at #b#e#m300010400##n#k.

So...even Loha has heard the rumors about that giant boar. I haven't seen it myself, but I've tracked an unusually large animal to the caves near here. I just need to figure out which one is its den...
Since you came all the way here, could you help me out?
With so many people getting injured by the boars around here, I'd like you to clear some of them out. It's nothing excessive...maybe 100 or so? I know you must be busy.
You come all this way, and you just... Look, think it over, and come back, okay?
A #o5250002# is a dangerous foe...have you cleared them out?
I had heard that you changed quite a bit... Looks like I heard right. Good job. I'll finish off the rest of the beasts here. Oh, there's one more thing...
You just need to #b#eeliminate 100 #o5250002##n#k monsters. That's all!
With fewer monsters roaming about, I managed to find the cave where that giant boar lurks. It looks like Boulder Mountain Cave is connected to deeper, small caves. That's where you'll find that boar.
For the safety of the camp, we must defeat that beast. Kao, I could really use your help with this.
All right. Enter the cave, eliminate #o5250004#, the giant boar, and take out 150 #o5250003# monsters as well. Once Chao is put down, I fear the other boars may become more hostile. Be careful!
Oh. Maybe you haven't changed as much as I thought, Kao. It's a shame Lohd isn't here...he would take care of this in a flash...
Did you take care of Chao?
Is that its horn? Goodness, Kao...you really are something! You've just ensured the safety of everyone that travels these mountains. Good work!

Eliminate #e#b150 #o5250003##n#k monsters and #e#b#o5250004##n#k, the giant boar, inside the cave and bring back #r#eChao's Tusk#n#k as a proof. Be careful! The monsters in the cave are extremely dangerous.
You need to get this done before someone else gets hurt. Eliminate 150 #o5250003# monsters and the giant boar.
We have to tell the whole camp that Chao has been defeated! Kao, go give them the good news!
Oh, you'll probably need the proof that you defeated Chao. Take #t4000674# to Loha.
Are you getting shy? You did an amazing thing! Tell the world!
What did Kanderune say? Did he learn anything about that giant monster?
What?! You defeated that monster? You?! Kao...you are AMAZING! I feel like you just grew up before my eyes. Great job, Kao...really great job.
Oh yeah, Yuris was looking for you. You should go see her.
Take #t4000674# to Loha and tell her she can relax a little, now that Chao has been defeated. You did a great job, Kao.
Did you learn anything about that giant monster at the Boulder Mountain Cave? Or did you forget all about it? Geez, Kao...Go ask Kanderune again.
Slow down, Kao. You dropped the tusk, didn't you? I know you're excited, but you need to be more careful. Now, take this to Loha.
Hello! Enjoying the weather? I'm not! This humidity wreaks havoc on my machines! I hate it!
I have a favor to ask of you, which I just KNOW you will do. After all, we are FRIENDS, aren't we?

So I made this communication device. I know how it looks, but it's pretty handy! Anyway, I wanted to give this to my good friend Ellin. That way, whenever I'm craving more fruit, I can contact her directly! Since this is a special gift, I want to make sure it's the right color. Could you ask Ellin what color she wants it to be?
Wait, but...no...you were supposed to say 'sure, no problem.'
What is it now? Did you come to help protect the forest?
I thought I TOLD you, I'm not so buddy-buddy with Yuris! And who cares about the color of some stupid mechanical junk! I have more important things to worry about.
Please go ask Ellin what color she prefers. She's in the Deep Fairy Forest.
Look, I can't deal with this myself. Tell Athena Pierce! Her people are in just as much danger!
Not too long ago, I saw a minion of the Black Mage here in the Fairy Forest. I knew the fairies had been acting weird lately, but I had no idea...

Anyways, I followed that minion and overheard that Lady Ephenia has joined forces with the Black Mage! She's planning to contaminate Victoria Island with poison, and eradicate all life here. Athena Pierce needs to know about this...and she needs to stop Lady Ephenia.
This is very very important. Talk to me again when your heart is ready.
Ah, welcome. Thank you for helping us look for a new settlement earlier. But what brings you here this time? You don't look so well...
You have something that you must tell me?
No...that's...impossible... She's the queen of fairies... How could she agree to such a thing?!
Give Athena Pierce this news NOW! We don't have a second to lose!
Then...what I saw back then was...
No...that's impossible. Fairies have little love for humans, but they have no reason to join forces with the Black Mage.
I'll need a proof. As a fairy myself, I can't belive such an accusation so easily.
No...that can't be...
Does it really make sense that Ephenia, the lady of the forest, has joined the Black Mage?
Lady Athena Pierce, you have noticed that Ephenia has changed as well, yes? Please...do not deny your feelings.
You already knew that the poison was spreading from the Fairy Forest, didn't you? Morever, Jackie's story from her escape matches what Ellin said.
I'm not the greatest prophet, but my prophecy also matches the current situation...\nIt's time to make a decision. If you cannot do this, I'll have to take a stand.
Do you really think Ephenia joined the Black Mage...?
We must stop the poison from spreading through the forest. I humbly ask for your aid. You will help us, will you not?
Go to the Fairy Forest, and #b#eeliminate 150 #o5250005# monsters and 150 #o5250006# monsters#n#k. We cannot allow them to spread their poison further.
Please...this is the time for action, not reflection.
How did it go?
Thank you. It was an unfortunate necessity, but the poison's spread should be limited. However, there is still an important task to be done.
It pains me to say it, but those fairies need to be dealt with. We cannot allow their poison to spread.
This will be the last favor we ask of you.\nPlease go to the #r#eQueen's Hiding Place#n#k within the Fairy Forest and #b#edefeat Ephenia#n#k. We cannot allow her to lead Victoria Island into ruin.
Beware, for Ephenia has a potent charm ability. I will pray for your success... Our future lies in your hands.
I know it will be difficult, but this is necessary to safeguard our future. Let me know when you are ready.
Have you dealt with Ephenia?
You have our thanks. The camp is safe, and Athena Pierce is very grateful for everything you have done. Please go see her at the Camp Conference Room. She wishes to give you a token of her gratitude.
Ephenia is a dangerous opponent. The longer you wait, the tougher this becomes.
We are sincerely grateful for your aid. I hope this helps in your future adventures, even if just a little. Please, take care of yourself...
I pray your future will be filled with blessings...
I'll give you the #i1142363:# #t1142363# title whenever you wish.
Heeey! If it isn't my good friend... uh, Donald? No. Josephine! No. Krang? Is that right? I'm sure it's close enough. Ya gotta help me out, Krang!\r\n
You heard about this new theme park that's opening up? Fantasy Theme World?

It's another one of those Fantasy-brand parks, like the one in Malaysia, the one with all the bears! Who needs that many bears in one place?! Makes me sick, I tell ya. Bear sick. But, as a fellow theme-parker, I feel obliged to send a little gift to the owner

I could do it myself, of course, but... don't make me come up with an excuse, Krang. Just take the #b#ecable car#n#k on the right side of #e#rLudibrium#k#n over to Fantasy Theme World and deliver this plant-thing I found in the dumpst... flower shop.
What?! I am Spiegelmann! How could you possibly say no to this face?!
Welcome... to #eFantasy Theme World#n! The only place in Maple World where dreams come true. I see you've brought a gift!
I'm guessing these are from Spiegelmann. They reek of jealousy and pomade.
Why are you not taking those to Madame Ming? Take the #b#ecable car#n#k at the right end of #e#rLudibrium#k#n to get to Fantasy Theme World.
Welcome to Fantasy Theme World. Did you come empty-handed? For shame.
Ah, come on! This is DEFINITELY not a trap! Just take these to Madame Ming in Fantasy Theme World. The cable car will take you right there.\n
We're holding a wonderful event to celebrate the grand opening of Fantasy Theme World. Won't you be a doll and participate?
Oh, splendid! I've hidden 5 Treasury Notes around the park that entitle the holder to one wonderful item from the Fantasy Enterprises treasuries.
You're more than welcome to leave my park immediately if you're going to be a sourpuss.
Did you find all five notes?
You've really given the park a thorough looking at. Enjoy a little gift.
Fantasy Theme World is the newest branch in our exciting line of Fantasy amusementoriums! Search every nook and cranny. You wouldn't want to miss the fun.
Do you want a tip on how to have even more fun in my wonderful Fantasy Theme World?

Fantasy Theme World is home to three wonderful new attractions. THRILL in the spook-filled halls of the Ghostacular Mansion! SPILL through the air with the heart-pounding Gyro Drop! And CHILL your nerves with the northern winds of The Viking! Visit all three,
You're going to regreeeeeet it.
Did you enjoy the Big 3?
What do you mean, the rides were weird? You just don't understand my vision! Take this souvenir and go away.
Ah, you still haven't enjoyed the Big 3? Remember, it's the Ghostacular Mansion, the Gyro Drop, and The Viking.
Ah, you still haven't enjoyed the Big 3? Remember, it's the Ghostacular Mansion, the Gyro Drop, and The Viking.
Welcome to the Ghostacular Mansion! I'm giving away stamps to those brave enough to get to the end of the mansion. Do you have it in you?
Don't have a heart attack!
Too scared?
Did you have fun in the Ghostacular Mansion?
Hey, look at you! You made it through the Ghostacular Mansion. Don't look at me for that stamp. I'll tell everybody you made it through.
I'll be waiting for you at the Gyro Drop. Take your time!
Don't be scared. You probably won't lose any limbs. Just go in there, have some fun, and hang out with 50 Ghosts and Rataculas, okay?
Did you take a look?
You say you found some white fur up there? I'll send somebody to fix it up. At least the view was cool, right?

I've got your Gyro Drop stamp right here. I mean, you can't SEE it, but the other employees can. \nI'll be waiting for you at the Viking! It's made for level 125 patrons and up, so don't go chickening out!
Do you think you could take a run to the top of the Gyro Drop and see if something's causing trouble up there?
Do you think you could take a run to the top of the Gyro Drop and see if something's causing trouble up there?
There's nothing better than The Viking if you want to test your mettle! Want to give it a whirl?
Now get in there, and smash up 350 Bearic the Whites! The Viking's not exactly a ride, so much as it is a big pit full of monsters. HAVE FUN!
Ya scared?
Did you have fun? That took a lot longer that I expected. Maybe you need to train more.
I Viking stamped you! Don't worry about where the stamp actually IS.\nHey, you went through all of the Big 3! Go to Madame Ming for your prize.
You're not going to have fun if you don't hunt down 350 Bearic the Whites. I say that, because there's really nothing else to do.
What do you wa... er... How can I help you?\r\n#L0##bDo I have to buy tickets to enter the park?#l\n#k
I dunno, maybe, or maybe you can just help me out, and we can have a little deal.

I'm glad we can make a deal, because this #eCreeper Scarlion#n from #b#m223010000##k took the #e#rtickets#k#n while I was... doing things that weren't sleeping. I really can't afford to lose this job. Can you help?
You sure? The ticket prices are CRAZY steep.
(Whispering) Hey!
(Whispering) Don't let Madame Ming hear you. Did you find the tickets?
Whew! That lady scares me to the bone. \nOkay, I'll let you in and out of the park as much as you want for now.\n
Hurry up before Madame Ming notices! You have to bring back all 20 tickets!
Hey, help me out with another favor...

So, we got these new hats in, and I was putting them out and I saw a #bRatacula#k and I freaked out and now all the hats are gone. All #r100#k of them! Can you go get them back from the Ghostacular Mansion in #b#m223010100##k? Those things creep me out!
You're gonna ditch me?! I thought we had a deal!
Please tell me you found the hats.
Whew! Could you maybe like, put those out for me, and sell them? \nI suppose I SHOULD wash these at least once. Ugh... \nI wonder if that #eTown Mascot#n is having more fun in #e#b#m223010200##k#n.
Did you find all 100 hats yet? The #eRataculas#n in the #bFunky Station <2>#k should have them.
Hey, can I help you out? No photos...
Oh, hey, we've met in Edelstein, right? I, uh... I had to take a part-time job. Got some sweet new parts on order before I saw my paycheck... Actually, can you help me out?\r\n

The monsters in this park are crazier than Bella. I didn't come prepared for that! I've been stuck on this dang merry-go-round for hours! How about you clear up about 200 of them so I can get to work?

If you're willing to help, I'll give you some #bDelicious Thanksgiving Food#k in return and also give you a chance to try your luck at winning a #bPet Turkey#k. What do you say?

Good choice! Have you heard about the #bTurkeys#k that have recently been appearing around the #kTowns and Mini-Dungeons#k? Well, what I need are some #bYellow Turkey Eggs#k from those #bTurkeys#k. Don't need too many, just #b5#k, that's all.
You should know that #bTurkeys#k are only available around Thanksgiving, so don't miss this special opportunity! If you change your mind, come back and see me.

Where are the #b5 Yellow Turkey Eggs#k I'd asked you for? Go to any #rarea surrounding Henesys, Kerning City, Perion, Ellinia or Orbis, or any Mini-Dungeon#k to find the #bTurkeys#k. Press the #eW#n key to see the World Map if you need help locating the Mini-Dungeons. Put your cursor on the map to see the areas marked #bMini-Dungeon#k. Try to find the dungeon that matches your level.
