Did you find a way out?
Please find a way to escape these roots!
Please hurry, we need to get out of here.
I'm not sure I can make it through the exit.\r\n#L0##bWhat should we do?#l\n#k
I brought this scroll with me. It's supposed to take me to a nearby town, but it doesn't work for me. Can you take a look?\r\n
Here's the scroll.
I really can't go out that exit... I'm not lying! Please!
Hurry now. Look for the exit.
Ah, #b#h0##k! You came back!
Thank you. The World Tree is safe thanks to your efforts.
The Maple Alliance has decided to present you with the #r<World Tree Guardian>#k title and medal.

The World Tree is safe now, but the threat is still very much there. The culprit who sealed the World Tree in the first place is attempting to #rresurrect the seal guardians#k. Victoria Island will be in big trouble if that happens.
Your continued attention to this matter is both important and expected. The fate of Maple World rests on your shoulders.
Remove the seal on the World Tree and escort it to Ereve.
Did you get rid of the first seal?
The suffocating darkness seems to have subsided a little.
Can you handle the seal guardian beyond the clock door?
Can you handle the seal guardian behind the teapot door?
I should be more prepared this time. The energy here is strong...
The seal won't go anywhere unless we remove the seal guardians.
Did you get rid of the second seal?
The darkness seems less oppressive than before.
Can you handle the seal guardian behind the teapot door?
Can you take care of the seal guardian beyond the crown door?
The door with the crown is radiating evil! Better not let my guard down...
The seal won't go anywhere unless we remove the seal guardians.
Did you get rid of the third seal?
The darkness is so weak now!
Only one seal guardian is left. I feel an incomparable power coming from it. You won't stand a chance under #rlevel 110#k. Talk to me again when you are strong enough.
Can you handle the seal guardian behind the crown door?
Only the final seal remains. Get rid of the seal guardian beyond the dragon door.
Feels like this is going to be tough. Better get ready!
We're so close to removing the seal! We can do it!
Can you handle the seal guardian behind the dragon door?
The spell on the East Garden will only be broken if you get rid of #bVon Bon#k on #r<Normal Mode>#k.
Be sure to get rid of every single #b#o7120110##k in the East Garden on #r<Normal Mode>#k.
The tea party will open at the tea table on #r<Normal Mode>#k.
Heya. I'm Tricky. Pierre's my owner.
I think Pierre is just the greatest owner a cat could have. That's why I'm going to let you get him a present!
Go collect 20 #rBurning Tails#k, meow. You can get them from #b#b#o7120110##k or #b#b#o7120112##k creatures at East, West, and South Garden.
Yeah, the Imps serve master Pierre. But a few less Imps won't hurt his feelings.
You're going to toss away this once-in-a-lifetime chance to present a gift to Pierre? You're nuts.
Did you collect all the Burning Tails?
Not done yet? What's taking so long?
Hoink! I take care of the Crimson Queen's South Garden.
The Queen really loves red roses, but only blue and purple roses bloom in the South Garden. Will ya help me out?
The Queen will be so happy when she sees all the red roses in the garden!
I think you could just paint #b5#k of the blue or purple roses red for today.
The Queen may eat me alive if she gets upset. You shouldn't ignore a lady's request...
Be thorough with your painting!
Oink oink oink! (Thank you!)
The #bCrimson Queen#k is in Castle Crimson on #r<Normal Mode>#k.
W-who's there? Have you come to rescue me?
I am Laviola, daughter of the lizard tribe chief. I was chosen to be the sacrifice that kept our people safe from our god's wrath, but I didn't think it would be like this.
I just can't get out of here with all those #b#o7120111##k monsters prowling the North Garden. Please help me.
It's not that I don't believe in you! I just need your conviction to get out of here. Please help.
I should be able to escape if you take out 5 #b#o7120111##k monsters in the North Garden on #r<Normal Mode>#k.
Vellum will eat me alive if he finds me here!
Thank you, you saved my life.
Hurry, Vellum's coming!
You saved our tribe. We will never forget your sacrifice!
Defeat #bVellum#k on #r<Normal Mode>#k in the Abyssal Cave.

One...two...three...four...and five! Remember, these are made with #rmagical powers#k which will fade after #rone day#k. The boss in Ereve told me to give you 5 of these every day, so come find me okay? Good luck!
You don't need them? Okay, suit yourself!

Hey! I just received a request from Ereve to give you 5 #b#i4033611##t4033611##k items. You're aware that you're going to need these keys to get to where the Lutavian seal guardians are, right? You want them?

These scallywags are hungry no matter how much I feed them. But do they hire me an assistant? No! Ungrateful pirates... I oughtta just get some nobody like YOU to cook for them! Heeey... You know your way around a dutch oven?
Take the #bDimensional Mirror#k to Tangyoon's Kitchen if you've got the guts interested! Let's show these pirates what a FEAST looks like.
No interest in cooking? I'll just tell the pirates to go drink sea water then.
No time for training sessions, rookie! I need you on that cutting board right away!
Let me know when you want to cook. You just need to be in #ba party of 3, level 60 - 90#k. I don't want any kids losing their fingers in my kitchen.
You want to move up the ladder, you need MY approval. Show me you can cook 3 dishes without using the wrong ingredients, and we'll talk about your career opportunities.
I want you to cook something so good that it satisfies Mr. Chomps.
Cooking isn't just about eating, it's also about making people happy.
Not bad. I'm sure the Nautilus crew would be happy if you joined up... yeah, I guess that ain't gonna happen. Here's your medal.
Nothing better than a good plate of grub.
You must cook at least 3 dishes without any wrong ingredients to be considered worth my time.
Where am I? Where is the princess? Where is the Mist Cutter?!
Shattered... Nobunaga destroyed everything I had.
This is no time for moping. I must remember my training. There was the battle, and a flash of light...
And now this unfamiliar place. I do not see the walls of Honnou-ji, the fires of battle. I swear there was a voice. I'd better look around.
No. I will stay here and return to my thoughts.
Are you all right?You were out for a minute there.You look surprised.Your injuries seemed light. Give yourself a moment to become acclimated, and you will be fine.
We have christened our base Momijigaoka. It is hidden by a copse of scarlet maple trees. I will take you there.
Do you need more time to recover? I won't rush you.
This is Momijigaoka. Many great leaders preside within its walls. Ask around, and you will find the path to your destiny.
I will take my leave. I'm glad I found another survivor in this strange land. I wish you well.
Oh, if you have lost your weapon, take one of mine. I know they are not of noble standing, but they will serve you well.
Momijigaoka is at the top of that hill.
You will find our temporary training grounds lacking, but worthy enough for your purposes.
Perhaps you can prove your usefulness by defeating 10 of my Floateyes in Training Dojo 1.
You returned. That's a start.
You need more training if you're to be of any substantial help towards my cause.
I thought I had made myself clear. Ten Floateye familiars in the Training Dojo. Go.
I don't care how tired you are right now. Move on to the next lesson.
Go to the next Training Dojo and battle the stronger familiars, Onieyes. And do try to look presentable while you do it.
You returned. That's a start.
I'd heard you were a master of Battoujutsu, but you haven't shown me anything to be impressed with. You should continue your training.
I would like you to destroy... 20 of the Onieyes. Bring me their heads if you'd like.
I was hoping you would have higher standards for yourself. Weren't you named the Bladed Falcon? Such a moniker is undeserved, from what I have seen. Nonetheless, let us continue.
Take down 30 of the Conjureyes stationed in Training Dojo 3. They will be much stronger. Perhaps you can join them, if you prove yourself!
You returned. That's a start.
I suppose you're proud of yourself, having turned my training dummies into horse feed. You will understand that I don't have the resources to continue your journey of self-improvement.
Take time to prepare for the battles ahead. The enemies will be fighting back this time.
Are the Conjureyes in Training Dojo 3 too strong for you? I should not be surprised...
The daimyo was good enough to provide me a training ground, despite their feeble resources, but my powers still elude me. The realities of this new world are maddening. Will I ever find my strength?
I must collect my thoughts. And perhaps find a good daikon-infused hot pot.
My first mission must be to regain my power. Only then will I be of use to the alliance.
Only then will I be able to save the princess. I cannot imagine the fear and strain she must be experiencing, but I will revisit it upon Nobunaga tenfold.
Before any of that, I must locate the scoundrel Oda Nobunaga. The people of this strange land can not possibly be prepared for the evil he will bring.
The road ahead is long and winding, frought with peril, as it must be. I will free Momijigaoka of its troubles, then I will deal with the demon king.
I am fairly confident in Momijigaoka's secrecy. Oda's troops seem to stumble about with no orders, and a fog cannot be dispelled by a fan.
However, I am troubled by the presence of this four diamond crest. It must mean...
Oh honorable samurai, will you dispatch a troop of Oda Scouts? I know there is a small force to the east. Certainly your trusty blade will not falter.
The crest is that of Takeda Shingen, but I cannot comprehend why. Takeda's men are prideful and strong. They would not surrender to the Oda clan. They must be in danger!
Takeda's soldiers will be nearby. I will get to the bottom of this mystery.
Takeda-Daimyo may be stuck on Maple Hill Road 2. Please help him.
The falcon returns. You have no doubt realized that Oda knows where we are. His men are practically swarming the eastern reaches of our base.
It is only a matter of time before he descends upon Momijigaoka, and we will not last the day if that happens.
We must act first. To wait for luck is to wait for death. Will you grace us with your sword?
I knew you would be willing to acquiese. Go to Momijigahara 1, and take care of the enemy forces there.
We cannot wait for the enemy to establish a base. This mission is critical to our success.
How goes the attack? Do not tarry.
The enemy will only grow stronger. We cannot afford for any one man to under-perform.
Hurry to Momijigahara 1 and take care of the Oda Soldiers. I would like fifty, but feel free to dispatch more if you are able.
The situation looks bleak. Enemy numbers seem to swell at rates we can never hope to match. Even with you, Yukimura, and Kanetsugu on our side, we are hopelessly outnumbered.
I must confer with the other clan leaders. For now, you would be best served out on the battlefield. If you are up to it...
We need a radical change in our battle strategy. Picking off Oda's weakest men isn't going to get us anywhere.
For now, reduce the enemy's numbers at Momijigahara 1. I will work on our plan.
We have wasted enough time with Oda's minions. We must move deeper into enemy territory, and strike at the heart of his leadership structure.
Venture into Momijigahara 2 and defeat a squadron of Oda Warriors.
The enemy scrambles like boar from a brush fire. I may lead us to victory yet.
You must break their command structure, sellsword! Go to Momijigahara 2 and hunt down 50 Oda Warriors.
My plan was a success. If I am not the next Shogun, it will only be because I am too effective. You continue your assault. I will tell you when we are done thinning their ranks.
You must break their command structure, sellsword! Go to Momijigahara 2 and hunt down 50 Oda Warriors.
Is... is that #b#p9130010##k?
Hayato, you seem to have adjusted to your new surroundings, though you look more spindly than usual. Do not neglect your training. Nobunaga will not be a pushover.

Challenging the Oda clan head-on with our army would be suicide. Nobunaga has shown an impressive knowledge of this world in his short time here. It would be like facing a day of sport with improper diet.

So, I have something to ask of you. Leave us. Go, and take in this new world. Find allies, find power. Find out what they eat to stay trim... everything is pigs and fat here. Only then will you truly be of any use in the coming battle.
Yes! You'll find a town with inhabitants to the south of Momijigahara. The enemy has most likely created a pathway to get to it.
Let me know when you're prepared to depart. And do not tell the others. They will not understand.
Are you almost ready? No one here has juiced in days. I think I feel my skin flaking off!
Welcome to the Mushroom Shrine. How can I help you? Oh! Please don't step on that spot. I just swept it.
Go down on the hill to the east. There's a town south of Momijigahara. It will be relatively easy to find with Oda's men tromping all about.
I must pay a visit to this Victoria Island, to learn the lay of the land. Afterwards, I can investigate Ereve, Edelstein, and Ossyria. Perhaps one of them will have a decent millet stew.

The shrine maiden suggested Athena Pierce in Henesys. I am uncertain what a pelican is, or what I should trust it above a well-made atakebune, but I am a foreigner here. I will go to this Six Path Crossway, and do what I must to reach Victoria Island.
Hey you! I need to talk to you.
Your clothing is bizarre, but you seem to have skill and that's what I need right now. Can you help me with these blasted monsters?
I thought I smelled the heady perfume of chivalry on you. I want your help with a little golem... situation.
Exit east from Henesys, then go south through Windflower Forest until you come upon the Golem's Temple. The Dark Stone Golems will be a good test of your abilities.
I suppose that sword is just for decoration.
You don't appear to have had your brain smashed in, so that's a plus. I hope you'll forgive me for asking you to keep up the good work...
Would you be kind enough to go back and clear out more of the Dark Stone Golems? They reproduce so fast.
If you're willing to keep up your rock-smashing ways, the Mixed Golems are really doing a number on the temple's architecture. Would you mind?
I applaud your bravery. The Mixed Golems are a whole lot meaner than the Dark Stone Golems, but I'm sure you won't lose any limbs.
I suppose that sword is just for decoration.
We're getting a little closer to having our temple back. Keep it up!
Can you take care of 100 Mixed Golems in Golem's Temple 2? Exit east from Henesys and head south to Windflower Forest to enter the Golem's Temple.
Now, you've managed to not die a few times, which makes me very optimistic that you won't be completely annihilated by the golems I want you to fight next, but... are you sure you're up to it?
The Icy Mixed Golems in Golem's Temple 3 are... are you going to hate me if I say they're cold-hearted?
I suppose that sword is just for decoration.
I see a few dents in your lacquer, but nothing debilitating. Well done!
Can you take care of 100 Icy Mixed Golems in Golem's Temple 3? Exit east from Henesys and head south to Windflower Forest to enter the Golem's Temple.
This will be my last favor, I promise. You've still got a little fire in your heart, don't you?
Good, because it's about to get hot! Flaming Mixed Golem hot! There is no way we can clean off all the scorch marks while they're bumbling around Golem's Temple 4.
Extinguish those rocky beasts, and the temple will finally return to what it was before... the place where everybody went to throw away their old magical rocks.
I suppose that sword is just for decoration.

I'm sooo glad to have the temple back under control. I've got like twenty bags of old enchanted rocks just waiting for a good home. I'm certain these won't fall to the dark side and become evil golems like the rest of them.
Can you take care of 100 Flaming Mixed Golems in Golem's Temple 4? Exit east from Henesys and head south to Windflower Forest to enter the Golem's Temple.
Talk to Grendel the Really Old in the Ellinia Magic Library. You can take the Regular Taxi to get there quickly.
Who might you be?

Some guy... or girl... Some person in armor like yours met with the Black Wings in the little building near the Golem's Temple Entrance. I can't believe they're using our temple for their stupid evil!
Akechi Mitsuhide wants help from the Black Wings? Nobunaga's ambitions have grown. He must seek to control both Japan and this new land.
Nobunaga must be curbed like the rabid dog he is. I must return to the blue-eyed archer and tell her of the danger she is in.
Who are you?
Did you take care of all the Star Pixies? They're in Cloud Park I.
The monsters just get onrier and onrier as you go into the park. I bet that's where your little clues will be, hehehe!
Why don't you try to be a grown-up and hunt Lunar Pixies this time?
Lunar Pixies like to hang out at the Cloud Park III and IV. I'm sure they'll have what you're looking for.
How's the Lunar Pixie hunt coming along? Go check out Cloud Park III and IV to find them.
The people you spoke of are getting deeper into the park. You'd better head all the way in!
Your best bet would be to find a bunch of Luster Pixies. They'll have to have something useful.
I really do hope you find the clues this time. Not like last time.
How's the Luster Pixie hunt coming along? Take a look around Cloud Park V to find them.
The ones that you're looking for are probably in the Garden of Darkness.
Just as Athena Pierce feared, Nobunaga has allied himself with the nefarious Black Wings...
What could he be scheming that he would require their power? Perhaps his forces are weaker than I thought.
The Oda clan was never one to rely on diluting their own power with underhanded deals. It seems unlike him.
And using dark magic to cause chaos in Maple World... where is the rigid, structured warlord I have battled in the past?
All this thinking is making me hungry. I'd best return to Momijigaoka... maybe that nice fellow Kenshin will have me over for dinner.
Actually, I should stop by Orbis and check on Yukimori. A familiar face might do him well.
Hello, young samurai. Have you eaten? Are you prepared for the news?
Shingen is the man with the plan, so listen to what he has to say.
Honnou-ji is north of Momijigahara 2. I will await you there.
#b#p9130080##k is preparing a battalion east of the Honnou-ji walls. Knowing him, you will need to be there to supervise.
The Mouri dogs were right. Security in this area is lax as can be.
The Eastern wing of the temple is right over this wall. Prove yourself worthy of your name, Bladed Falcon. The princess needs you.
I shall remain here to protect the escape route. Be cautious. It is still possible that the frail security is a trap.
I don't see Princess Sakuno by your side.
Have you spoken with Princess Sakuno yet?
I don't recognize your markings. What brings you to Mu Lung?
Go to Mu Lung and locate Tae Sang.
A suspicious group of people wearing odd clothing passed through when I was on my way to the Peach Farm. They sort of looked like you actually, frilly and ancient.
I didn't pay much attention. I was inspecting the trees. The blossoms are particularly vibrant this time of year. Talk to Tae Soo. He's the farmer around here.
Exit Mu Lung and head west to get to the Peach Farm. Tae Soo looks after the farm, so he should be easy to find. And be sure to marvel at the trees!
I see. Well, it looks like you're on your own.
What a healthy tree! This year's harvest should be excellent. Oh! hello. You were looking for me?
Head west from Mu Lung to reach the Peach Farm. Tae Soo should be there.
Suspicious people? Yes, I did see them. It was right around the time Tae Sang came to inspect the trees.
The Peach Monkeys and Reindeer were in a tizzy when that group passed through. I've never seen them so worked up. I fear they're becoming a threat to the farm.
If they don't settle down, this year's harvest will be ruined. They must learn discipline! Can you teach them?
Give them a good wallop! I want to see some monkey fur on you when you return.
I guess you're making the right decision. These majestic trees DO deserve to die at the hands of a feral monkey colony, don't they?
How's the Peach Monkey and Reindeer situation?
That was brilliant. They're as docile as can be now. This year will bring a magnificent harvest after all.
What motivation do your enemies have for ruining my precious peaches? There must be something for them to gain.
Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.
Perhaps they were just envious of the peachy aroma wafting through the air. Not everyone can whip up a killer harvest like this, you know.
Why not ask Do Gong in Mu Lung Temple? He keeps an eye on everything in Mu Lung.
Mu Lung Temple is to the right of Mu Lung. Do Gong is the wisest of the masters. I'd be surprised if he doesn't have something worthwhile to say.
You're better off asking Do Gong for more info. I'm just a simple peach man.
No need to speak. I already know what you seek.
Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.

You don't know this, but Maple World's energy flows strongest in Mu Lung. You could say Mu Lung is the piece that holds the whole puzzle together. When evil is afoot in Mu Lung, you can be sure that Maple World's energy is the goal.
The people you speak of are after Mu Lung's energy, no doubt. If they were near the Peach Farm, they will soon be upon the forest, where the energy flows strongest. You must follow them.
There's a forest deep within the farm; a forest teeming with monsters warped by Mu Lung's energy. The Sage Cats are particularly nasty, but I would like you to hunt them.
Success rarely follows apathy.
Did you find what you were looking for?
So they planned to use Mu Lung's energy to control the monsters. But why?
Two hundred Sage Cats. It will take that many to reveal the full truth, I am sure of it. Find them in the Virtuous Forest near the Peach Farm.
They must be headed for the Goblin Forest. It's a real energy sinkhole.
Investigate the Goblin Forest to discover the true intentions of these menaces. I can assure you they're up to no good.
The goblins have dug in deep within the Virtuous Forest. The lord of the area is powerful, so you would do well to prepare yourself and move with caution.
Success rarely follows apathy.
How could Akechi Mitsuhide have orchestrated this invasion? That silver-haired devil could be more of a threat than Nobunaga...
I must send word to Momijigaoka.
You should investigate the Goblin Forest and see for yourself. It's in the Virtuous Forest.
Dear loyal subject, I received your report. You have uncovered a plot none could predict. Akechi Mitsuhide is a traitor to us all, even Nobunaga.
However, it matters little whether Mitsuhide works of his own accord. Both he and Nobunaga must be stopped.
Do not let this new development faze your resolve. You must keep your focus to unravel the enemy's plan.
Haruaki and I will deal with the confusion in Momijigaoka. You focus on saving the world. - Sakuno
The princess is right. It doesn't matter who I face. All evil must be banished from Maple World.
I won't let the problems of my people infect Maple World. I have no choice but to take down anyone who gets in my way...
I will restore the Matsuyama clan if I must tear down the pillars of the sky to do so.
But where do I start?
Welcome back. We can talk when you've had a chance to get your bearings.
Rendezvous with Hashiba Hideyoshi outside the Eastern Honnou-ji wall.
Nobody else seems to be following us.
There are still enemies everywhere.
Everyone is finally here. Let's get started.
Shingen-Daimyo is summoning the alliance.
Hayato, I've got a job for you.
The time to fight has come. My hair is standing on-end in anticipation! I need you at Honnou-ji. Head north from Momijigaoka 2. Go.
You've been a real help to our alliance, the kind of soldier I dream about when I'm taking my mighty-naps. That's why I planned this whole thing around you.

I'm sending you in first. You're going to go in to the temple, stir up a little chaos, and help my boys get inside without too much of a struggle. It's going to be dangerous, even for the Bladed Falcon, but I think you can pull it off. You in?
Excellent! I might as well spread tidings of victory right now! Best of luck to you. Charge through the Honnou-ji main gates and go wild!
What happened, did somebody cut off your power? I knew I couldn't trust those camp barbers...
How fares the battle?
You did all right out there. I saw those yellow-bellied Oda dogs flying over the hillside to get away from you.
Defeat 200 of the Oda Army's low-ranking warriors and secure an entry path for the allies.
The real fight starts here. I'm sending in my best men to begin the assault, and I want you alongside them. Ready for some action?
Fight your way deeper into the battlefield and take care of the samurai captains. I can't wait to watch them scrambling around without their bosses.
Could you take care of 300 Oda Samurai Captains? It's the only way to win a battle.
What happened, did somebody cut off your power? I knew I couldn't trust those camp barbers...
How fares the battle?
See that? The enemies are scattering! Their base is crumbling! I can feel the winds of victory ruffling my mustache. Today is the day I feel like a king!
Disrupt the enemy chain of command by defeating 300 Oda Samurai Captains.
There's only one thing left to do. Defeat Takigawa Kazumasu and reclaim Honnou-ji. The enemy resistance should fall apart without Kazumasu.
You should have no problem with Kazumasu, right?
Kazumasu is hiding in Honnou-ji Temple. He knows the end is coming. Don't let him down!
What happened, did somebody cut off your power? I knew I couldn't trust those camp barbers...
Enemy general Takigawa Kazumasu is in the temple. Defeat him and end this battle!
Hey Hayato, you're looking tough as a wild boar. I've got to tell you, I've been impressed with the gumption you've got. You're a real stand-up kind of samurai.

I just, aw geez do I hate this kind of mushy nonsense. Look, I got you something. Don't get all emotional on me and start expecting 'handshakes' or 'pleasantries'. It's just because you did a good job. Only, it's not exactly done.
I need to find the right harness for the job, and frankly I don't feel comfortable asking another warrior for their clothing sizes. Are you up for a little shopping?
No samurai ever turns down presents. It's the first line in the bushido code book... I think. Go talk to Kikkawa Motoharu and see if you can get fitted for a nice harness.
I promise it's a great gift, it's just not a complete great gift.
Did you find a worthy harness?
Wow, that is one fine harness you got! Those red details would really light up my mane... maybe I'll go get one for myself later.
Oh, I'm forgetting myself. I, lord of all that is mighty and strong, present you with the Onikageh, the greatest horse in all of the Takeda Cavalry. It is a symbol of our proud heritage.
You've treated us like family. You've fought for us, you've bled for us, now you will ride like us. May Onikageh serve you well.
A rider must use the best quality items available. Otherwise, you put your life on the line.
Your battoujutsu is stronger than ever. I hope you'll still be at our side when the days of battle come again.
I've got something for your hard work.
My father once used this harness. If Shingen-Daimyo has provided you with Onikageh, this harness is the only equipment suitable for such a noble steed.
May the glory of the Matsuyama clan live once more.
Hayato, a scout found the pieces of a blade in the forest. I believe it was yours, so I took the liberty of having it reforged. I have also had your original armor recreated.
You have been of great service to my reign. It is only fitting to return you to your former status. Please cherish these gifts.
You carry too much already. Please relieve yourself of some items.
You've grown very strong in this new world, Hayato. I am pleased to see my faith in you was well-placed.
Your equipment is ready. The blacksmiths have been working around the clock. I hope you will treasure them, as we treasure your service.
Who're you to be wandering around our kingdom? We need true warriors to save us from the penguin menace! Get outta here if you aren't going to help.
Kanna! Get your legs about you, we have work to do. Oh that's right... You don't know what happened yet. So pay attention. I won't repeat this. Repeat: I will NOT repeat this.
As you know, there was a raid at Honnou-ji. By the time the alliance showed up, it was a scene of utter chaos. Nobunaga was fighting someone, but we couldn't tell who amid the madness.

You stopped Nobunaga's ritual. I hope you remember that part because it was fine work on your part. Good job. But we were shocked to find that it was Akechi Mitsuhide's men fighting Oda's army. They revolted from within, turned on their own kind like animals! Akechi must have wanted all of Japan for himself. Still, it takes some sort of warrior's spirit to stand up to Nobunaga like that. I'm not without respect for the man.

The fierce battle raged for hours. Akechi leapt from soldier to soldier, felling enemies much larger than himself with ease. I think I saw him cut a man in half! But before he could reach Nobunaga, a sizzling beam of light erupted from Honnou-ji Temple and something extraordinary happened.

The light enveloped us, seeped right into our minds, and everything went dark. When color returned to the world, we found ourselves in this unfamiliar place filled with strange creatures. Even the physics are different here.
It's a lot to process. Try to let it sink in.
The light scattered everyone. The others are all over the place. Some may even be in a different time for all I know.

I got here few days ago, and I found you while I was searching for Kenshin-Daimyo. If she's hurt, I'll probably just give up. I don't want to live in a world where I can't protect her. A world without Master Kenshin is like a world without air.

Anyway, I'm glad you landed so close by. We're going to need your help. Those of us who arrived first set up a base on top of this hill. Why don't you head up and get accustomed to this place? Let me show you where it is.
You will find our temporary training grounds lacking, but worthy enough for your purposes.
Perhaps you can prove your usefulness by defeating 10 of my Floateyes in the Training Dojo 1.
You returned. That's a start.
You need more training if you're to be of any substantial help towards my cause.
I thought I had made myself clear. Ten Floateyes in the Training Dojo. Go.
I don't care how tired you are right now. Move on to the next lesson.
Go to the next Training Dojo and battle the stronger familiars, the Onieyes. And do try to look presentable while you do it.
You returned. That's a start.
Ah, your body. It's fine... I mean it's looking better... I mean you look strong.
I would like you to destroy... 20 of the Onieyes. Bring me their heads if you'd like.

What I mean to say is that you've improved. But not enough! Someone who trained with the great Onmyouji, Haruaki, should have higher standards. Continue your training until your body is perfect like Master Kenshin's. Oh, that's not what I meant... Just get stronger.
Take down 30 of the Conjureyes stationed in Training Dojo 3. They will be much stronger. Perhaps you can join them, if you prove yourself!
You returned. That's a start.
I suppose you're proud of yourself, having turned my training dummies into horse feed. You will understand that I don't have the resources to continue your journey of self-improvement.
Take time to prepare for the battles ahead. The enemies will be fighting back this time.
Are the Conjureyes in Training Dojo 3 too strong for? I should not be surprised...
Did you strike fear in the hearts of the enemy?
Oh, wow! You actually survived! That should keep Momijigaoka safe for now. Oda's Army must not be used to this new world either.
Good work. Return to Momijigaoka and take a break.
Those Scout's Reports contain some interesting info. You should take a look.

Maple Hill Road 1 is crawling with Oda Scouts. I need you to take out 30 of them and grab 10 Scout's Reports, but I understand if you don't want to engage the enemy yet. Not everyone is disciplined enough to adapt to a new world so quickly.
Are the scouts too much for you?
I thought you'd be ready for at least 50 scouts by now. Perhaps not?
Motonari requests your presence.
Kanna, our base has been exposed to the enemy. It seems your paltry efforts weren't enough.
Nobunaga's full army has yet to arrive, but he has plenty of strong soldiers stationed just outside Momijigaoka . Once his main force arrives, he will sweep over Momijigaoka like a tempest.
We will not wait for the enemy to attack. We will deal the first strike and turn the tides of battle before Nobunaga has the chance. This is your task, Kanna.
Good. Prepare yourself.
We cannot wait for the enemy to establish a base. This mission is critical to our success.
Let me know when you're ready.
It seemed unlikely that lowly soldiers would be entrusted with such energy. If anyone in Oda's army possesses this aura, it'll be a high-ranking officer.
You must make your way farther into the enemy camp. Try hunting down some warriors in Momijigahara 2.
Isn't that Tsuchimikado?
Tsuchimikado must have something to say.

Kanna! How's the new world treating you? You're looking a little...out of sorts. Have you not been eating your vegetables? How do you expect to rescue Princess Sakuno and defeat Oda Nobunaga if you don't eat your vegetables?

It's obvious that we don't have the strength to take on Nobunaga in a head-on battle. We don't even know where to find organic supplies around here. I don't think any of our soldiers are even getting five servings of vegetables. But Nobunaga's troops are so healthy. It's like they landed right on a garden or something.

If Oda's Army can get used to this place, we can too. Are you up for a little journey? You can travel the world, regain your strength, make some powerful allies, and find out how we can set up a produce supply route!
Yes! You'll find a town with inhabitants to the south of Momijigahara. The enemy has most likely created a pathway to get to it.
This mission is absolutely essential! Let me know when you're ready to depart.
Are you almost ready? No one here has juiced in days. I think I feel my skin flaking off!
Welcome to the Mushroom Shrine. How can I help you? Oh! Please don't step on that spot. I just swept it.
Start by going down the hill to the east. Apparently there's a town with inhabitants to the south of #b#m807020100##k.The enemy scouts had to mark the location. It should be easy to find.

I should remember these three names: Maple World, Victoria Island, and Ossyria. My immediate destination is Ereve, which is accessible from the Victoria Island. I can take my time investigating Ossyria and Edelstein afterwards.

Just like Kino Konoko suggested, I should go to Ereve and talk to Empress Cygnus. I need to take the World Tour Guide from the western side of the Mushroom Shrine to get to Henesys, then the plane to Ereve from the Six Path Crossway.
Huh? Who are you? You came to see the Empress?
Go find Hersha in Ellinia on Victoria Island.
Hmph. Think you can fool me? If you're really here on Neinheart's request, you'll have no problem producing evidence.
Did you lose #b#t4033273##k?
Here, don't lose it again.

To the north of Ellinia lies the Cursed Forest. It's quite a creepy place, kind of perfect for creepers like you actually. Of course there are dangerous monsters there, but we haven't bothered them and they haven't bothered us. Until now.
The monsters have started attacking people lately. It's almost as if someone's poking the hornet's nest... You don't know anything about that, right?

I'm afraid your word isn't quite enough. I'll need to see that you do honest work before I believe a stranger like you had nothing to do with our monsters' sudden change of heart. You look like you can take care of yourself, so why not head to Lupin Forest, the entrance to the Cursed Forest, and take care of some Lupins for me.
Head north from Ellinia to get to the Cursed Forest. I have my eyes on you, and I can see funny business from miles away, so don't try anything!
No? I knew it! You must be one of the conspirators!
Did you get rid of all the Lupins? You're not just pretending to do the mission while you plan your nasty schemes are you?
Not bad. 50 Lupins is a decent haul. Don't think for one second that proving your strength will prove your innocence though! I've got a few more tricks up my sleeve.
Still not done with the Lupins? Head north from Ellinia and you'll reach the Cursed Forest. Lupin Forest is the entrance to the Cursed Forest.

You'll find Zombie Lupins if you venture deeper into the Cursed Forest. Since you share many traits with the Zombie Lupins, creepiness being the most obvious, I think it's only fitting that you destroy them.
Can you stomp out 50 Zombie Lupins? They're a lot tougher than the Lupins you fought before, so you might want to admit your wrongdoings before you risk your life. The choice is yours.
Let's see how skilled you really are. Zombie Lupins are in Head Lupin's Nest, Dark Tree Forest, and Polluted Tree, all deep within the Lupin Forest.
No? I knew it! You must be one of the conspirators!
Did you get rid of all the Zombie Lupins? Or have you been thinking about confessing your guilt?
So you even managed to take out the head of the Lupins. Slightly impressive. I'm beginning to think I was wrong about you.
Okay, I'll allow one quick break. Then we'll discuss the next mission.
Still not done? Go to Head Lupin's Nest, Dark Tree Forest, and Polluted Tree, deep within the Lupin Forest to find more Zombie Lupins.

This is the final mission, your last chance to give up and admit that you're plotting something with our monsters! There are disgusting witches known as Maladies in the deepest part of the Cursed Forest. They don't like bright places, but even they have emerged to harass our fine citizens. Discipline 50 of them if you are truly pure of heart.
You can find Maladies in the deepest part of the Cursed Forest: Forest of Evil Energy 1 and 2.
No? I knew it! You must be one of the conspirators!
Still not done? You can find Maladies in the deepest part of the Cursed Forest: Forest of Evil Energy 1 and 2.
Did you finish all of the missions in #b#m101000000##k? I haven't heard anything from #b#p1103003##k.

Welcome to Ereve. Neinheart told me everything. It can't be easy to carry out Neinheart's grueling requests on a strange world, but you've put all of our minds at ease. Thank you for all of your hard work.
According to reports from Hersha and others, Nobunaga and his army were behind the monster disturbances. Some reports even say that Nobunaga conspires to ally with the nefarious Black Wings.
This means that you're no longer the only one in danger now. My knights and other powerful forces in Maple World will need to help stop Oda and the Black Wings.

I already got in touch with Athena Pierce in Henesys, and I'll reach out to other heroes all around Maple World. I'll ask for full cooperation from your people as well. Would you deliver the message to them?
I hope that we can work together to bring peace to Maple World and your people.
The Empress is with Shinsoo over to the right. Please mind your manners.
You should hurry to Ereve.
Hm? I haven't seen you before. What do you want with me?

You're not having problems with hunting Jr. Yetis and Dark Jr. Yetis are you? Jr. Yetis are in Watch Out for Icy Path I while Dark Jr. Yetis are in Watch Out for Icy Path II. They're very manageable if you've got a hint of fighting skill.
The monsters that live deeper in the snowfields are more violent. The cold has twisted them. Perhaps you can find what you're looking for there?
Try hunting some Pepes and Dark Pepes in the Cold FIeld. 100 of each should give you a good idea of what you'll find.
I do hope you find what you're looking for this time.

You're not having problems with hunting Jr. Yetis and Dark Jr. Yetis are you? Jr. Yetis are in Watch Out for Icy Path I while Dark Jr. Yetis are in Watch Out for Icy Path II. They're very manageable if you've got a hint of fighting skill.
The strange people were sighted deep in the snowfield. Investigate the wilder areas and you may still find traces.
You'll find Ice Valley deep in the Cold Field. It's a place of punishing, icy winds that can freeze a man solid. Continue your investigations by hunting Hectors and White Fangs there.
I do hope you find what you're looking for this time.
How's the hunt coming along? You don't look very exhausted. Hectors and White Fangs are in Ice Valley 1 and 2.
The suspicious people that you're looking for were in Ice Valley II. You better hurry.
Shingen is the man with the plan, so listen to what he has to say.
Hello, Kanna. My hair warned me of your approach.

#b#p9130093##k is already at the eastern Honnou-ji walls. Honnou-ji is to the north of Momijigara 2. Unfortunately, my hair can't teleport you right now. The dry air here seems to have sapped some of its power, so you're stuck walking. My apologies.
Shingen was right. I snooped around the area while you were on your way and the security here is quite lacking.

We're so close to the eastern temple wing. I almost feel sorry for the enemy. But Master Kenshin's first rule is no mercy, so Oda's Army will see none from us! Kanna, I leave the rescue of the princess to you.
I shall remain here to protect the escape route. Be cautious. It is still possible that the frail security is a trap.
I don't see Princess Sakuno by your side.
Have you spoken with Princess Sakuno yet?
I don't recognize your markings. What brings you to Mu Lung?
Go to Mu Lung and locate Tae Sang.
A suspicious group of people wearing odd clothing passed through when I was on my way to the Peach Farm. They sort of looked like you actually, frilly and ancient.
I didn't pay much attention. I was inspecting the trees. The blossoms are particularly vibrant this time of year. Talk to Tae Soo. He's the farmer around here.
Exit Mu Lung and head west to get to the Peach Farm. Tae Soo looks after the farm, so he should be easy to find. And be sure to marvel at the trees!
I see. Well, it looks like you're on your own.
What a healthy tree! This year's harvest should be excellent. Oh! hello. You were looking for me?
Head west from Mu Lung to reach the Peach Farm. Tae Soo should be there.
Suspicious people? Yes, I did see them. It was right around the time Tae Sang came to inspect the trees.
The Peach Monkeys and Reindeer were in a tizzy when that group passed through. I've never seen them so worked up. I fear they're becoming a threat to the farm.
If they don't settle down, this year's harvest will be ruined. They must learn discipline! Can you teach them?
Give them a good wallop! I want to see some monkey fur on you when you return.
I guess you're making the right decision. These majestic trees DO deserve to die at the hands of a feral monkey colony, don't they?
How's the Peach Monkey and Reindeer situation?
That was brilliant. They're as docile as can be now. This year will bring a magnificent harvest after all.
What motivation do your enemies have for ruining my precious peaches? There must be something for them to gain.
Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.
Perhaps they were just envious of the peachy aroma wafting through the air. Not everyone can whip up a killer harvest like this, you know.
Why not ask Do Gong in Mu Lung Temple? He keeps an eye on everything in Mu Lung.
Mu Lung Temple is to the right of Mu Lung. Do Gong is the wisest of the masters. I'd be surprised if he doesn't have something worthwhile to say.
You're better off asking Do Gong for more info. I'm just a simple peach man.
No need to speak. I already know what you seek.
Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.

You don't know this, but Maple World's energy flows strongest in Mu Lung. You could say Mu Lung is the piece that holds the whole puzzle together. When evil is afoot in Mu Lung, you can be sure that Maple World's energy is the goal.
The people you speak of are after Mu Lung's energy, no doubt. If they were near the Peach Farm, they will soon be upon the forest, where the energy flows strongest. You must follow them.
There's a forest deep within the farm; a forest teeming with monsters warped by Mu Lung's energy. The Sage Cats are particularly nasty, but I would like you to hunt them.
Success rarely follows apathy.
Did you find what you were looking for?
So they planned to use Mu Lung's energy to control the monsters. But why?
Two hundred Sage Cats. It will take that many to reveal the full truth, I am sure of it. Find them in the Virtuous Forest near the Peach Farm.
They must be headed for the Goblin Forest. It's a real energy sinkhole.
Investigate the Goblin Forest to discover the true intentions of these menaces. I can assure you they're up to no good.
The goblins have dug in deep within the Virtuous Forest. The lord of the area is powerful, so you would do well to prepare yourself and move with caution.
Success rarely follows apathy.
Absurd! Akechi Mitsuhide was behind all of this, not Nobunaga. That unsightly demon is dangerous enough on his own.
I must report my findings to Momijigaoka. Time to send a letter.
You should investigate the Goblin Forest and see for yourself. It's in the Virtuous Forest.
Dear loyal subject, I received your report. You have uncovered a plot none could predict. Akechi Mitsuhide is a traitor to us all, even Nobunaga.
However, it matters little whether Mitsuhide works of his own accord. Both he and Nobunaga must be stopped.
Do not let this new development faze your resolve. You must keep your focus to unravel the enemy's plan.
Haruaki and I will deal with the confusion in Momijigaoka. You focus on saving the world. - Sakuno
The princess is right. It doesn't matter who I face. All evil must be banished from Maple World.
I won't let the problems of my people infect Maple World. I have no choice but to take down anyone who gets in my way...
Then, I shall return to Japan.
But where do I start?
Welcome back. We can talk after you catch your breath.
Rendezvous with Hashiba Hideyoshi outside the Eastern Honnou-ji wall.
Nobody else seems to be following us.
There are still enemies everywhere.
Everyone is finally here. Let's get started.
Shingen has summoned all the alliance members.
Kanna, I have a favor to ask of you.
The time to fight has come. My hair is standing on-end in anticipation! I need you at Honnou-ji. Head north from Momijigaoka 2. Go.
You've accomplished so much. Without you here in Maple World, I don't know that we'd even stand a chance. That's why I can only trust you with the job at hand.
I want you to charge ahead of our forces and create a diversion. Only you are strong enough to lead our entry. Will you do it?
Excellent! I might as well spread tidings of victory right now! Best of luck to you. Charge through the Honnou-ji main gates and go wild!
You're the only one for the job. Your rejection is a blow straight to the hair.
I trust you're having fun?
Splendid performance! And not a hair out of place! How do you do it?
Defeat 200 of the Oda Army's low-ranking warriors and secure an entry path for the allies.

Thanks to your ingenious display of combat skills, our forces slipped onto the battlefield with no casualties. Now for the real battle! If we concentrate our efforts, we can ensure a swift victory. Will you lend your hand again?
Fight your way deeper into the battlefield and take care of the samurai captains. I can't wait to watch them scrambling around without their bosses.
Take care of 300 Oda Samurai Captains. I know it sounds like a lot, but I've seen you fight. It should be nothing for you!
Please, Kanna. We need you now more than ever. You're giving me gray hairs.
Taking a quick rest? We're all rooting for you, Kanna.
See that? The enemies are scattering! Their base is crumbling! I can feel the winds of victory ruffling my mustache. Today is the day I feel like a king!
Disrupt the enemy chain of command by defeating 300 Oda Samurai Captains.
There's only one thing left to do. Defeat Takigawa Kazumasu and reclaim Honnou-ji. The enemy resistance should fall apart without Kazumasu.
Kazumasu is yours, Kanna. Do your worst.
Kazumasu is hiding in Honnou-ji Temple. He knows the end is coming. Don't let him down!
We don't have much time. Please think of the ramifications.
Enemy general Takigawa Kazumasu is in the temple. Defeat him and end this battle!
Welcome, Kanna. I'm so proud to have you as a friend.
It seems like you've recovered all of your former strength and then some! You're quite the one person army.
This is for you. It was once my mother's, and it belongs in the hands of a great Onmyouji.
My mother, Izumono Kata, was a descendant of Abeno Seimei. She was a powerful Onmyouji, and I know she would have wanted you to have this charm.
You've already brought the Matsuyama clan much honor. Your exploits will not go unnoticed.
Since you're always fighting on my behalf, even in foreign lands, I#b personally crafted something#k for you. This should fit just like your old outfit. Do you like it?
Kanna, you make me proud. It is an honor to offer my services to such a great Onmyouji. I can craft outfits and weapons for you now.
Please take this outfit and fan. I used an ancient technique to craft them.
You're back. Do you need a second to catch your breath?
Hello, Hayato.
Go to #b#m211041700##k in the El Nath Mountains and report to #b#p9130087##k to learn the details.
Hello, Kanna.
Go to #b#m211041700##k in the El Nath Mountains and report to #b#p9130087##k to learn the details.
I've been waiting for you.
Go to #b#m211041700##k in the El Nath Mountains and report to #b#p9130087##k to learn the details.
How is your mission going?
I see. So you lost #b#t2430824##k. It would have proven most useful for gathering intel on Nobunaga. What's done is done.
I actually had few of them transcribed, so you can have one.
They're incredibly hard to come by. Please be careful from now on.
#b#e#h0##k#n! Did we have an appointment? Oh, you'd like to hear about the new and improved way to #r#eenhance equipment#k#n with scrolls and Potential items?
Whew, I was worried I'd forgotten to include this appointment in my day planner.
All right, listen closely. This info should make things a little easier.

Click the #e#rEnhancement button#k#n below to open your Enhancement window. From there, you can see and use the scrolls and Potential items you have available.\r\n#i3800499#\r\nYou can also #e#rdouble-click directly on scrolls#k#n to use them on equipment.

You can Combine scrolls in the Enhancement window's #e#rCombination tab#k#n to create #e#rnew scrolls#k#n!\nAnd don't forget! You can also use the existing Legendary Spirit skill to Enhance your stuff!
That concludes my explanation. Have a great day! I swear, we did NOT have a meeting scheduled... Oh, are you still here? Did I mention how amazing you look today?
But I haven't told you anything yet! Let me know when you're ready to listen.
Do you think purple contacts would be too much, too soon? Perhaps you're right. I'll stick with my current baby blues. Oh, what's that you have there? May I take a look?
Ah, how quaint...
If you don't show me the item, I can't assist you. Well, perhaps I could, but I would only be eighty percent certain of my accuracy.
This is a remnant of Mystic Energy from the clone you eliminated, manifested into physical form. I'm not sure you'd be interested in the technical explanation, so I'll just say...

Use the item! There's a small chance it will transform into an item that belonged to that boss. Almost as small as the Maple World Idol crew finally accepting me this year, but we must never give up hope.

You can trade these Sengoku Coins in for some very fancy items to help with your... monster exploding? I don't really know what you do. Clear seven party quests five times each, then #rclick the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen#k or visit the #rEvent Guide#k.\r\n

Clear the following party quests five times during the Sengoku Festival: Remnant of the Goddess, Lord Pirate, Romeo and Juliet, Forest of Poison Haze, Dragon Rider, Resurrection of the Hoblin King, and Kenta in Danger. Do this, and you will win #b40 #t4310054#s#k AND #ra special medal.\r\n
Clear seven party quests five times each, then #rclick the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen#k or visit the #rEvent Guide#k to get your Sengoku Coins! \r\n
Don't miss out on easy coins!\r\n
Give it your all! \r\n
Give it your all! \r\n
今まで我が家門のためにお励みくださり、感謝します。その礼として贈り物を準備しました。どうか受け取ってください。
イベント期間中にモウリ家のために働いてくだされば、このように贈り物を用意します。参考にしてください。

イベント期間中にモウリ家のために働いてくだされば、このように贈り物を用意します。参考にしてください。
今まで我が家門のためにお励みくださり、感謝します。その礼として贈り物を準備しました。どうか受け取ってください。
貴殿のおかげで、我が家門のことと本能寺の様々なことが簡単に解決されたそうです。今までのことに誠に感謝しています。
#h0#のおかげで、こちらでの問題も簡単に解決されたようだ。これはお礼だ。弱小だが…一応受け取ってくれ。

#h0#のおかげで、こちらでの問題も簡単に解決されたようだ。これはお礼だ。弱小だが…一応受け取ってくれ。

#h0#のおかげで、こちらでの問題も簡単に解決されたようだ。これはお礼だ。弱小だが…一応受け取ってくれ。
今までご苦労だったな。#h0#。これからもよろしく。
はは！最近#h0#殿のおかげで色んな問題が見事に解決される。ここモミジヶ丘でもそなたの名を知る者たちがふえているぞ。お礼の意味で#b#i4310054##t4310054##kをいくつか準備しているのだ。近頃はこれが有用と聞いたな。

Where's that hat I gave you? I want to see how cool you look. Open your inventory and equip it!

Whoa, Kinu didn't bore you to death? Well, it still can't have been too good. We'd best do a little physical work to get your heart pumping.
You can use the portal on the left side of the map to move to the training area. Follow the signs! I'll be there.
Are you sure? I was sure you'd be ready for a good workout.

You have to touch the flag to finish this test. Don't half-heart it!
Yo! I'm Kizan. I'm gonna teach you to get rough-and-tumble.\r\n
First off, you need to know how to attack. The most basic swing is with the #rCtrl key#k. Go defeat #b3 #o9300730##k monsters in the Drill Hall and show me that you can handle it.\n

I-I am...
Empress! How many times must I scold you for wandering about? Who is this?!
Be calm, Neinheart, I don't think I'm in any danger. We may be welcoming #h0# to the Cygnus Knights very soon, so say hello.\n
So you used Elemental Slash to take down those monsters? Not bad... Not bad at all. That's how I do it.

I'm too busy to be explaining all day long. If you wanna pass this test, you'd better listen up! You need to find boxes on the map and destroy them with a Regular Attack. Beat up any monsters that show up, and pick up a Proof of Exam with the Z key. Bring me back 3, and I'll let ya pass.
#h0#, you're looking tougher. I think I'll let you be a Knight-in-Training.\r\nGo see the Empress at the center of Ereve. Just follow the arrows.
Prove me right, #h0#.
Not feeling tough enough? Relax, even the best knights started where you are today. Just work hard, and don't let me catch you slacking off.
#h0#, you look well. I am proud to see you take on this position.
I don't want you rush into battle yet, though. You will continue your training, yes?\r\nGo see Neinheart. He will tell you what to do.
You shouldn't keep the Empress waiting. Head to the center of Ereve, #bright next to #p1101001##k. Follow the arrows.

The others have most likely been too forgiving of your shortcomings, but I will be honest with you. You will not be able to carry out the missions I require.

However, I never waste a valuable asset. You will assist the more senior members until you are ready to stand on your own. Go find #b10 Boogies#k at the #bCrossroads of Ereve#k, and do whatever she requires.
Press the Q key to open your quest info window. Select your destination and press the Enable Navigation button to be guided to 10 Boogies.
Are you going to just stand there dumbfounded? You are a Knight-in-Training. Act like it.

Go find #b10 Boogies#k at the #bCrossroads of Ereve#k, and do whatever she requires. Press the Q key to open your quest info window. Select your destination and press the Enable Navigation button to be guided to 10 Boogies.\n
Did you just now get here?\r\n#L0##bYeah, how did you... Did you find what you were looking for?#l\n#k
This doesn't look like the spot. Ugh, Neinheart's gonna lecture me alllll daaaaay. I can't take it!
See if you can find Timu on your World Map. You go first. I'll catch up.\n
Oh, wait! I remember. I dropped my bag in Tiguru's Forest when I was tying my shoe. Go get it back! Hurry, hurry!
Find Tiguru's Forest on your World Map and go take a look!
I just know it's there! You gotta go. I really like that bag!

You've heard of the Black Wings, right? They are, for lack of a better term, our arch-nemeses. One of them entered Ereve and stole a very important treasure.
Shinsoo's power keeps evil at bay, yet #r#o9300743# #p1104001# was able to walk right into our town. Our defenses can never be perfect, particularly when our enemies can change form.
Still, I cannot imagine the cur will have gotten far.

A #o9300743# will be smart enough to change into another of the senior knights, but you must look past the outer appearance. #rYou will realize something is wrong when you talk with them.#k Concentrate, and you may be of use.\n
Is this too much for a Knight-in-Training? Your Empress needs you.
Did you defeat #o9300743# #p1104001#? I might have taken you too lightly.

We must recover that treasure. The #o9300743# has not escaped Ereve. Search every corner, talk to every knight. Return when you have the #b#t4032101##k. Make sure to search #m130010010#, #m130010020#, and #m130010120#.
You performed admirably on that test. Perhaps I'll be able to use you for more than cannon fodder.\r\n#L0##bWhat test? Is the Empress safe?#l\n#k

Once, some time ago, the Black Mages did infiltrate our ranks. It was their master of disguise, and it caused quite a stir.
However, the Chief Knights were more than a match, as I had calculated they would be. The treasures that were stolen were recovered with no incident.

The ordeal has proved quite useful as a teaching tool. It is at once a lesson to never let down your guard, and a useful test of lateral thinking. Any knight who completes it has proven themselves able to handle rapidly-changing situations, and thus capable of operating in the field. Expect your first mission shortly.

Why, 'ello there, mate! #h0#, right? I'm #p1101007#, ol' captain of the Thunder Breakers. I must say, it is the epitome of delight to make yer acquaintance. \r\n#L0##bYou're awfully nice for a pirate.#l\n#k

Heh, just because I swashbuckle don't mean I can't mind me 'please's and 'thank you's. Now would ye oblige this ol' sailor by listenin' to an explanation of #e#rLinked Attacks#n#k? \r\n#L0##bSure. Explain away!#l\n#k
It sounds real fancy-like, but the term just means ye can use yer next attack skill even before yer prior one finishes. \r\n#L0##bOh, that's neat.#l\n#k

Aye. There'll be less time between skills, which means #bye'll be attackin' more quickly#k. This system also lets ye keep #bStance#k up. A good defense is the best offense, as they say. Also, if ye learn the #bChain#k skill, yer attacks'll do more damage.
Sharp one, aren't ye? Thanks for listenin' to me ramble on. I wish ye the best in yer adventures. I'll be watchin' from afar.
I must not be explainin' meself well. Let me try again...

I'm shocked. You actually possessed the perseverance to make it to level 10. As a matter of course, I'm promoting you to Knight-in-Training, but first tell me, which knight's path do you intend to take?
There are 5 different paths. I don't believe in second chances, so once you pick, I won't allow you to change your mind.
This is a significant decision. Take time to think it over.
My chief knights are over to the left. Speak to them to learn more about each path.
They are all good paths. Return to me when you've made up your mind.
I am #p1101003#, #bChief Knight of the Light#k, leader of the #bDawn Warriors#k. If you pursue the path of the Dawn Warrior, you will be under my command.

A Dawn Warrior is more than a Warrior. We are swordsmen and swordswomen of light! We deal with enemies head on, relying on our strength and stamina to win the day! #bWe have high STR and balanced DEX#k.
We are blessed by #bSoul, the spirit of light#k. If you join us, Soul will become your combat partner and guardian, always by your side in battle.
Only those who possess a burning heart, sharp eyes, an even sharper blade, and undying loyalty to the empress are suited to be Dawn Warriors. Let me know if you wish to pursue this glorious path!
Make a decision that you will not regret.
Oooh! A new knight! Nice to meet ya! I'm #p1101004#, #bChief Knight of Fire#k and #bleader of the Blaze Wizards#k.
Sooooo, Blaze Wizards are like Magicians in that we have #bhigh INT and Magic ATT#k and loathe melee combat, but we're also so much more!
We've bonded with #bIgnis, the spirit of fire#k! You can summon him to fight with you in battles, which makes you super duper extra powerful! That's something regular old Magicians can only dream of.

We're looking for people who have a passion to succeed... people who never ever give up, no matter how scary their enemies are. If you think you have the spark and sizzle to be a #bBlaze Wizard#k, let me know!
Pursue that path that fits YOU!

Nine hundred ninety-nine... And one thousand. Pardon me, I was just finishing my daily push-ups. So, you wish to be a knight? I am #p1101005#, #bChief Knight of Wind#k and #bleader of the Wind Archers#k.
Wind Archers are like Bowmen. We shoot arrows at enemies from a distance and #bpossess high DEX to ensure accuracy in our attacks.#k You don't mind if I do crunches while we talk, do you?
Where was I? Oh yes. Unlike Bowmen, we are aided by #bVentus, the spirit of wind#k, who protects us and enhances our arrows.

Wind is the symbol of freedom, but freedom without discipline is just self-indulgence, which I don't tolerate. If you think you can balance freedom with restraint, the path of the #bWind Archer#k may be for you. Let me know if it is. In the meantime, I have to get started on my squats.
I await your decision...

So you've willingly chosen to become a knight. How... curious. My name is #p1101006#, #bChief Knight of Darkness#k and #bleader of the Night Walkers#k. I suppose I'll have to keep you around if you choose this path.
Night Walkers are essentially Thieves. We attack from afar and #brely on LUK, DEX, and cunning to get past obstacles#k. I wonder if you have the cunning it takes to be one of us...
We are protected by #bUmbra, the spirit of darkness#k, who aids us in our fights. We dabble in poisons and let no one but ourselves direct our paths.

We operate in shadow, doing things to carry out justice other knights would never dirty their hands with. And that is all I am willing to share. If you wish to become a #bNight Walker#k, I will not stop you.
Pursue a path that will leave you with no regrets.
So ye've past the test and are ready to choose yer path, eh? Well, if ye choose to be a Thunder Breaker, I'd be delighted to welcome ye to me metaphorical crew.
A Thunder Breaker is like a Brawler. #bWe use STR to pound our enemies with naught but our knuckles!#k
We've made a pact with #bFulgar, the spirit of lightning#k, who'll fight with us, guard us, and even jump into our knuckles now and then for a little extra oomph.

Even though we fight with our fists, we're not barbarians! I expect me crew to treat others with kindness and be real refined-like, savvy? If yer on board with that philosophy, I'd love for ye to join the path of #bThunder Breaker#k.
I'll wait for ye to decide what ye want to do.

I will be extremely disappointed if you do not head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters...

I see that you're qualified to take the Knighthood Exam. Perhaps I should re-take it as well, just to refresh myself. One must be ready to take on any challenge at a moment's notice, you know. So, are you ready to begin right now?

To pass the exam, simply head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters. Now, if you want a real challenge, defeat 3 million of them. That's what I would do.

Take that ol' book to Neinheart. He's getting ants in his pants waitin' for it.
Thank ye kindly for all ye've done. Now, to Neinheart! I should be gettin' back as well.

Shinsoo has temporarily left Ereve to search Maple World. She has told me of your exploits and of how strong you have become, #b#h0##k. I would like to give you a #bspecial Medal#k.\r\nCome find me in #bEreve#k.\r\n
I await you in #bEreve#k.
As you wish. Visit me in #bEreve#k if you change your mind.

Welcome back, #b#h0##k. \r\nI still remember your first day in #bEreve#k... Kiku was teaching you the proper way to hold a sword. And now, you are on par with my chief knights, #bMihile, Oz, Irena, Eckhart, and Hawkeye#k!
Shinsoo and I are in agreement. You are our sixth #bchief knight#k, #b#h0##k.
You are a star in this world of darkness. When the sun shines, the stars hide, unneeded. But when darkness blooms, as it does now with the threat of the Black Mage, the stars become our guide.
Maple World needs more knights like you, #b#h0##k.
Visit me now and again, #b#h0##k. \r\nWith #bShinsoo#k away, this place feels so lonely...
You finally look like a knight. I'm tempted to give you your #bfirst mission#k.
Head to #bVictoria Island#k to investigate the #rBlack Wings#k. I've heard rumors that the #rPuppeteer#k is up to something.

Find #bmy informant, #p1103001##k in #b#m100000000##k on Victoria Island. Take the #bboat#k from #b#m130000210##k.
If you still have business to take care of in #m130000000#, I suggest you do it now.
You have the fragrance of #m130000000# on you, yes you do. Is the Empress still in charge there? I guess she would be, but I can never remember. I am #b#p1103001##k, the watcher of #b#m100000000##k!
Oh! I have a note, a note here for #h0#. Is that you? It says, 'Tell #h0# about the #rBlack Wings and the Puppeteer#k.'

I'll give you the condensed version. A long time ago, there was this scary old wizard called the #r#p2159359##k. Some heroes sealed him away, but now a bunch of creeps want to bring him back. Those are the #rBlack Wings#k.
We've been fighting them for a while, but they're #rtough adversaries#k. Thankfully, they haven't managed to bring back the #p2159359#...
You must take a boat to reach #bVictoria Island#k. Get to #b#m130000210##k.

The #rPuppeteer#k, in particular, is one tough cookie. He can #bcontrol monsters with his dolls#k. I have dreams like that sometimes, only the dolls are my mom and we're in a cheesecake wonderland. That's normal, right?
