Hey, I bet you remember being booted out of here by that #rbarrier#k, don't you? Well, it's been weakened quite a bit. Come to #bCrimsonwood Keep#k while you can! Maybe you can shoo off some of these pigeons for me...
I'll be waiting for you in #bCrimsonwood Keep#k... mostly because I can't move!
C'mon, what happened to your sense of adventure?!
There you are! I need you to be my eyes and ears in Masteria.
Wait, I have some statue business to attend to...

Fooled ya! There's no such thing as statue business. But there IS an altar for the #blegendary heroes of Masteria#k in Crimsonwood Keep. It used to hold a set of #blegendary weapons that were used to hold off Naricain#k.

There was one weapon for each of the guilds, the Stormcasters, the Windreavers, the Shadowknights, the Flamekeepers, and the Bosshunters. But the #rTwisted Masters#k wanted to exploit them and use them for, you know, evil. When they stole them, it threw Masteria into chaos... Probably all part of Naricain's big plan to rule our lands.
I don't know how they got them in the first place, and I didn't have any way of finding out... until now!

Now that the #rbarrier#k is down, you can get to #b#m930100000##k! If you can figure out why that #rbarrier's gone#k and what they're using the #blegendary weapons#k for, well that might help us set things right.
I KNEW you'd help. Talk to the #b#p2135000##k in #b#m930100000##k. It's the only other statue that doesn't have a personality made of stone.
Oh, so now you're too good for Masteria?
Are you a #bforeign warrior#k? Masteria has need of you.
Masteria has lost its #rwill to fight#k.
Take the #bbottom right#k portal to the #r#m930100000##k. The #p2135000## should be there.
The #baltar#k in Masteria is more #rimportant#k than you'd think. It is the sword and shield that protects us, and we must keep it sharpened.

When the #blegendary weapons#k fell into the hands of the #rTwisted Masters#k, our people could no longer bear arms. The continent fell into chaos. We must return the weapons to the #baltar#k to win the fight.

The masters are evil incarnations of our greatest warriors, twisted by the world of Versal and seduced by the evils of Naricain. They will #babsorb the souls of the weapons#k, and bring Naricain back to our lands.
They have shielded themselves with #rbarriers#k to finish their absorption, like soldiers fleeing from the fray.
The barrier that once kept your people at bay has been taken down, and the #rTwisted Masters#k now focus their energy on their own personal safety. A chink has appeared in their armor!

This is the time for your traveling warriors to sweep in for a surprise attack. If they completely absorb those weapons, irreversible destruction will sweep across Masteria. Enter the #rCrimsonwood Altar#k and vanquish the masters!
Masteria's battle is in your hand. Report to #bRidley#k once you defeat the masters.
You're running from a fair fight?!
Did you find out any more about what's going on?\r\n#L0##b(You tell him about the Twisted Masters and the legendary weapons.)#l\n#k
Oh, the #baltar#k! It kept #bstability in Masteria#k in my age, before Naricain came and wrecked it all. That just might work!

You think Masteria will be peaceful again, now that the weapons are back? I fear we've only begun to see the fruit of Naricain's evil schemes. There seems to be a strange #rnew barrier#k across our path to the Phantom Forest. It doesn't bode well for Crimsonwood, or the rest of Masteria...
Either way, you did good. Peace will come to this continent eventually. Maybe on the day the #rnew barrier#k disappears, we'll need #byour help#k once again!
Masteria is fighting a losing battle. Enter the #rCrimsonwood Altar#k, vanquish the masters, and let #bRidley#k know what happened.
Did you find anything else about the #rmasters#k in the #m930100000#?

Has anyone told you about the #bStone Colossus#k? It's a great beast of rock whose head pierces the sky. We Halflinger's wouldn't be more than a pebble under its toenails! Wouldn't you like to see something like that?
Come see me anytime. We'll have a little chat about big things, hehehe...\r\n#b(Visit Chief Tatamo in Leafre.)#k\n
I understand. I'm terrified of giants.
Oh my, you've come about the giant! I knew you'd be curious.
Oh, but where do I begin? Give me a moment, give me a moment.

There's only so much we can do with burnt up wood and old supplies. Maybe this camp is too close to the #bStone Colossus#k... No. I can't move it. I just need to figure out some way to make it work...\r\n#L0##bUm, excuse me.#l\n#k
Who are you? I'm a little busy here.\r\n#L0##bMy name is...#l\n#k
I SAID, I'M BUSY.
Maybe I oughtta climb up from the other end... \r\n#b(This guy's a lost cause. I should talk to somebody else.)#k
Darn kids never know when to mind their business...\r\n#b(Should I try again?)#k
Haven't seen you around here, stranger! Whatcha doin' hanging out with a bunch of fluffballs like us?
You really want to check out the #bStone Colossus#k? Seriously?
Mumble mumble...\r\n#b(I should talk to another Halflinger.)#k
I'm happy! So, so happy! I think my brain might explode!\r\nI had no idea you were into exploring. That's like my number one THING! Besties!\r\n
You should probably know your new best friend's name. I'm #bKona#k! I work for that old goat over there, #bLavi#k. I'm just his assistant for now, but I'm gonna grow up to be THE best explorer ever.

Did #bLavi#k blow you off? He always does that. It's just 'cause of all the #rmonsters#k around here. \r\nHey, you look pretty strong, don't you? You have rugged combat-tested muscles. You ARE a fighter, right?
So cool! Go beat up a bunch of #rMantises#k and #rBlood Mantises#k. Can you smush #r80#k of them? I bet you can.
Keep heading east to find the Mantises. Ya can't miss 'em!\r\n#b(Take out 80 Mantises and Blood Mantises.)#k
My new besty cannot be a wimp.
You handled them ALREADY? Wow. So action!
Super! You're pretty nifty.
I bet #bLavi#k will want to talk to you now. He likes when things get smushed.\r\n#b(Talk to Lavi.)#k
Keep heading east to find the Mantises. Ya can't miss 'em!\r\n#b(Take out 80 Mantises and Blood Mantises.)#k\n

These monsters brought our exploration to a screeching halt. Look at 'em! With their beady eyes... I'll never make it up to the Stone Colossus at this rate...\r\n#L0##bMaybe I can talk to the Stone Colossus.#l\n#k
You were blessed by the #bGreat Spirit Guwaru#k? What kinda weirdo are you?
I want to see how tough you are before I send you anywhere you might lose a limb.\r\nWhy don't you go take care of some #rMantises#k for me? It'll be fun. They come in all shapes and sizes.\r\n
I'll be watching.\r\n#b(Go to the Colossus West Road and hunt Mantises.)#k
What, you think you can keep those fingers forever?
All right. I guess you're tough enough to go up to the #bStone Colossus#k, but don't come complaining to me when you get your teeth knocked out!
It's essential to be supplied before you head out into the wild blue yonder.\r\nAnyway, #bKupo#k is waiting for you.\n
Take out #r100 Mantises, 100 Bloody Mantises, and 150 Poison Mantises#k.
Doesn't this look awesome? Don't you just want to GO on it?
I wish we had fuel, but we can't get it up the road with all the monsters. If only a brave fighter-type person would get us some.\r\n#b(Kupo is giving you the old Halflinger Eyes.)#k

My ride is super green. Crystal. Emerald. I use PEANUT OIL to run this puppy. Well, it actually can use just about any plant fuel. Which is why I was hoping you could get some oil from #rFloras#k. Because I ate all the peanuts...
Think you could handle some #rFloras#k? They hang out around the #bColossus East Road#k, and I only need about 100 #rDamp Seeds#k.
Awesome. I like you already.
Chino kept telling me you were crazy about fighting. What a liar...
Where are the Damp Seeds?
Aww yeessss, this is the stuff! The smell!
Think you could handle some #rFloras#k? They hang out around the #bColossus East Road#k, and I only need about 100 #rDamp Seeds#k.
You know I still need your help, right? I need #r100 Oily Seeds#k from the #rDark Floras#k to give this puppy a hyper boost!
You're pretty cool.
Oh, come on! We're gonna go so fast!
Where are the Oily Seeds?
Aww yeah, that's the stuff--the fuel to solve my problems! This ride is about to burn naturally-produced rubber!
Hunt #rDark Floras#k on the #bColossus East Road#k, and collect #r100 Oily Seeds#k.
Whoa, that was a shaker! Reminds me of the first time that old #bStone Colossus#k first moved. I wonder what happened this time.
I bet something big's happening. I don't know if you oughtta go exploring anymore. Seems like you might get... blown up or something.
#b(There was a massive earthquake while you were cruising in Kupo's Ride. Talk to Kupo in Kupo's Station.)#k
You're not gonna give up? We must be friends for life. I HAVE DECREED IT.
Keep heading east and talk to my friend #bChino#k. She's super cute and she can get you up to that colossus.
Oh, but you'd better bring her something. #bChino#k would be stoked if you brought her #r100 Hornet Honeys and Large Poison Glands#k. She hates hornets so much.
See you around, pal!
You changed your mind?
Ah, another hornet-hater! Welcome to the club.
I saw you out there, cracking those stupid exoskeletons open. I watched from my perch. Because I'm a sniper.
Collect 100 Hornet Honeys from Hornets and 100 Large Poison Glands from Poison Hornets for Chino. Just keep heading East to see her.
Yes?\r\n#b(Collect 100 Hornet Honeys from Hornets and 100 Large Poison Glands from Poison Hornets.)#k\n
The name's Chino, and this is my trusty rifle, Martino. I came out here to scout the area before the rest of the expedition arrived. Me and Martino have been making the place safe...
Kupo had to have told you something about me, right?\r\n#bHe said you were cute and you were here.#k
Martino and I will make sure to blast those ugly goggles off of his head next time I see him through my scope!\r\n#b(Chino seems angry.)#k
There's an elevator me and the team have been using to get to the Stone Colossus nearby. It should make a pretty easy trip, if you want to get a closer look.
If there were less stinging bugs flying around, I could get you up there. Between you, me, and Martino, I bet we could cut down the population enough to make it safe.
Take down 150 more #rHornets and Poison Hornets#k?
I'll provide firing support from here!\r\n#b(Hunt down 150 more Hornets and Poison Hornets.)#k
I can't fault you for chickening out.
Did you take care of them?
It'll be nice to go outside without having to bring my tennis racket.
Exterminate 150 Hornets and Poison Hornets.

Whew, great work there! Martino approves. You sure you're not a sharpshooter?\r\nI still can't figure out what got those hornets all stirred up. You think it has anything to do with that earthquake?\r\n
Head up to the #bStone Colossus#k and let me know what you find.
(You fought off the Hornet swarm on your way up to the Stone Colossus. Talk to Chino at the top.)
Lonely... So very lonely... None can hear... \r\n#L0##bI can hear you!#l\n#k
You... hear me?
I wait for you. Very long time. Long as the land and sky...
No... Only wind... No one here...
I am happy, so happy. I very alone...\r\n#L0##bUm, nice to meet you too. Where are you from?#l\n#k
Me? I do not know. I am from nowhere. Where am I now?\r\n#L0##b(This guy's not much of a talker...) I was hoping you could tell me that. The Halflingers thought you were part of the mountains.#l\n#k

Mountain... yes, I am mountain. And rock. And land. I am part and whole.
One day, my eyes open. I stand. Little creatures run. Birds fly away. I was scared.

#L0##bIs that why you're not moving anymore? So you don't hurt anybody?#l
#k
I am big. I move. Little ones hurt. So I don't move.\r\n#L0##bThat's... so... sweet... must... hold... back... tears... #l\n#k

Sweet? NO. I make problems. Bad insects around me. I see more and more. I don't know why.
Darkness inside me. Scared of dark thing...
#L0##bWhat kind of dark thing?#l
#k
I do not know. Something dark is inside me. It fills up my belly... Then... I must smash. I must destroy.
...W-what did I just say?\r\nI am not good. I will hurt you. Stay away. Run away!
You will help me? It could be dangerous.
Thank you, little friend. I want to be good. I want to be free.
Scary creatures with dark power live on me. I can feel dark power in my skin. Clean them off. Please clean them off.
Please. I do not know when I might change. I'm scared.\r\n#b(Exterminate 250 Polluted Tree Spirits on the Stone Colossus Torso.)#k\n
I do not know when I might change. I'm scared.
I feel cleaner. Did you do that?
Thank you. But there are still more.
I do not know when I might change. I'm scared.\r\n#b(Exterminate 250 Polluted Tree Spirits on the Stone Colossus Torso.)#k
I hear whispers inside... They want to corrupt me. They are on my head. So loud. Will you climb my head? Will you make the voices go away?
Please. I don't want to hurt anyone.\r\n#b(Exterminate 250 Polluted Tree Spirits on the Stone Colossus Torso.)#k
Please. The voices are getting louder.
Did you make them go away?
Thank you, but I still hear the whispers.
Please. I don't want to hurt anyone.\r\n#b(Exterminate 250 Polluted Tree Spirits on the Stone Colossus Torso.)#k
I still hear whispers... Maybe I am broken. Maybe I am the problem. It's all my fault.
Don't let me hurt you. Go away. Stop helping me. Go away.\r\n#b(There's nothing more you can do to help the Stone Colossus right now. Return to #eChino's Station#n for now.)#k\r\n
You should go back. There is nothing you can do for me.
#h0#, I saw you coming up. Good timing.
#b(You explain what's happened to Chino.)#k\r\nDark energy, huh? I was worried this might happen. I've got something to tell you...\n
Go back...\r\n#b(Return to Chino's Station.)#k
Martino and I spied a group of suspicious people on the Stone Colossus's head a couple of days back. I'm guessing they're the ones causing all this trouble.
Could you take a look?\r\n#b(#eHead to Stone Colossus Torso 3#n.)#k
#b(Is the Stone Colossus really okay? I should go talk to it.)#k
I must hurry.
I guess I could just let it go crazy and go on a giant rampage...
My heart is restless. I feel dark energy inside fighting to come out. Go away.
You will help me? Not run away?\r\n...You are truly a friend.

#b(The Stone Colossus stifles a yelp and the world shakes as it shudders. It seems to be in pain.)#k
#h0#... There is pain inside. I-I will let you go inside, if you want.
#L0##bInside you?#l
#k
It hurts inside. You must go inside...
Make the darkness go away. Please cut the darkness out.\r\n#b(Enter the Stone Colossus and eliminate Polluted Rock Spirits and Corrupted Rock Spirits.)#k
Please... hurry...
I-I feel cleansed, but...
The darkness is still there. Deep inside me. Please help...
No... time... ugh...\r\n#b(Eliminate the evil Rock Spirits inside the Stone Colossus.)#k
I am losing myself. The darkness will control me soon.\r\nI have one last request... Go inside my #bheart#k. It hurts... Something bad is there.
I will hold out as long as I can.\r\n#b(Face the Tarantulus in the Stone Colossus's Heart.)#k
I can't go on much longer...

I feel nice now. Good.
You are a brave hero.
#L0##bYou're pretty brave yourself. You held out for all that time. Maybe YOU are the hero.#l
#k
I did not want to smash and destroy. There was no choice.
I am happy now. You are my hero and my friend. Our friendship will last until the stones crumble.
I want to keep talking.
Our friendship will rise like the sun. I do not like to fight, but I will for you.
You are my friend now.\r\n(The Stone Colossus seems really pleased.)

Thank you for saving the Stone Colossus, mortal, but the great Tarantulus will not be put aside so easily. It will wait in hiding and strike the Stone Colossus from within. Would you be willing to face the #rTarantulus#k again?\r\n
There will be some sort of clue. There must be.\r\n#b(Fight the Tarantulus and return with a Demonic Rune.)#k
Well now, this was SORT of important, but I never can understand mortal priorities.

This rune has been marked by a #rDemon#k. Most of them have been in hiding since the Black Mage was sealed away.\r\nMy own weakness has allowed them to return... and I fear it will not be the last time.
Rest well, little mortal. We shall meet again.
(Hunt the Tarantulus and return with a Demonic Rune.)
H-hey, can you tell me where I am? Also, how come there's a big rock guy over there?
A-A Stone Colossus? Why did I come here? I swear I was wandering around Perion. I might be easy on the eyes, but I couldn't use a compass to save my life.
I wouldn't even have left town if I hadn't heard of this valuable stuff called #bRoyal Jelly#k. Doesn't that sound delicious? I just HAD to get some.
I even saw the right monsters... but I'm not much of a fighter, hehe. Do you think... just maybe... that you could get me a Royal Jelly since I gave you that info?
Ohhh, I can't wait to eat it! The portal next to us goes right to the monsters.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornet in the Swarm Stronghold to get Royal Jelly.)#k
Aw, I really wanted to eat it.
That's the Royal Jelly? Gimme gimme!
Look at that luster... Yup, this must be the Royal Jelly.
Could you maybe get me a Royal Jelly since I gave you that info? I'll be sure to compensate you.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornet to get Royal Jelly.)#k
Words CANNOT describe what I've just experienced. I feel... like I am younger by 10 years now. It tasted like utopia or paradise or nirvana. Cloud nine.
PLEASE. I need more. I need #r10 Royal Jellies#k or I might as well just jump off a cliff.
Thanks. I want others to be jelly of my jelly!\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornet in the Swarm Stronghold to get Royal Jelly.)#k
Cliff it is.
Are those... really Royal Jellies for my belly?
Tears. Of joy. Streaming down my face. So hard. Mmmm. This is a flavor sensation!
Can you be a pal and get me 10 Royal Jelly items? I need them. So bad.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornets to get Royal Jelly.)#k
You don't have the #b#t1402179##k. There isn't much I can do with nothing...
#b#h0##k, lifting the curse of the Kaiserium has gotten a little out of control. \r\n#L0##bMaybe it can't be broken after all...#l\n#k
No, no. It's not that... We will just require a LOT of ingredients. The curse has had a long time to set in. \r\n#L0##bI'll get as much as I can.#l\n#k
We need Reindeer Milk, Twilight’s Dew, and Power Elixirs... 50 a piece.\r\n#L0##bThat seems doable...#l\n#k
AND 100 Vellum's Helms, 100 Zakum Certificates.\r\n#L0##bUh, okay...#l\n#k
All your #b#t4033767# will disappear#k if you #bforfeit your quest#k. Keep this in mind!
Bring me #b5#k samples of #b#t4033767##k. I'll be collecting the other ingredients.
You are impossible!
Last but not least, 100 samples of #t4033767#.\r\n#L0##bYou are a crazy person.#l\n#k

I've been told. The other items are relatively commonplace, but the #t4033767# is absolutely integral to the process. You can get a single sample by defeating Magnus.\r\n#L0##bAnd... we need 100?#l\n#k
Ugh, I thought you were interested in breaking this curse! Fine. Bring me #b5#k! Five little samples of #b#t4033767##k. Do you think you can handle it?
There you are, #b#h0##k.
All the other ingredients are here, too. Maybe this will actually work...
I'm going to use up all of your #t4033767#. Any extras will help the process along.
Please give me the #b#t1402198##k, too. This curse will be broken!

Click on people with #i3800569##blightbulb icons#k over their heads to start quests. You must be some sort of genius to have figured that out for yourself! It took me two semesters to master that skill.

Remember to click people with this icon #i3800570# over their heads, too. That's how you turn in quests and get your rewards. I've read all about it in textbooks, though it's a little advanced for me.
Later, when you're higher level, you can also click the lightbulb icon #i03800265# on the left side of the screen to grab new quests. Just gimme a few years, and I'll reach that level myself!
Since you've been so nice and let me talk for five whole minutes without running away, I want to give you a present!
This next step is really, really tough! You have to #bclick#k OK, and then the quest completion icon #i3800570# over my head to finish the quest. Don't worry if you don't get it on your first--
You're so silly! You have to click #bYes#k to accept my gift! But I guess, if someday you want to refuse someone's quest, it's all right to practice pressing #bNo#k.
HOLY RIBBON PIGS! You have amazing upper body strength! With talent like that, you owe it to the world to complete LOTS of quests. Just use the hotkey #b[Q]#k to see what quests are available!
Some'll be a cinch. Others might be a bit tougher. But they'll all be appropriate for your level. Click the #i3800569# icon when you're in the mood to do quests.
Now here's the gift I promised you! I hope it doesn't collapse when you use it, like the last few times...
I made the #b#t3010000##k myself, with stickers and love! When you sit in chairs, you'll recover health more quickly. It took me half a year to master the technique. It's all in the wrist.
Now, I want to tell you all about #bhunting#k. It's totally frightening, but most quests require it. I'll meet you where the #bmonsters#k are.
Just take the #bportal#k to the right. And remember... Feet first! Don't try to dive into the portal like I did the first few months.
Goodness, you have such a graceful, beautiful walk. You could be a model. Anyway, let me tell you about #bhunting#k...
#bHunting#k is the act of eliminating monsters. The more monsters you eliminate, the stronger you'll be! Some even drop presents after you smash them!
Try it out by pressing #b[Ctrl]#k to smack those #bJr. Sentinels#k to the right, er, left, I mean, right! Sorry, I get confused sometimes.
Bring me #b1 Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k, too. I've always wanted to see one but still haven't quite figured out which end of my sword I'm supposed to hold.
I know I'm not as smart or as pretty or as cool or as brave or as strong as you, but I really, really want you to do my quest.
You're the strongest person I've ever met! Those monsters didn't stand chance, did they?

To get stronger, you'll want to fight monsters #bnear your level#k, which means you'll have to hunt tougher monsters as you level up. By the way, let me know if you ever see any Lv. -10 monsters for ME to hunt...
If you ever find yourself in a pickle, you can use #bconsumable#k items found in the Use tab of your inventory. Just double-click!
Here, try it out by eating this apple. Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.
I'll even give you more apples after you've finished chomping on that one! Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.
I didn't poison it! I would never do that to my best friend in the entire world, no matter how jealous I was! Talk to me again and choose 'yes'!
WOW, I've never seen anyone eat with such amazing technique! Maple World is full of stuff for you to munch on, just remember to check the effects before you put anything in your mouth.

You're so good at everything you do. Here, take this apple. And this one. And here are a few more for good measure. You know, you might want to drag these apples to the #bhotkey window#k to access them more easily.
You still have the apple I gave you! I know eating is really intimidating, but I believe in you! Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.

Supposedly, you'll get #bAP#k to improve your stats and #bSP#k to train your skills each time you gain a level. But this is stuff I only understand in theory, since I've never leveled up myself. Sigh.
You can manually distribute your AP, or you can use the #bAuto-Assign#k button to do it automatically. For your skills, press #b[K]#k to open your Skill window, where you can spend your SP.
Go on and press #b[K]#k to open your Skill window now! I've always wanted to see it in action!
That was SO COOL! You should hotkey your favorite skills. Just drag the skill icons from the Skill window to the hotkey window, and you'll be able to use your skills at the touch of a hotkey!
You're not refusing because you don't want me to watch, are you? How mean!
You'll get all sorts of skills as you level up. Offensive skills, stat-boosting skills, movement skills... I've memorized the entire list. If I could learn even one skill, I would die happy!
Part of the challenge is figuring out which skills to level up first. But I'm sure a genius like you will have no problem with that!
And I'm sure you'll also remember to #bhotkey#k your favorite consumable items and skills, WITHOUT needing to write it on your hand.
I've think I've shared with you just about everything I've learned from 8 years of Hero School. I just have one last little surprise...
You've been so nice chatting with me when you're obviously destined to be some sort of mega-hero that I felt obligated to get you a present.
It'll take everything you've got to successfully retrieve it, though! I put a box #i3800571# way up high. Destroy it with attacks to get the #b#t4033915##k, then return to me, okay?
For a little extra boost, try jumping from a #i3800572#. Use ladders and platforms to your advantage, too.
But... But... I got it just for you!
Watching you in action is like watching poetry in motion. I swear, meeting you has changed my life for the better. Here, sniff sniff, let me unlock that box for you.
Go on. Open it up. It's the least I can do.
Do you like the #bequipment#k I picked out? Try it on. It's stylish, AND it boosts your stats.
Double-click the gear from the item window, or drag it to the equipment window. Press [E] to check out your equipment.
Hopefully, this equipment will help you remember me. Promise me you'll wear it forever?
I guess that's that. You're a true Explorer, now. I'm really, really going to miss you. You were my first true friend.
It's time for you to expand your horizons. Maybe someday I'll advance past Maple Island, too... In the meantime, find #bLucas#k in #bAmherst#k.
Chief Lucas will be waiting for you in Amherst, just over to the right.
I know, I don't want you to leave either! But I'd feel awful if I held you back. Though... If you really want to stay here with me forever, I won't stop you.

Hello, #h0#. What brings you here?
So, you want to get rich quick? Well, our guild can help you with that.
Trade win Dolce 10 times to proceed to Luna, the next trade area. You will be able to get more Gold and EXP there.
#h0#, you should be able to reach the next trade area before anyone else.
Are you busy or something?
#h0#, you still have not completed the 10 trades in the Dolce region. Go to the trade UI and mouse over an area to see how many trades you have completed.
Hello #h0#, I knew you would come.
Are you not impressed with the riches of Luna?
You know, you can't say that you've traded until you've traded with Rosa.
And with the rare monsters I've heard about around there, you should definitely visit.
You can move on to Rosa area after you have traded in Luna 15 times.
Aren't you curious to see what awaits you in the big sea?
Wow, #h0#! I knew you wouldn't let me down.
You can now trade with in the Rosa area.
Start your trade on the map. You must pay a small fee to do so.
Remember, you need to look at the big picture. Invest now in your future.
#h0#, you still have not completed the 15 trades in the Luna region. Go to the trade UI and mouse over an area to see how many trades you have completed.
Hello, #h0#. Thank you for coming.
Many ships were lost in the recent typhoon.
One of the ships that sank was carrying a valuable load of cubes. We need to recover our costs.
Can you collect some cubes for us? We will compensate you for your time. \r\n You may hunt Grosso Polpo to get the cubes while you travel to Rosa area and International Trader.
Thank you. If you hunt some monsters in the Rosa area, you should have plenty of fragments before you know it.
Bring them to me and I will reward you handsomely.
I understand. The place is very dangerous, after all.
If you ever change your mind, please let me know.
Great, I knew you wouldn't let me down.
Cubes are plentiful among the monsters of the shipping lanes.
I would appreciate it if you could bring them to me.
The best place to get fragments is from the kraken along the way to Rosa. Bring those to me.
You should eliminate the kraken in the Rosa area.
Hello #h0#! The merchant guild has a job for you. Do you wish to hear about it?
There is a guy named Mr. Do in Herb Town. We received a request from him for a special Medicinal Kettle from Dawnveil.
Well, I did hear that people are saying Mr. Do is not as good as he used to be...
Okay, I will entrust the trade to you.
I guess you're busy. Come talk to me when you've got some time.
You need to finish the trade with Herb Town with the Medicinal Kettle in your possession.
You need to finish the trade with Herb Town with the Medicinal Kettle in your possession.

Hello, #e#b#h0##k#n. Have you been to the #e#rCommerci Republic#k#n on the west coast of Dawnveil? I am sure someone of your means can get there easily. But I do need to give you one bit of information.\r\nDo you want to hear it?

You can become a honorary citizen of the #b#eCommerci Republic#k#n. Go to Commerci in Dawnveil, collect Commerci emblems, do favors for Mayor Berry, catch bounty monsters, and participate in trades. These are all part of the #eCommerci Life#n\r\nYou will become a honorary Commerci Citizen if you live out each part of the Commerci Life 10 times.
It won't hurt to just hear me out, you know.
How did the Commerci Life feel for you?\r\nI hope you liked it, because you are now a #e#bhonorary citizen of the Commerci Republic#k#n!
Congratulations! Now Commerci welcomes you as one of its own.

Let me know if you change your mind.

The cats on the coastal road have been causing quite a few headaches in Commerci for a while now. Can you go take care of them?

Go eliminate #b#e200 #o9390807##k#n critters. They keep increasing in numbers, even with all our efforts. The fish cart we send to Commerci is always in danger.\r\n#fMob/9390807.img/stand/0# 200 #o9390807#
Are you sure?

Hello, I am #b#e#p9390220##k#n from the Commerci Trade Center. Commerci, as I'm sure you know, is the greatest trade republic in Dawnveil. You really must make a trade yourself to truly understand the Commerci Life. Do you wish to give trading a try?
Good. Diligence is the cornerstone of business. Why don't you do #b#e1 trade#k#n?
You will never accomplish anything if you cannot commit to anything.
Good. Diligence is the cornerstone of business. Why don't you do #b#e1 trade#k#n?

Hello, #e#b#h0##k#n\r\nHave you heard about #e#rCommerci Republic#k#n on the west coast of Dawnveil? It is a dangerous land, so you really shouldn't head there yet. But it's the hot new destination for all the adventurers of Maple World. So we wanted to go over the ancient documents at the Helios Tower Library about the place, but we lost them to some monsters.\r\nWill you help us out?
Thank you! If you can help Wiz the Librarian #e#b10 times#k#n, then we will give you the title of #b#e#t1142663##k#n to show our appreciation for your hard work.
Are you not interested in Dawnveil?
Did you get some information on Dawnveil?\r\nYes, good...and I believe you now qualify as a #e#bDawnveil Explorer#k#n! You will soon be able to set foot in Dawnveil.
Couldn't you get to Dawnveil if you weaken Tynerum?
Thank you! If you can help Wiz the Librarian #e#b10 times#k#n, then we will give you the title of #b#e#t1142663##k#n to show our appreciation for your hard work.

I'm sure you heard from #p9010000#, but the ancient documents at the Helios Tower Library disappeared during a monster attack. I believe the document held records of the golden continent, Dawnveil. Go eliminate the monsters and bring back #b#e 30 #t3994882##k#n items.
Make sure to search the monsters throughly. I am sure they have it.
I guess my request was too difficult for you.
Make sure to search the monsters throughly. I am sure they have it.

Hello, #h0#. Have you heard about the newly-discovered continent? All the collectors are itching to collect new and rare items from this mysterious land. Do you have any interest in those items, #h0#? I heard that Cassandra is looking for them already. Will you go help her?
Help her 10 times and I will recognize your rare collecting skills.
Do you not like Cassandra?
I've spoken with Cassandra. You've helped her greatly. I think you have a knack for collecting things.
I think that title is perfect for you.
Help her 10 times and I will recognize your rare collecting skills.

#e#b#h0##k#n! Did you hear? A new continent was discovered south of Ossyria! I knew something was up when all these rare items started showing up. They must have come over from there. Can you bring some of them to me?
Great! I know where you can find them. You will need to search the monsters. Like, inside. 'Cause I think those stupid monsters swallowed them all. Get some and bring them back to me.
I really want to see those items.
Great! I know where you can find them. You will need to search the monsters. Like, inside. 'Cause I think those stupid monsters swallowed them all. Get some and bring them back to me.
The Empress need you right now. Can you come to Ereve?
I will be waiting.
It would be wise of you to listen.
Welcome, #b#e#h0#...#n#k\r\nThe Empress has been waiting for you. Go see the Empress immediately.
I knew you wouldn't refuse.
Something strange is going on. I fear for Maple World.
Ask Neinheart to tell you more.
Ask Neinheart to tell you more.
M-my emerald...
Ah-HA! Don't never leave me again, my shinin' piece of heaven!
I reckon them monsters found mah emerald whens I was gettin' to mah bathin'.
Y'uns don't know how much this means me. This here little stone brought a tear to mah eye whens I seen it.
WHERE'S MAH EMERALD?!
I tell ya what. Y'uns wanna know more about Dawnveil?
I don't see no harm in telling you what I know.
Dawnveil's a big ol' place, made up of a buncha different nations. You get what I'm puttin' out there?\r\n
Ever since that ol' barrier popped up in Tynerum, we ain't seen much of the other nations. Like we just plum got cut off!
But don't go askin' me when this all started! I ain't from around here?
Somethin' wrong with your noggin?
Am I in... Dawnveil?
I guess Parbell was telling the truth.
Maybe somebody around here can give me some answers.
There's gotta be somebody with a sandwich around here... I'm starving.
Eh, I'll just stand here and stare at the sun instead.
That'll scare those no-good alley cats! Good work out there.
I've got another doozy of a favor to ask ya.
I don't think ya got all 100 #b#o9390807#s#k yet.
Ya did a good job scarin' off those Tomcats...
But ya didn't do nothin' about them #b#o9390806#s#k!
I keep seein' them... sneakin' around, lookin' mangy... CONGREGATIN'. If you don't scare them off, who knows what they'll do!
That's the ticket! Show 100 of them #b#o9390806#s#k who's boss!
Oooh, ya too busy to help an old fart?!
Back already? I knew I could count on ya #b#h0##k.
You sure are nice for vacationer. We don't get many tourists 'round my village, but you can come back any time ya like.
I thought you was gonna hunt down 100 of them #b#o9390806#s#k!
Oooh, speakin' a which. We do got one other traveler. A fancy-lookin' fella. Calls himself #bLeon Daniella#k.
He's got a head like an ice cream cone with all that goop in his hair, but he seems like a good enough kid. Maybe you two's'll get along!
You better hurry up, before that boat takes off.
Ya'd rather stay here with an old snakehead like me? That boat ain't stickin' around forever!
Go on, get!

Okay, go east from the town, follow the coastal road, and you'll be in San Commerci in no time. It's a single road so you won't get lost, but be careful of thieves.\r\nI'll see you in #e#bSan Commerci#k#n!
Time to head to San Commerci! Leon said it was a great town!
All I have to do is head south, right? Easy!
No, no I should never trust a guy with hair nicer than mine.
N1: Ahh! Doppleganger!
I'll let the Merchant Union know so you'll be able to get in. Please be polite when you talk to Gilberto. He is quite powerful in Commerci.
Man, I can't sleep tonight. The air's too... moist.
I'm gonna take a walk, clear my head.
What's that noise? Maybe it's Leon...
The #bDelfinos#k are responsible! They prey on our good merchants from the San Commerci canals!
It has forced us to isolate ourselves. It's costing me more than a pretty penny, let me tell you.
What do you want to know about those Delfinos?
You'd like more information on the Delfinos?
We lived a good life alongside the Delfinos. Most of our merchants rarely interacted with them, but there was no hostility.

San Commerci was nothing but a small fishing village in the early days of the Republic. We fished our area of the seas, they fished theirs... but then the spice trade began and this port doubled in size overnight.
I'm sure the Delfinos are only upset because our town has prospered without them. It's the only rational explanation to their transition into roving gangs of bandits.
The Delfinos must be treated with a firm and swift hand. It's the only thing they'll respect.
Just as well.
Delfinos don't like to get caught in a big fight. They roam the canals in small groups, but they can disappear in an instant.
I'll head that way. See you in the #b#m865020000##k.
Let me know when you're ready to hunt some fish.
It's my first time fighting the Delfinos, and they're weaker than I thought.
Why did it take so long to defeat these weak monsters? To be fair, they would raid at night in small numbers and catch people by surprise.
Is it just me, or was that way too easy?
Take this, fishlips!
That's not all. Let's mop 'em up!
That won't even scratch me!
Ugh... Too many...
Let's push it to the limit, #h0#!
You want to leave now? The fun's just starting!
Let's go back and talk to my dad!
Let me know when you're ready to roll. There's adventure afoot!
Hey, there you are!
You look ready for battle.
Let's hit the seas!
It's kind of a given, but when you fight pirates, you fight on the open sea.
We're going to need to be ready. Like SUPER ready. We're not going up against a buncha fishmen this time, know what I mean?
Of course you know what I mean! I'm excellent at explaining stuff.
Oh, sorry. I mean Delfinos are descended from fish, and these guys are not so the fight will be tougher.
We're gonna need some food, some water, maybe some like rocks and stuff in case the boat gets messed up.
Oh, we should probably find a crew too.
All right! I'm gonna go think of my perfect crew and put it out in the universe. Gimme a minute.
I've got it in my head now. The bodacious crew to compliment our seafaring adventure. I'm gonna go get them together, and you go get all the supplies, okay?
All right, sidekick!
But, I'm the hero... I don't get the supplies.
Head over to the #bGeneral Store#k and tell them I sent you. They know my dad, so they'll give you everything for free.
Let's stick it to those pirates!
Don't be nervous!
Ye shall fear these pirates for I, Captain Blood meself, be in derect command!
Oh man, Grosso Polpo at a time like this?
Okay, I've had some time to think my thoughts...
I'm really bummed out. I know you're not from around here, but there's a guy from the Heaven Empire in town, and that's bad news. They like to think they're the rulers of Dawnveil.
I mean, the Empire's got lots of money and a huge army, but all the nations of Dawnveil rule themselves. In fact, they used to ignore us when we were just fishermen.
But they're paying attention now. We've got as much money as they do, and they're scared we're going to take their tile. Commerci's turning into a problem.
No? Why not?
My dad's been all stressed out about it for months now. He's been trying to open trade with Danbar, their capital, but they just won't say yes.
Now they're sending some high-ranking hot shot over to give us terms? It's bad, you know?
Okay, so let me start over again. I'm really bummed out...
My hunch was correct. I'm glad to see Leon so passionate about something other than looking handsome. He reconfirmed my own suspicions of their offer.
But Leon rejected them right off the bat. He was thinking of the people of Commerci first. He behaved like a true leader.
Pardon my fatherly pride. We have urgent matters to discuss, if you would.
If there is one family in Commerci as influential and clever as we Daniellas, it's the Tremier Merchant Union.
#bVaughn Tremier#k is a meticulous and cunning man. A man after my own heart, truth be told.
He and I have a bit of a... rivalry, but I believe we can bury the axe long enough to deal with this problem. Please take him this letter.
Was it the father stuff?
Vaughn Tremier will be nearby, just to the east.
Psh. Gilberto gets his stockings in a bunch when the Heaven Empire comes calling. I'm not the fool who put this whole nation on the line.
Tell that pompous fool he's talking nonsense. He made his mess. He can clean it up.
My union needs my attention, not some muddy deal with that backstabbing lout.
Didn't you say you were Gilberto's messenger?
Leave me alone, you little parasite.
I understand the circumstances Miss Tremier is in. Vaughn has his reasons as well, I'm sure. Either way, we're out of time.
This isn't a very safe spot to stop. San Commerci's a safe city, but there are packs of wild wolves out here in the outskirts.
Miss Tremier's safety is our primary concern. #h0#, maybe you'd be kind enough to stick around and deal with any wolves that show up?
All right, clear out the Grey Lupos on the #b#m865030100##k.
Why? Are you afraid of being alone?
There's trouble!! Go quickly, #h0#!!
Maybe... 100 of them?
Are you ready to go find Claire?
They were headed towards the #b#m865030200##k. Let's go!
Talk to me when you're ready.
There's some bad energy nearby... and look how those guys are dressed.
Whew, I think we did it.
Hurry, let's go inside.
Take out the rest of the guards.
Let's take care of these assassins and then get out of here!

string.name: msg
string.value: Hey, there's Leon! And... Claire? What are they up to?
Go to the harbor. Leon will meet you there.
We're all ready to set sail. Did you get everything?
All right, time to take off! Our destination: Maple World!
We've got a little time left. Make sure you're all set!
Be careful!
Forget about escaping.
There's no time to waste.

string.name: msg
string.value: You said you discovered a new barrier?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yes, sir!

string.name: msg
string.value: This barrier you found sounds intriguing, but we don't have enough people to deal with it. All of our forces are on guard duty.

string.name: msg
string.value: Since you're already helping me out, do you want to do me one more favor? Can you investigate the barrier?

Investigate the barrier!
Hunt any monsters you find and search for any clues! 50 of each kind should do.

I'll send Leon with you as backup.
I suggest you go with a party. It might be dangerous!
Talk to me when you want to help.

string.name: msg
string.value: Did you have a look at the monsters?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yeah! But something's off... There are too many Delfinos.

string.name: msg
string.value: I thought that was strange too...
The Delfino Hideout must be around here somewhere...
I should investigate further. Talk to me if you remember anything else!
Go to the canal. Leon will follow you.
Have you hunted each kind of monster inside the new barrier?

string.name: msg
string.value: Did you find anything new?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yeah. I'm pretty sure I'm going in circles...

string.name: msg
string.value: Same here! I had something strange happen too. Do you want to hear about it?
I checked the area as soon as I got here and followed this one Delfino into the canals. But it disappeared and I found myself at the entrance of the barrier!
Are you busy? Too bad...
I wanted to find a way in, but it's like a maze in there.
And I picked something up that the Delfino dropped... Where is it... Give me just a sec.\n\nLet me look for it.
The canal is like a maze...

string.name: msg
string.value: Found it. Look!

string.name: msg
string.value: Show me! ...It's a nice drawing. Looks like part of a map.

string.name: msg
string.value: Right? I think that Delfino dropped it. Should we look for the rest of the map?
Okay, we can go look for other pieces of the map and meet back here.\r\nI would say we need 10 more pieces to complete it.
I should go find the piece of the map.\nTalk to me when you want to go!
Did you find all the pieces? Already? Awesome! Let's put them together.
(You put the pieces together carefully...)
Finally, it's done! Look! This must be where we are right now! This map will lead us to the Delfino HIdeout!
What about those map pieces? We need at least 10.
We should be able to get pretty far with this map, but I want to look around inside the barrier a little more. There's a lot of new plants and ores to find, untouched by people.
Speaking of which, I have a favor to ask you. I'll investigate around here, so can you go to the deep parts of the canal and eliminate any monsters on your way?
The Delfino Hideout might be really close, so keep your eye out! Hunt any monsters you see and come back safely!
Did something come up? That's too bad... Talk to me when you want to investigate the deep parts of the canal.

string.name: msg
string.value: What did you see in there? Did you see the Delfino Hideout?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yup, it was there. And Riverson!

string.name: msg
string.value: Riverson was there? Did you get him too?

string.name: msg
string.value: Oh yeah, it was a tough battle.

string.name: msg
string.value: Great work! I guess the investigation ends here, then?
Let's go report all this to my father. I'll be putting all the information together. Talk to me when you're ready!
Eliminate any monsters you see in the deep ends of the canal!
Okay, the information on the deep ends of the canal is all ready.\r\nShall we head to see my father?
Let's go back to my father!
Do you need time to get your information together? Talk to me when you're ready!

string.name: msg
string.value: Did you finish your investigation?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yes, Prime Minister! There were a lot of novel plants and ores inside of the barrier. They will surely be quite useful to us and the townspeople.

string.name: msg
string.value: Good work. What about you?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yes, sir! I found the Delfino Hideout in the deep end of the barrier. And Riverson was there as well.
You found the Delfino Hideout, and Riverson to boot... Your hard work is most appreciated! Thank you very much!
Let's go report to my dad!

string.name: msg
string.value: I have a question. You said you found a new barrier. What was it like?

string.name: msg
string.value: The new barrier was in the Sospetto Forest. It was dark and damp out there. I also felt a terrible, ominous energy.

string.name: msg
string.value: That sounds extremely dangerous. We'll have to follow up, just in case. Since you've already been out there, can you lead the investigation?
Leon will be of help. Talk to Leon!
I will look into that matter later.

string.name: msg
string.value: What's up?

string.name: msg
string.value: I'm heading over to Sospetto Forest. Would you like to come with me? The Prime Minister said you'd be able to help.

string.name: msg
string.value: Sospetto Forest? Where's that?

string.name: msg
string.value: I felt a terrible force out there. We'll have to investigate to find out more about it.

string.name: msg
string.value: Terrible force, huh? That sounds dangerous. All right, I'll come with you. I want to check out any potential hazards to the Merchant Union or Commerci Republic personally.
Dad said I'd be of help?\nSure, I'll go investigate with you!
Let's go to Sospetto Forest!
Leon will be of help. Talk to Leon!

string.name: msg
string.value: What? So many Assassins!

string.name: msg
string.value: Isn't this strange? Why are there so many Assassins gathered here? They must be plotting something!

string.name: msg
string.value: Yeah! We should get rid of the Assassins nearby first!
Sounds like a plan. Let's take out 100 Nightcutter Assassins, 100 Nightwhip Assassins, and 100 Nightpriest Assassins. Talk to me once you're done!
Are you chickening out?
Have you cleared them out?
I knew you could do it! You cleared them out so quickly!
But I saw one member of the Assassins escaping... We should follow him!
Let's meet again after you eliminate 100 Nightcutter Assassins, 100 Nightwhip Assassins, and 100 Nightpriest Assassins!

Wait! If there are so many of them around here, maybe they're all hiding out here somewhere. They might be hiding Il Capo even... Maybe we'll find out more about what the Heaven Empire is plotting... I'll look around here!\r\n\rCan you go further inside?
Take Il Capo down if you run into him and look for any clues to the Heaven Empire conspiracy! Talk to me when you find anything from taking out the boss.
Are you giving up? I think we're super close to uncovering the Heaven Empire's plot!

string.name: msg
string.value: Did you find Il Capo?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yeah, and I found this envelope!

string.name: msg
string.value: Really? I wonder what's inside.\r\nI'll check it out!
Oh no... It's empty.
Get rid of Il Capo when you find him, and look for any clues about the Heaven Empire's plot!
Get rid of Il Capo when you find him, and look for any clues about the Heaven Empire's plot!

string.name: msg
string.value: Wonder why he had an empty envelope with him...

string.name: msg
string.value: I think he opened it in a hurry. The Assassins looked pretty shady when we got here, like they were trying to hide something... Maybe he still has whatever was in the envelope...

string.name: msg
string.value: You must be right! We should look for the document after hunting down the Guild Assassins.
Let's each look for it! Talk to me when you find the document!
We have to look for whatever was in the envelope...
Did you find the document?
I knew it! One of the Guild Assassins had it. Let's take a look.
I'll read this document, give me a minute.\nTalk to me in a little bit, I have to take my time to read this.
Did you get the document that was inside the envelope?

string.name: msg
string.value: The document is in some kind of secret code. I can't make it out.

string.name: msg
string.value: I'll take a look too!

string.name: msg
string.value: You're right, this is in a code...

string.name: msg
string.value: Let's bring this to my dad! What do you think?
You should hold onto the document yourself. Let's head back!
Are you busy?

string.name: msg
string.value: We're back.

string.name: msg
string.value: Good work. Did you finish your investigation?

string.name: msg
string.value: Yes. Guild Assassins were in Sospetto Forest. And we got this from Il Capo. Do you want to take a look?

string.name: msg
string.value: Of course!
It's in code... Unfortunately I can't make it out either. We have to get someone else to decode it. I'll hold onto this document!
Good work. This is very helpful.
Let's head back to show my father the envelope and report what happened today!
Did you finish your investigation? Anything you'd like to show me? Like...a document?
Hi, #b#h0##k! Happy New Year! I prepared a small event to celebrate this special occasion. Want to learn more about it?
Let me know if you change your mind.
You'll find a list of fun New Year's activities in the #bachievement notifier to your left#k.
Click the #bgift box icon next to the achievement name#k when you're done to get your rewards.\n\nI hope you have as much fun completing the list as I had making it!
I'll see you when you're claiming your rewards!

Hey there! Cassandra has prepared 30 questions for the Daily Event that has the odds of you winning at 100%! #bFrom December 4th through January 31st#k, this daily event is a guaranteed win for everyone who participates!
In order to receive a prize, you have to pass the test. Your last test is to correctly respond to the question I give you.
Are you going let the oppportunity of a lifetime pass you by?
I'll give you a rundown on Merchant Union Trade Voyages. Listen to me carefully.
There are three possible routes you'll end up on. The Goldway is rich with Denaros, the Huntersway is rife with monsters to earn EXP, and the Silkway is an item trader's dream.
Please keep in mind that we can't give you or your party any reward if you don't survive the voyage. It's simple economics, you understand.
Your job will be to protect the items we've brought along for trade before any ne'er-do-well's have a chance to steal them.
Your final pay will be based on how many of those items you manage to protect.
And, just for a bit of sport, whoever eliminates the most monsters will get an extra bonus...
That's it! Talk to me when you want to sign up.
Hello there, #h0#. If you're here about the Merchant Union Trade Voyages, you've come to the right place. We need hired muscle to help us make our way through dangerous waters.
I know you'd be a great helper on our vessels, #h0#, but we do have some rules and regulations. If you want to hit the water, you'll need a Trade License from Herb Town.

Our Merchant Union Trade Voyages are a great opportunity to get EXP and items even when your ship is out of energy. You can go out up to 3 times per day, and you might even get a #t4310100:#, depending on your route.
What do you think? Do you want to put your name up on the mercenary list?
So the rumors about the bravery of you Maple Islanders is true. Talk to me again.
Satisfied with the regular voyages? I suppose you don't have the heart for a grand adventure...

string.name: msg
string.value: I think it's #b#m865030300##k. We should start heading out there.
Hi, #b#h0#!#k\r\nThe winter's cold has reached its peak. It's time to draw a line in the snow! Are you ready to go on this last hunt of the winter with me?

Click on the #i3800423#Attendance Icon on the left of the screen to open the Attendance Log. Go through the Attendance Check quests, get stamps, and get some gifts!\r\r\n#e[RED Winter Attendance Event Season Four Schedule]\n#b> 1/27/2014 - 2/9/2014#k
Where are my 30 #b#e#i3994870# #t3994870# pieces? My fingers are going to freeze off if I don't get them! Remember only monsters near your level range carry them!

Bounties! That's what the Commerci Life is all about!\r\nWait... That's not right! I mean, there isn't really a #ediabolical madman#n or anything in Commerci, but there is this outlaw with a bounty on his head, the #b#e#o9390865##k#n. Go bring him in and I will give you a reward.
#e#b#o9390865##k#n is at the canals.\r\n#fMob/9390865.img/stand/0#
Think it over.
#e#b#o9390865##k#n is at the canals.
Still haven't left? Admit it, you're scared.
Hey, the view's kind of nice from here!
Wait, am I bleeding? I think I might be bleeding.
Maybe I should try to find a way out of this trap instead of daydreaming about pizza.
Maybe if I used the Ctrl key to attack the tree? Oh wait, I forgot! I'm all chained up, so I can't. Back to pizza, it is!
Bell, bell, come back to me! Ctrl to attack the tree, Z to pick up the bell!
Bell, bell, come back to me! Ctrl to attack the tree, Z to pick up the bell!
If you're not going to play with the wolves, can I play with them instead?
Press the S key to open the stat window. I have no idea how I know that!
Hey, you wanna join us? Great idea! So glad you mentioned it!
I'll meetcha in town! Bye!
Use the Change Mode skill and press the Right arrow key, boss! Shake it out!
Then press the Ctrl key to use the Snow Leopard Charge skill!
Drink that potion, boss! If you don't have any, forfeit your quest and talk to me again!
Use the Change Mode skill and press the Right arrow key, boss! Shake it out!
Then press the Ctrl key to use the Snow Leopard Charge skill!
Use my power to defeat those monsters!
It was so amazing how I defeated those monsters! Real hero-like! But then I guess I fell asleep for three days. Even the way I sleep is legendary!
As a member of the Critter Champs, I'm obligated to go on an adventure! I've always dreamed of this day... The day I set out to begin my hero's journey!
I'm totally ready. Maple World, here I come!
First, gotta say bye to Granny!
Maybe the timing isn't right...
Welcome to Stump Town, where even the stumps are beautiful. I'm Chief Woodrock.
I don't think we've met, but I get a really heroic vibe off of you...
To open the World Map, press the [W] key, then click on Stump Town. After that, press the Navigate button on the upper right!
All right! To Stump Town we go!
Follow the navigation arrows!
Maybe the timing isn't right...
Welcome to Stump Town, where even the stumps are beautiful. I'm Chief Woodrock.
I don't think we've met, but I get a really heroic vibe off of you...
Stump town takes your breath away with it's beauty and peacefulness, doesn't it?
But this one kid, Bluffing Tom... He's been spreading wild stories about kobolds invading. It's totally ruining the mood.
Can you tell Tom to stop spreading rumors?
Thanks, kind stranger.
Don't tell me you believe Tom. He's lied way too many times...
You beat all those kobolds? Hey, you're strong!

It's a bummer that the townspeople don't believe me. Their lives are in danger! Can you take the portal at the center of town to get to #b#m866000100##k and bring back 10 #b#t4034000##k items? That oughtta prove that I'm telling the truth!
I... I've got other stuff to take care of, that's why I can't do it myself. I ain't scared! Now get me those #t4034000# items!
Are you a scaredy-fox or something?
Hey! You made it back alive!
Hang on to them, because we'll need them later, okay? Next up is...
Hunt #o9390912# monsters to get 10 #b#t4034000##k items!
What? Old man Woodrock still doesn't believe me?
Okay, to convince him, we need to show him 15 #b#t4034001##k items. Trust me. I'm a pro at this bluffing stuff.
One small hunt for you is one giant step for Stump Town! I made that saying up myself.
Tick, tock! Time is a wastin'!
Do you have the #b#t4034001##k items?
Okay, now remember, don't lose those or you'll have to get new ones! Now, give me a second...
Hunt #o9390913# monsters and get 15 #b#t4034001##k items!
You got 'em all?

string.name: msg
string.value: Great! These'll really the feng shui in my bedroom!

string.name: msg
string.value: Actually, you're looking at a bunch of #b#t4034001:##k items!

string.name: msg
string.value: You sure? These are #b#t4034001:##k items? I don't think so...

string.name: msg
string.value: You seem like a good person. Take my advice: stop hanging out with Bluffing Tom.
Are these for me? To decorate my home?
Are you kidding me!? He said they were bear claws?
That's it. I have no choice but to take matters into my own hands! Eliminate #b#o9390913##k monsters and protect the town!
I'd help, but I have really important stuff to do. So you go on ahead. I'll catch you later.
A TRUE hero would've accepted...
Oh, hey! You're back!
Nice job. Let's tell #p9390312# all about your heroic deeds!
I think you missed a couple of #o9390913# monsters. I still see some running around.
There you are! I need your help! Some townspeople ventured into the forest and didn't return, so I followed them...
And I saw a whole mess of kobolds!
Can you find Tom's grandma in the dark forest? I don't know if this'll help, but she's one hot mama...
Thank you! I should've listened to you earlier...
I guess I deserve that since I didn't believe you earlier, but this isn't about me!
Who're you?
I was just here, eating raspberries...
Did you find Tom's grandma? Where could she be?! I hope she's safe!
Oh, that's right... My son escorted me here, but I don't know where he went...
Can you keep an eye out? He's probably nearby. You'll recognize him because he's almost as good-looking as I am.
Bring him back safely.
Fine, leave him if you want. I'll just sit here and munch on fruit.
Thanks for finding me!
But I have a problem. Want to hear?
I wonder where he can be... Can you keep an eye out?
I can't find my son. He's a great kid, really bright, though sometimes he talks too much.
Can you find him for me? He's probably wandered into the deep parts of the forest. Haha, he always wants to be a hotshot, like his papa. That's me.
Thanks. Please find him.
Guess I'll have to look for him myself, unless you change your mind.
You missed it! I just defeated a gazillion kobolds with my bare fists! It was like, pow pow POP bam!
Let's head back to town and let everyone know what we did! I'll include you in my story. I'll say you wiped my brow and fed me sips of water while I fought! \r\n#b(You will be moved to town.)
Did you find him? It's getting kind of chilly...
Really? The kobold den is around here? We need to wipe 'em out so Stump Town'll be free of them once and for all!
Thank you.
You're not gonna tell Woodrock again, are you?
Hey, back already?
Hey... It's not here! Is that good? Is it bad?\r\nGive me a second to think...
Not good enough!
One of these monsters HAS to have what I'm looking for...
Tell you what. Go to #m866000140# and get 30 #t4034004# items!\r\n\r\n(You will be taken to the nearby map if you accept.)
I mean it this time! Just tell me when you've got all the items I asked for!
I thought we were friends...\r\nTalk to me when you're ready to be a TRUE friend.
Finally! Took you long enough!
There it is! My mom's handkerchief! \r\nTo tell you the truth, which I ALWAYS do, my mom's been missing for a while. I was out searching for her when I ran into kobolds.
But nobody believed me when I told them!
But now I know for sure. The kobolds kidnapped my mom!
I need more than that...
I really need your help!
My gut tells me they have my mom somewhere deep inside the #bKobold's Den#k! Will you please go save her?
Whew, I knew I could count on you.
But... But... It's my mom!
Please, go to the very end! That's where my mom'll be! You have to save her!
Huh, so there's a King Kobold?
We have to do something to keep Stump Town peaceful! Let me think...
How'd it go?
I see... Legends say that the kobolds are protected by some strange power. Tom's mother might know more...
Did you give King Kobold what for yet?
Did you meet #o9390915#?
(You explain about the seal near #o9390915#.)
Here's the deal. Kobolds get stronger when they smell humans! But I can fix that for you. Bring me a couple of items and I'll craft you some Kobold Perfume. Mmm, mm!
Well, you just let me know if you need that perfume.
Back already? You're almost as quick as my baby boy, Tom!
Just give me a second to whip it up...
That's not enough... Bring me more!
Peeeeeee-you! That stinks!
Go report your progress to Woodrock while I go over there and vomit.
If you want to proceed, you've got to smell like one of THEM.

string.name: msg
string.value: Holy stump! Something stinks! Wait... it's you! But you found a way to defeat King Kobold?

string.name: msg
string.value: Go get him!

string.name: msg
string.value: What're you waiting for?

string.name: msg
string.value: I don't think you're ready to talk to me yet...
You... defeated #o9390915#? For real?
Now Stump Town will remain forever peaceful! You're a real #bhero#k, you know that?
Aren't you forgetting something? Something important? Like destroying a royal kobold?!
Show Woodrock what you collected! You'll do it, right?
Talk to me after you show Woodrock, okay?
What's the problem? Just show him!
What have you got there?
This is supposed to be evidence that there are kobolds around?
Tsk, did Bluffing Tom put you up to this? You can get cooking knives like this anywhere!
You still haven't gone to Woodrock? But Stump Town is in danger!

string.name: msg
string.value: What, you still have business with me?
Show Woodrock what you collected! He'd better believe you this time...
Talk to me when you're done showing Woodrock! I'll be waiting!
What, why not?
Hm? You again?
Are these... what I think they are?!
Bear claws?! FOR ME?! Thanks! Hold on a second!
You still haven't talked to Woodrock? What are you waiting for? Hurry, go!
Hop on, kid. What're you waiting for?
We're waiting for you to leave! Hurry up!
If you think I look totally fab today, hop on board. If you think I look wretched, stay there forever.
All right. Let's get going.
You'll change your mind soon enough.
Hello. You're looking for Evan?
Bruce can probably help you out. Why don't you go talk to him?
I'll let Bruce know you're on the way. You can find him at the center of town.
Let me know if you want to talk to Bruce.
Just a second. I'm in the middle of something...
You didn't hunt enough Stone Golems yet.
Wow, back already?
Oh, let's see. Evan... has an older brother named Utah.
Oh, did you want to know more than that? Um, let me think...
The ground is still shaking! Take care of those Dark Stone Golems!
It's so nice that the earth's stopped shaking...
Oh, yeah, a #bpretty girl#k stopped by earlier with this letter...
She said it was for #bthe kid with the big ears#k. Guess that's you! Here, I'll read it!
You didn't get all the Mixed Golems yet! Come back when you're done.
I'm Utah. What do you want?
Why is everyone looking for Evan? You want my help? Great, then you're gonna help me with a few chores, first!
Wait right here.
What're you waiting for, squirt? Follow the red arrow!
I'm building a house. That's right, you heard me.
But I'm missing a few things. I need items off of Stone Golems so I can build great, big, grand columns!\r\n
Get me some #b#t4000671##k items!
Just so you know, Icy Mixed Golems live in Golem's Temple 2. Now get me 70 #b#t4000671##k items!
Evan's going to live in my new house with me. Does THAT change your mind?
Nice. I think I can build some nice columns with these.
I need my Icy Mixed Golem's Fragments.... Get me more!
Next, you're going to help me with the house's flooring.
I want a floor that heats up in the winter!
Good! You can get what I need from Flaming Mixed Golems, who live in Golem's Temple 3.
You can't have a house with JUST columns. Don't you know anything?
Sweeet! Now I'll have heated floors! Evan'll like that, too.
Next up...
You don't have the 70 Flaming Mixed Golem's Fragments that I asked for!
The roof! After this, my house'll be done!
Get me 50 Icy Mixed Golem's Fragments and 50 Flaming Mixed Golem's Fragments. Don't give me that look. This is for Evan, too!
I knew you were someone of substance! I'll introduce you to my little bro for SURE, after this. Heh, heh, heh!
What? You want me to get rained on? Meanie!
Evan's busy with all that Alliance nonsense. He hardly EVER comes home, but please do wait around. So you can help me.
Perfect! Now I have all the materials I need for my house.
I'm gonna go build now. I'll introduce you to Evan the next time he stops by, whenever that is. And I'll let you know if I think of more chores!
Hey! You made it! Well, this is Ereve. Nice, huh? I already told Cygnus that you should join the Alliance.
From here on, it's all up to you! Prove how good you are!
Let me know when you get to Ereve!
Bad golems! Bad golems! They make me so mad! Hey, who're you? Wait...
You haven't met Pia yet? Pia is on the left side of Henesys.
Hey #h0#! I had a feeling we were both fans of Blake! Nice to meet you. When did you join the fan club? Wait a second... your name's not on the list. Well, don't worry. We can fix that!
The autograph event is about to start. I wonder what Blake is like in person? I bet he's cool. So cool. I can't wait!
Hey, aren't you...
Waaaaiiit!! Don't attack us! I'm sorry about last time!
Now, now... Just calm down! We can wipe the slate clean, have a fresh start!
So, what are you doing here? Are you here for the audition, too?
Oh, you came to get the Spirit of Rock too?
Really? We have some business with him too. Why don't we make a deal? You scratch our back and we'll scratch yours.
We're here for the audition at Kerning Square.
Ugh, it's because of that Spirit of Rock or whatever its name is...
We lost our audition tickets.
The #rCherry Bubble Teas#k on the #r1st and 2nd Floor#k of this building should be carrying Audition Scratchcards.\nCan you hunt some #rCherry Bubble Teas#k and get #b40#k #rAudition Scratchcards#k?
Listen, kid: we need to stick together.
Did you get all of the Scratchcards?
Well... here goes. Hey, Victor, Vincent! Help me scratch these bad boys!
Not this one... Not this... No... Nope... Arrrrgh! All 40 of these were busts! Unbelievable!!
HOW IS THAT EVEN POSSIBLE??!!!
Hey, stop wasting time! Remember, you need to hunt #rCherry Bubble Teas#k to get #b40#k #bAudition Scratchcards#k.
We can't give up now. Help us some more and I know we'll get in!
I hear that people have had good luck with #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k. You can find them on Mango Bubble Teas.
#b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k from #rMango Bubble Teas#k should do it.\r\n
Great! I'm counting on you! Hunt some #rMango Bubble Teas#k and I'm sure you'll be able to snag #b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k.
Hey, kid. Help me out, will ya?
Did you get all of the Scratchcards?

string.name: msg
string.value: Well... here goes. Hey, Victor, Vincent! Help me scratch these bad boys!

string.name: msg
string.value: All busts?!

string.name: msg
string.value: Arrrrggghhh!! My dreams has been shattered!! All I want is to be a famous singer and swim in a pool of cash. Is that so much to ask?

string.name: msg
string.value: She fainted.
Hey, stop wasting time! Remember, the mission is to hunt #rMango Bubble Teas#k and collect #b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k.
Poor Vicky... I didn't realize she wanted to be a singer this bad... Well, maybe if I help her get that audition pass, she'll finally fall into my waiting arms! Hey, you. Can you help?
Get #b60#k #rVIP Audition Scratchcards#k from #rMelon Bubble Teas#k. That'll get us in for sure!
Great! You're the best, kid. I'll leave you to it. Remember, you need to hunt #rMelon Bubble Teas#k. I'll try to get Vicky awake by the time you finish.

Wow, that was fast.

string.value: EXCELLENT! Now let's scratch 'em!

string.name: msg
string.value: Hmm? You already got them?

string.name: msg
string.value: Um... Vicky?

string.name: msg
string.value: Gimme that.

string.value: (She silently scratches the tickets.)

string.name: msg
string.value: (She silently scratches another ticket.)

string.name: msg
string.value: (She silently scratches even more tickets.)

string.name: msg
string.value: Yes yes yes YESSSS!!! Finally! A winning ticket! I finally get to be in the audition! WOO-HOO!!

string.name: msg
string.value: OMG I'M SO HAPPY I'M GONNA 'SPLODE!!

Good. Get me #b55#k #bYeti Keychains#k. You can get them on the third and fourth floors of the Shopping Center.
C'mon, we're talking about the Spirit of Rock here!
Thanks to me, Vicky's definitely gonna win now. Oh man, she's gonna think I'm so cool. SO COOL. Blahhhh I'm so excited ahhhh!!

string.value: Um, Vincent... I don't think that's a compliment...

string.name: msg
string.value: Anyway, we're all good to go now!
We can't miss this opportunity! The opportunity for me to capture Vicky's heart... er... I mean... I mean for you to meet the Spirit of Rock! Yes... yes, that's what I meant...
Here, I wrapped up everything you brought. Give this to Vicky and tell her to pass it on to the judges when she auditions.

Wait, think about it: Spirit of Rock! THE Spirit of Rock!!

string.name: msg
string.value: Ah HA! So it WAS Vincent's idea, wasn't it? I knew it!! VINCENT!!!!

string.name: msg
string.value: AHHH!!! Y...yes, Vicky?

string.name: msg
