string.name: msg
string.value: W... what? I didn't say that...

string.name: msg
string.value: I, the beautiful and talented Vicky, will win solely with my voice!

string.name: msg
string.value: Whoa, really? No dirty tricks? That doesn't sound like you.

string.name: msg
string.value: What did you just say? (Scowl)
What? What is it?! I don't have all day!
Leave me alone, I'm busy practicing. If you don't have anything to say, then just continue being a loser with Vincent.
I don't have time for stupid bribes! I need to keep practicing or I won't win the audition!
Plus, I still haven't decided what I'm gonna wear... and my hair... and my perfume... How about you go tell Vincent to help me?
That's what I thought. You don't have a choice. You HAVE to help me.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
What's that? Vicky wants me to help with her audition preparations? Woo hoo! She finally noticed I exist!
Hooray! I get to be Vicky's stylist for the day!
Someday they'll make a movie about us. I can see it now: a sordid love affair between a singer and her handsome manager! It'll win an Oscar, I tell you!
Tell Vincent to get me ready for my auditions.
First up: a perfume to match Vicky's trendy style! You'll help me out again, right? Right?

I knew you'd come around! Alright, you need to go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square, get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume from the #bPerfume Shop#k and then give them to Vicky.
You might miss the Perfume Shop since it's pretty tiny. Take the portal on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k instead. It'll take you directly to the shop.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Did you get the perfumes?
Eww... Gross, what IS this? Nope,this one's disgusting too...Vincent's taste in perfume is just... AARRRGH!!
Wait a sec, this one isn't that bad. I'll use it. Tell Vincent to keep up the good work, I guess.
Go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square, get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume from the #bPerfume Shop#k and then bring them back to Vicky.
You might pass by the Perfume Shop since it's so small. Take the portal on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k to go to the shop.
Where are my perfumes? I'm growing impatient...
Really? Vicky liked it? SHE LIKED IT??!!
Yaaayyy!! Now onto the outfits! Help me again, pretty please?

Hunt some Kid Mannequins and collect #b50 Bunny Suits#k. She's gonna look drop dead GORGEOUS in one of those. You can find them on the #rfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square. Bring them to Vicky so she can try them on!
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
So it's the outfits now, huh?

string.name: msg
string.value: Barf, what is this? A Bunny Suit?! Is he serious??!! I just... My brain feels like it's gonna explode.

string.name: msg
string.value: On the other hand, these modern pop starlets sure do dress in some wacky things. I guess I should show that I can look good in any outfit.

string.name: msg
string.value: Is she trying to be optimistic or is she for real?
Vicky will look positively stunning in a Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. You can find them on the fifth and sixth floors of Kerning Square. Hurry back and bring them to Vicky!
Where is my outfit? I can't go on stage looking like this!!
Now for my favorite: hairstyling! Now's our chance to really bring out her beauty. She doesn't want to damage her real hair with any dyes, so let's go for a sassy wig!
Get me some blonde wigs from the Female Mannequins. You can usually find them on the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square.
Go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square and get me #b50#k #bWigs#k.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Did you get the wigs?
Now it's time to style this wig into something truly special. All my salon training has come down to this... THIS IS MY MOMENT!! Let's do this!
Go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square and get me #b50#k #bWigs#k.
Where are the wigs? Hurry up, time's a wastin'.
All ready! OMG it's so perfect it's going to blind my eyes! Bring this to Vicky!
Handle it with care when you hand it to Vicky. It's very delicate.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
A wig this time, huh? How original.
A blonde wig, huh? Well, I was hoping to keep my own violet hair color...
But whatevs. I know I can work it in any hair color. Awww yeaaahhh!
Hurry, bring the wig to Vicky.
Well, I do need a flashy hairstyle. I just hope Vincent did a good job.
Really? REALLY? Vicky liked it? She really liked it? Excellent, excellent this romance scenario is unfolding just as I planned... (He rubs his hands together maniacally)
Last, but not least: I need an item to really bring out Vicky's intellectual side. You're still gonna help me, right?
Bring Vicky #b70 Fedoras#k. You can find them on Male Mannequins, they like to wear them sometimes.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
You're still getting those Fedoras for me, right?

string.name: msg
string.value: So let me get this straight: I'm wearing a blonde wig and a fedora, in a freaking bunny suit?

string.name: msg
string.value: Whatevs, don't matter. My beauty will shine in any outfit!

string.name: msg
string.value: (Then why did she ask to be styled? Sigh.)
Bring Vicky #b70 Fedoras#k. You can find them on Male Mannequins, they like to wear them sometimes.
I think Vicky still needs some kind of accessory. Something that will really stand out.
Oh boy, oh boy, oh boy! Vicky liked it, didn't she?
Vicky's style is now complete. All that's left now is the actual singing. I have no idea what kind of song Vicky should sing. Can you help her choose a song for the audition?
Yay, you're the best! Talk to Vicky and see how you can help.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Still choosing a song for the audition?
Hmm, what song should I sing? Obviously I can perform any and all songs ever written with my perfectly beautiful voice.
Go help Vicky choose a song.
Hmm... Nope. Can't think of one. I guess I should listen to some music to get ideas. Why don't you help me find some CDs with good songs.
There is a Music Shop on the #bseventh and eighth floors of Kerning Square#k. Get me #r35#k #bLatest Hits Compilation#k from there.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Did you get the Latest Hits Compilation?
What's with all these modern pop songs? These girls all sing about nonsense and the beats are too fast for me... I can't sing these.
There is a Music Shop on the #bseventh and eighth floors of Kerning Square#k. Get me #r35#k #bLatest Hits Compilation#k from there.
You know, retro IS pretty trendy these days... I can definitely sing a golden oldie. My voice is better suited for that.
I need 55 Greatest Oldies CDs.
Retro is in! I need you to get me 55 Greatest Oldies CDs.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Did you get the Greatest Oldies CDs?
Aha, this is it! Such great songs! You can't beat the classics.
Retro is in! I need you to get me 55 Greatest Oldies CDs.
But I still don't know what song to pick.
Now that I think about it, Victor likes to listen to old school music. He must know a thing or two about which oldies songs are good. Ask him to pick a song for me.
I'm sure Victor won't mind. Go speak to him, he'll help you.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
You need help with choosing an Oldies song? I can help, that's all I listen to.
Here, let me have a listen.
I'm sure Victor won't mind. Go speak to him, he'll help you.
This one's pretty good. Tell Vicky I like track number 10.
Wait a minute, you know how Vicky can get. Tell her I like Track 5, then she'll definitely pick number 10.
Eh, doesn't matter to me.
Let me say this in a Vincent/Vicky voice: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh? Cough, cough, cough.
So? What song did Victor choose?

string.name: msg
string.value: Number 5? Really?

string.name: msg
string.value: I like number 10 WAAAYYY better than what Victor picked out.

string.name: msg
string.value: (Victor was right... She is kinda dumb.)

Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

Go tell Vicky. HURRY.
I guess I don't have a choice, do I? Alright, I'm going to go get ready.
Oh yeah, you said you're here to get the Spirit of Rock, right? Talk to Victor. He'll know.
I'd appreciate it if you'd eliminate the Spirit of Rock before I get back from the preliminaries.
I need utter silence! I must be zen and save my vocal energy for my audition!
Ask Victor about the Spirit of Rock and steal... I mean, uh, um, blargh!! Listen, just defeat it and then come see me!
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Are you here for the preliminaries?
NOOOOOOOO!!!!! I failed the preliminary round!
I can't believe I failed! Those judges were mean!
I didn't even get the legendary guitar. Ugh, this is the worst!
The auditions haven't even begun yet. Defeat the Spirit of Rock and then come back.
Well, at least I found out where the Spirit of Rock is. It's on the #7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k in Kerning Square. If you destroy it, it'll make me feel better.
Defeat #rSpirit of Rock and its underlings Cheap Amplifiers and Fancy Amplifiers#k. You'll find them on the #b7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k of Kerning Square.
Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?
Did you defeat the Spirit of Rock?
YOU DID IT! You defeated the Spirit of Rock!!
Vicky finished her preliminary round too, so ask her how it went. We haven't talked to her about it yet, but by the looks of it she didn't do too well...
Eliminate Spirit of Rock and its henchmen Cheap Amplifiers and Fancy Amplifiers. They'll be on the #b7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k of Kerning Square.
#bMihile#k told me that you did a great job. I'll give you #b#p1101002##k's second mission.\r\n
Your next stop is Sleepywood. People there are talking about #bTristan's Sword#k.
Go to Sleepywood and get #bTristan's Sword#k. Talk to the excavation leader, #b#p9390352##k. He knows what's going on around there.\r\n
Are you just gonna give up like that?
What, already?\r\n
You collected fifty of them already? Wow, you're way better at this than I thought you'd be!\r\n
I thought so. #bCopper Drakes#k are too tough for you!\r\n
Who are you? Ugh... I'm so exhausted.
Oh, the boss sent you, huh? Probably to help me? Well, I'm tired, exhausted, lonely, and doing everything myself...\n
You can find out more from #b#p9390353##k.\r\nHe should be at #b#m105020000##k...
#bTristan's Sword#k?
I'm guessing you heard about it from #b#p1101004##k. Look, I know you can hunt a Copper Drake or two and think you're hot stuff, but #bTristan's Sword#k isn't just any item.
Anyway, all I know about #bTristan's Sword#k ended at #b#m105020000##k. Hm, let's see...
Once you get the key, get it to #bMudry#k.
Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.
I didn't know you were so kind!
Hm? Already?
You already got sixty of them? Incredible! You helped me so much!
I thought so. #bDrakes#k are pretty scary monsters.
Oooh... You are a strange one. I must observe!
Hm? My conclusions about you are all wrong... Is my magnifying glass broken?

string.name: msg
string.value: Wow, you came back in a flash!\r\nBut let me take a look to see if they're all okay.

string.name: msg
string.value: (She's going to count all 70.)
...This is okay...
...This one... fascinating.
Are these welding burns?! Amazing...
AND done. I learned approximately 47 new facts while I was sifting through those tools.
Oh, you're here. Thank you for helping out my workers.\r\n
So, we meet again. Do you want to help us one more time?\r\n
Go to #bAnother Door#k.\r\n
This is the information #b#p9390354##k got. There are three places where the sword might be buried over by Another Door.
But, we don't know which one is the spot... And the monsters ate up the keys.
Let's start with the first location. Hunt #bWild Kargos#k near the #bTemple Entrance#k and you'll get #bTristan's First Key Fragments#k. Collect enough to piece the key together.

string.name: msg
string.value: Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.

string.name: msg
string.value: How do I use this?

string.name: msg
string.value: You seriously don't know how to use items at your level?! Fine, fine. The key fragments should be in the Use tab of your inventory. Double-click on them to use them. You should collect as many as you can for better shot at finishing the key.

string.name: msg
string.value: Head to the #bTemple Entrance#k when the key's finished, and talk to Canary.
Did you get the key?\r\n
You found the key. Give it to me! Let's try it here!\r\n
...Nope. Not working.\r\n
Oh well. All this baggage is wearing me out... When are we heading out for the next door?
Go talk to Canary.
Get more Key Fragments to piece together!
We need to find the second door.
I guess we should head to the second location. Hunt #bTauromacises#k near the #bCollapsed Temple#k and you can get #bTristan's Second Key Fragments#k. Collect some to piece them together.
Talk to #b#p9390354##k once you get the key.
Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.
Look, I said I'm tired from carrying all this stuff around. Are you going to make me repeat my instructions... AGAIN?
Hey, you. You look a little different than last time. Did you get the key?
You found the key. Give it to me! Let's try it!
Welp, this one's no good either!
Let's get the last door!
Go talk to Minah.
Hm, get more Key Fragments to piece together.
We should find the last door.
I guess we should head to the third location. Hunt #bTaurospears#k near the #bGloomy Temple#k and you can get #bTristan's Third Key Fragments#k. Collect some to piece them together.
#bMudry#k will be at the third location.
Once you get the key, get it to #bMudry#k.
Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.
I didn't know you were so kind!
Go talk to Mudry.
Hm, get more Key Fragments to piece together.
Hurry on in. I'm heading back to Sleepywood. It's too dark in these caves.
Come back to Sleepywood when you get #bTristan's Sword#k.
It's right in front of you...
Oooh! Is that Tristan's Sword?
Oh, good! You found the sword. Let me see...\r\nHUUURRRFFFF... T-this thing is really stuck in its scabbard! Maybe you could give it a try?
What, why would you come here, you were in the caves.\r\n
I'm just not strong enough... You can give it a try.\r\n
From my observations, you're keeping #bTristan's Sword#k in the same pocket you keep your other items.
Haha, a hint is a hint.
You're much younger than me! And youth means strength!\r\n
Have you drawn a sword before?\r\n
Oh, well that's too bad.
Oh, would you look at that? I guess the sword crumbled into rusty dust. That'll happen when you stick a metal thing in a cave for over a decade...
Good work, anyway. Tell #b#p1101004##k, would you?
You didn't get my hint? #bTristan's Sword#b is in your inventory!
I don't have time for blather, so make it short.\r\n
Talk to #bIrena#k. She'll give you your third mission.
Did you even need to talk to me?
#bMihile#k and #b#p1101004##k told me good things about you.
#b#p1101002##k wanted me to give you this mission.
Your next stop is #bEl Nath#k.
\r\n#b#p9390355##k is going around begging for money. There's something fishy about that guy. Talk to him, and find out what he's up to.
Go straight to #bEl Nath#k.
All right, then. That's too bad.
Did you get them?
Thanks, kid. I can make all kinds of stuff with this leather. Like gloves, or a new strap for my banjo... Just wish I had a way to get a fire going.
Hey, I told you I was hungry.\r\n
Hey, not bad, not bad.\r\n
I think I'll make myself a slick fringe vest with that leather... Just gotta get a some wood from the hill where the Pepes went missing...
Hey, I told you I was hungry.\r\n
Did you get it?
Righteous. Now if I can get myself a #b#t4034023##k to use as a tool... I'll be all set to make some...
#bSweet and Sour Yeti Leather Stew#k. You never smelled a stink so good, I'll tell ya.
Hey, I'm cold and hungry over here!
From my research, you appear to have something to tell me.
You look like you want something from me. What is it?
My magnifying glass?! T-this is my treasure! My preci-- wait, no, I have about a thousand of them. Sure, you can have it.
I can loan it to you whenever you want.
Surely you know somebody with a magnifying glass... There's nothin' wrong with begging.
I don't know what you're gonna use this for. But keep it clean, okay?
See you later!\r\n
You don't want it?\r\n
Did you get that magnifying glass?
This thing's an old model, but I guess I can work with it.
\r\nTalk to me when you're ready.
Give the magnifying glass to whoever needs it!
I thought you was gonna get me a magnifying glass. What am I gonna do, huh?
This thing's real old. It's only gonna work about once every two minutes. Use it somewhere in El Nath and it'll lead the way.
Go ahead. And remember, you can use it once every #b2 minutes#k.\r\n
You'd be better off trying.\r\n
I heard a lot about you from the Chief Knights.
Take a short break and come back to me.\r\n
Didn't you hear me? Eckhart!
Who are you? What are you doing here?\r\n
Oh, you must be here on behalf of #b#p1101006##k.\r\n
Speak to the #bfour Alphonse brothers#k in #bOrbis#k.
Go ahead, sit right there. No, no, no, wait! Those are my nice clouds, those are only for special occasions. Sit somewhere else.
If you're looking for information, you'll have to go somewhere else! Me and my brothers only know about rainbows and tickle fights! I bet old lady #b#p2032001##k could help you, though!
She lives in a maaagical little house in the #bCloud Park#k. I'm sure you'll get along great!
Whatchu gonna do?\r\n

string.name: msg
string.value: Who are you?

string.name: msg
string.value: I'm #h0#. Alfonse Green sent me over, and I just thought I'd barge right in.

string.name: msg
string.value: How rude! This is not a barge-friendly household!

string.name: msg
string.value: Are you #p2032001#, the future lady?

string.name: msg
string.value: Well, I don't like to boast, but yes... yes, I can see the future. In fact, I can tell that you still have questions to ask me!
What future secrets do you wish to uncover?
Whatcha doin? Aren't you gonna go to the #bCloud Park#k?
An ominous prophecy?

Ominous prophecy it is! Well this one's not TOO ominous. Just that #b#m200000000# is going to smash into the ground in a blaze of fire and destruction#k. Pretty soon, actually, unless my watch is slow.
Oh, you're the righteous explorer type, eh? Looking to save #m200000000#, huh?
Are you confident, or just a knucklehead? There's no way you can save #m200000000#. It's hopeless.\r\n
How can you even call yourself an adventurer when all you care about is yourself? \r\n
Hiya. I listened to your conversation with #p2032001#. I don't think you should bother her right now. She's meditating to find a way to save Orbis.

#p2032001# saw this in the future a long time ago, and she's been trying to stop it ever since. So far, she's stumped, but I think all that excess weight Orbis is carrying is part of the problem. Maybe you could help me with this?
There are too many monsters swarming around Orbis! They're too heavy, they're gonna make it fall right out of the sky unless someone does something!
Eliminate 50 monsters from the #o3230200# and #o4230106# populations to keep Orbis in the air.
Look, I'm just asking for your help to stop Orbis from falling down. Jeez, helpful much?\r\n
Man, are you actually rooting for Orbis to fall down??!!\r\n
Oh, well then, I can answer it.
There are a lot of different kinds of Cloud Pieces. Each Pixie has their own, but I only know about #b#t4034007##k's Cloud Pieces.
Hmm, maybe 150 of them?
No, no, no!\r\n
Wow, you already got all of them?\r\n
Good work! Now go talk to my other friends and help them out! #b#p2032001##k's just gonna love you!
Hurry! Go get 'em!\r\n
Oh, well then, I can help you.
There's soooo many different Cloud Pieces. I hear each Pixie has a unique kind, but I only know about #b#t4034008##k's Cloud Pieces.
I dunno, how does 150 sound?
So good!!
So bad!!
Did ya get all of 'em?
Sweet. Now you should go talk to all my other buddies. Help them like you helped me, then seek out #b#p2032001##k.
What are you waiting for? Go get them now!\r\n
Do you feel the clouds trembling? There's too many Pixies around here, they're too heavy!!
I need you to hunt 200 #b#o3230200##k, 200 #b#o5120000##k, and 200 #b#o4230106##k monsters.\r\n
Sounds great!\r\n
You're a meanie, you know that?\r\n
You got them all already? That was fast.\r\n
Nice! You'll need to speak with the rest of my friends now. Help them out, then talk to #b#p2032001##k.
It's monster huntin' time. Go get 'em!\r\n
I can help you out.
I've heard that there's a ton of different Cloud Piece types. That's what makes Pixies so unique. Unfortunately I can only help you with #b#t4034009##k's Cloud Pieces.
I think 150 sounds like a good, solid number to me.
Tee hee, I'm so giddy I could die!\r\n
Why not, you grinch?!

Oh, and before I forget; the Empress wanted you to have this.\r\nPlease use this in your mission to help others.
Not everyone can become a member of the Maple Alliance.
I see you're still taking good care of that #b#t1113093##k I gave you. That makes sense, it's sentimental, I get it. But what if I told you I had something else?

IF, and only if, you reach level 130, I will take that old crummy crumb-bum ring off of you, and give you this new, and much fancier #ering#n in its place. Pretty neato, yesss?\n#i1113094:# #t1113094:#

I'm not going to watch you this time. I saw that weird conversation you had with the frozen yogurt guy, and it sort of spoiled my enjoyment of watching other peoples' lives. But come back when you hit #e#r130#k#n!
Are you kidding? Think of your fingers!

Oh, no... NO. Did you seriously lose that #e#b#t1113093##k#n?! Oh my gosh, the shipping on those things alone takes like a month! Why are you here again? I hope you're not going to ask me for another ring...
Actually, NO. Here's my offer. You go through boot camp to apologize for disrespecting my perfect and amazing gift-giving skills, and you can have another one.
I worked hard to get that ring in the first place, so you're gonna have to work hard to get it back. Hunt #r#e999 monsters#k#n around your level, THEN you can have it.
No, way! Not for free!
Ugh, did you actually do it? I'm still super mad at you, but FINE. Here's your ring.
I still can't believe you could lose something so valuable!
I worked hard to get that ring in the first place, so you're gonna have to work hard to get it back. Hunt #r#e999 monsters#k#n around your level, THEN you can have it.
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Do you know about #bQuick Slots#k? They let you #bactivate skills and items with hotkeys#k!
It's even easier than walking on two legs! \r\nSimply #bdrag#k a skill or item to your Quick Slots!\r\n#i3800631#
Quick Slots let you #bdirectly use#k skills and items just by pressing the #bhotkey that matches the Quick Slot#k! Make sense?
Try it right now! Go, go, yay!
Place any skill or consumable item into a #bQuick Slot#k!
True heroes use Quick Slots! Talk to me again when you find the hero in your heart.
Did you try your Quick Slots yet?
Hey, hey, you did it!
Remember, there are separate Quick Slots for #beach of your 4 modes#k!
Just click drag a skill or consumable item to a #bQuick Slot#k!
Do you know about the #bCash Shop#k? You can buy all sorts of super shiny things there!
You can use #bNX#k or #bMaple Points#k in the #bCash Shop#k... Sorry, kitten kisses aren't accepted.
Click the #bCash Shop button#k at the bottom of your screen to check it out!\r\nJust window shop a bit. I'll have a #bgift#k for you when you get back.
Go on! I'll be waiting for you with your #bgift#k when you return!
Don't be afraid of the #bCash Shop#k! It's full of pretty things!
This #bgift#k is for you! I hope you like it.
Seeya later, fox-agator!
You didn't go yet? Click the #bCash Shop button#k at the bottom to enter!
I know you want to be strong, like a real champ, right?
One way to do that is to collect and use all sorts of #bequipment scrolls#k. These'll let you enhance your gear.
To make it work, you need both a #bscroll#k and a piece of #bequipment#k to use it on.\r\n#i2046093# + #i1252000#
Make sure that the #bscroll can be used#k on that particular piece of equipment.\r\nOtherwise, it just won't work!

Then, just #bdrag the scroll onto the equipment#k!\r\nIf you have too many scrolls to keep track of, you can also click the #bhammer icon#k at the bottom of your Inventory. This shows your scrolls in a more organized layout.
Take this #b#t2046093;##k and use it to enhance your gear and grow strong!
Have you been to the #bFree Market#k yet?
In the #bFree Market#k, players can create shops to #bbuy and sell items#k.
Go to the #bFree Market#k and find yourself some good deals!\r\n#i3800630#
Take this #b#t2310000;##k! You can only use it once and it expires in a week, anyway.\rAn #b#t2310000;##k helps you search for items. Trust me, I'm a pro shopper!

string.name: msg
string.value: #b#h0##k, have you ever heard of #bPantheon#k?

string.name: msg
string.value: The Nova of Pantheon are embroiled in a bitter war. They're also members of the Alliance. Perhaps you could keep on eye on their situation on my behalf.

string.name: msg
string.value: I'm trusting you, #b#h0##k, at least enough to take on this very important mission. \r\n( To start, Accept the #bTo Pantheon#k quest using the quest light bulb above your head.)

string.name: msg
string.value: You can get to Pantheon by taking the #bInterdimensional Portal#k in the #bSix Path Crossway#k. Why don't you talk to #bBeldar#k?\r\nGood luck.

string.name: msg
string.value: Perhaps that trust was misplaced? Return to me if you have a change of heart.
#b#h0##k!\r\nHow is Pantheon?

string.name: msg
string.value: Hey, Neinheart!\r\nWe've made it to the center of Heliseum.

string.name: msg
string.value: I see. The Maple Alliance would be in your debt if you could help Pantheon reclaim #bHelisium#k.

string.name: msg
string.value: Keep up the good work.
You still haven't completed my mission. Are you serious about joining the Maple Alliance?

string.name: msg
string.value: It's likely that #bEdea#k will contact you shortly.\r\n

string.name: msg
string.value: The Novas are preparing to retake #bHeliseum#k, but we need you to drive #rMagnus#k away. \r\n(To start, Reach Lv. 102 and accept the #bNova Troubles#k quest using the quest light bulb above your head.)

string.name: msg
string.value: Leave it to me! \r\nI'll go straight to Heliseum as soon as #bEdea#k contacts me.

string.name: msg
string.value: Thank you.\r\nAnd good luck.

string.name: msg
string.value: Are you afraid of #rMagnus#k? I'd hoped I could count on you...
How did things go in #bHeliseum#k?

string.name: msg
string.value: We kicked #rMagnus#k booty all the way out of #bHeliseum#k!\r\nThe dang jerk got away, though...

string.name: msg
string.value: I see...\r\nI suppose I have to congratulate you on a job well done.

string.name: msg
string.value: You did well for yourself.\r\nSpeaking of which...

string.name: msg
string.value: We are taking steps to officially accept you as a member of the Maple Alliance.

string.name: msg
string.value: Wow! Really?

string.name: msg
string.value: Have I lied to you yet?\r\nReturn to #bEreve#k when you are ready.\r\nI'll be waiting for you.
What became of reclaiming #bHeliseum#k?
